store_data.about_the_game:
A Note from the Developer

Hello and welcome to the Rushline store page!

I am developing Rushline because I love the thrill of games like Blur and want to bring that specific "combat racing" feeling back to life with a fresh, stylized look.

The game is currently in early development. By wishlisting the game and following along, you aren't just waiting for a release, you are supporting the creation process. My goal is simple, I want to create a fun, tight multiplayer racing game where the driving feels just as good as the shooting.

I am very open to feedback and ideas. If you have suggestions on handling, power-ups, or tracks, please post in the Community Hub. Let's build this together!

Rushline

Speed is Only Half the Battle! Crossing the finish line first takes more than just a heavy foot. In this third person combat racer, strategy is just as important as speed. Navigate vibrant, stylized landscapes while managing a lethal arsenal of power-ups to protect your lead or hunt down the frontrunners.

Master the power-ups, the tactical depth lies in your loadout. Every pickup is a chance to change the race:

  • Offensive Tools: Launch targeted strikes to stall rivals or drop hazards to protect your rear.

  • Tactical Defense: Time your shields to absorb incoming fire just before impact.

  • Nitro Bursts: Save your boosts for the perfect straightaway or to recover instantly after a hit.

Experience tight, arcade style handling designed for high speed flow. Master the drift mechanics to carry momentum through winding forest paths and meadows. The serene environment is the perfect backdrop for the chaos on the asphalt.

Compete with the world! Battle friends and strangers in fast paced multiplayer lobbies. With a focus on fair competition and skill based power-up usage, no two races are ever the same.

Game Features:

Global Multiplayer: Join online rooms and test your talents against players worldwide.

Tactical Combat: A balanced item system where every attack has a counter.

Stylized Visuals: Race through high contrast, beautiful nature themed environments.

Arcade Physics: Easy to pick up controls with a high skill ceiling for drifting and combat timing.

Please add Rushline to your Wishlist to get notified of updates and playtests!

store_data.about_the_game:
Asteroids are worth trillions. They're also spinning at 200 meters per second and hurtling through the void. Nobody talks about that part.

You're a Wrangler — one of the few people crazy enough to fly out into deep space, harpoon a tumbling rock, and wrestle it to a dead stop with nothing but thrust, cable, and stubbornness.

The Wrangler's Loop

  • Scan — Find the rocks with the most precious metals.
  • Despin — Harpoon it, deploy sticky thrusters, and tame the spin.
  • Mine — Laser out the voxels once the asteroid is stabilized.
  • Sell & Upgrade — Haul the payload back to the station, get paid, and build a bigger ship.

Harpoon. Tether. Survive.

Every asteroid is a physics problem trying to kill you. They tumble on multiple axes and don't care about your schedule. Latch on, fire your thrusters against the spin, and try not to get wrapped around a million-ton rock in the process. Start small with slow-spinning boulders, and work your way up to monsters that will fling your ship like a ragdoll.

Build Your Ship. Fly Your Ship.

Full voxel ship builder. Cubes, wedges, cylinders — block by block, thruster by thruster. Build something efficient, or build a flying dumpster with seventeen engines strapped to it. We're not here to judge. Whatever you build, you fly. Your ship's mass, thrust, and shape matter when your life depends on the engineering choices you made twenty minutes ago.

Missions in the Deep

The frontier doesn't hand you a career path. It hands you a list of jobs and a fuel tank. Out in the belt, your radio will crackle to life:
  • Rescue Operations — Stranded ships, dead engines, bad orbits. Harpoon them and tow them to a station before their air runs out.
  • Armageddon Runs — An asteroid is on a collision course with a station. Deflect it. Blow it apart. Whatever it takes.

If you enjoy...

The physics-first workplace danger of Hardspace: Shipbreaker, the satisfying mining loops of Deep Rock Galactic, and the ship-building progression of Avorion... you'll feel right at home in the belt.

Features

  • Physics-driven asteroid wrangling — Harpoon, tether, and counter-thrust against procedural asteroids with real spin, mass, and momentum.
  • Full voxel ship builder — Design your ship block by block and fly it in 6DOF (First/Third person).
  • Deep Upgrade Trees — 7 upgrade paths. Improve your mining lasers, cargo hold, hull, and thrusters.
  • Toolbox of destruction — Tethers, sticky thrusters, explosives, and more.
  • Dynamic Frontier — Respond to random radio encounters, rescue missions, and station defense contracts.
  • Controller Support

STORY

There was once a boy grew up in the shadows of an orphanage, burdened by nightmares he could never escape.
Years later, he returns to confront the darkness that has haunted him since childhood.
There, he uncovers horrific truths long buried in silence.
Every choice he makes may lead him closer to the truth… or drag him into a dreadful end.
And in the end, this cursed place will reveal the price that truth demands.

CINEMATIC SEQUENCES 

Experience the story like a movie, with fixed-camera angles and immersive, atmospheric direction.



 

QUICK TIME EVENTS
 

Stay alert in tense moments—one slip could decide life or death.

SELECT YOUR BEHAVIOR

Your decisions and behaviors will shape multiple Deaths... or leading to truth

  • Psychological Mystery

  • Quick Time Events

  • Interactive choices

store_data.about_the_game:
【What Kind of Game Is This】

《MY SLIEM gets stronger after it dies》 is a role-playing game set in an isekai (another world) rebirth theme. You play as a seemingly weak slime thrust into a fantasy world full of unknowns and dangers.

【Game Mechanics】

The core of the game lies in its unique "Death Growth" mechanic: each failure is not an end, but a step towards greater strength. Through constant battle, rebirth, and accumulation, the slime will become increasingly powerful, ultimately uncovering a massive conspiracy.

Permanent talents can be selected after death.

【Gameplay】

The game uses intuitive top-down perspective controls combined with a pixel art style, creating a visual experience that is both retro and trendy. Players need to click, move, dodge, and cast various spells to contend with diverse enemies on dynamic battlefields.

Challenge Storyline Enemies

【Inventory System】

For a better player experience, players can gather items in the world and synthesize items to gain an advantage in battle!

Gather

Synthesize Items

Items can be placed in the quick-access bar below for easy use during combat.

Drag items out to use them.

【Content You Can Experience in the Game】

The game features 5 types of magic, with nearly 70 spells to cast. There are enemies from 5 different species, totaling over 50 unique enemies to hinder your progress. The game length is about 5 hours (if all goes well). Welcome to an otherworldly adventure!

The encyclopedia can be used to equip magic.

Accumulate magic direction by dashing.

SteelBlade Shop Simulator is a game that combines shop management and arena combat, set in the vibrant and colorful streets of Japan.

Build your own SteelBlade shop, open SteelBlade boxes, manually combine parts to create powerful SteelBlades, and choose your own path: sell your SteelBlades to customers for profit or take them into the arena and fight.

Manage Your Own SteelBlade Shop

Purchase shelves, expand your shop, and increase your shop level.
Stock your store based on customer demand and use your earnings to unlock new equipment, upgrades, and areas.

Open SteelBlade Boxes

SteelBlades are made up of three main parts:

  • Top, Middle, and Bottom components

  • Tier 1 to Tier 4 rarity levels

When you open boxes:

  • You obtain individual parts

  • You manually combine these parts based on your own choices

  • The SteelBlade you create can be sold or used in arena battles

Every SteelBlade is the result of the player’s decisions.

Enter the Arena

SteelBlade Shop Simulator is more than just a shop management game.

Take your custom-built SteelBlades into the arena:

  • Battle against different opponents

  • Test the performance of your part combinations

  • Win matches, earn rewards, and create even stronger SteelBlades

A Japanese Street Experience

  • Environments inspired by Japanese urban architecture

  • Neon signs, narrow streets, and anime-inspired visuals

  • A living city with a day and night cycle

SteelBlade Shop Simulator brings management, strategy, and action together in a single experience.

Build your shop.
Create your SteelBlades.
Dominate the arena.

store_data.about_the_game:
With limited colors, paint a story of infinite tenderness. Every fill brings you closer to the truth of their disappearance.

Brush the Starfall is a unique game that masterfully blends strategic color filling with fragmented storytelling. You must paint the board into specified colors within a limited number of moves, solving elegant logic puzzles. Through journal entries, experience a poignant story about warmth, companionship, and a final farewell.

🎨 Strategic Color Fill – Within a limited move count, paint the board to the target color.

📖 Diary as Narrative Core – Random diary fragments unlock upon clearing levels, piecing together that warm past like a puzzle.

🌌 Gameplay as Metaphor – Each spread of color is a quiet interpretation of "how light propagates."

🕯️ Dual-Paced Experience – Quick, accessible intellectual challenges + deep, lingering emotional reading, perfectly suited for both fragmented and immersive time.

【Gameplay: Heal the World with Color】

Your task is intuitive: each level is an elegant, clean board of colored tiles. Within a limited number of moves, you must choose colors to "dye" the entire board into the specified target color. It's not just a reaction game, but a micro-strategic planning exercise. You'll calculate color connectivity, anticipate the board state several moves ahead, and achieve the goal with the most economical moves. As you progress, the board shapes and color combinations become more intricate, as if you're restoring the vibrant life to forests, flower fields, and streams. With logic and color, you are repairing this silent world.

【Narrative: Read the Truth Beyond Color】

Each time you fill an area with a warm color, you "repair" the vessel of that memory and gain a chance to unlock a journal page. The journal is the truth. Written in the first person, it gently recounts the story of the "Color Team" – Clover the guardian representing emerald green, the warm orange Aju, the snowy white Cloud, the crystalline blue Fengya… How they met, how they made each other's worlds come alive, and why they eventually faded and disappeared together.

🎨 Strategic Color Fill – Within a limited move count, paint the board to the target color.

📖 Diary as Narrative Core – Random diary fragments unlock upon clearing levels, piecing together that warm past like a puzzle.

🌌 Gameplay as Metaphor – Each spread of color is a quiet interpretation of "how light propagates."

🕯️ Dual-Paced Experience – Quick, accessible intellectual challenges + deep, lingering emotional reading, perfectly suited for both fragmented and immersive time.

【Gameplay: Heal the World with Color】

Your task is intuitive: each level is an elegant, clean board of colored tiles. Within a limited number of moves, you must choose colors to "dye" the entire board into the specified target color. It's not just a reaction game, but a micro-strategic planning exercise. You'll calculate color connectivity, anticipate the board state several moves ahead, and achieve the goal with the most economical moves. As you progress, the board shapes and color combinations become more intricate, as if you're restoring the vibrant life to forests, flower fields, and streams. With logic and color, you are repairing this silent world.

【Narrative: Read the Truth Beyond Color】

Each time you fill an area with a warm color, you "repair" the vessel of that memory and gain a chance to unlock a journal page. The journal is the truth. Written in the first person, it gently recounts the story of the "Color Team" – Clover the guardian representing emerald green, the warm orange Aju, the snowy white Cloud, the crystalline blue Fengya… How they met, how they made each other's worlds come alive, and why they eventually faded and disappeared together.

store_data.about_the_game:
What is it?

Do you like classic solitaire and the tarot’s occult aesthetic?

Star and Serpent Solitaire is a Klondike-style variant played with a 56-card tarot deck (with four extra Page cards) and 3-card deals, built for long-term play.

Unlimited Free Demo

Try the demo for as long as you like. Gameplay and content are the same as the full version; the demo adds a brief reminder message on launch and does not include Steam achievements. Wishlist to get launch notifications and updates.

Key Features

  • Unlock the 22 Major Arcana that appear during play; win to unlock the card.

  • Get your fortune told on wins: a playful tarot-style reading tied to the featured Major Arcana card.

  • Earn gold and unlock content that carries over between games.

  • Collect treasures that build up in your Treasure Chamber over time.

  • Unlock a shop for upgrades and collectibles through progression.

  • Unlock a slot machine for “try your luck” rewards (gold and rare treasures) through progression.

  • Make it yours: change backgrounds and card backs (including your own image), and toggle visual extras on/off.

  • Optional Zen mode: distraction free experience with all markings disabled.

  • Separate profiles, achievements, and statistics.

Warnings, Before You Buy

  • This is a difficult variant of Klondike solitaire.

  • Try the free unlimited demo before you buy and see if the game suits you.

  • All games cannot be won. This game uses full randomness and resembles playing solitaire with physical cards. This is a risky design decision I took early on. Some computer solitaire players will not enjoy this.

  • 56 card deck winnability is approximately 6-10% lower than in regular 52 card Klondike solitaire.

  • In long term you can expect to win perhaps 10-20% of the games, depending on skill and luck.

  • There is no easy mode.

Developer

Star and Serpent game studio is an independent developer from the backwoods of Finland.

Press

Press kit and inquiries: please use the ‘Visit the website’ link on this page.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aim your shot and launch your ball into waves of enemies in Rogue Ricochet. Every weapon you mount changes the physics, effects, and damage of the ball. Keep it in play for as long as you can to collect XP, Gold, and deal as much damage as possible. It's inevitable however that you'll become overrun or miss the ball, and this is where Rogue Ricochet lets you between volleys, plan the next attack and gain the upper hand once again in the deckbuilder.

Between volleys you spend your resources to draw cards and sequence them perfectly to better suit the enemies you face on the changing battlefield. Every bounce counts as you clear dungeons, collect gold, and explore locations in search of the greatest high-scoring build.

Between encounters, explore a procedurally generated world full of kingdoms, dungeons, settlements, and the unknown. Collect quests and upgrade your Ball Loadout and your Deck to face more enemies and larger foes.

Key Features

  • Weapons on the Ball: Physically mount weapons that change your trajectory, damage, and status effects with every bounce.

  • Multi-Ball Loadouts: Build and rotate between independently equipped balls, each with its own weapon configuration and cooldown.

  • Tactical Card Phase: Time freezes. The camera pulls back. Queue spells, manage your hand, and plan your next devastating move.

  • Bullet Time Combat: The world slows when the ball approaches. Jolt it back, melee nearby enemies, and aim with precision.

  • Procedural World: Explore an ever-growing map of kingdoms, biomes, and uncharted territory. No two journeys are the same.

  • Intelligent Enemies: Creatures that dodge, charge, cast, and adapt. Elite modifiers, phase-based bosses, and more.

  • Strategic Deckbuilding: Every draw, burn, and play is permanent. Manage your hand wisely or pay the price.

EQUIP YOUR BALL

Forget simple stat buffs. In Rogue Ricochet, you physically attach weapons to your ball!

Mount swords, spears, magic staffs, buzzsaws and more at precise angles onto your ball. Every weapon changes the physics. Heavy weapons pull your trajectory wide. Light weapons keep you nimble. Each brings its own damage types, weight profile, status effects, crit chances. That's not all though, unique weapons also add unique cards to your deck that to synergise with the action on the battlefield. The endless combinations of broken builds are yours to discover.

Build and rotate between multiple ball loadouts, each with its own weapon configuration and cooldown. Craft a devastating heavy-hitter, a status-spreading menace, a precision assassin, or something entirely your own.

Weapons, Armour and your deck degrade with use along your adventures. Rest at settlements to repair, replace, and rethink your approach.

Fight Smart, Hit Hard

Combat rewards precision, timing, and split-second decisions.

  • Bullet Time kicks in when the ball approaches. The world slows to a crawl, giving you a heartbeat to position, aim, and strike.

  • Jolt your ball with a perfectly-timed paddle lunge. Nail the timing and send it screaming back into the horde.

  • Melee Attack enemies that get too close. Your paddle is a weapon too.

  • Aim with intention. Angle your paddle toward your cursor and turn every bounce into a calculated strike.

Clear encounters fast to earn higher ranks and bigger rewards. Every second counts.

EXPLORE A LIVING MAP

The worlds in Rogue Ricochet are not on a fixed map. It grows as your character grows.

Each region you visit belongs to kingdoms that range from ungoverned wilds to vast empires. You never know what lies beyond the next border.

Navigate the map and plan routes through battlefields and rest stops, or just wander into the unknown and see what you find. The terrain and biomes shape the world and encounters, with its own enemies, bosses, challenges and dangers.

More biomes and types of regions are planned to be added before release, including the regions to dynamically interact with each other depending on their type and what situation you as a player have left them in as you ricochet between them.

Play Your Cards Right

When your ball hits the back wall, time freezes it's to plan your next cause of action.

Welcome to the Card Phase. Survey the chaos, study your hand, and set up your next play. Queue spells, buffs, strikes, and more. Then launch your ball and watch them fire off in sequence as it tears through the enemy ranks.

In Rogue Ricochet you spend your levels to draw cards from you deck, the higher the level you spend to draw the better buffed the card. However once used your cards are spent for that journey. So choose wisely as you will need to find ways to keep your deck synergising from one encounter to another lest you're overrun. Rest at Inns or do side quests on your journey to ensure you don't end up running out of cards, balls and options.

The card pool will grow significantly throughout Early Access, with new spell types, deeper synergies, rare discoveries, and much more.

On the Roadmap

Rogue Ricochet is in active development.

  • A Growing Arsenal: New weapon types, elemental infusions, legendary uniques, and more

  • An Expanding Deck: Deeper card pool with new spell types, powerful synergies, and rare finds

  • New Classes & Races: Fresh playstyles, starting builds, and abilities to master

  • New Biomes: Uncharted regions with unique enemies, hazards, and secrets to uncover

  • Meta-Progression: Permanent unlocks and rewards that carry across runs

  • Legacy System: Your fallen heroes leave their mark on future worlds

  • Endgame Bosses: Multi-phase encounters that test everything you've built

  • Save & Continue: Pick up your run wherever you left off

  • Mod Support: Create and share your own weapons, cards, enemies, and more

  • ...and much more, shaped by player feedback and community direction

store_data.about_the_game:
Hybrid Arcade / Simulation Train Gameplay

Take command of a 20-ton steam train and pilot it successfully to the goal in this new arcade / simulation hybrid game from ROBYSOFT! Inspired heavily by Japanese train simulators such as Densha de Go!, Steam & Glory takes the action out west. Not only must you arrive on time and stop on a dime at the station, but you'll have to race to evade bandits, dodge wagon crossings, pick up bonus gold and keep your rig from flying off the track or bursting into flames!

Control your Rig the Right Way

Unofficially compatible the ZUIKI Mascon train controller, you will feel the full-weight of your payload as you use the extra clicky and granular throttle and brake lever to fine tune your train's speed around twisty canyon turns, up challenging hill climbs, and across snowy plateaus to complete your mission on-time and intact. Steam & Glory is also playable with Xbox-style gamepads and keyboard. (Note: ZUIKI Mascon controller is the property of ZUIKI and no official endorsement or claims of compatibility from ZUIKI is implied.)

Soak in the Old West

Steam & Glory features a variety of missions across classic old west landscapes presented with a nostalgic PS1-era aesthetic, and a sweeping western soundtrack from D.D. Curry. Earn increasing ranks for the excellence of your performance. Can you best your rivals and achieve the rank of Top Steamer?

Not only must you arrive on time and stop on a dime at the station, but you'll have to race to evade bandits, dodge wagon crossings, pick up bonus gold and keep your rig from flying off the track or bursting into flames!

Control your Rig the Right Way

Unofficially compatible the ZUIKI Mascon train controller, you will feel the full-weight of your payload as you use the extra clicky and granular throttle and brake lever to fine tune your train's speed around twisty canyon turns, up challenging hill climbs, and across snowy plateaus to complete your mission on-time and intact. Steam & Glory is also playable with Xbox-style gamepads and keyboard. (Note: ZUIKI Mascon controller is the property of ZUIKI and no official endorsement or claims of compatibility from ZUIKI is implied.)

Soak in the Old West

Steam & Glory features a variety of missions across classic old west landscapes presented with a nostalgic PS1-era aesthetic, and a sweeping western soundtrack from D.D. Curry. Earn increasing ranks for the excellence of your performance. Can you best your rivals and achieve the rank of Top Steamer?
store_data.short_description: Steam & Glory is a hybrid arcade/simulation train game where you take control of a 20-ton steam train as you steam, brake, ring your bell and blow your whistle to power through to the goal! Take in the scenic old west views as you race to get to the station on time!

store_data.about_the_game:
nurny battles HD is a little indie PvP auto battler with pre-rendered 3d visuals and gimmicky characters that can be played ONLINE or locally. Every character is fully uniquely programmed so that they all function differently (not counting upgraded fusion forms of the same character), and none are redundant in niche. It's quality over quantity. Every nurny can sometimes be viable (or terrible) depending on the situation. Also, there are very few 'industry plant' synergies where things are just lazily hard coded to gain +20% attack while used with something else or whatever, synergies come naturally from the interactions between different abilities that inherently work well together.

The main versus mode has you and your opponent progressively upgrade your teams side-by-side to counter each other, so building a good team is less about just working well in a vacuum, and more about beating the specific things you've been fighting against so far. Characters can interact with allies just as much as with their enemies, making machine-like setups with emergent interactions.

It has no live input during battles, so it can be played perfectly fine if you don't have a good reaction time, have a poor internet connection that causes lag or delay in most games, or if you have a physical disability. you can even play the game online in a way with someone who doesn't own it by streaming your screen to them, going to local versus instead of the nurnynet, and just letting them tell you where to place their units for them, like 'gluey louie to E4.'

the game is mostly meant to be a fun thing to mess around in with someone else, it's PvP, not singleplayer. you can customize your characters, background and a TV broadcast in-game and your opponent can see them too, there's random round phenomena that just derail matches because i think it's funny, and the game is surprisingly active on the Discord server so there's usually someone to play with randomly if you go there for matchmaking.

by the way, you're always set to play the stable version by default, which is older but more tested. however, you can opt-in to the experimental steam branch at any time to play newer updates early, at the cost that they're not finished being tested and de-bugged. if you ever wish the game had more updates, switch to experimental if the current one isn't in a buggy state (or report those bugs if it is and then they can be fixed sooner and that update can be pushed out as stable for everyone)

About This Game

Phinger Physics is a physics-based puzzle game where you solve challenges by drawing lines and boulders directly into the world. Using realistic motion, friction, and collision, your goal is to guide a golden ring into the bullseye — but how you do it is entirely up to you.

Each puzzle encourages experimentation, creativity, and careful planning. Draw ramps, barriers, and supports to control motion, redirect momentum, and overcome obstacles. There is no single solution — the fun comes from discovering your own.

The game features 50 handcrafted puzzles arranged across five difficulty tiers, from Freshman to PhD, offering a smooth progression from intuitive concepts to deeply challenging problems. Whether you enjoy relaxed problem-solving or complex physics interactions, Phinger Physics rewards thoughtful design and clever solutions.

Designed for both mouse and touchscreen input, the game feels natural whether you’re drawing with a cursor or directly with your finger.

store_data.about_the_game:
👁️ The Modern Face of Loneliness

  • Solo Dev: Developed from scratch by a single person, without using any pre-made models (assets).

  • A Digital Mirror: Its goal is not to demonize technology, but simply to show the dark void created by social media.

  • Lonely in a Crowd: In a world of 8 billion people, why are we so isolated? Why do we only look at screens even when we are side by side?

  • A True Story: Based on a real event centered around a lack of communication and social media addiction.

    🌀 A Procedurally Generated World

    Poolside Vigil's world is built from scratch every time you play. You will never experience the same nightmare twice.

    • Changing Spaces: The layout of the rooms and hallways is completely random.

    • Unpredictable Enemies: You never know when and where the danger will appear.

    • Dynamic Loot: The locations of the items you need to survive change every time.

      ⚖️ Choose Your Own Experience

      Decide how you want to play the game.

      • Normal Mode: Hide from enemies, control your asthma to avoid an attack, and loot around to keep your phone charged. A true fight for survival.

      • Safe Mode: No mortal danger or enemies. Just focus on the story and comfortably explore the creepy liminal atmosphere.

🌑 Watch Your Back!

You have no weapons, you can't fight. All you can do is run and hide.

  • They Can Pop Up Anywhere: Enemies don't have a fixed location, they can appear suddenly.

  • No Memorizing: When you replay the game, enemies won't be in the same place. You must constantly stay alert.

    💊 Watch Your Breath (Asthma)

    As if the enemies weren't enough, you are also fighting your own body.

    • Avoid the Toxic Tree: Stay away the moment you see the "Smoking Kill" tree, or you will run out of breath.

    • Find Medicine: Collect randomly spawning loot to avoid asthma attacks and stay alive.

      📸 Collect Memories

      Don't just run, you need to solve the story too.

      • The Toy Phone: Use that plastic phone to find hidden memories around you.

      • Memory Museum: Display every piece you find in your museum and understand what really happened.

        🔎 Discover Anomalies

        This place is already not normal, but some things are extra wrong.

        • Look Closely at the Rooms: Find things that are wrong or out of place (anomalies) around you.

        • Keep Your Eyes Open: The faster you spot the weirdness around you, the better.

          🧩 Push, Pull, and Slide!

          Just running is not enough, sometimes you need to use your brain and muscles:

          • Use the Items: Push, pull, and play with the physics of objects around you to clear the path or solve puzzles.

          • Have Some Fun: This might be a nightmare, but when you see that water slide, don't forget to slide down and have a little fun!

            🖍️ Don't Get Lost, Leave a Mark

            Draw your own path so you don't keep going in circles in the massive maze:

            • Use Spray Paint: Leave marks with spray paint on the places you pass so you don't get lost in the maze.

            • Examine the Pictures: Don't forget to examine the story-related pictures you see on the walls to understand the story.

              🌊Inspiration & Style

              Poolside Vigil is deeply inspired by internet phenomenons like POOLS, Liminal Spaces, Found Footage, and the Backrooms, especially the “Backrooms Pools” or “Poolrooms” concept.

              We would like to thank Jared Pike, considered one of the original artists behind the Poolrooms concept, whose work had a massive impact on the visual direction of this project, for his inspiring creations.

store_data.about_the_game:
Real terrain. Real geometry. Real consequences.

<ALIGNMENT: Engineering Odyssey> is a hardcore infrastructure simulation driven by authentic topography. Every project unfolds in a distinct geographic setting—mountain passes, river valleys, coastal corridors, urban fringes. The land itself dictates your constraints and shapes the visceral experience behind the wheel. There are no abstract grids here. Every ridge, every ravine is a boundary you must confront.

Core Features

Real Geographic Environments (GIS Integration)

Engineering-Grade Design

Drive to Validate

Workflow

Survey – Interpret the terrain. Identify control points and constraints.

Align – Plan horizontal and vertical geometry. Balance earthwork.

Construct – Build interactively: pavement structure, slope stabilization, bridge placement, tunnel portals, interchange ramps.

Verify – Drive the finished route. Gather feedback through the wheel and pedals.

Iterate – Revise the design. Fix the flaws.

Localization

More than text translation—terminology is adapted to match regional engineering standards and conventions.

Community priority: Swedish · Norwegian · Danish · Finnish

store_data.about_the_game:
THIS GAME CONTAINS NO AI GENERATED ASSETS. IT IS 100% REAL ART BY REAL ARTISTS.

ABOUT

In Seeing Double you control two characters, Pitter and Patter, in perfect sync with each other on two separate screens.

They each have their own view of the world, but you will quickly find that they do not see eye to eye.

Platforms, obstacles, and collectables that appear visible on one screen may be hidden on the other. Swap your attention strategically back and forth in order to navigate the mind-bending parallel worlds of Seeing Double.

Will you find a way to reunite this cute couple? Or will they remain trapped between realities?

KEY FEATURES

■ Old School 2D platformer action.

Run, jump, dash, climb, and more. Just like the good old days.

■ Platform mechanics galore.

Bounce high off of enemies and springs, ride moving platforms, bonk your head on strange boxes.

■ Frequent checkpoints that autosave your progress.

Fall to your death or need to exit out of the game? You'll quickly respawn at a nearby potted plant, with most rooms having at least one checkpoint.

■ Unlock new moves.

Jump into this vat of mystery liquid to unlock cool new abilities, such as the ubiquitous double jump, ground pound, dash slide, or crouch jump. Don't worry, it's safe. We've tested it.
■ Secrets.

For those with keen eyes and an adventurous spirit.

■ Meet wacky characters.

Who will definitely not try to rip you off.

■ Play a carnival game.

And win wild prizes.

■ Piss yourself in fear.

Wait, what? Ignore that. I'm sure it's nothing.


■ Uncover a tragic tale.

And discover how it all went wrong.

Thanks to the following:

Music: Penzilla, Cemal

Coding help: Peyton Burnham's platformer series on YouTube, Jon Peterson (Pixelated Pope)

Art: 1-Bit Platformer Pack by Kenney (Assets), 1-Bit Sci-Fi Tileset by Omniclause, Robo Factory 1-B by Rumblecade

store_data.about_the_game:
• This is a straightforward game that combines "tower defense battles, base building, and idle gameplay."

  • The game simulates the development process of an ancient mountain bandit stronghold. With tower defense (Tower Defense) as its core combat mechanic, it pays tribute to (Fenghe) several classic masterpieces (such as Warcraft RPG - Thief TD, Element TD, and Cultivation Simulator) while ultimately simplifying the gameplay. By integrating idle mechanics, it balances "addictive excitement" with "simple and relaxed" enjoyment.

  • Each character functions as a stationary tower—they do not move on their own. Whether engaged in combat, gathering resources, or crafting, all actions are carried out in the form of tower defense (TD).

  • Plunder residents, merchants, and troops from various cities to obtain currency, resources, and experience. This is all about attack—no defense. Engage in battles with zero loss, allowing you to acquire resources effortlessly and worry-free, with no fear of stagnation from defeat.

  • In a reimagined world of Huaxia, legendary figures from various dynasties converge. Recruit, upgrade, assign professions, and equip them—multifaceted cultivation systems allow these characters to grow and evolve in every dimension.

  • Characters can be deployed not only for combat but also for gathering resources, forging equipment, researching technologies, and refining elixirs. Leverage their unique strengths to continuously develop and expand your mountain stronghold.

  • A map of alternate history awaits your exploration—cities, wilderness, and special locations are scattered across the land. Plunder resources, hunt beasts in the wild, delve into hidden realms, and in the later stages, embark on campaigns to conquer the world and claim dominion over all.

  • Featuring extensive advancement paths, this chart only outlines the initial tier of professions. By the mid to late stages, a rich and intricate professional system will take shape, offering specialized directions for both combat and production roles.

The game will be released as soon as possible (and it should be quite soon!).

If you enjoy this style of gameplay, please: Add to Wishlist + Follow!

store_data.about_the_game:
Clock in and discover the dark secret behind one of the world’s favorite canned meat brand in Beef, a surreal horror experience like no other.

It is your very first day at "Silver Quality" Factory. In your first day as an operator, your job is simple: ballance temperatures, cut and shred any lump of meat you find in the line of production, and to ensure every pack of sausage meets the legendary "Silver Quality" that made this brand grow to become to popular!

But the Silver Quality Factory wasn't built on hard work alone. Between the gears and the meat, voices cry out from the vents. When the machinery shifts, you’ll find yourself hearing things, seeing things... And asking yourself if you really are alone.

  • Your first day in this job: Do your best! There's nothing wrong... Ignore those noises... Just do your best!

  • A Descent into Darkness: Can you solve the puzzles of a dark, dungeon-like environment where you might not be alone?

  • The Shadow Road: Survive a high-speed gauntlet of beasts illuminated by the flickering thunder.

  • A Legacy at Stake: Uncover the truth about Earl Goldfin and save the lost souls beyond the cold factory walls.

  • Like the good old times: "Beef" was developed with low poly graphics, mimicking the aestethic of classic console and PC games.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the zoo! You'll be playing as Annette Cylon, a sketalian girl who just graduated with majors in both Zoo and Wildlife Medicine. In school, Annette's grades were outstanding, and she was highly dedicated to her studies, but she's been struggling with a constant battle with her own melancholy and aimlessness, leaving her jobless. Luckily, opportunity struck when her uncle on her mother's side, Seth Petrooth, offered her a job in his zoo. Buckloot Island Zoo is a strange place, almost resort-like and remotely located in the middle of an archipelago. Some busywork seemed like just the thing to distract Annette from her own ghosts, so she accepted the job and climbed aboard the train to Buckloot Island. What she didn't expect was the other train hurtling her way, full of misfortune and disaster.

In Mutasmagoria, you'll find:

  • Strong world-building: The universe of Mutasmagoria is based on a unique speculative evolutionary direction. In this world, all vertebrates evolved from a hexapedal fish-like ancestor, resulting in two entirely different sapient 'human' species. Throughout the game, you'll explore the nature and culture of both these sides of this new kind of 'humanity,' alien and familiar all at once.

  • Expansive Mind Library: Annette has a figurative library in her head that you can access anytime to help dig into information about this new, strange world. Just like a real-life library, you'll have access to all the information from the start, but you aren't expected to acquire all the information at once. This means that for puzzles, you set the pace at which you gather clues rather than being gated by the game.

  • Puzzles built into the world: Puzzles in the game are built around curing the alien-like animals in the zoo with the resources available to you. Because of Annette's studies in biology, information about the animals is easily accessible, but diagnosing, creating medicines, and stopping unseen viruses that could create a future catastrophe? That requires critical thinking that goes beyond reading the mind library. Every clue and solution revolves around the game's biologically unique world and natural mechanisms.

  • Time is ticking: In the game's main mode, taking actions in the zoo will use up time. Some tasks must be completed each day, and if you don't finish them all, there are consequences (usually bad ones). The choices you make and the tasks you complete - or don't - culminate in multiple possible conclusions to the story. And not all puzzles are created equal - some are more important to your success than others! 100%ing the game's scenario and completing every single puzzle is borderline impossible; you'll need to make smart choices about what's vital for the zoo and what can go undone. For those who prefer a less stressful mode of play, difficulty modifications are available that let you play without a timer at all.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Campground Simulator 

Step into the role of a campground shop owner and transform a quiet stretch of wilderness into a thriving, cozy retreat. From stocking shelves and managing prices to helping campers find what they need, every decision shapes the atmosphere—and success—of your campground.

Experience the rhythm of daily life as time passes, weather changes, and customers come and go. Earn money, gain experience, unlock new items, and gradually expand your campground into the perfect outdoor escape. Whether it’s a calm morning restock or a busy evening rush before nightfall, there’s always something to do.

Designed with a relaxed, immersive pace, Campground Simulator blends hands-on management with cozy vibes, letting you play at your own speed while building something uniquely yours.

Light the fire. Open the shop. Welcome the campers.

Key Features

  • 🏕 Run Your Own Campground
    Manage a small outdoor shop and campground facilities in a peaceful forest setting.

  • 🛒 Stock, Price, and Sell Items
    Order supplies, place them on shelves, set your own prices, and serve customers at checkout.

  • 🌦 Dynamic Time & Weather System
    Experience changing days, nights, and weather that affect the mood and flow of the campground.

  • 📈 Progression & Unlocks
    Earn money and XP to unlock new items, upgrades, and features as your campground grows.

  • 🧍‍♂️ Living Customers
    Watch campers browse, queue up, make purchases, or leave if their needs aren’t met.

  • 🪵 Hands-On Gameplay
    Pick up boxes, stock shelves, manage inventory, and interact directly with your environment.

  • ☕ Cozy, Relaxing Atmosphere
    A calm, immersive simulator focused on comfort, creativity, and steady progression.

store_data.about_the_game:
You play as an independent programmer living a quiet and simple life. One day, you receive a request for help from a company that specializes in gold mining deep within cave systems. They inform you that one of their technical systems has failed and they need someone capable of fixing it.

What seems like a simple technical job quickly turns into something far more mysterious.

After arriving at the site, you find the place unexpectedly empty. There is no one to guide you, and no clear explanation of what is happening. All you know is that you came here to repair the system… but every step forward reveals something new.

Inside the dark caves, you will face puzzles and obstacles that require careful thinking and focus to overcome. As you continue deeper, the place slowly begins to reveal its secrets.

Explore the environment, solve puzzles, and uncover what this company is hiding deep beneath the earth.

But remember…

Some discoveries can be more dangerous than gold itself.

• Atmospheric Horror Experience – Explore dark and unsettling environments deep within mysterious caves.

• Puzzle Solving – Use logic and observation to solve puzzles and progress further into the facility.

• Story Discovery – Piece together clues to uncover the truth behind the mining company.

• Immersive Exploration – Search the environment and interact with different systems and objects.

store_data.about_the_game:
Engine: Unreal Engine 4, Development Time: 5 Year Span ( From 2022 to 2026 ), Scale: Large Scale,

IMS Intelligence Corp

IMS Intelligence Corp is a Large-Scale First Person / Third Person Story-Telling Game with a 13-Chapter Story Campaign, 4-Maps Special Missions & 33 Maps Survival Mode, 4th Installment In the Super Incursion Series and the Biggest/ Longest And Most Ambitious Entry to the Series surpassing all previous entries. Takes place at the same-time same-place as the Events of the Original Super Incursion And IMS Death Squad so while those stories are unfolding this one is happening at the same time and it interacts with those stories events.  IMS Intelligence Corp's Story Campaign follows the Intelligence Corp team 1 of 3 IMS Teams deployed to Advanced City, Gemstone Island to carry out Operation: Winter Strike. You take control of IMS Private Daryl Kalashi an Intelligence Officer, The Intelligence Corp team is the Intelligence Gathering And Processing unit of the Winter Strike mission made up of IMS Intelligence Officers unlike other teams that are made up of Special Forces Soldiers. They are a small unit of the much larger IMS Intelligence Division and they work closely with the Advanced City IMS Base. They're job is to carry out enemy survillience, intercept and process enemy communications, process environment layouts to aid in military advances, communicate with and gather data from spies in the enemy side, process and provide any data that can aid the 2 other teams in the operation. 

CONTEXT: At the start of the operation, The Intelligence Corp team is the first of the 3 teams to leave for and arrive in Advanced City, with Specialized Force being the last. When They got there they got split, majority of Daryl's team was sent directly to the Advanced City IMS Base to join members of the IMS Intelligence Division there while Daryl Kalashi is sent off to do some very important tasks. 

IMS Intelligence Corp (Game) was developed from the ground up as the biggest, longest and most ambitious Super Incursion Installment to date, its story campaign is longer than all previous installments campaigns. Its got the largest amount of Launch content than any other installment. Its Story is 13 Chapters long each chapter being 45 mins to 1 hour to complete. store_data.about_the_game:
This is a fun casual running game where you control a golden capsule rolling forward on a cobblestone track. Your goal is to collect the glowing yellow coins along the way while avoiding obstacles like red blocks. You’ll also need to watch out for scene elements such as benches and scaffolding on both sides to avoid colliding and veering off the track.

The top left corner of the interface displays your current distance traveled and the number of coins collected in real time. As the distance increases, the obstacles and coins on the track become more densely distributed—this tests your reaction speed and requires you to adjust the capsule’s direction nimbly.

With a bright, fresh art style and an open tree-lined track setting, the game is easy to play yet full of rhythm. The sense of achievement from collecting coins and the tension of dodging obstacles will keep you hooked.

store_data.about_the_game:
RE-VIVED is a zombie survival fps game in a pixelated style featuring a variety of weapons, enemies and bosses for you to fight. Equip gear, upgrade your weapons and fight a wave of zombies as long as possible. Each map has its own unique set of enemies for you to kill and obtain loot from.

Maps:

There are 3 maps to play in RE-VIVED:

  • Dungeon: The first level and easiest map to play. You will fight regular zombies, a ghost mini boss every 10 rounds and a mummy will spawn when every portal on the map is destroyed.

  • House: The second level is a medium difficulty map. You will fight civilian zombies, a swarm of rats every 10 rounds and a boss marine zombie.

  • Cottage: This is the hardest level in the game. Farmer zombies will be the norm while coyotes will swarm you every 10 rounds. The final boss will be a bear.

Weapons:

There are 12 weapons in RE-VIVED. Most of them are the same but here are some notable guns:

  • The M12 is a shotgun that deals massive damage and gives you a lot more money than the average gun

  • The Bazooka is a rocket launcher that deals massive area damage that burns the zombies if they are still alive after the explosion

  • The Poison Revolver shoots poison balls that go through enemies and poison them for a certain amount of time

  • The Springfield is a sniper that shoots up to 5 zombies at a time

  • Finally, the Flamethrower is, as the name implies, shoots fire that burns zombies. It might not deal the most damage but it gives you the most money out of any weapon.

store_data.about_the_game:
A LITTLE BACKGROUND:

You're a hacker-punk at your lowest point: jobless, single, friendless, and without family. This job could save your life. All you have to do is penetrate the security of an abandoned government facility, hack into the cameras and devices that allow you to explore it and find the anomaly.

The problem is, the building isn't really abandoned, and the entity that inhabits it, doesn't want to be disturbed.

THE PROPOSAL (OR HOOK ;) )

Experience this adventure through the software deadFish(), an ingenious camera navigation system that presents the player with a fun challenge as they traverse the map and access even the most remote corners to find the bug.

A PROMISE FOR THE FUTURE:

This game is the first installment in the DeadFish series. It introduces the mechanic that will be a constant throughout all the games: hacking cameras and terminals to navigate the physical world.

This mechanic tests your sense of direction; there will come a time when you won't need to look at the map, just the coordinates will be enough.

Future installments will add more hackable objects, from vehicles to weapons and combat suits. This is your chance to practice using this mechanic to get the most out of the games to come.

store_data.about_the_game:
We operate a machine that emits radiation and sends signals directly to customers’ brains while they eat in the restaurant. If the signal is used too frequently, it starts affecting us as well.

Heavily affected customers must be tested. They become extremely sensitive to radio sounds — high volume can push them to dangerous levels. Some try to protect themselves with earplugs or similar methods, which helps us identify their condition.

To control the situation, we must use an anti-signal machine. If we spread too much radiation or use the signal on normal people, they start vomiting and give low ratings. The restaurant must stay above three stars, or the Ministry of Health will inspect us.

Excessive radiation also attracts military attention, triggering investigations due to abnormal radiation levels.

store_data.about_the_game:
The debut game from Black Sheep Game Makers: A Turn-Based Party-Combat Comedy RPG with Skill-Based Quicktime Events.

Young Scout gets transported to the zany, offbeat, and magical otherworld of Atlas in retribution for not feeding their leftover pizza to a stray cat. Along their way they fight nasty enemies and meet powerful friends, participate in two (2) coups, investigate a mafia made of animated fast food, fight pirates, ghosts, and sharks (one enemy,) save a pop band on the brink of collaspe, climb the highest mountain in the world, and then travel to third, even purpler world to fight gNazis and defeat GNOME HITLER. But even then it's not over, will the final showdown between Scout and the Cat be the death of one of them, or will they all go home unscathed? Only you can decide.

And what will happen to those you met along the way? To those kids who just wanted to go to school? To the sheriff of that wild west saloon? To the police and the pirates and the wolves and the beach resort and the citizens of the ghost town and Atlas' favorite band? There's only one way to find out. 

Other Content:

10 Companions to fight beside Scout in battle, some only briefly, some permanently.

A forest level.

A sentient jar of mustard.

A bullracer turned actor turned superhero!

Caves.

Over 100 NPCs.

Dog people.

A RAT GOD!!!

A police officer who just wants to sell his jeans.

Mentions of someone named Carrotface.

Combining a barelyeth comprehensibleth dialecteth of Shakethspearethean Englisheth with the speecheth of the catseth of lols, it doeseth it!

The GOATs of detective work.

Negative depictions of a fast food restaurant, including soda stained floors.

Gnome Hitler.

The Mysterious Sign Writer.

Gnome Hitler.

Gnome Hitler.

OH NO!!! I'VE SUMMONED GNOME HITLER! HE'S EATTTING ME!!! HELP...

*Found in a second piece, as if it was written much later.*

All kidding aside, Wonderlanders is intended for most players of retro-inspired 2d RPGs, was inspired heavily by Undertale/Deltarune (see El Turneda and also the logo) and actually started development with the delightfully insane premise "Earthbound with dungeons."

Its probably family friendly, but it does have some somewhat dark humor and cartoon blood. There aren't actual Nazis, just a group of gnomes (read: Interdimensional Alien People) who represent a very heavily mocked cartoonification of Nazi ideology. Up to one person, and in one possible playthrough, a child, can be kidnapped and eaten by wolves (this is not including the main character and one other character, who are also children, and can die by wolf). There are implications of mental illness attached to the randomly violent actions of one character. Swearing occurs in the story, but no swear worse than frick is ever on screen or in the audio, though players who know the swears used can figure out what they are if they think about it.

Negative depictions of a fast food restaurant, including soda stained floors.

Gnome Hitler.

The Mysterious Sign Writer.

Gnome Hitler.

Gnome Hitler.

OH NO!!! I'VE SUMMONED GNOME HITLER! HE'S EATTTING ME!!! HELP...

*Found in a second piece, as if it was written much later.*

All kidding aside, Wonderlanders is intended for most players of retro-inspired 2d RPGs, was inspired heavily by Undertale/Deltarune (see El Turneda and also the logo) and actually started development with the delightfully insane premise "Earthbound with dungeons."

Its probably family friendly, but it does have some somewhat dark humor and cartoon blood. There aren't actual Nazis, just a group of gnomes (read: Interdimensional Alien People) who represent a very heavily mocked cartoonification of Nazi ideology. Up to one person, and in one possible playthrough, a child, can be kidnapped and eaten by wolves (this is not including the main character and one other character, who are also children, and can die by wolf). There are implications of mental illness attached to the randomly violent actions of one character. Swearing occurs in the story, but no swear worse than frick is ever on screen or in the audio, though players who know the swears used can figure out what they are if they think about it.

store_data.about_the_game:
The sun has set on this American suburb, but the walk home is no longer familiar.

In this minimal 3rd-person horror experience, you are pursued by something unknown. What begins as a solitary presence soon becomes an oppressive unrelenting force. As the darkness looms, the neighbourhood feels like it's stretching and twisting, and the path home is never ending.

Features

  • A Growing Presence: You are never truly alone. The stalkers are persistent, threatening, and desperate. Every step gets you closer to home, and them even closer to you

  • A Dark Embrace: A short, high-tension experience designed to be played in a single sitting, though you may find yourself returning to the dark more often than you planned

  • Full Immersion: Minimal UI to keep you trapped in the moment

  • A Walk Home: Minimal controls to keep things simple - walk, or run, to safety

  • Learned Behaviours: Make your way home safely by reflecting on your past attempts. Capture is not the end, but neither is escape...

Inspired by psychological horror movies, and short-form indie horror games like The Exit 8

Optimised for SteamDeck!

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone has heard of the legend of the Dragon's Egg at the top of the Tower...
They say it is a taste so sublime one could die of happiness...
As a wealthy gourmand with a dream, you've decided to seek the legend for yourself!

Dragon's Egg combines old-school RPG Dungeon Crawling with Autobattler mechanics and a unique cooking-themed leveling system, blending dark fantasy themes with a cheeky sense of humour.

Assemble your Party!

Hire eager adventurers from the nearby town to climb Belfry of Heaven and fight the hordes of hostile creatures guarding the path to higher floors. 

Character Customization is simple but highly variable:

  • Choose from 1 of 6 Jobs to suit a character's basic role,

  • Equip your party members with the right weapons and charms, then select a powerful Weapon Style that matches your needs.

  • Survive the perils of the dungeon with Hobbies!

Strategic combinations of Job, Weapon Style and Hobbies will be key to unlocking new floors of The Tower and all the way to the top! You'll be able to change everything about your party anytime you're outside The Tower, so try out new party compositions and weapon styles to improve your party's capabilities.

Once you've prepared your adventurers, feed them a fortifying meal and send them off to The Tower!

Dungeoneering!

Once you're in The Tower, you'll need to battle monsters and search for treasure in the form of Cooking Ingredients that you'll use later to level up your party members. 

  • Climb semi-randomized floors of The Tower and clear quests given to you by the townsfolk for rewards.

  • Battle hordes of strange and challenging creatures in quick and vicious autobattler segments.

  • Find new weapons, ingredients, cooking utensils and more to improve your party!

  • Make sure to avoid dangerous traps, status effects and demons!

  • Then escape back to town before you're overwhelmed...

Downtime!

Before heading back into the tower to climb higher, you'll be able to level up your adventuring party with the ingredients you've collected. 

  • Cook meals for your party to permanently increase their skills and give them temporary buffs for the next adventure.

  • Equip your party with new weapons you've collected from the tower, or buy new weapons with your profits.

  • Experiment with new and powerful Weapon Styles to enhance your battleplans.

  • Improve your cooking equipment to create bigger and better meals to further level up your party.

Can you reach the Dragon's Egg?
Ascend to Gastronomic Euphoria!

An adaptive difficulty system means there's never any dead air as you evade, shoot, and bomb through 5 hypnagogic stages filled with strange creatures. - Simple and intuitive hi-/loscoring system that rewards aggressive/pacifist playstyles

- Practice mode lets you repeat any part of the game: prepare a virtuosic performance!

- Local and online leaderboards, but never forget your greatest rival: yourself!

- Fast and smooth visuals from your deepest, darkest digital dreams

- An old-school arcade experience: all killer, no filler. Death is a teacher!

store_data.about_the_game:
Notice: The purchase of the base game includes Chapter 1 only.
Additional chapters may be purchased separately and may have an additional cost.

Some stories were not forgotten.
They were hidden.

Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game that blends exploration, atmosphere, and fragmented storytelling. Each chapter presents a different story, set in isolated locations shaped by secret experiments during the Cold War, deep within the forests of Siberia.

Nothing is fully explained.
Nothing is accidental.

As you progress, you will uncover censored documents, abandoned facilities, and presences that should not exist. Each story appears independent… until small details begin to connect.

The true horror is not only in what you see,
but in what you understand too late.

Chapter 1

In the first entry of Lost Stories, you step into the role of a young Soviet man with little memory of his past. One night, unexplained sounds and vibrations begin to echo through the forest. Locals call it “The Pulse.”

Something is asking for help.

As you venture deeper into the woods, you must explore, interpret what you find, and survive an entity determined to protect what was buried long ago.

Features

  • Psychological horror focused on atmosphere, tension, and narrative, without relying on constant jump scares

Some stories were not forgotten.

Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game that blends exploration, atmosphere, and fragmented storytelling. Each chapter presents a different story, set in isolated locations shaped by secret experiments during the Cold War, deep within the forests of Siberia.

Nothing is fully explained.
Nothing is accidental.

As you progress, you will uncover censored documents, abandoned facilities, and presences that should not exist. Each story appears independent… until small details begin to connect.

The true horror is not only in what you see,

Something is asking for help.

As you venture deeper into the woods, you must explore, interpret what you find, and survive an entity determined to protect what was buried long ago.

store_data.about_the_game:
🏀🏀🏀

About This Game

Tiny Hoops is a relaxing idle basketball shooter that flows at the bottom of your screen, allowing you to step in and take control whenever you want.

You develop your character and, when you feel like it, grab the ball yourself and take shots to actively join the game.

Your character shoots automatically, runs to the hoop, and earns points on their own. Using the points you gain, you strengthen your character, speed up the game’s tempo, and shape your own playstyle.

Idle Gameplay with Optional Active Control

Tiny Hoops keeps progressing even when you’re not actively playing.
However, if you want, you can jump in and speed things up by throwing the ball into the hoop with your mouse.

  • Leave the game running in the background

  • Step in at the right moment to earn points and money faster

  • Freely switch between idle and active gameplay

Every Shot Earns a BasketCoin

Every shot at the hoop earns you a "BasketCoin".

  • For every basket you score, you earn 1 Gold BasketCoin,

  • For every time the ball bounces off the backboard, you earn 1 Silver BasketCoin,

  • For every time the ball bounces off the rim, you earn 1 Bronze BasketCoin.

You can use these coins to level up your character's skills or buy drinks that provide temporary effects.

Upgrade Your Character

Your character’s performance is entirely shaped by your decisions.

  • Increase running pace

  • Improve shooting speed and efficiency

  • Boost shot accuracy

  • Manage the energy system to keep your character active for longer

All upgrades are done through a simple and intuitive menu using the character development icon located in the upper left corner of the screen.

Momentum & Interaction System

Consecutive successful or missed shots can temporarily affect your character’s performance.
By stepping in during these moments, you can:

  • Clear negative effects
    (As your character keeps missing shots, the chance of failure increases due to having a “cold hand”)

  • Maintain positive effects
    (As your character makes successful shots, the chance of success increases thanks to a “hot hand”)

This system turns Tiny Hoops into more than a passive idle game, creating a fun, lively experience that constantly engages the player.

Temporary Boosts & Shop

With temporary boosts you can earn throughout the game, you can:

  • Gain short-term performance increases

  • Speed up the game’s pace whenever you want

When used strategically, these boosts can significantly impact idle progression.

Customization

Customize your character, basketball hoop, and rim to match your style:

  • Outfit pieces, various accessories, and color options

  • Basketball designs and hoop appearances

Continue the Game on Basketball Courts in Different Parts of the World

  • Play on various basketball courts with different backgrounds.

  • Reach a total score and unlock a new basketball court.

Each court has a different finishing score. Choose whichever you want and continue shooting on basketball courts in different parts of the world.

Stats & Menu Design

  • Playtime

  • Shots taken

  • Performance statistics

All this information is stored in a clean statistics screen.
Menus never interrupt gameplay and always remain a natural part of the screen.

A Relaxing Atmosphere

  • Separate sound effects for the ball, hoop, and net

  • Ambient audio that fits the environment

  • Minimal yet lively backgrounds

Tiny Hoops is designed as a game you can enjoy at a glance during short breaks or leave running for long sessions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter the Gravezone. Survive the Arena.

Gravezone Arena is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where every wave pushes you closer to death - or domination. Face endless hordes of zombies, choose powerful upgrades, manage ammo and resources, and reshape the battlefield by building walls between waves.

Fast-Paced Arena Combat

Fight against increasingly dangerous zombie waves, including elite enemies and fast minions. Dodge, shoot, reload, and adapt as the arena becomes more chaotic with every round.

Build Between Waves

After clearing a wave, enter Build Mode to place walls and reshape the arena. Create choke points, protect yourself, or trap zombies - but choose wisely, your build resources are limited.

Roguelite Upgrades & Rarity System

After each wave, pick from randomly generated upgrades with different rarities:

  • Increase damage, fire rate, reload speed, or range

  • Unlock auto-shooting, drones, and special bonuses

  • Find rare and legendary upgrades through special pickups and slot-machine events

Every run is different.

Weapons, Ammo & Resource Management

Use a growing arsenal of weapons like pistols, shotguns, and SMGs. Ammo is limited - decide whether to spend upgrades on raw power or survival resources.

Dynamic Enemies

  • Basic zombies swarm in numbers

  • Elite zombies hit harder and may drop powerful rewards

  • Fast minions overwhelm you if you lose control of the arena

Atmospheric Pixel Art World

Explore a dark, moody city brought to life with detailed pixel art, dynamic lighting, environmental effects, and subtle world events like drifting clouds and ambient destruction.

One Arena. One Life.

No checkpoints. No mercy.

How long can you survive the Gravezone Arena?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to GLORIO.
A place where dignity is optional, friendships are temporary, and collecting cucumbers somehow makes sense.

GLORIO is a ridiculous top-down party game built for chaotic couch multiplayer. Up to four players battle, race, steal, and sabotage each other across seven different game modes, all designed to turn any living room into a loud, slightly unhinged party.

Every character comes with three unique abilities, because one way to annoy your friends is never enough. Teleport, dash, confuse, trap, or simply ruin someone’s perfect plan at the last possible second. Skill helps — but chaos helps more.

And yes… you collect cucumbers.
Why? Because GLORIO said so.

Each match is fast, unpredictable, and packed with moments that make people shout things they immediately regret. The rules change, the arenas fight back, and no round ever goes exactly as planned. Winning feels amazing. Losing is usually hilarious.

GLORIO was made to be played together, on one screen, with controllers flying, snacks disappearing, and someone yelling “THIS GAME IS STUPID!” (right before asking for another round).

Perfect for parties, game nights, and any situation where fun matters more than balance.

Features You Probably Care About

  • Local couch multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • 7 chaotic game modes (yes, seven)

  • 3 unique abilities for every character

  • Fast, absurd, party-ready gameplay

  • Short rounds that always turn into “one more game”

  • Colorful, cartoon-style visuals

  • Designed for controllers and loud rooms

store_data.about_the_game:
Quantum Brain Strategy is a turn-based hex-grid strategy game where tactical combat meets knowledge-based decision making. Command your units across a dynamic 2D/3D hexagonal battlefield, capture territory, trigger powerful special hexes, and outthink an increasingly aggressive AI opponent. Victory isn’t just about positioning—it’s about learning, adapting, and making smart choices under pressure.

At the heart of the experience are educational hexagons that challenge human players with curated questions drawn from thousands of hand-crafted entries across 17 categories, including science, history, technology, arts, and pop culture. Answer correctly to gain strategic advantages—or suffer penalties that can turn the tide of battle. AI opponents play purely strategically, leaving learning challenges exclusively in the hands of the player.

Quantum Brain Strategy features a polished 3D presentation with animated hexagonal prisms, wave-based board motion, responsive sound design, and tightly packed hex layouts for a clean, tactical feel. A robust acknowledgment system puts you in control of game pacing, while advanced AI difficulty levels—culminating in the near-perfect Quantum AI—offer a relentless test of planning and foresight.

Quantum Brain Strategy blends classic board-style tactics with modern visuals and meaningful educational depth, delivering a focused 1v1 experience that rewards both brains and bravery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tunnelers is an online co-op horror game where you mine for gold with up to 5 players. Venture into dark tunnels, recover lost equipment, set off explosives, and uncover secrets as you descend into increasingly dangerous caverns in pursuit of the eerie unknown at the bottom.

Find and extract as much gold as possible to obtain maximum profits. Use your hard-earned cash to purchase better mining equipment, or find it yourself in the abandoned underground passageways. Don’t spend all of your earnings, as you’ll need to pay the elevator service fee to continue your descent.

The caverns are dark and disorienting. Mark explored paths, or dig your own tunnels if necessary. Use proximity voice chat to keep in touch with your fellow miners.

Keep away from various hazards, traps, and unsafe equipment. There are more dangerous things lurking in the dark. Avoid fatal accidents or be forced to restart your descent.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world shuts down due to an outbreak that turns people into zombies. The Global AI takes over to form quarantine zones. You are one of the survivors in a walled off block under quarantine. The city is covered in miasma that sickens people, but you're less affected by it. Perhaps you are the chosen one to save the people in the block.

Gather food and supplies to trade with other survivors. Craft, farm, and cook to make things to help you. As you manage your Energy, Mental, and Hygiene. Build a relationship with survivors by talking to them, giving them gifts, and taking on personal quests to help them. Romance the many beautiful women. Eventually, convert them to your cult.

Watch out and keep yourself from being spotted, as zombies are deadly and can lower your Mental if they spot you. With the right preparation, you may be able to fight them off with a weapon.

Learn skills by reading books to help your survival. From learning to communicate better, craft and cook better, etc, to be more useful to the survivors as well as your own survival.

The game features animated, full, uncensored adult content with partial voice acting. 

Dive into the world of Apocalypse Cult Leader, and save the people of your block as you give them not just a way to survive but purpose to continue living.

List of features and content —

-Explore open-world city block

-Engage in dating sim mechanics (give gifts and do personal quests)

-Engage in farming, crafting, gathering items

-Engage in QTE combat

-Engage in uncensored animated adult scenes

-Manage RPG-style stats related to gameplay (eg. Charisma, Combat, Sex, etc.) 

-Barter with NPCs using relative item values

store_data.about_the_game:
“The Lucky Stray Cat” is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel, told through an urban horror narrative reminiscent of Junji Ito’s storytelling style.

The story follows Long, a penniless, unemployed writer barely surviving in a crumbling tenement. One rainy night, his life veers into the uncanny when he takes in a stray cat with an unnatural talent for drawing in money.

As Long’s fortune rapidly grows—bringing wealth, comfort, and a beautiful companion—an ominous truth begins to surface: every location where the cat "finds" money is inextricably linked to a grisly death.

Key Features

  • Experience the story through a Visual Novel–style narrative.

  • Explore atmospheric dungeons, scavenging for items, equipment.

  • Fight grotesque monsters and urban horrors using classic turn-based combat.

  • Answer quirky, humorous quizzes that analyze your personality.

Idle Bookstore is a cozy desktop idle game about building a bookstore experience.

Start with a small shop, a few books on the shelf, and a humble freelance writing gig. As you earn money, you’ll expand into new stores, hire staff, and decorate your space into a book haven.

But you don’t have to build alone.

Multiplayer That Feels Like Hanging Out

Idle Bookstore is designed around a simple fantasy: co-working with friends in a cozy shared space, even if you’re all doing your own thing.


In multiplayer lobbies, everyone appears as an avatar working at their desk. You’ll see what others are up to in real time — writing, reading, watching, or working — like a tiny online café for productivity and creativity.

Write Together. Sell Together. Grow Together.

  • Sell books written by players in your lobby, helping their careers while growing your own store.

  • Earn avatar customizations through shared activities, so your desk and character reflect your style.

  • Share productivity goals, track your sessions, and give each other likes when someone finishes an activity.

store_data.about_the_game:
English Localization is fully supported! (Screenshots are from early development version)

Welcome to Stack Haven – A wholesome cultivation paradise where everything can be stacked!

This is more than just a card-stacking game; it is a healing journey to restore a lost "Grotto-Heaven" (a mystical spirit realm). As the Master of the Haven, you will guide a group of adorable animals to farm, practice alchemy, cultivate immortality, and breed, rebuilding this spiritual sanctuary from the ground up.

🃏 Stack Everything, Reshape the Haven

Stack two cards together, and miracles happen!
Stack an animal on soil to Farm spirit herbs; stack a pickaxe on a rock to Mine ore. Through simple dragging and stacking, you can build complex production lines: from basic cooking and farming to hardcore Alchemy and Artifact Crafting. Use "Magnetic Channels" to achieve full automation, freeing your hands to watch your Haven flourish on its own.

🐼 Spirit Beast Breeding & Infinite Variety

The animals here are more than just workers—they have flesh, blood, personalities, and talents!

  • Unique Traits: Pandas are natural cooking masters but hate mining; "Tea Master Pandas" brew Enlightenment Tea to boost XP; even the "Silly Roe Deers" might surprise you.

  • Genetics & Mutation: Want stronger helpers? Let your animals breed! Traits can be inherited or mutated. You might breed a rare "Dream-Weaving Cat," a loyal "Celestial Hound," or even legendary Divine Beasts like the Azure Dragon or White Tiger!

  • Charming Foxes: Encounter a rare Nine-Tailed Fox? Use its charm ability to turn enemy beasts into your cute companions!

💌 Journeys, Not Farewells

This is a cultivation world, but it is not cruel. We refuse to abandon our friends.

  • Wandering System: Is the Haven getting too crowded? Or perhaps an animal's stats aren't ideal? Don't sacrifice them! Send them out to Wander the World. They will occasionally send you Letters from home, sharing stories of their travels and bringing back rare souvenirs. They never leave; they just explore further.

  • Spirit Shrine: Did an animal fall in battle or reach the end of its lifespan? The Shrine is always open. Brew an "Elixir of Life" or simply wait patiently, and your departed companions will eventually return to your side.

✨ Merit & Happy Cultivation

  • Happiness to Merit: Keep your animals well-fed and happy! Their "Happiness" converts into "Merit" (Good Karma).

  • Roguelike Blessings: Use Merit daily for a lucky draw! Merit also prioritizes your animals, granting them random epiphanies and stat boosts.

  • Defend the Haven: The outside world is dangerous. Stack your animal army to fend off Fierce Beasts and demons, protecting this pure land.

In Stack Haven, every stack is a surprise, and every animal is family.
Start now and restore this lost paradise!

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn the dial, match the parts, and listen to their stories.

D1AL-ogue is a cyberpunk repair puzzle game where you fix androids in a city under an eternal gray night.

Welcome to your workshop.

This is Chroma City, a place where the sun never rises, and only the artificial light of 'Neon-Shine' illuminates the streets. With 'Polar Night Day,' the longest night of the year, just ahead, the city is shimmering with festive lights and shadows.

You become the manager of a repair clinic tucked away in a corner of the shopping district, welcoming customers who emerge from the dark.
They are not ordinary humans, but androids known as Electronic Vital Entities (E.V.E).
Your mission is to operate the old-school diagnostic console [D1AL] to fix their broken parts and return them to their daily lives.

Circular Puzzle Action

Forget simple repairs. You must manually rotate and manipulate a circular grid that visualizes the android's internal core.

  • Rotate and Merge: Within a limited battery capacity, move and rotate modules to merge three of the same kind into a higher-tier unit.

  • Strategic Repair: Precisely replace units while avoiding spreading electronic narcotics and overloaded units on the verge of exploding.

Stories of those living daily lives where the abnormal is the norm

Androids with unique charms and backstories will visit your workshop.

Instead of a warm cup of tea or a cocktail, serve them a perfect repair. The stories they share will change depending on your skills.

Key Features

  • Circular Puzzle: A unique puzzle mechanism based on a circular grid.

  • Light Narrative: Trivial yet deep daily stories within a cyberpunk universe.

  • Retro Aesthetics: Pixel art visuals combining 98-era PC style with Neon Noir.

Now, turn the D1AL and connect with them.

-------------------------------------------------------------

All resources used in the game are either 100% hand-crafted or licensed assets.
Log collection is strictly limited to gameplay information for game improvement purposes.
