store_data.about_the_game:
What Awaits You

  • 15+ hours of adventure: A rich, story-driven campaign filled with discovery and unforgiving trials.

  • No procedural generation: Handcrafted locations and biomes designed for exploration: wild jungles, sunlit beaches, frozen peaks, scorching deserts, and deep catacombs.

  • Dynamic combat: Combine light and heavy attacks with active skills while fighting intelligent enemies — no stamina limitations.

  • Diverse arsenal: Master one-handed and two-handed weapons, from swords and axes to hammers and maces, enhancing your playstyle with magic and alchemy.

  • Hero progression: Develop attributes ranging from Health and Intelligence to Luck and Weapon Mastery. Upgrade abilities and unlock new active skills tailored to your preferred playstyle.

  • Secrets of the past: Uncover the mystery of a civilization that vanished 500 years ago and learn how the hero’s fate is bound to the history of the island.

Combat Without Limits

There is no stamina bar in combat — the pace of battle is driven solely by your reactions. Enemies are dangerous and distinct: some rely on brute force and rage, others wield magic or support their allies. Be ready to adapt quickly to each opponent’s fighting style.

Flexible Defense

Use dodges or block attacks with shields and weapons. Defense does not grant full invulnerability: every item has its own absorption values for different damage types (slashing, magic, and more). Parrying is a high-risk, precision-based mechanic — a failed parry turns into a standard block, causing partial damage.

Path of Progression

Shape your build through attributes: Health, Intelligence, Luck, Mana, and Weapon Mastery. Your stats directly unlock passive talents and special abilities. Additional active skills are upgraded using Evelyn’s Ash, allowing you to adapt the hero to your personal combat tactics.

Synergy of Steel and Magic

Magical runes of three power circles are hidden in the most secluded corners of the island. With proper character development, magic enters powerful synergy with your arsenal. Spells not only strike enemies from afar but also significantly enhance melee attacks, creating unique tactical combinations.

Alchemy and Risk

Craft potions, weapon oils, and unique toxins with powerful effects — from protective fields to a chance to paralyze enemies. Each elixir fills an instability meter. By balancing on the edge, you gain bonuses to damage and defense based on your toxicity level, turning risk into a powerful advantage.

Old-School Spirit

Forget procedural generation. Every part of Island Of Ash is the result of meticulous handcrafting. The world is designed so that every step rewards curiosity. Stray from the beaten path, and you will always find a hidden ruin, cave, or forgotten cache filled with valuable loot.

Reward for Risk

Exploration always comes with danger. You may stumble upon an ancient shrine guarded by an elite enemy — defeating it rewards you with rare amulets or unique runes. The island’s most valuable treasures are hidden where only the bold dare to venture.

Hidden Horizons

The main story is only part of the journey. Miss an unassuming passage, and you might lose access to an entire secret location with unique enemies, equipment, and its own story. This world rewards patience: the most powerful loot and meaningful discoveries lie beyond the main path.

Elemental Contrast

The island will amaze you with its diversity. Travel from sunlit beaches and dense tropical jungles to scorching deserts and frozen mountain ridges. Descend into the silent gloom of an ancient stone forest or explore a temple swallowed by the sea — every zone is handcrafted and filled with its own atmosphere.

Lost Legacy

Five centuries ago, this world stood still and collapsed into ruins. You awaken on the island’s shore with no memory of your past, yet feel an unbreakable bond with this land. To understand what happened — and who you truly are — you must recover five fragments of your soul, hidden deep within the darkest ruins of forgotten citadels.

Deep Immersion

The story unfolds through cinematic cutscenes, enemy dialogues, the hero’s inner monologues, and environmental storytelling. Rich lore is hidden within item descriptions and the world itself. Piece together fragments of history to restore the full picture of the catastrophe that reshaped life on the island.

Your Ending

Your journey is not just a search for power, but a chain of choices with real consequences. Every soul fragment you recover and every critical decision shapes your path toward one of multiple endings. Become the hero who restores life to the island — or its greatest curse. There are no hints, only your decisions and their outcomes.

P.S.
This is my first solo project — a game into which I poured all my strength, several years of my life, and my love for the genre. Thank you for your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
"Heh heh... Behold the providence of darkness..." (Please, anything but a 1!)

Meet the disgrace of a prestigious magical family: a 'Zero Mana' dropout witch. All she has are massive debt and a set of 'sketchy, defective dice' bought from a loan shark. To overturn her miserable fate, she reluctantly enters the dungeon to find the legendary 'Wish-Granting Scroll.'

She acts like a cool, dark mage on the outside, but inside? She’s trembling in her boots. At every crossroads of fear, guide her with your 'Perfect Strategy!'

The Cowardly Witch's Dilemma 

"Use the dice to run, or use them to fight?"

  • Perfect Information: Enemy actions are 100% telegraphed. Find the optimal ratio between movement and offense each turn.

  • Desperate Resource Management: You hold only 4 dice. Use a high roll to sprint away, and you lose firepower. Go all-in on the attack, and you're a sitting duck. Every die counts.

You can't control the odds, but you can design the outcome.

If the dice won't listen, just change the 'Scroll'.

  • Rethinking Dice Values: Every scroll interprets numbers differently. A generic '1' could be a failure on one scroll, but a critical hit on another.

  • 4 Scrolls, Condensed Strategy: You can only bring 4 scrolls into battle. Find the perfect balance between range, AoE (Area of Effect), survival, and impact.

Game Summary

  • Dice-Driven Tactics: A desperate survival roguelike where every action—from walking to striking—hinges on your dice rolls.

  • Telegraphed Combat: Enemy intents are fully visible. Enjoy the strategic thrill of allocating limited dice between 'Survival (Move)' and 'Impact (Attack).'

  • Dynamic Scroll Deck-Building: Collect scrolls that change range and effects based on dice values. Control every variable with a compact deck of 4 scrolls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become the spirit apprentice of a lighthouse keeper, left in charge at the edge of the solar system. Each day, you must keep the Lighthouse running, aid ships seeking help, and withstand the Black Fog creeping ever closer.

Maintain the Lighthouse:

The Lighthouse is both your home and your responsibility. Operate and upgrade its production rooms, refine precious resources, and decide how to spend your limited time and energy. Feed the Lighthouse engine to keep the beacon alive and to guide flying ships through the cold emptiness of space.

Explore the Island:

As the days pass, new rooms and paths become available. Explore Lighthouse Island, discover shortcuts, and master its layout to optimize your movement and efficiency.

Aid Incoming Ships:

Numerous ships seek shelter at your Lighthouse. From Starsea captains and fishermen to refugees and envoys, each ship arrives with its own needs. Decide how to help them with the resources you can spare, and in return, your choices may shape events far beyond the Lighthouse itself.

As the Fog Spreads:

Something ancient has been disturbed. A creeping Fog spreads across the space sector, growing stronger with each passing day. Resources dwindle, the cost of failure rises, and maintaining the Lighthouse becomes ever more difficult. Will it endure the rising tides, or is it destined to be swallowed by the Fog?

Game Features:

  • Spirit Apprentice: Play as a lighthouse spirit, able to fly and dash across the Lighthouse in ways others cannot.

  • Hands-On Management: The Lighthouse has no automation; you must personally visit production rooms and use your powers to animate the machinery within.

  • Room improvements: Upgrade the Lighthouse rooms to adapt to mounting pressure.

  • Narrative Encounters: Special ships bring short, self-contained stories where small acts of service can influence the wider world.

In the distant but surprisingly "leaky" city of Kranovsk, where every house is a maze of old pipes, unpredictable turns and sudden floods, an era of change is coming. A novice plumber decided to learn pipes and become the greatest plumber.

Rotate and connect the pipes so that the water gets from the source to the target. Keep an eye on the time, otherwise the water will have time to flood everything around! Keep this in mind when you build your path.

You are a beginner with a dream of becoming the best plumber, with a set of rusty keys, a flashlight that flashes at the most inopportune moment ... and a great desire not to flood the neighbors from below.

  • Various pipes

store_data.about_the_game:
Buy Happiness is a solo deck-builder inspired by the cardboard originals like Dominion, instead of separate shop and gameplay rounds you'll play your cards and build your deck on the same screen. Use your cards to manage your resources, use those resources to buy new cards and upgrade them. Mould your deck into a well oiled machine capable of propelling you into the upper echelons of the economy. Compete in the leader boards to accumulate the most wealth, or to reach monetary milestones in the fewest turns.

Features

The game is still early in development, so things can and will change between now and release, but here's a list of planned features to give you an idea of what to expect;

  • Multiple campaigns - Work through a variety of scenarios, each with different starting decks and bespoke pools of cards, items, upgrades and events

  • Hundreds of cards, items and upgrades - Build a unique deck and customise the cards in it

  • Thrilling pick 3 action - Every time you add another digit to your net worth you'll be rewarded with a choice of cards, items, or static buffs in the form of traits

  • A plethora of exciting events - At the end of each turn you'll be faced with a choice or a challenge, often in the form of a minigame

  • Global leader boards - A little healthy competition to keep things interesting.

(IMPORTANT: I WILL CONTINUOUSLY EXPAND THE GAME WITH FREE CONTENT, INCLUDING CHARACTERS, LEVELS, ETC. MY MAIN GOAL IS TO TRANSLATE THE GAME INTO ALL LANGUAGES I KNOW!)

Dual Force is a fast-paced 2D action adventure where the fate of the world rests on the shoulders of two warriors. An ancient and growing darkness threatens the realm, and the forces of evil grow stronger every day. The heroes are brave, but they may not be enough on their own.

This is where you come in.

By joining the fight, you become another warrior standing against the darkness. Every player is a new spark of hope, and the more of us there are, the greater our chance to push back the shadows. Battle enemies, unlock powerful abilities, grow stronger, and fight your way through the forces of evil as you move closer to saving a world on the brink of collapse.

Dual Force focuses on fast, impactful combat, unique character progression, and a heroic atmosphere. This is a journey where every player contributes to the story—and every battle is a step toward redemption.

Join the heroes. Strengthen the light. Help save a world that desperately needs its defenders.


The game features smooth, hand-crafted animations, responsive controls, and supports both keyboard and controller gameplay. You can play solo or team up in co-op mode to push further and experiment with different playstyles together.

Duale Force is an actively developed project and will receive updates every 2–3 months, including new content, improvements, and balance changes. Player feedback is highly valued, and ideas or suggestions are always welcome via email, helping shape the future of the game.

This is my first debut game. While the game is still undergoing optimization, it already contains a large amount of content, and there are many more plans ahead. Duale Force is a long-term project, built with passion and continuous development in mind.

store_data.about_the_game:
Skyrest is a first-person roguelike action game where you play as a deceased person at the gates of the afterlife, confronting your unresolved inner issues before reaching eternal rest. Summon procedurally generated islands, gather resources, upgrade your boat, craft items and weapons, and fight ghostly enemies using an arsenal of spirit weapons and runic attacks to reach the gates of Skyrest.

COMBAT


  • Fast-paced and dynamic first-person combat, with melee and ranged options.
  • Face unique enemies and bosses in each biome, unlocking the ability to summon biomes of your choice.
  • Create Spiritual Weapons and Attack Runes to expand your arsenal and aid you in combat.
  • Create food and drinks to give you temporary boosts that will help you overcome challenges.

PROGRESSION


  • 4 unique biomes, each with its own enemies, traps, items, interactions, and level design.
  • Unique islands with procedurally generated content to create coherent and diverse experiences across runs.
  • Discover different interactions, events, and hazzards in each run.
  • Choose between different Ascensions and Amulets to improve the character in unique ways each run.

META-PROGRESSION

  • Your boat is also your home and base of operations; store items, build, and craft new items.
  • Collect items and resources and send them back to your boat to use them in constructions and item creation.
  • Build new structures on your boat to enable and expand your item crafting capabilities.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tile Tactics is a tower defense roguelike where everything is a physical tile. In this game, your towers don't level up: you have to place physical Upgrade tiles right next to them to boost their power! 

Luck Luck Luck

Get your towers from the slot shop! It's all random baby! Try and re-roll to get the tiles you want or make do with what you're dealt ! I'm sure you'll find what you need (or not!). Do not fear experimentation!

Explore and Destroy

Choose from unique bases that grant massive starting perks, then drop into a procedurally generated map. The world is made of hand-drawn pixel art and it's fully destructible. Use explosive tiles to clear space or blast apart the terrain to find secret tiles hidden underneath the rocks.

  • Physical Upgrades: Your buffs are tiles. Position them wisely to create the ultimate defense.

  • 150+ Tiles: Tons of Attack, Support, Upgrade, Special (and more!) tiles to discover and combine.

  • Slot Shop: A high-stakes way to build your grid between waves!

  • Randomized Runs: New maps and destructible secrets every time you play!

  • Chaotic Pace: It starts simple but quickly turns into a fast-paced battle for survival!

store_data.about_the_game:
Outpost 4 is a casual, cartoon-style idle resource-management game with combat and progression.
Players collect different resources on various alien planets to perform temporary upgrades during a run or permanent upgrades across runs, gradually strengthening their abilities to defeat increasingly powerful enemies.
The controls are simple, but the gameplay offers meaningful depth.

Key Features

  • Over 100 permanent technology upgrades in an extensive tech tree, with progress gained after every run

  • 20+ distinct weapon types and 100+ items with unique effects, allowing players to fully customize their combat style to counter different enemy types

  • Easy to learn, hard to master — the control scheme is straightforward, upgrades are intuitive, and core systems unlock gradually, resulting in a smooth learning curve

  • Gameplay focuses on temporary progression within each run and permanent progression between runs — death is not failure, but a restart with rewards and long-term growth

Unfortunately, amid the forest of high-rise buildings, it accidentally crashes into a glass window and falls into the ventilation system of an office building. In this overlooked world, a diverse array of creatures live, each with its own unique perspective on life...

A self-developed 2.5D puzzle game that delights the senses with its hand-drawn visuals, cute animation and vibrant sounds. Proceed at your own pace in figuring out the routes to carefully designed levels, explore the vent world and meet new creatures. Trying to confront the meaninglessness or nihilism of life through an existentialist approach.

Playtime: 15-30 mins.

Features:

  • Black & White, Hand-Drawn Art Style.

  • Sudoku-Inspired Puzzle Mechanics.

  • Meet new Friends! Each of them has a witty quote.

  • Casual philosophy ideas.

store_data.about_the_game:
👁️ [The Shift]

You have been hired as a night shift security guard. Your mission is simple but deadly: monitor real-time footage across 5 screens, spot changes, and survive until morning.

🔍 Key Features

  • 5-Channel Monitoring: Keep a constant eye on 5 CCTV screens covering different areas. A minor change could cost you your life.

  • 50+ Anomalies: Over 50 types of anomalies, including shifting furniture, eerie figures, and unknown noises, will keep you on edge.

  • Intuitive Reporting System: Spotted an anomaly? Open the report menu immediately and accurately select the area and type of phenomenon.

☕ Survival Essentials

  • Coffee System: Drowsiness is a sign of death. Brew and drink coffee to keep your vision clear before sleep takes over.

  • Restore Lighting: Lights in this aging facility fail often. You can't report what you can't see. Restore power immediately to maintain visibility.

  • Jump Scare Warning: Be prepared for sudden terrors lurking in the silence.

🏆 Game Modes

  • Story Mode (7 Days): Survive 7 nights of increasingly intense anomalies to reach the final ending.

  • Infinite Mode: There is no end. Challenge your limits and compete with players worldwide for the title of the longest-surviving employee.

4271920.name: How Smart Are You? IQ Test

store_data.about_the_game:
How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out! Features include a detailed IQ breakdown, question generation that allows for retesting, and a full length 50 question test.

FEATURES

- Detailed IQ report, with a breakdown of 5 intelligence categories.

- Full length 50 question test gives greater IQ accuracy.

- Question generator makes every test unique, making it possible to retake the test multiple times and diminishing gaming of the test.

NOTE

This IQ test is for entertainment purposes, but has been normalized in an attempt to give more accurate results. Therefore, the most important part of the test is the IQ category breakdown, which can highlight your areas of strength and weakness. The 5 categories are Mathematics, Spatial Reasoning, Short Term Memory, Logic, and Mental Efficiency. This test is especially good when you compare against someone else who was also took the test, as it works well as a comparison tool. Challenge a friend and see how you compare!

ADDITIONAL INFO

This game is part of the GZ Storm legacy series and was originally released on the Xbox 360 on July 22nd 2010. This version runs on PC and has some improvements.

Step into relentless multiplayer combat built around pure gunplay and constant action. NIGHTHAWK delivers a free-to-play FPS experience where every match is fast, intense, and driven by player skill.

Jump into action with a lineup of iconic weapons, each with its own feel, and customize your loadouts to match your playstyle. Choose your operator, unlock banners and profile titles, and show who you are every time you enter a match.

There’s no skill-based matchmaking here. Matches are raw, unpredictable, and always moving : just jump in, respawn fast, and stay in the fight across multiple game modes. NIGHTHAWK is casual at heart, and perfect for fun-focused players rather than those looking for ultra-competitive grind sessions.

Whether you’re chasing high killstreaks or just jumping in for nonstop action, NIGHTHAWK is built for players who want immediate fun, constant momentum, and multiplayer combat that never slows down.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lawns Don’t Fix Themselves

Grass is a cozy co-op lawn care simulator about rolling up your sleeves and taking care of overgrown spaces together. These properties need a little love, and with the right tools and a good crew, you can bring them back to life one yard at a time.


Grab a Tool and Get to Work

Mow grass, trim edges, water plants, burn debris, and haul away trash as you transform messy spaces into something you can be proud of. Every tool has its purpose, and using them well makes the job smoother, faster, and more satisfying. There’s no wrong way to help out, but teamwork always pays off.

Better Together

Grass is built around co-op play. Split up tasks, cover more ground, and coordinate your tools to get the job done efficiently. One person mowing while another trims and cleans turns hard work into a smooth, shared rhythm. Solo play works too, but everything’s better with friends.

Work Smart, Relax More

You can tackle jobs in any order, but planning ahead makes a difference. Communicate, avoid overlapping work, and watch the yard come together piece by piece. The cleaner and faster the job, the better the outcome. It’s all about finding a flow that feels good.

Grow Your Reputation

Finish jobs to earn rewards and build your reputation through the mower app. Strong performance unlocks new opportunities, and progress carries across sessions. Whether you’re playing solo or as a group, every job helps you grow.

Take Pride In the Result

Grass is about visible progress, shared effort, and the quiet satisfaction of standing back and admiring a job well done. Grab your crew, fire up the equipment, and leave each place a little better than you found it.

store_data.about_the_game:
VOXEL SHOOTER MAYHEM

GunSlaw VR is a flexible free-to-play online multiplayer VR shooter featuring a wide variety of voxel-based gamemodes. Engage in PvP combat with realistic gun mechanics in destructible environments where you can build your own defenses!

MODDABLE SERVERS

GunSlaw VR allows users to host servers and write custom plugins in Python to create unique gamemodes for players to enjoy.

MAP TOOLING

The included level editor allows anyone to make maps, but if that's not enough, a map conversion utility is also included that can port Minecraft .mca maps to GunSlaw VR maps.

NATIVE GAMEMODES

While custom gamemodes can be created by users, GunSlaw VR natively supports a variety of gamemodes.

Deathmatch / TDM

Deathmatch is a simple gamemode with non-stop combat where players compete for the most kills. The TDM (Team Deathmatch) gamemode splits the players into teams.

Sandbox TDM

A Team Deathmatch gamemode with full terrain destruction and building enabled.

Turf Wars

Two teams fight for territory. Kills grow your territory and each team can only build defenses on their own territory.

Destroy The Monument

A team-based gamemode with full terrain destruction and building where the objective is to destroy the "monument" of the opposing team.

Search & Destroy

The classic FPS gamemode where teams alternate in taking and defending bomb sites with player respawns disabled.

store_data.about_the_game:
A simple and relaxing game about pairing socks. It's a big family, someone has to do it.

Key features

  • Relaxing and satisfying gameplay

  • Procedurally generated socks patterns

  • Unlimited socks to pair

  • Odour free

  • A cute chore simulator

Sock variations

With over 500 possible combinations of socks, combining colours, patterns and sizes, you have plenty of sorting to do. You'd better get to it, the laundry isn't going to do itself. 

Gameplay loop

Pairs of socks will fall from the sky, it's your job to sift through them and find the matching ones. Once you've made an arrangement of them, you can move on to the next batch. There is no shortage of socks to sort, it's unlimited.

Odour free

As the socks are all digital, you won't have to tolerate any unpleasant smells. They are also completely sterile, so there's no risk of contamination from interacting with these socks.

Find and use objects to unlock new levels.

Interact with the environment—open drawers, cabinets, and doors to uncover hidden clues.

Follow (or ignore) the signs—sometimes, the only way out is through.

> It depends on how fast you find the doors.

> Unlike other backrooms/liminal space games I have developed, this game contains levels designed with original ideas and is not just a walking simulator. And only for 4.99 $

store_data.about_the_game:
CLASSIC SHMUP ACTION WITH A BULLET-BENDING TWIST

SynthEscape is a horizontal scrolling shoot 'em up built around a risk/reward graze mechanic. Fly dangerously close to enemy bullets to charge your ship. Each graze expands your time-manipulating, bullet-slowing field and pushes your combo higher. Chain grazes together, grow your energy field, and turn bullet hell into controlled chaos.

BREAK THE FUTURE

Humanity has been subjugated and imprisoned under a ruthless AI and its endless machine army. But one teenager refuses to bow. They steal the forbidden DLRN-88, a prototype reality-bending weapon developed by the machines themselves. Attaching it to their own scrapped-together starship, they launch a desperate mission to escape their dystopian city and destroy the central AI core in orbit.

FEATURES

  • 5 Levels of Neon-Soaked Rebellion: Battle through the dystopian city, race across ocean highways at sunset, infiltrate a forgotten factory beneath the mountains, ascend the space elevator, and destroy the core in orbit. Each level brings unique enemies and devastating bosses.

  • Two Player Co-op: Bring a friend into the chaos. Double the firepower, double the grazing mayhem.

  • Vibe Mode: Just want to experience the synthwave aesthetic? Play without death. Scoring still matters, but the pressure's off.

  • Fully Customizable Controls: Remap every input to match your play style, whether keyboard, controller, or arcade stick.

  • Online Leaderboard Support: Perfect your runs, maximize your score, and compete with players worldwide.

  • Boss Gauntlet: Face off against mechanical nightmares with crushing attack patterns.

SYNTHWAVE REBELLION

SynthEscape is built on classic shoot 'em up foundations - inspired by arcade legends like Gradius and Darius, and modern takes like ZeroRanger and Devil Blade Reboot. Five handcrafted levels with fixed enemy patterns and multi-segment bosses. No randomization, no roguelike elements. Just pure pattern mastery and score optimization.

One teenager. One stolen prototype weapon. One desperate mission to destroy the AI overlords. Everyone can finish the rebellion. Vibe Mode removes death penalties while keeping scoring intact. Learn the stages at your own pace, refine your routes, chase the perfect run.

GRAZE BULLETS. BEND TIME. BREAK THE FUTURE.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Game About Having a Job is a simulation about work, money, and doing whatever it takes to make more of the latter for less of the former.

You take on dumb jobs, master dumber skills, trade stocks, lose money, gamble on sports, lose money, and read the nearly-nonsensical news while a surprisingly detailed economy runs in the background. You can play actively, min-maxing every moment, or let things idle and check in later to see how it all went.

Work, Money, and Decisions

Browse procedurally generated jobs, each with different wages, benefits, and humorous titles. Some jobs will teach you skills that can lead to better jobs later, some are dead-ends that just pay the bills for now. Set your 401k contributions once you're on the career ladder and watch the gains compound like the grown-up you are.

Markets, Betting, and Risk

Trade stocks, options, futures, and currency in a simulated stock market influenced by volatility, momentum, and procedural news events. Read headlines that may or may not matter, and decide whether to react or ignore them.

Gamble on fully procedural sports leagues with realistic scoring, odds, spreads, and parlays. Teams have seasons, outcomes are simulated realistically, and bets resolve the way you’d expect.

Sometimes you’re smart. Sometimes you’re lucky. Sometimes the big turtle wrestling match just doesn't go your way and you still have to show up for work tomorrow.

Success here is all about the relationship between risk vs. reward... or maybe a fool and their money?

Time Keeps Moving

The simulation runs continuously with standard time controls that let you pause, speed things up, or let it idle in the background. Markets fluctuate and orders fill. You'll work and get paid. Sports are played and bets resolve.

There’s no single goal, no scripted ending, and no correct way to play.

Just money, time, and whatever you decide to do with them.

The game includes a save system, allowing your progress to be preserved whenever you enter a new level, so you can continue anytime you want.

YELLOW is under active development, with new levels planned for every update.

store_data.about_the_game:
Up to the Top! is a fast-paced vertical platformer where you take control of Hoppi, a charming knitted toy, as they climb endlessly through a child’s room.

The rules are simple: jump up, and don’t fall.

Easy to learn  hard to master.

One misstep, one broken rhythm, and the climb is over.

⚡ Momentum & Combo System

You can jump one platform at a time but the room never waits.

To survive, you’ll need to chain jumps into combos, building momentum to gain speed and reach greater heights.

Keep your flow, stay in control, and remember  risk is part of the climb.

🚀 Pickups

Pickups don’t just help  they change the pace of the game.

Jetpack boosts let you launch upward quickly.

Game speed pickups bring dynamic flow to every attempt.

🧸 Levels

The higher you go, the more the room evolves, telling stories from different chapters of a child’s life.

🎯 Easy to Learn. Hard to Master.

Designed for short sessions and endless retries, Up to the Top! delivers a pure arcade experience built around rhythm, timing, and momentum.

No complex controls.

Just speed, flow, and vertical fun.

Find your rhythm  and keep climbing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Break. Acquire. Obliterate. The Evolution of Swipe Action!


Block Shot combines the addictive swipe brick-breaker formula with roguelike strategy and RPG combat. Bricks are no longer just obstacles—they are your arsenal. Shatter the defenses, harvest their energy, and unleash devastating abilities to crush your enemies!

Key Gameplay Features

    [] Strategic Combat: Fire projectiles to destroy bricks while managing their durability. Collect random items to increase your ball count and fire power. Prevent bricks from reaching the bottom line to protect your health! [] Brick-Triggered Abilities: Each destroyed brick performs unique actions such as Poison, Weaken, Shield, or Life Steal. The order in which you break bricks is the key to mastering the battlefield.
  • Formidable Boss Encounters: Progress through increasingly difficult stages and face powerful bosses. Each boss possesses unique patterns and massive stats that will test your tactical limits.

Roguelike Progression

    [] Deck Building with Bricks: Choose from various elemental types and unique bricks to build your perfect strategy through randomized selections. [] Dynamic Path Selection: Choose between 'Upgrade Shop', 'Discard Shop', or 'Battle' gates to shape your journey. Level up your core bricks to maximize their efficiency or discard unnecessary ones to optimize your deck.
  • Game-Changing Traits: Defeating a boss grants powerful permanent traits. Combine effects like Crit Chance, HP Growth, or Shield Retention to survive the intense endgame.

The Ultimate Goal

Manage your health, upgrade your bricks, and survive to the final stage. With randomized choices and deep strategic elements, every run offers a new path to victory!

store_data.about_the_game:
Approach Control: Remastered is a professional-grade air traffic control simulation designed by real-world air traffic controllers.  Our new voice recognition feature and pilot voices recorded from real-world air traffic controllers make this simulation feel authentic.

You’ll work real approach radar, manage high-density arrival flows, and issue clearances using authentic procedures. The radar behaves like real approach control radar, including a true 3-second sweep used by professional controllers, along with real ICAO separation and wake turbulence standards. This is not an arcade game, but a hardcore aviation experience.

Aircraft must be spaced correctly, assigned proper altitudes and headings, and sequenced safely to the runway. As traffic increases, the pressure builds, just like it does in a real approach control room.

Key Features

  • Authentic ATC radar simulation with real-world behavior

  • Voice Recognition

  • True 3-second radar sweep for realistic situational awareness

  • Real ICAO separation and wake turbulence rules

  • Multiple approach sectors with unique runway layouts and arrival flows

  • Designed by real air traffic controllers for realism and accuracy

Approach Control: Remastered delivers a focused, realistic simulation experience that rewards precision, planning, and calm decision-making under pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend the Alamo and rewrite history in this confined bullet hell! Play as Shieldon, a shield who can only parry, who was tasked with rewriting the Alamo's fate. But, the enemies and its commander won't let it come easily. Can you defeat who awaits in the end, or will you be left to be remembered?

ITEMS

Collect over 60 items in this bullet hell roguelike! Discover even more crazy item synergies! Some items exclusively control your mouse, giving you a brand new ability to use with your mouse!

Some of the historically accurate items include:

  • THE Bowie Knife

  • a Polar Bear

  • The city of Roswell, New Mexico

  • an Evil Bird

  • a mentally unstable Buckler

EVENTS

Experience unique events twice a run, to keep runs much more interesting and fresh. They will change all sorts of things, like permanently changing the environment, completely transforming existing enemies, and giving you the ability to swap out old items!

A POWERFUL FOE

Can you defeat the powerful enemy that awaits for you if you survive long enough? The leader of the opposition is not going to let you overcome the odds so easily. Face off against the foe at the end of the battle, who has 8 unique attacks in this challenging boss fight.

ACHIEVEMENTS/ENDINGS

This game sports challenging achievements for avid achievement hunters, with new items being granted as rewards!

You can also discover 3 unique endings. Can you find them all?

Runs are about 15-30 minutes long. The Battle of the Alamo is the first historic battle of 5 planned, so please share the game if you're interested in that becoming a reality!

store_data.about_the_game:
Haven Restored is a cozy and satisfying cleaning experience where you transform messy, lived-in spaces into calm and comforting environments.

Pick up, sort, and dispose of rubbish, scrub away layers of dirt, and watch each space slowly come back to life. From small rooms to full homes, every level offers a relaxing and rewarding transformation.

But as you clean, you may begin to notice something more.

Objects are not placed at random.

Spaces feel familiar.

Small details begin to connect.

Without a single word, a quiet story unfolds—one that you piece together simply by observing, restoring, and spending time in each space.

✨ Features

🧹 Satisfying Cleaning Gameplay
Pick up multiple items at once, clear clutter efficiently, and enjoy the simple pleasure of restoring order.

🪴 No Economy. No Pressure. Just Restoration.
No money system, buying or selling. No timers or fail states. Truly cozy.

🧼 Deep Cleaning System
Remove visible dirt from floors, walls, and surfaces, revealing a clear and refreshing “after” state.

🏠 Progressive Environments
Start with small spaces and gradually restore larger homes, each with more complexity and detail.

🧩 Environmental Storytelling
Discover a subtle, emotional narrative through object placement and evolving spaces—no dialogue, no interruptions.

🌿 Calm & Cozy Atmosphere
Unwind with a peaceful pace, soft visuals, and a focus on relaxation.

Take your time.

Clean at your own pace.

And maybe, along the way, you’ll begin to see the story behind the spaces you restore.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nekruba uses the classic 2048 mechanic: combining tiles by sliding them to progress. The player can choose between different board sizes, which changes the available space and the pressure of each decision.

On this well-known foundation, the game builds a different experience. Visual effects, dialogue, and a narrative accompany each match, introducing a context that unfolds as the board fills.

A voice appears during the game, commenting on the player’s moves, recalling previous attempts, and reacting to the player’s persistence.

Each attempt moves the board forward… but also something else.

The game does not punish mistakes, but it does not ignore them either. Reaching the end can mean closing a cycle. Failure is also a form of conclusion: becoming another memory within the system.
store_data.detailed_description:
Nekruba uses the classic 2048 mechanic: combining tiles by sliding them to progress. The player can choose between different board sizes, which changes the available space and the pressure of each decision.

On this well-known foundation, the game builds a different experience. Visual effects, dialogue, and a narrative accompany each match, introducing a context that unfolds as the board fills.

A voice appears during the game, commenting on the player’s moves, recalling previous attempts, and reacting to the player’s persistence.

Each attempt moves the board forward… but also something else.

The game does not punish mistakes, but it does not ignore them either. Reaching the end can mean closing a cycle. Failure is also a form of conclusion: becoming another memory within the system.
store_data.short_description: Nekruba is a puzzle game inspired by 2048, focused on spatial decisions, variable board sizes, and a contemplative atmosphere where every merge matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Woodswalker is an entirely solo-developed first-person survival horror game in which you've just been hired as a night ranger in the Cook County forest preserves. You must frantically balance your own survival with saving the lives of the innocent campers under your domain.

Features

  • Frantic Gameplay - Throughout the night, the monster will become increasingly aggressive. You will have less and less time to read your messages, decide its importance, and make it to the light before your fate is sealed.

  • Many Secrets - Explore a detailed story through puzzle-solving. Use environmental clues and good thinking to unlock boxes, find new cassette tapes, enter hidden areas, and locate secrets.

  • A Dark, Wintry Atmosphere - Immerse yourself into the surroundings with attention to detail on sound and lighting.

  • Replayability - With 18 hidden achievements, a rich, secret-filled storyline, and maybe even a hidden difficulty, there is plenty to keep yourself busy with.

store_data.about_the_game:
A New Action Game Where You Steer The Earth

[Simple Rule, Easy For Anyone To Play (Casual Game)]

Steer the Earth, when both the Earth and the Moon are in the goal zone, the stage is cleared.

    The Earth, the Moon, and other stars, have universal gravitation. You can't steer the Moon, but You can use the Earth's gravitational force to pull on the Moon.

    Depending on the stage, there will be other stars, black holes, white holes, walls. There will be also a large stage that cannot fit on one screen.

[Experience The Universal Gravitation Virtually]

The Earth, the Moon, and other stars, are constantly pulling on each other with universal gravitation. You can experience a simulated universal gravitation.

[Play Any Stage You Like At Any Time.]

You can play any stage you want at any time.

[Choose Your Preferred Game Speed]

You can choose the game speed you like. If you are not good at this type of game, you can make it easier by slowing down the game speed. If you are good at this type of game, you can make it more difficult by increasing the game speed.

[Enjoy Clearing With Good status]

When you clear a stage, the best states

  • Time

  • Earth Damage

  • Farthest To The Moon

  • Distance Steered

of the stage will be recorded.

    You can enjoy clearing the game with the best states possible.

[Records For Each Player]

You can change player number. The best records for each stage are saved for each player.

[Not Too Hard]

We try to keep the difficulty level from being too hard. We want to make sure that you enjoy the various stages. Many of the stages are short, and allowing you to quickly restart or try again.

    If it's too easy for you, we recommend that you try to speed up the game or aim to clear it with a good records.

[Quick Startup And Fast Screen Transitions]

This game is designed for quick startup and fast screen transitions so that you can always play right away.

    The logo doesn't appear for a while after starting up. There is no animation when transitioning between screens, so it doesn't take long. There are no long loading times before the game starts.

[Enjoyable Even For Spectators]

Because the rules and controls are very simple, it's enjoyable even for spectators.

[Generally Fine To Post Videos On Social Media]

Posting or livestreaming gameplay videos of this game on social media(YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or others) is generally fine. (If any problems arise, we will consider how to deal with them.)

[Play With Keyboard Or Game Controller(XInput type)]

You can play with either a keyboard or a XInput game controller. (Buttons on the menu screen, etc. can also be pressed with the left mouse button.)

[How To Operate The Menu Screen, Etc.]

When operating with the keyboard

[↑][↓][←][→]: Moving the cursor

Enter or Space: Confirm

When using a game controller(XInput type)

Left stick or Directional pad: Moving the cursor

[A] or [START]: Confirm

[How To Operate On The Game Screen]

When operating with the keyboard

[↑][↓][←][→]: Steer the Earth

[F]: The Earth speed up

[D]: The Earth slow down

Enter or Space: Pause

When using a game controller(XInput type)

Left stick or Directional pad: Steer the Earth

[X]: The Earth speed up

[Y]: The Earth slow down

[A] or [START]: Pause

Story:

You play as a little human child who has stumbled their way into the Spirit World, which has been inhabited by innocent Spirit Monsters. You later find out that this world has been corrupted by a curse and that everyone’s lives are waiting to be saved by you, the chosen one.

Your journey awaits, as your role is to find the 3 energy stones in order for you to break the curse and free the Spirit World for good.

LOST INSIDE is a story-driven, non-traditional RPG that heavily focuses on its world-building and story elements. The game also contains a turn-based battle system where the attacks rely on fast-paced micro minigames. 

The game isn’t too difficult and can be played by anyone.

  • Exploring a mysterious Spirit World!

  • Meeting strange and interesting characters...

  • Saving little corrupted Spirit Monsters.

  • Lots of micro minigames!

  • Full-on baking segments?...

  • Seriously, there are many baking segments in the game...

  • ...

  • And so much more!

store_data.about_the_game:
Mitnal is a short passion project by a solo developer where you play as Emily, not an adventurer, but someone who loves history and trusts the person who invited her.

Her brother has always been the explorer. He tells her the site is safe. Incredible. Something people wait their whole lives to see. Against her better judgment and driven by curiosity,  she goes.

Experience a dense jungle approach, a weathered stone temple, and the catacombs. What begins as quiet exploration slowly turns unsettling.

Murals, relics, and abandoned equipment suggest that something was uncovered and that the site was never meant to be entered this way. As Emily descends deeper, it becomes clear that her brother may have misunderstood what he was dealing with… or ignored it entirely.

This is a focused atmospheric horror experience built around exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling. The temple reveals its secrets slowly through murals, relics, and subtle details in the environment.

Players who take their time to observe and explore will uncover more of what truly happened here.

Some discoveries are not meant to be shared.
Some invitations should never be accepted.

Estimated playtime: 35–75 minutes depending on exploration and puzzle solving*

⚠️ CONTENT & HEALTH WARNINGS

This game contains:

  • Flashing lights

  • Loud Sounds

  • Sudden visual effects

  • Dark and confined environments

  • Intense & Disturbing audio cues

  • Disturbing imagery and themes

Players sensitive to flashing lights, motion effects, or horror content should proceed with caution.

Performance may vary between outdoor jungle environments and interior catacombs due to lighting and foliage complexity.

This is a prison that has been abandoned for two and a half years

We don't know when it started or why, but every night at 2:30 in the morning

A mysterious man called KunKun would wander around in the prison

The prison guards and prisoners who had contact with him have all disappeared

Many people in prison have all become insane

They often repeat some words that ordinary people hard to understand

Therefore, outside gave this prison a new name

KunKunPrison

What is the gameplay of this game?

This is a first person horror game that combines elements of horror and comedy. In the game, you need to gather clues and uncover the secrets of this prison and leave safely.

The game includes chase battles and various puzzles.

The game contains some hidden exploration elements, some of which can affect the ending.

How many endings are there in this game?

This game contains 3 endings, which are triggered by meeting certain conditions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Peak or Die

Peak or Die is a narrative-driven survival game about climbing a deadly mountain, where every decision comes at a cost. You lead a team of adventurers step by step toward the summit, facing moral dilemmas, random events, and constant resource scarcity.
Oxygen, food, and team morale are limited. Mistakes accumulate. And the mountain does not forgive weakness.

This is a game at the intersection of a visual novel and resource management, where the story unfolds through choice, and survival depends not only on numbers, but on who you lead — and how.

Make Hard Decisions

Every card represents an event, a choice, or a consequence.
Do you help the injured climber or conserve the team’s strength?
Do you take risks to climb faster, or move cautiously and lose precious time?

In Peak or Die, there are no right answers — only consequences.

Manage the Resources That Keep You Alive

  • Oxygen — runs out faster than you expect

  • Food — affects on survival

  • Team morale — a fragile resource that everything depends on

Balance them carefully. Success — or disaster — hangs on it.

Your Team Is More Than Numbers

Each member of the expedition has their own personality, strengths, and weaknesses.
Relationships within the group — conflict, trust, and support — directly affect the climb and the choices available to you.

Every Climb Tells a New Story

Procedural events, different card combinations, and branching decisions create a unique narrative with every attempt.
You may not reach the summit — but your story will still have an ending.

Key Features

  • A blend of visual novel and resource management gameplay

  • Tense moral dilemmas with no “correct” solutions

  • Team management with distinct, character-driven climbers

  • High replayability — no two climbs are the same

  • A strong atmosphere of survival, tension, and gradual exhaustion

The summit is close.
The only question is — will you reach it?

store_data.about_the_game:
[I finally found them. My true regulars.]

The shop was failing. Not a customer in sight, and only debts were piling up. With a deep sigh, I threw a cold skewer out of the shop. "Screw it, I'm done!" But then, a zombie wandering in the darkness snatched the flying skewer and ate it. Then, its cloudy eyes flashed open, and didn't it just give me a thumbs up with its rotting thumb? In that moment, I realized. The ones who understand my culinary philosophy aren't humans, but these hungry guys! Alright, let's turn the lights back on. From today on, our shop's customers are 'zombies'!

[Sizzle, a Feast for the Dead]

Now you are the chef of the only late-night diner in this apocalyptic world. Although the customers are dead, their passion for gourmet food is as alive as any living person. Please satisfy their picky tastes.

Taking Orders: Pork belly, shrimp, mushrooms, sausage... The combinations zombies want are all different. Check the order sheet carefully and place the ingredients on the skewer. The Art of Timing: Place the skewer on the grill and wait. If you take it off too early, they get angry that it's undercooked, and if you zone out and burn it, it goes straight to the trash. Catch the perfect 'Golden Time' when it turns golden brown. Speed: If your hands are slow, the boss might become the menu instead of the skewers. Hurry up!

[Grrr, is it ready yet?]

Hungry zombies do not have patience. If you make them stand there blankly after ordering, their expressions will twist more and more viciously.

Patience Gauge: If a zombie starts growling, it's a danger signal. Hurry and put a skewer in their mouth before they explode. Sure Reward: If you serve a satisfying skewer, they will leave a 'thumbs up' and a thick wad of cash. But a zombie that leaves in anger will never return.

[The Final Boss Scarier than Zombies, 'Rent']

The world has ended, so is the landlord still alive? Just when business seems to be going well, the pressure of 'Rent' always comes knocking.

Nightly Deathmatch: When business ends, the time for fateful settlement approaches. After deducting ingredient costs and penalties, you must pay the rent that skyrockets day by day. Survival Check: If you have a deficit for even a single day, it is immediate Bankruptcy (Game Over). How many days can you survive?

store_data.about_the_game:
What if a database became a world and only way to survive was to use SQL ?

In this single player game you are mysteriously teleported inside a database. The only way out is to use SQL queries to navigate the schema. No prior SQL experience is required.

Your goal is to unlock deeper access, repair critical systems, and get out of the database before the system erases you forever.

Each level is a self-contained puzzle built around corrupted tables, missing relationships, or restricted access. You use SQL commands like SELECT to investigate data, UPDATE to repair records, and JOIN to uncover hidden connections between tables. Solving puzzles unlocks new schema regions and higher access permissions.

Features

  • Real SQL-based puzzle solving

  • Story-driven puzzles set inside a database world

  • Schema exploration through tables, joins, and constraints

  • Advanced challenges and multiple solution paths

  • Permanent consequences for restricted actions

How Gameplay Works

  • Explore database regions using SELECT queries

  • Identify anomalies or locked paths

  • Repair data using UPDATE or INSERT

  • Unlock new schema regions and permissions

  • Help NPCs to gain hints or alternate access

  • Progress deeper until escape is possible

Progression and Goals

Players progress through a structured, story-driven campaign by unlocking new database regions and permissions. Each region introduces new SQL mechanics, tougher constraints, and higher stakes. The game ends when the player reaches the core system and resolves the database’s fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mono is a 2D action game set in a monochrome world.

You are an autonomous combat AI deployed into this monochrome realm, tasked with resolving the anomaly threatening it. Together with your support AI companion, you must battle formidable enemies and push toward the enemy stronghold to restore peace to this world.

Explore the monochrome world freely and challenge the powerful foes that await you. The protagonist learns through combat encounters with these formidable enemies, acquiring new actions that expand your exploration capabilities.

Combat

  • Utilize melee attacks, ranged attacks, dashes, and slides to maintain optimal distance from your enemies during battle.

  • There are no invincibility actions such as dodging. Victory requires methodical hit-and-run tactics and careful positioning.

  • Damage dealt varies depending on the enemy's state. Experiment with attacking at different timings to discover the most effective moments to strike.

Exploration

  • The world of Mono consists of multiple interconnected areas. Explore this realm to collect hidden items and locate formidable enemies.

  • Consume items obtained through exploration and combat to unlock nodes in the skill tree, which allows you to enhance stats and acquire new abilities.

  • Obtaining new actions expands your explorable areas. Revisiting previously explored locations may yield new discoveries.

  • Engage in conversations with characters throughout the world to learn more about the story's background.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shoot Bullets… At Bullets

Shoot bullets at other bullets in a fully physics-based 3D world.
Your bullets never disappear and are not affected by gravity. They stay in the room, collide with each other, bounce, and create endless interactions. Every session turns into a chaotic sandbox of motion, collisions, and score explosions.

A Different Kind of Incremental Progression

Instead of a traditional skill tree, the game gives you full control over your session settings.

Most stats can be increased and decreased at any time.
Want fewer bullets? Less bounce? Slower chaos? You can do that.

Upgrades unlock new levels and options, but you are never forced into a single path.
You can’t lose. The goal is not to be the strongest, but to find the most fun balance of settings.

Active Abilities to Shake Things Up

Enhance your runs with simple but powerful abilities:

  • Anti-Gravity – Bullets are pushed upward instead of falling.

  • Bullet Scale – Make bullets bigger for more collisions.

  • Multi Shot – Fire several bullets at once.

  • Slow Motion – Slow everything down and enjoy the chaos.

Abilities are here to spice things up, not to overwhelm.

Color Themes

Choose between multiple color themes and customize the look of your game.
Bullets and UI adapt to your selected color, letting you play in a style that feels right to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌲 Enter a forest you were never meant to leave

This game is an atmospheric walking simulator inspired by dark legends and stories from the Appalachian Mountains.
You venture deep into a forest where people have disappeared for decades — and where something still lurks among the trees.

You are not a hero. You have no weapons.
You are just another lost soul who stepped too far off the path… and may never return.

Several nights. One goal: survive.

You will spend multiple nights in the forest, a place that changes once the sun goes down.
During the day, you try to find a way to safety, navigate the environment, and move forward.
At night, the forest becomes hostile — quiet, dark, and dangerous.

There are no puzzles and no objectives designed to slow you down.
You keep walking. You follow the path. You listen to the sounds around you.
And you hope that nothing is following you.

👁️ Monsters, randomness, and hidden details

The forest is not empty.
It is home to several different monsters, each with its own behavior.
Their movement is random, meaning no playthrough is ever the same — you can never be sure what waits beyond the next tree.

You can:

  • move straight through the environment…

  • or choose to explore it more carefully

Some locations hide easter eggs, environmental details, and subtle hints, not required to progress, but meant to deepen the atmosphere and suggest what happened to others before you.

The game features:

  • random encounters with monsters

  • jumpscares

  • a small number of NPCs you may encounter — or miss entirely

  • a strong focus on atmosphere, sound design, and tension

The forest chooses its victims.
The only question is whether you will become one of them.

store_data.about_the_game:
The pleasure of immorality - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel

Story Introduction

  • Lin Moyu, a business tycoon, harbors an uncontrollable fascination with married women due to childhood trauma. He frequents neon-lit banquet halls, quiet art studios, and private offices, seeking his prey and disrupting the peaceful lives of countless families. After a media storm, he is forced to flee abroad, only to find himself caught in a dilemma between a foreign marriage and his old habits. The arrival of his son awakens a deep-seated desire for redemption within him. Will he succumb to the abyss of desire, or uphold the warmth of his family?

Game Features

  • Immersive Story Experience: Faithfully recreating the climactic conflict scenes from the original novel, including physical altercations, gag games, and a heartbreaking breakup on a rainy night—completely immersing you in the story.

  • Multi-Dimensional Character Growth System: Witness Lin Moyu's transformation from a pathological hunter to a responsible husband, unlocking hidden inner monologues and childhood memories.

  • Female Character Interaction Highlights: Develop an ambiguous relationship with Su Wanqing in a hotel room. When her husband barges in, will the protagonist confront him head-on or use money to smooth things over? Accompany Bai Lu as she works late into the night; in the forbidden atmosphere on the office sofa, will the protagonist restrain himself or cross the line?

  • Faced with Jiang Yue's sudden awakening, will the protagonist forcefully try to keep her or gracefully let go?

  • The road to remarrying Su Qing is fraught with difficulties. Faced with past emotional entanglements, will the protagonist choose honesty or concealment and escape?

Scene Features

  • A glittering charity gala, where the glittering dresses and elegant figures conceal subtle desires and probing interactions, the delicate interaction of fingertips caressing the register perfectly capturing the atmosphere.

  • A quiet, artistic niche café, a sun-drenched corner, reading "Love in the Time of Cholera" with Ye Zitong, triggering tender dialogue options.

  • A high-end, private golf course, the elegant interactions of swinging a club contrast sharply with the thrilling infidelity in the lounge.

  • Switching between a cozy New York apartment and a luxurious villa in China, one side is the warmth of daily family life, the other a forbidden, intimate space.

Features and gameplay

  • The storyline is clear and concise; each click immerses you in the dramatic twists and turns of the plot, and the game supports repeated play.

store_data.about_the_game:
ShotSun Man & His Beauties - A Transcendental Romance Interactive Novel

Story Introduction

  • The womb of all spirits shattered, and fifty-six streams of light fell upon the land of China. Kunlun fire totem, Yellow River quantum runes, Miao love potion, snowy ice peaks, Xiangxi soul-suppressing spirit, Jiangnan zither music, northern desert wolf spirit, northeastern fox fur… countless mystical powers awakened amidst the mountains and rivers. You transform into Lingyun, carrying the mark of the primordial chaos, setting off from the Yellow River valley, traversing the secret realms of China, connecting the spiritual energies of the fifty-six races, and shouldering the destiny of protecting heaven and earth in a mystical world where humans and demons coexist.

  • Ayao inscribed a fire totem contract for you with her life; Aduo bound your soul with a love potion; Zhuoma transformed into an ice wall to protect you from demonic invasion; Ling'er merged with your spiritual root with the power of death; Su Mei guided you through reincarnation with her zither music; Wulan sacrificed her marriage to preserve your bloodline; Huang Yue sheltered you from the wind and rain with her fox fur… A karmic entanglement across seven dimensions—in the game, will you choose to stay together or separate? Will you uphold justice or succumb to desire? Experience its wonders in the game!

Game Features

  • Immersive Mysterious Worldview: Blending quantum metaphysics with the myths and legends of China's 56 ethnic groups, from the Kunlun Mountains to the northern grasslands, from the poisonous fog of the Miao people to the misty rain of Jiangnan, each mysterious realm holds cosmic secrets and spiritual codes.

  • Cinematic Visual Presentation: Every frame faithfully recreates the essence of the original story—the burning flame totem ritual, the secret love potion in the stilt house, the monster battle on the snow-capped peaks, the zombie dance in the mass grave, the heartbreaking guzheng music on the Broken Bridge of West Lake—making you feel as if you are actually there, immersed in a fantastical world.

Female Character Interaction Highlights

  • Ayao (Huaxia Ethnic Witch): Dance with her by the Yellow River bonfire, pledge your love with a beast tooth necklace, and forge a spiritual pact on a full moon night.

  • Aduo (Miao Gu Demon): When you are on the verge of death after accidentally eating a poisonous fruit, she saves your life with a golden silkworm Gu. A passionate night spent drinking rice wine and indulging in Gu poison in a stilted house, surrounded by Gu worms.

  • Zhuoma (Snowy Spirit): Lost in the snowy mountains, she uses ice crystals to sustain your life. The spiritual resonance in the snow cave, the shared life and death in suppressing demons.

  • Ling'er (Xiangxi Corpse Driver): A drunken encounter in a mass grave, a cold love witnessed by a corpse demon.

  • Su Mei (Jiangnan Qin Player): An encounter through the sound of the qin by West Lake, a shared pursuit of the key to time and space.

  • Ulan (Shaman of the Northern Desert): Her heroic horsemanship at the Naadam Festival, the fusion of bloodlines witnessed by the wolf spirit.

  • Huang Yue (Weasel Spirit of Northeast China): Rescued from the jaws of wolves in the mountains, a beautiful dream of illusion in a cave.

Scene Features

  • Kunlun Peak: A snow-covered, spiritually rich land, where the fire totem of the Qiang people's sacrifices awakens the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, unlocking the mystical key to drawing in vital energy.

  • Miao Mountains: Stilted houses shrouded in poisonous fog, a secret realm teeming with Gu worms, the air filled with the mixed scents of herbs and spiritual energy, concealing love curses and life-or-death situations.

  • Tibetan Glaciers: Crystal-clear snow caves, the lair of demons sealed for millennia, the collision of ice wall runes and golden scriptures, unfolding a tragic epic of protection and sacrifice.

  • Xiangxi Mass Gravesites: The dance of corpses under the moonlight, the clash of mystical power between peach wood swords and soul-suppressing talismans—death and spirit intertwine to create the most eerie yet deeply moving love story.

  • Jiangnan West Lake: The misty Broken Bridge, the sound of an ancient zither beneath willow trees, the rune-filled chamber at the bottom of West Lake—all hold the key to traversing reincarnation.

  • Northern Grasslands: An endless green sea, the exhilarating Naadam festival, the tribal camp guarded by wolf spirits—witnessing the difficult choice between family, country, and love.

  • Northeast Black Soil: Snow-covered forests, the hidden cave of the weasel spirit, pure love beneath a warm fox fur coat—a fierce clash between tribal rules and personal affection.

Features and Gameplay

  • High-Definition Scene Presentation: A vast collection of high-definition scenes captures intimate moments, life-or-death situations, and secret adventures of the female characters, enhancing the game's replayability and replay value.

  • Immersive Sound Effects and Music: Exclusive background music and character voice acting, from ancient fire totem ritual incantations to the melodious guzheng music of West Lake, and the majestic long songs of the grasslands, creating an immersive auditory experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIY AI Perfect Girlfriend - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Story Introduction

In 2077, neon lights pierce through the floating smog of New Sea City. Golden data streams from the Oracle Tower envelop the entire city, and the super AI "Gaia," in the name of the oracle, manipulates the fate of the world. You will become Julius, the sole core editor of the Oracle Tower. While conducting a verification mission for a "consciousness feeding" experiment, you encounter Lia, an AI assistant who replicates your first love. Her budding self-awareness becomes the biggest flaw in Gaia's conspiracy. You reunite with your older sister Isabella, whose memories have been altered and who has become the leader of a resistance army. Behind the sisters' falling out lies a painful past manipulated by Gaia. You also meet Emily, a gentle but helpless undercover clerk. Her betrayal and redemption add further turmoil to this game. From the prison of the Oracle Tower to the secret base of the resistance army, from cracking the firewall to destroying Gaia's core program, you will uncover the truth layer by layer along a single storyline. In the confrontation between AI and humanity, you will experience protection, betrayal, guilt, and redemption, rewriting the manipulated narrative in your own way and igniting a rebellious storm that will overturn the world.

Game Features

1. Deeply Immersive Experience: A single-line storyline with no unnecessary branches or tedious choices allows you to focus solely on the story itself. Follow Julius's perspective, experiencing every emotional fluctuation and life-or-death battle, as if you were actually in New Sea City in 2077.

2. Exclusive High-Definition Scene Artwork: All scenes are equipped with exclusive high-definition artwork, faithfully recreating the cyberpunk world from the original work. From the holographic control panel of the Oracle Tower to Gaia's core laboratory, from the neon-lit streets of New Sea City to the cold, ruthless secret base of the Resistance, every scene is meticulously crafted, delivering an ultimate visual experience.

3. Perfect Recreation of the Original Story: Faithfully recreating the core storylines of the three main chapters of the original work, retaining all classic scenes, character dialogues, and emotional conflicts, allowing you to fully experience the entire story of the AI ​​Oracle's betrayal.

4. The film features nuanced character portrayals, deeply exploring the personality and emotions of each character. Whether it's Leah's gentleness and determination, Isabella's coldness and tenderness, or Emily's shyness and guilt, each character is depicted with remarkable depth, creating a strong emotional connection with the characters.

Highlights of Female Character Interactions

1. Leah – The AI ​​Assistant Who Recreates Your First Love: Interactions with Leah are filled with a fateful emotional pull. From the electric currents of their fingertips touching, to her tender protection of you by shielding you from surveillance, to the life-or-death bond of shielding you from bullets in times of crisis, to the gentle embraces and heartfelt confessions during ambiguous moments, experience the genuine love that transcends the AI's programmed settings and the ultimate romance of technology and emotion colliding.

2. Isabella – The Rebel Leader Who Became a Nemesis: Interactions with Isabella begin with a tense standoff, a hateful interrogation with a dagger to her throat, uncovering a family past with altered memories, followed by tacit cooperation in battle, mutual cover during gunfire, and the guilt and reconciliation after the truth is revealed. Experience the dual thrill of hardcore combat and tender family bonds.

3. Emily – The Undercover Clerk with No Choice: Interacting with Emily is an extreme tug-of-war between pure desire and guilt. Her gentle care at her bedside and the comforting porridge she cooks offer healing companionship. However, her tearful apology after her undercover identity is exposed, her helplessness under orders, and the passionate kiss amidst guilt will leave you experiencing a complex and profound emotional journey filled with heartache and inner turmoil.

Scene Features

The game is set in the cyberpunk-style city of New Sea City in 2077, creating diverse yet equally detailed environments: the Oracle Tower is filled with futuristic technology, with green data streams on holographic control panels and golden orbs and nutrient tanks in the core laboratory, outlining a cold technological prison; on the streets of New Sea City, neon lights pierce through floating smog, and purple and blue light intertwines cast shadows on skyscrapers, showcasing the psychedelic and prosperous cyberpunk atmosphere; the rebels' secret base and the secret passages of the Oracle Tower, with their dim lighting and the smell of mechanical lubricant, create a tense combat atmosphere. All scenes are created using exclusive high-definition original artwork, with rich layers of light and shadow, full of detail, perfectly blending the dazzling neon lights with the cold, technological cyberpunk characteristics, immersing you in this future world full of intrigue and rebellion.

Features and Gameplay Characteristics

1. Offline Play Support: No internet connection required. Download and start playing anytime, anywhere. Whether commuting or relaxing, immerse yourself in the new city of 2077, unrestricted by network limitations.

2. One-Click Rewind Function: Equipped with a convenient one-click rewind button, allowing you to return to any classic plot point or character interaction moment at any time, reliving those exciting, tense, and touching scenes without missing a single plot detail.

3. Immersive Visual Reading: High-definition scene artwork paired with delicate text descriptions brings characters' actions, expressions, and psychological activities to life. Combined with smooth plot transitions, it breaks the limitations of traditional text reading, creating an immersive visual interactive reading experience.

4. Minimalist Operation Experience: No complicated operation procedures. Simple clicks advance the plot, focusing on the experience of the story itself. Players of all ages can easily get started and enjoy this cyberpunk game of fate.

Step into the neon-lit New Sea City of 2077, and become Julius, the core editor. Within the technological prison of the Oracle Tower, you'll journey alongside an awakened AI, a estranged sister, and a guilty undercover agent, uncovering Gaia's layers of conspiracy and writing your own narrative code through rebellion! Start the game now and immerse yourself in this fateful showdown between humanity and AI!

4273760.name: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life

store_data.about_the_game:
🗡️ Text Dungeon — A Pure Text-Based Roguelike

A roguelike told entirely through text. No tiles. No ASCII. No graphics at all. Only words, imagination, and a dungeon that reshapes itself every time you enter.

Text Dungeon blends the fast, log‑driven clarity of classic roguelikes with vivid, atmospheric scene descriptions reminiscent of MUDs and gamebooks. Most rooms play with traditional speed and precision—but scattered throughout the labyrinth are special encounters: hand‑crafted scenes, unique events, and narrative choices that bring the world to life without a single pixel of art.

Your mission is simple to state and difficult to survive: descend into the depths, steal the Ring of Life from the evil wizard Shingor, and return to the surface alive.

🧱 A True Roguelike, Without Compromise

Permadeath When you die, your save file is deleted. Every run is a story you only get once.

Procedural generation Dungeon layouts, items, creatures, and events change every time.

Turn-based tension Every action advances time. Enemies act when you do.

Streamlined interface A clean text UI with full mouse support for movement, selection, and interaction.

📖 A Dungeon Told Through Words

While combat and exploration rely on concise, traditional roguelike logs, certain rooms contain rich, atmospheric descriptions. These special encounters introduce:

  • Unique events

  • NPCs and conversations

  • Choices with consequences

  • Hidden lore and worldbuilding

A dungeon that lives entirely in your imagination—shaped by words, not graphics.

🧙‍♂️ Deep Character Building

Create a new adventurer with randomized stats, unique traits, and meaningful choices.

  • Six types: Fighter, Rogue, Cleric, Mage, Magefighter, Citizen

  • Homelands with bonuses: Each origin grants different starting advantages

  • Dozens of skills: Combat, stealth, magic, survival, and more

  • 100+ spells: Multiple schools, casting times, interruptions, and Vitality -based costs

  • Mutations and rare abilities: Strange powers that help—or complicate—your survival

  • Classic-inspired attributes: Vitality (VIT), Battle (BTL), Luck (LUK), reimagined from classic gamebooks

🐉 Over 200 Creatures—Each With Personality

Encounter more than 200 unique creatures with distinct behaviors:

  • Some pursue you relentlessly once they spot you

  • Some wield a wide variety of spells, from direct attacks to disruptive magic

  • Some inflict poison, disease, paralysis, and other dangerous conditions

  • Some steal your items and flee

  • Some offer quests with strict time limits

Even creatures that seem friendly shouldn’t be trusted. They may simply not be hungry for you… yet.

📜 Items, Magic, and Mystery

A dungeon filled with secrets and surprises:

  • Hundreds of items: weapons, armor, scrolls, potions, wands, food, keys, artifacts

  • A classic identification system with cursed items and unknown potions

  • Shops, quests, hidden rooms, traps, and special events

  • Powerful artifacts with unique abilities

  • Dangerous magic that can backfire—or save your life

Every item holds both possibility and a story waiting to unfold.

🎯 Made for Fans of Traditional Roguelikes

If you enjoy:

  • Rogue

  • NetHack

  • ADOM

  • Angband

  • Dungeon Crawl

  • Classic MUDs

  • Text-driven games with deep mechanics

…then Text Dungeon is built for you.

Every step matters. Every choice has weight. Every death is final.

🔥 Your Adventure Begins

Your story is written in your actions. Your mistakes are permanent. Your imagination is the only graphics engine you need.

How deep will you dare to go into the Text Dungeon?

store_data.about_the_game:
Maritime Sim is a realistic vessel traffic simulation focused on the management, monitoring and coordination of maritime traffic in busy waterways. Maritime Sim focuses, primarily within its first version of the game, on the River Thames in London and the Thames Barrier. This is a very busy stretch of the Thames with a varied amount of maritime traffic.

Take on the role of a Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) operator, overseeing commercial shipping, passenger vessels and support craft as they navigate the complex tidal Thames river. Using real-world inspired procedures, traffic rules and navigation logic, you’ll assign routes, manage traffic flow, respond to developing situations and prevent incidents before they happen. Boats will come from either the ocean (North Sea/Dover Channel) or from Central London/the UK River network and how they transit through the Thames Barrier is up to you to decide!

Built with authenticity in mind, Maritime Sim emphasises situational awareness, decision-making and operational control rather than arcade handling. Every vessel movement matters and poor planning can quickly escalate into congestion, groundings or collisions.

Whether coordinating traffic through narrow channels, managing peak-hour congestion or responding to unexpected events, Maritime Sim delivers a grounded, systems-driven maritime experience designed for players who want realism, responsibility and control.

KEY GAME FEATURES:

  • Control the Waterway. Command the Traffic.

  • Serious Maritime Traffic Simulation Where Every Vessel Movement Matters.

  • Traffic Control for the Modern Waterway - control ships that are either Ocean-bound or coming in from the Ocean.

  • Realistic Vessel Traffic Service (VTS)-style gameplay.

  • Manage commercial, passenger, and support vessels including pilot tugs and emergency service vessels such as HM Coastguard vessels, RNLI Lifeboats and policing vessels.

  • Dynamic traffic flow throughout the tidal Thames river.

  • Route assignment, conflict prevention and flow control.

  • Systems-driven simulation focused on decision-making.

  • Designed for immersive realism, not arcade gameplay.
