store_data.about_the_game:
River Runners is a cooperative multiplayer adventure where you and up to 3 friends must work together to survive a dangerous, ever-changing river. Each player occupies a single seat in the raft, controlling a paddle on their side. Only by paddling in sync can you effectively steer and stay on course. Communication is vital as you react to sudden obstacles, sharp turns, and unexpected events.

The river grows more dangerous as daylight fades. Time is a limited resource, and as the sun sets, visibility drops, making it harder to spot threats ahead. Along the journey, collect resources to purchase useful items and upgrades that improve your chances of survival. But beware—colliding with obstacles can damage the raft, tearing holes that must be patched quickly before it loses air. Strong teamwork, quick decisions, and clear communication are the key to making it to the end.

Work Together

Maneuvering the raft is not a one person job, everyone in the raft needs to coordinate to avoid obstacles and collect loot.  Clear communication and quick decisions are essential.

Avoid Crashing

Bumping into terrain and other obstacles floating in the river can puncture holes in the raft.

Patch Holes

Holes in the raft drain its air, too many holes for too long will sink your crew.

Collect Money

Collect chests floating in the river to turn in for money once you reach base camp.

Purchase Items

Purchase different items with the money you've collected at the start of each day to aid your team in their next day on the river, each one is harder than the last.

Have Fun

Explore the different twists, turns, and challenges that each leg of the river throws at you and your crew.

Features

  • Up to 4 players

  • Multiple legs of each river that build on your progress from the last

  • Online co-op (we don't recommend playing alone)

  • Cosmetics to customize your character

  • Randomized obstacles, each run presents different challenges

  • Multiple items to customize your approach to each run

  • Proximity voice chat

store_data.about_the_game:
You must dance. Dance, Detective!

Story 

It’s August 9th, 1986. You are Detective Gene Burning, sent undercover aboard a private cruise ship to solve a murder. Your only way in? Pose as the ship’s recreational ballroom dance teacher. Your job is to investigate the murder of Stephanie Delafontaine, chief science officer of the Bolero Chocolate Company. 

Suspects will waltz, tango, and cha-cha-cha their way into exposing their darkest secrets. Create custom dance choreographies, teach them how to dance on beat, and uncover hidden clues to reveal the real killer. Because sometimes the truth only comes out on the dance floor.

Game Features 

  • Play as an undercover detective solving a murder mystery

  • Meet a wacky cast of ghastly characters

  • Create dance choreographies by arranging dance moves to uncover secrets

  • Collect and combine clues to get closer to the truth

  • Includes a little rhythm minigame! Because you have to dance on beat!

  • Handmade pixel art inspired by DS and GBA classics

  • Designed by a certified ballroom dance teacher. Learn real ballroom dance moves!

  • Enjoy the cruise!

store_data.about_the_game:
Start from an empty shop and build the city's largest hardware empire.

In Hardware Simulator, you manage every daily process of a business firsthand. From product procurement to shelf arrangement, from sales to inventory tracking—every detail is shaped by your decisions.

Develop your business step by step with the revenue you earn; unlock new tools, increase your delivery and wholesale transport capacity, and expand your product range. In addition to customers visiting your physical store, take online orders, prepare them, and deliver to homes to grow your business volume.

The pricing system in the game has a dynamic structure. Set product prices according to market balance; if prices are too high, customers will abandon their purchases, while the right pricing policy increases your sales and popularity. Rising popularity means more customers and a busier order flow.

Realism isn't limited to business management alone. You also need to consider your character's basic needs such as hunger and thirst. Neglecting these needs during an intense work pace directly affects your efficiency and job performance.

The progression system is entirely based on your performance. Larger deliveries, improved products, and increased customer traffic come your way depending on how balanced, efficient, and strategic your management is.

With its high-quality and realistic graphics, step-by-step growth structure, and management-focused gameplay, Hardware Simulator offers a deep and satisfying simulation experience.

Set up your shop, make the right decisions, and become a successful hardware store owner.

🛠️ Detailed and realistic hardware store / business simulation
🏪 Physical store management and online order system
🚚 Delivery and logistics: Expand your delivery and wholesale transport capacity by purchasing different vehicles
💰 Dynamic pricing: Wrong prices mean lost customers

📦 Wide product range: Manage inventory tracking and product variety
🍔 Survival mechanics: Satisfy hunger, thirst, and bathroom needs
🏦 Bank and credit system: Take out loans to grow your business, pay your bills
🚨 Security management: Take precautions against thieves entering your store
🧹 Cleaning and maintenance: A dirty store means lost customers
🔓 Level and reward system: Progress based on performance, unlock new content
🛒 Product development: Increase variety and profitability by unlocking new products
🎨 High-quality and realistic graphics: Immersive and detailed visual experience

store_data.about_the_game:
The Honest Little Fisher
A cozy fishing adventure

The Honest Little Fisher is a charming fishing adventure focused on calm exploration, steady progression, and the joy of discovering the sea.

Set sail across a peaceful ocean world, catch fish, sell your haul, upgrade your boat and equipment, and gradually build your fishing life. Play at your own pace and enjoy a relaxing experience designed to feel rewarding without pressure.

Discover 1,500+ Real Fish Species

This is more than a fishing game. It is also a living ocean encyclopedia.

  • Over 1,500 real fish species to discover

  • Each fish includes scientific names, classification, and fun facts

  • A growing in-game Fish Collection that tracks your discoveries.

If you enjoy collecting, learning, and completing journals, this game is made for you.

A Fisher’s Journey

Explore, catch, sell, upgrade, and discover.

  • Explore a wide ocean filled with islands, reefs, and fishing spots

  • Catch fish of different rarities, from common species to legendary finds

  • Sell your catch and invest in better boats, gear, and supplies

  • Upgrade your fishing life and reach new heights

  • Complete your Fish Collection and master the sea

Build Your Fishing Life

Start small and grow over time.

  • Unlock and sail different boats, each with its own strengths

  • Improve your fishing with upgradable equipment and tools

  • Prepare for longer journeys with food and supplies

Progress is steady, meaningful, and awesome.

A Living Ocean World

The sea is full of places and surprises.

  • Visit multiple islands and ports

  • Encounter dynamic events such as treasures and sharks

  • Navigate reefs, changing conditions

  • Enjoy a calm atmosphere designed for relaxed exploration

Every journey offers something new to discover.

Play Your Way

Choose a relaxed experience or add light challenge through optional difficulty settings.

The Honest Little Fisher is designed to be family-friendly and accessible, while still offering depth for dedicated players who enjoy progression and completion.

Features at a Glance

  • Cozy ocean exploration

  • 1,500+ real fish species with facts and scientific classification

  • Growing in-game Fish Collection

  • Boats, gear, and meaningful progression

  • Dynamic ocean events and discoveries

  • Food and supply system for longer trips

  • Full localization in German, English, and Spanish

Made With Care

The Honest Little Fisher is a passion project created with love and attention to detail. It is calming, welcoming, and enjoyable for players of all ages.

  • Use stealth, positioning, and firearms to survive encounters

store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval Decklords is a roguelike card game which focus on 3-card poker gameplay.

Core Mechanics

  • Three-Lane Board: Matches take place across the Left Flank, Center, and Right Flank. Each lane is evaluated independently to determine a winner.

  • Poker-Based Scoring: Players play exactly three cards per lane to form hands.

  • Deck Management: The deck consists of 40 cards featuring standard suits and numbers 1–10.

  • Match Constraints: Each match consists of four turns.

Progression and Upgrades

  • League Structure: Each season includes 18 total duels to determine ranking and tournament progress.

  • Currency and Upgrades: Players earn silver coins based on match results.

  • Card Improvement: Spend 5 silver coins to upgrade any of the 40 cards in your deck once per season. Upgrades reset each season, though top-ranked players may retain a limited number of improvements for future sessions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Charmcraft Idle 🪄

Charmcraft Idle is a cozy, whimsical idle / incremental game about running a magical shop in a colorful fantasy world. Gather resources from forests, mines, and gardens, transform them through crafting disciplines, and sell enchanted goods at your own pace, whether you’re actively clicking or letting your shop run itself.

Start hands-on, clicking to collect, craft, and sell. As your shop grows, hire skilled staff to automate every step and keep progress flowing even while you’re away.

🌲 Gather From a Magical World

Collect raw materials from multiple locations:

  • Forests filled with fantastical trees

  • Mines rich with crystals and precious metals

  • Gardens where magical plants grow with unique properties

  • Exploration areas that hide familiars and artifacts

🧙‍♀️ Run a Witch’s Shop

Craft and sell a wide variety of magical goods, including:

  • Enchanted scrolls and runes

  • Carved wands and flying broomsticks

  • Crystals and fine jewelry

  • Brewed potions made from garden-grown ingredients

  • Sewn robes, cloaks, and pointed hats

  • Discovered familiars and rare artifacts

Each product comes from distinct resources and crafting skills, creating layered progression that grows more complex over time.

🔮 Learn, Craft, and Improve

  • Study to unlock new enchantments

  • Level up skills to improve speed and efficiency

  • Upgrade resources and crafted goods to increase output and value

  • Equip the items you craft when you go out exploring to improve your expedition results

  • Expand storage to support a growing operation

The more you learn, the more powerful your shop becomes.

👥 Automate With Staff

Hire workers to handle gathering, crafting, and selling for you.

  • Assign staff to specific tasks

  • Unlock offline progress through automation

  • Focus on planning while your shop runs itself

Start click-heavy, then gradually transition into a fully automated magical enterprise.

✨ Features

  • Idle / incremental gameplay with manual and automated progression

  • Deep crafting systems with multiple disciplines

  • Magical resource gathering across themed locations

  • Hire-able staff and offline progress

  • Cozy, colorful, witchy aesthetic

  • A bright, whimsical art style with all hand-drawn artwork (Turn off "Bright Backgrounds" in the settings menu if you find the game too bright, or the text too difficult to read)

Floral Fury Online is a seed‑centric, physics‑driven MMORPG built in Unity 6.
Magic isn’t a hotbar cooldown — your inventory is your spellbook.
Every projectile is a Seed you must collect, craft, and physically throw.

🌿 CORE PILLAR: SEED = AMMO
Finite but renewable power. Run out of ammo? Switch to the Universal Basic Seed (infinite).
Upgrade seeds, fuse them, and trade them in a true player economy.

🏹 PHYSICS‑BASED COMBAT

  • Gravity and distance matter; aim your Seed Thrower like a real weapon.

  • Dodge and hit by skill, not by tab‑targeting.

  • Customizable Seed Thrower parts: Focus, Core, Heart.

🔥 14 ELEMENTS & COMBOS
4 Base: Fire, Water, Earth, Air
7 Hybrid: Lightning, Ice, Nature, Magma, Toxic, Metal, Shadow
3 Apex: Absolute Zero, Mutation, Cataclysm
Elements combine dynamically for damage bonuses and debuffs.

⚔️ PVE & PVP

  • Procedural Dungeons with bosses and rare loot.

  • PvP Arena: 1v1 Duel, 5v5, FFA.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lichworks is a necromancer-themed automation strategy game where you play as a lich who seeks to bend the world around him to his will through the use of his undead minions, who serve both as his loyal soldiers and as the backbone of his logistical network. Organize your minions with signposts and magical tomes, automate production chains, equip and upgrade your minions to claim dominion over the Human Empire.

 Features:

  Unique Minions: From durable zombies to speedy wraiths who can phase through obstacles.

  Automated production: Build out your base to harvest, craft and summon minions automatically.

  Forge swords, shields, and hats for your minions to augment their abilities and stats.

  Build walled fortifications, gates and defensive towers to protect your operations from incoming hero raids.

  Discover and wield power magics to support your minions in battle, or sacrifice them for your own power.

  Wage war against the many heroes and the loyal soldiers they lead into battle, wielding their own sets of abilities and tactics.

  Co-op multiplayer: build and conquer together with friends.

Minion Logistics:

Minions follow the path of placed signposts by the player to create loops. When placed next to buildings, this creates a link that allows for automated logistics. Leverage each minion's unique skills to optimize production chains and unlock new tactics on the front-lines of combat.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hentai Desire is a relaxing and casual swap-based puzzle game where your goal is to restore scrambled images by placing each tile into its correct position.


Designed for players who enjoy calm and satisfying gameplay, Hentai Desire offers a straightforward puzzle experience focused on observation, logic, and relaxation. Each level features a complete image that has been divided into square blocks and randomly shuffled across the screen. By swapping tiles, you slowly reconstruct the image piece by piece.



Simple Puzzle Mechanics

The gameplay is easy to understand and accessible to everyone. You simply select two blocks and swap their positions to move closer to the correct image layout. There are no complicated mechanics, no time limits, and no pressure — just smooth and intuitive tile-swapping puzzles that let you play at your own pace.


Relaxing and Stress-Free Gameplay

Hentai Desire is built around relaxation. The calm progression and gentle difficulty curve make it perfect for unwinding after a long day. As you advance, puzzles become slightly more engaging, encouraging better focus and visual awareness without ever feeling overwhelming.


Helpful Hints When You Need Them

If you find yourself stuck on a puzzle, optional hints are always available. These hints gently guide you toward the correct swaps without solving the puzzle for you, keeping the experience immersive and frustration-free.


A Cozy Casual Puzzle Experience

Whether you enjoy image puzzles, tile swap games, or casual puzzle games designed for relaxation, Hentai Desire delivers a comfortable and satisfying experience. Progress through levels at your own rhythm and enjoy the simple pleasure of completing each image one swap at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
NOTE: This is a Beta build representing the opening chapter of The VORIK Cycle. It serves as an introduction to the world, lore, and atmosphere. Further mechanics and story cycles are currently in development.

The VORIK Cycle is a psychological horror experience set inside an industrial nightmare.

You play as a kitchen worker reporting for a standard shift in a small, outdated store. But this is no ordinary job. You are trapped in a place where time is broken and death is not an escape—it is a restart.

In this introductory chapter, you must navigate the dark corridors, uncover what happened to the others, and realize that you are never truly alone.

Key Features

  • The Loop: Experience the beginning of a nightmare where every end is just a new start. Explore the factory and discover why the world refuses to let you leave.

  • Grounded Horror: There are no health bars or magic items here. Experience terror that feels physically heavy and brutally real. You aren't a soldier; you are just an employee trying to survive.

  • Industrial Dread: Navigate massive, surreal environments—from the deafening wind of giant fans to the silent terror of bottomless pits. The scale of the world is designed to make you feel small and forgotten.

  • You Are Being Watched: Something is stalking you from the shadows. Another force waits in the space between worlds. Learn their patterns, or suffer the consequences.

  • The Human Truth: The most dangerous thing in this factory isn't just the monsters in the dark—it is the consequences of your own actions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shanhai Yixian​ is an action-adventure game set in a world of immortal cultivation. You begin as a mortal, exploring a mysterious and brutal cultivation realm, searching for rare natural treasures, practicing powerful techniques and supernatural abilities, slaying demonic beasts or seizing treasures from others, and refining elixirs and magical artifacts. Step by step, enhance your cultivation, break through realms, and ultimately defy fate to dominate the world.

Random Spiritual Roots, Multiple Paths of Cultivation​

Each playthrough, your spiritual roots are randomly determined, with each type offering different cultivation paths. Are those with False Spiritual Roots doomed never to form a Golden Core, destined to remain insignificant in the world of cultivation? In this game, you can explore the cultivation realm to discover mysterious techniques that guide your path, gather precious herbs to refine high-grade pills that boost your chances of breakthrough, and ultimately overturn destiny to command your own fate and awe the world.

Multiple Maps, Explore Secret Realms and Ancient Ruins​

Discover ancient ruins, mysterious secret realms, and the caves of long-gone cultivators in search of rare treasures—though these treasures also attract dangerous cultivators and beasts.

Six unique maps feature different mystical realms and ruins, randomly generated cultivation resources, powerful and enigmatic demonic beasts, and perilous natural disasters of the cultivation world. Each map offers a different experience, making every exploration fresh and unpredictable.

Cultivator Duels, Unleash Your Powers​

Combine techniques, magical artifacts, supernatural abilities, talismans, and formations freely for diverse combat strategies, recreating authentic cultivator duels in an engaging real-time action game.

The five elements—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth—interact in cycles of generation and restriction, both for demonic beasts and magical artifacts. Using artifacts wisely can lead to quicker victories.

Will you slay beasts and seize treasures from others, or prioritize caution and flee when overpowered? Choose your own law of survival in the world of cultivation.

Pursue Longevity, Experience True Cultivation​

Mortals live barely over a hundred years, yet a Deity Transformation cultivator can live for millennia.

In the game, activities like searching for herbs to refine breakthrough pills, entering secluded meditation while waiting for secret realms to open, and practicing spells and supernatural abilities all consume time.

If you fail to break through to the next realm before your lifespan ends, you will exhaust your years and pass away in seclusion.

But if you reach the Deity Transformation stage, you can live for thousands of years, achieving true longevity—timeless as the heavens.

Rare Treasures, an Authentic Cultivation World​

Spiritual root testing, technique cultivation, pill and artifact refinement, spiritual sense detection, dual cultivation with a Dao companion…

The game incorporates a wealth of original cultivation and progression systems, allowing you to immerse yourself authentically in the experience of cultivation.

Official QQ Communication Group​

The game is currently in development. If you would like to suggest gameplay ideas to the development team, encounter issues in the game, or wish to interact with more players, you are welcome to join the official QQ group.

store_data.about_the_game:
As Duty Demands is a first-person narrative psychological horror experience centered on exploration, observation, and interpretation.

You play as Coral, a nurse who accepts a position at the Naval Retirement Home Del Bono — a secluded facility for forgotten war veterans, ruled by a former admiral obsessed with discipline and authority. What begins as a routine job quickly reveals a place shaped by control, neglect, and unresolved trauma.

Explore a facility where meaning is hidden in plain sight

There are no puzzles to solve and no enemies to fight. Instead, progression comes from careful exploration and active analysis of the environment. Crumpled newspapers, personal notes, medical documents, and the admiral’s own writings must be examined, unfolded, and read to reconstruct what happened within the facility — and why.

Every object tells part of the story, but nothing explains itself.

A reality shaped by ideology

Through environmental storytelling and written material, you uncover Admiral Del Bono’s philosophy: discipline as religion, authority as virtue, consent as an obstacle. His publications and methods reveal how a place meant for healing became something far more disturbing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Vocal Horror Stories is an episodic, voice-interactive psychological horror series set in India. Each episode tells a short and unique story where your voice controls the character’s mental state. Whatever you speak can change the environment in a positive or negative way. 

VOCAL HORROR STORIES – GAJA

In the first episode of this series, you play as Shivani, a young woman with an anxiety disorder from Chennai, India. During the COVID lockdown, she is desperately investigating her missing mother, Maya, based on the clues she has. However, her elephant-headed companion, Gaja (elephant in Sanskrit), has offered you some help but at a cost. Who is he? What is his plan? Did she find her mother in the end?

VOICE INTERACTION

Screaming will intensify the horror. You will need to say certain words into your mic to calm yourself. Additionally, some devices will also respond to your voice. So be mindful.

SOLVE THE CASE

You have questions. Only your missing mother has the answers. Find her using the clues inside your apartment.

ATMOSPHERIC STORYTELLING

The story will not be told directly. Rather, occurrences within Shivani's apartment will let you connect the dots and deduce the story.

ROOTED IN INDIAN FOLKLORE

The story and its clues draw from Indian culture and sentiments, giving you a deeply rooted experience.

DAYLIGHT HORROR

No flashlights! There is no darkness to hide in.

Additional Features

  • Story-rich, narrative-driven experience

  • VHS (retro) film aesthetic

  • In-game text messages from NPCs

  • Player voice activity tracking

store_data.about_the_game:
Delve into the Kingdom of Lumina

The once Gleaming and renowned Kingdom has become a dim sight from what it once was. A vast place for creatures of all manners and sizes, living under the protection of the Shining King. The home of a young moth named Luma, who unknowingly is about to lose everything they've ever known. But can they bring back that spark that once made this kingdom so mighty in the first place.

Locations

The Kingdom of Lumina has many different locations to explore. Walk through the glorious Gleaming City, or Dive into the sewers in The Underbelly. Take a stroll through the beautiful gardens of the royal family, or fight through overgrown and forgotten lands. Each location bringing new enemies, bosses, and challenges to overcome!

Gameplay

Explore the Kingdom of Lumina, overturn every stone to find precious trinkets, friends, and foes alike. Use the small bit of light still within you to help guide your journey, and unlock new ways to harness it through powerful bursts of energy, or simply pulling yourself through the air by making a physical lasso of light. You never know what you might be able to create.

Along the way you may also find Bulbs, which allow you to differ your playthrough with different abilities. Some may simply grant more money from enemies, while others allow you to defy death and dodge incoming damage entirely. How you mix and match these are up to you, and some may even allow you to interact with the world in entirely different ways.

Features

  • 5 Main Story explorable regions, with a few extra ones for those who venture.

  • Story and optional/secret bosses spread throughout the world for you to find and challenge!

  • Many different creatures you can meet and call friend. You never know what kind of story they can tell.

  • Tons of foes across all of the regions! From tiny bugs, to giant living rocks, to the pitched creatures of the void.

  • Many secrets spread across the world for you to find. Hidden in small cracks, and puzzles for you to solve.

  • A Bulb System that allows you to change how you play and interact with the world. Will you opt for more survivability? or will you drop your enemies faster than they can land a strike!

store_data.about_the_game:
Memories lost to the ocean. Conviction etched in the heart.

You wake up at sea with a blank mind. Fate hands you a second-hand shop, "Old Sydney Paper," and a manufacturer, "Third Feather."

"Become the 'First,' and we leave together."

Guided by this single vow from a one-winged girl, you step into the corrupt and dazzling Dark Heron City...

Build grid-based production lines to hand-craft "Gene Tiles." Customize your shop and office decor—your style directly dictates your clientele and employee growth.

Exploit emotions with rumors to manipulate the market. When you hold the fatal "Heart Info," will you expose it to crash the price to zero, or bury it to win their trust?

Enter "Natural Selection" duels. No Mahjong skill needed—just match tile patterns to attack. Turn your products into weapons to defeat and annex your rivals.

A story of "■ & Rain," "Bug & ■," and "Flower & ■." In the eternal night of Dark Heron City, find the only remaining warmth.

store_data.about_the_game:
There once was a city called Wittengrad...

A retro-inspired narrative game where the heavy, oppressive atmosphere of the loathed city of Wittengrad leaves its mark on every inhabitant. You play as Barnaba, who, like so many others, has fallen into the trap of dreaming about escape. Now, he is no longer fighting to fulfill his desires, he is fighting for his life.

A place where the people were never happy.

Wander familiar streets shrouded in thick fog streets that, under the cover of night, turn terrifyingly alien.

But they could not leave the accursed city…

Meet the inhabitants who find Wittengrad by night all too familiar.

So they rejoiced when their home was no more...

At least you have your customers. Anyone leaving Wittengrad must pay to cross over to the other side… but that’s a different story altogether.

 

Key Features

  • Short, 1-hour linear experience.

  • Two or three potential jump scares.

  • Focus on atmosphere and dread over traditional scaring.

  • Simple questing, stealth, and escape mechanics.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Harvester came without warning. A towering demon tore open the Spirit Realm, seized Boo's friends, and sealed their essence into spectral orbs scattered across forty deadly realms. Boo alone escaped. Now he must go back.

BREAK THE SEALS

Each orb holds a trapped friend. Navigate single-screen chambers filled with hazards, collect every orb, and reach the exit before time runs out. Some levels demand speed. Others demand patience. All of them demand precision.

BUILT FOR CHALLENGE

Inspired by the classics and the unforgiving single screen platformers of the 80s. No tutorials. No checkpoints. Tight controls. Fair but punishing design.

You will fail. You will learn. You will adapt. You will keep trying. You will have fun.

FEATURES

  • 40 Hand-Crafted Levels — Each chamber is a unique puzzle of platforms, timing, and danger.

  • Mirror Mode Levels — Some realms flip your world, reversing left and right.

  • Deadly Enemies — A variety of deadly enemies. Hellhounds patrol the ground, dragons swoop from above, and the Harvester's minions guard every realm.

  • Brutal Hazards — Crushers, flames, spinning blades, falling fireballs.

  • Precision Controls — Basic but responsive movement built for split-second decisions.

Cross every realm. Break every seal. Bring them home.

store_data.about_the_game:
No Nap November is a short psychological horror game set in a kindergarten trapped in an endless nap time.

The children are asleep. The lights are dim. The building is quiet but something feels wrong. What should be a peaceful routine begins to repeat, looping endlessly as November drags on.

Loops and Anomalies

Each loop, the kindergarten subtly changes. Toys shift position. Furniture is slightly misplaced. Familiar rooms don’t look the same twice. These anomalies are never obvious. They hide in plain sight, testing your memory, attention, and perception.

Your role is to observe carefully. Walk through the kindergarten, inspect small details, and decide whether something is off before moving forward. The environment reacts to your awareness. Missing signs allows a strange presence to grow stronger, altering the space in more unsettling ways.

A Strange Presence

As you progress, a strange figure begins to appear — something that doesn’t belong. One of the toys seems possessed, quietly causing the anomalies you observe. It hides in plain sight, testing your attention and memory. Each missed sign brings it closer.

Make too many mistakes, and nap time ends. Not everyone wakes up afterward.

The Cross

A frightened teacher. A cross on the door.
A momentary protection. Not using it has consequences.



The children are sleeping. You shouldn’t be.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chamber One is a story-driven 3D puzzle platformer set in a virtual testing laboratory.

You awaken in an elevator, with no memory of who you are or how you got there.
The system informs you that you are part of the Rebuild Test Program – an experiment designed to explore the human mind and its integration into a digital system.

Progress through test chambers, solve environmental puzzles, and observe the world around you. The story unfolds subtly through dialogue, atmosphere, and your own conclusions.

There are no enemies and no time pressure, but the system is far from safe. Its growing instability causes increasingly strange things to happen around you. You are left completely on your own within the system.
Only you, the system guiding you, and the growing feeling that not everything is as it seems.

FEATURES

  • Story-driven 3D puzzle platformer

  • Clean, minimalist sci-fi environment

  • Environmental storytelling

  • Logic-based puzzles focused on observation and timing

  • A quietly told, slow-building story that rewards attention and thoughtful reflection

  • A “Freemode” that allows players to directly enter desired levels in order to achieve new best times.

 

Chamber One is an experience about existence, the future, and the imperfection of a system.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hexagon Madness offers players a challenging single-player, first-person 3D platformer. Surviving rising and dropping platforms without falling off into the void. Face 60 rounds of unforgiving obstacles determined to stop you from reaching the end.

With each round comes a new obstacle or aid such as items to help the player survive. In between rounds, the player can upgrade his inventory of items using the shop.

In addition, as the player progresses, they can unlock new content such as game modes like the sandbox mode to create their own custom rounds. Unlock a model viewer in the Gallery section to observe each obstacle, item, upgrade and many more. The player can also play a tutorial mode to better understand the obstacles they've unlocked. 

The key to your survival lies in mastering quick decision-making and resourcefulness. Hexagon Madness incorporates dynamic physics that you can use to your advantage, allowing you to overcome every obstacle and survive through this challenge more effectively.

Hexagon Madness was created under the challenge of developing without planning or coordination between developers. Much like a game of telephone, each developer worked on the project for one week with no communication before passing it on to the next.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Maybe I should go into research." That's what I thought back in college. But under the pressures of real life, I gave up on academic research. With the help of my mentor, I started teaching at an ordinary high school. There, I met many friendly colleagues and kept in touch with my college friends. I used to think that my ordinary life would just go on like this, but everything began to change when I arrived at 'Fenghua School.'

Su Heling: The daughter of the owner of Qimo Real Estate, she studies at the locally renowned elite high school 'Fenghua School.' However, due to the decline of the real estate industry and resulting financial difficulties, although she attends an elite high school, she seems to face the possibility of transferring to another school. After Xu Bu arrives at 'Fenghua,' she becomes a student in Xu Bu's temporary class. Su Heling's life also seems to be encountering a new turning point.

Zhang Anyi: An English teacher in the same class as Xu Bu, and they share the same office. She started working a year earlier than Xu Bu and is the teacher with the closest relationship to him, often having meals together. She has a poor tolerance for alcohol, but when in high spirits, she always forces herself to drink, eventually being sent home by other female colleagues. She dresses elegantly, teaches gently, and is extremely popular among students.

Old Wei: Xu Bu's college roommate, from a coastal province known for civil service exams. He repeated two years of high school and is two years older than Xu Bu. After graduation, he chose to stay local and opened a Chinese fast-food restaurant, specializing in cold noodles and cold skin noodles. Although he is not yet thirty, he looks like he has already entered middle age. He still keeps in close contact with Xu Bu and often asks for suggestions on new products in his store.

Han Ji: A student of 'Fenghua School', who prides himself on having realized the truths of the world, is a teenager full of typical adolescent arrogance. His father seems to be a school administrator, so he usually doesn’t wear a school uniform. He looks down on ordinary students who quietly do their work, as well as on Xu Bu, who comes from an ordinary high school, considering himself the center of the world. At the same time, he seems to have a mysterious obsession with Su and Ling.

store_data.about_the_game:
One man's junk is an open world trading game, where you start with a paperclip, and barter your way up to a car, in order to go visit your family for the Holidays which is in 30 days

Key features

  • Trade over 350 items with more than 120 NPCs

  • Discover the gossip of the town by chatting with them

  • Freely explore the vast hand-drawn town of Chislington

  • Fast travel option available, at the cost of ingame time

  • Customise how your character looks

  • Automatic saving, resume your session any time

  • Multiple ways to succeed, there's no 'correct' method

You have $0 to your name. You reach into your pocket, and your fist closes on a single paperclip. How can you possibly afford to visit your family for the upcoming Holidays? As the saying goes: “One man’s junk is another man’s treasure”, and you’re about to put that into practice.

Your mission

With limited time on the clock, you must hassle the residents of Chislington, equipped only with your charisma and intention to barter. You’ll want trade items of equivalent value, but each time, ending up with something slightly more valuable. The idea is to eventually obtain a cheap beater car from the sleazy salesman at the end of the block, so you can drive home to your family. But that despicable trader is driving a hard bargain with absolutely no sympathy, so you have a lot of swapping ahead.

On your travels

While your main goal is to trade, you’ll also have the option to talk to people and learn about the various secrets and scandals of the town, if you wish to.

Not quite a walking simulator

The village is quite large, but you have the ability to fast travel. Unfortunately, this ability costs you ingame time, and you only have 30 days before the holidays. Perhaps it’s worth looking for a more efficient method of travel in the meantime?

Optional difficulty

Ideally you want to obtain a car in 30 days, so you can be back home for the holidays. However, this goal is completely optional, and if you miss it that’s ok. Your family will be happy to see you at any point you are able to make it!

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

SimElection is a turn-based political simulation where you take control of a political party and face the entire road to election day.
Manage your strategy, respond to media pressure, survive televised debates, control your finances, and decide how far you are willing to go to win.

Every decision matters.
Every turn can change the course of the campaign.

A deep yet accessible political simulator

In SimElection, players experience a full political term from the inside.
Unexpected news, uncomfortable interviews, rumors, internal tensions, negotiations, and major media events will shape the pace of the game.

Winning is not just about making promises. You must manage resources, protect your public image, control your party, and read the social climate to avoid losing support.

Dynamic campaigns and realistic elections

Take part in different types of elections:

  • General Elections

  • Regional Elections

  • Municipal Elections

Each election type has its own rules, rhythm, and consequences.
Vote counting unfolds progressively, territory by territory, recreating the tension of a real election night.

Decisions, consequences, and strategy

The game is played in turns, where you will:

  • Respond to political and media events

  • Manage your party headquarters

  • Deal with lobbies and pressure groups

  • Make key economic decisions

  • Face televised debates and interviews

  • Organize campaign events and final rallies

Nothing is ever completely safe — even good decisions can have unintended consequences.

Total political freedom

You can play with existing parties or create your own party from scratch, defining:

  • Ideology

  • Political positioning

  • Territorial strategy

  • Communication profile

The system adapts to major parties, small movements, regionalist groups, and emerging political forces alike.

Key Features

  • Turn-based political simulation

  • Full political party management

  • Dynamic events and campaign news

  • Interactive electoral debates

  • Interviews and media pressure

  • Economic and reputation systems

  • Territorial strategy with interactive maps

  • Progressive and realistic vote counting

  • Multiple election types

  • High replayability — every campaign is different

Recommended for players who enjoy

  • Management and strategy games

  • Political and social simulators

  • Decision-making with real consequences

  • Emergent narrative experiences

store_data.about_the_game:
The world didn't end with a bang. It ended with a whisper.

Decades after the collapse of civilization, nature has reclaimed the earth. Cities lie buried beneath vines and roots. The old world is gone, swallowed by an endless, untamed wilderness. You are a child of this new world, born into the quiet, raised in the shadow of ruins.

Last State is an immersive text-based survival game where every decision shapes your fate. Explore a massive procedurally generated world spanning forests, mountains, swamps, rivers, and the decaying remnants of human civilization. Master the art of survival through hunting, gathering, crafting, and exploration.

Perfect For Fans Of

Traditional roguelikes and survival games

Deep crafting and progression systems

Procedural generation and emergent gameplay

Text-based adventures with modern design

Games like Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead, NEO Scavenger, Unreal World and Project Zomboid

🌲 Vast Procedural World

8 unique biomes: dense forests, open plains, treacherous swamps, mountain peaks, lakeshores, rushing rivers, abandoned ruins and overgrown roads

Dynamic location descriptions bring every area to life

Discover hidden caches, abandoned camps and points of interest

🔥 Deep Survival Mechanics

Monitor hunger, thirst, warmth, fatigue, and hygiene

Build fires to stay warm and cook food

Construct shelters and eventually permanent housing

Weather the seasons from brutal winters to scorching summers

Manage injuries and illness with crafted medicine and bandages

🎯 Hunting & Gathering

Track and hunt different animal species from rabbits to bears and wolves

Fish in rivers and lakes with rods, traps and bait

Gather resources from each biome: mushrooms, berries, herbs, minerals and more

Set snare traps and fish traps for passive food gathering

🌾 Farming & Settlement Building

Establish farm plots and grow 15 different crops

Plant fruit trees and berry bushes for long-term food security

Build permanent structures with planks, beams, walls and roofing

Create your own refuge in the wilderness

🛠️ Extensive Crafting System

Craft over 100+ items from primitive tools to advanced equipment

Quality-based crafting: your skills improve with practice

Create weapons: spears, bows, arrows and more

Build structures: shelters, permanent houses, storage containers

Craft survival gear: clothing, armor, medical supplies

📈 Progression & Skills

Level up survival skills through practice: crafting, hunting, gathering and exploration

Unlock better success rates and higher quality crafted items

Score system rewards clever play and overcoming challenges

Multiple starting scenarios increase difficulty and replayability

🏴‍☠️ Dynamic Encounters

Meet friendly NPCs who can trade, share information or become companions

Face hostile survivors who seek to take your hard-earned supplies

Defend against wolf attacks and other predatory wildlife

Every encounter is procedurally generated and unique

🎨 Immersive Atmosphere

Rich environmental storytelling through detailed descriptions

Atmospheric pixel art visuals showcasing the world's beauty and danger

Dynamic narrative intro that sets the tone for your journey

Text-based interface with modern UI design

Survival is Just the Beginning

In Last State you're not just trying to survive. You're building a new life in a world that's moved on without humanity. Will you become a master hunter, trading pelts and meat? A skilled craftsman, creating tools and weapons? A farmer, cultivating the land? Or an explorer, uncovering the secrets of the old world?

The wilderness is vast. Resources are scarce. Danger lurks in every shadow.

🌍​ more biomes​ (with unique points of interest)

⚙️ complex game mechanics (complex and deeper actual and new game mechanics)

🎨 more immersive desing for ​​​better gameplay experience

🎊 new content (storyline, collectibles...)​

🎧 soundtrack (17 full themed tracks; 5 ingame now)​

Remember: In the wilderness, every choice matters.

Your story begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dead Rush is an FPS arcade shooter that combines fast-paced action, stylized visuals, and relentless waves of zombies.

Fight through infected areas filled with overwhelming undead hordes, collect a wide variety of weapons, and adapt your playstyle using powerful perks and upgrades. Constant movement, quick reactions, and aggressive combat are the keys to survival.

In addition to pure action, Dead Rush features simple challenges and objectives that encourage experimentation with different weapons and playstyles. From eliminating hundreds of zombies with a pistol to mastering rifles and heavy weapons, these goals add direction and replay value without slowing down the action.

Dead Rush focuses on straightforward FPS gameplay without unnecessary complexity. Jump straight into the fight, experiment with weapons, perks, and objectives, and see how long you can survive as the outbreak intensifies.

Play solo or team up with friends to battle endless zombie waves and complete challenges together.

Features

• Fast-paced FPS arcade combat

• Endless waves of zombies

• A wide and varied arsenal of weapons

• Perks and upgrades that shape your playstyle

• Simple challenges and weapon-based objectives

• Stylized visuals with smooth performance

• Solo and co-op gameplay

• Designed for high replayability

store_data.about_the_game:
The Legendary Boob Trap Dungeon is an adventure game where “evasion” is everything.

The protagonist ventures into four dungeons filled with temptations and traps to rescue the imprisoned princess.

The core rule is simple: “You cannot attack, only evade.”

All the player can do is observe enemy and trap movements, judge the timing, and keep dodging.

Observe the movements of traps (breasts and buttocks) placed on the field and act at the right moment to evade them.

Additionally, a goddess (a woman in an erotic form) roams the field searching for the protagonist. Her movements follow certain patterns, so identifying these patterns is crucial for progress.

Contact with traps or the goddess's gaze triggers brief erotic scenes, reducing the protagonist's sperm (HP).

Reaching zero sperm results in game over.

We aimed to create a game where the abundance of breasts and buttocks scattered across the field, combined with the goddess's presence, heightens the overall lewdness. Every step forward brings simultaneous tension and eroticism.

Game Features

  • Evasion-Focused Game play

    Touching enemies or traps reduces sperm; reaching zero sends you back to the checkpoint.

    Enemy movements follow predictable patterns; careful observation allows safe progression.

  • Abundant Checkpoints

    Checkpoints are generously placed throughout the dungeon.

    Failures allow immediate retries, maintaining a brisk pace.

  • Light Puzzle Elements

    Beyond pure reflexes, some situations require considering sequence and timing.

    By calmly assessing the situation, you won't encounter unfair difficulty.

  • Event Scenes

    Triggering specific traps activates short event scenes.

    These serve as narrative accents throughout the game, with multiple variations based on your current health state.

Difficulty Notes

This game is designed to minimize game overs.

With recovery options always available, it offers balanced accessibility even for those less skilled in action games.

store_data.about_the_game:
Space Combat Roguelite. Infinite Missions. Permanent Power.

Void Breach drops you into a twin-stick space combat roguelite where every mission is procedurally generated, every kill makes you permanently stronger, 20+ alien factions, and more than 100 ships with unique mechanics to keep you guessing. Chain devastating abilities, build unstoppable weapon synergies, and unleash reality-warping ultimate powers across missions that never play the same way twice. Quick 5-20 minute sessions. Dozens (maybe hundreds) of hours of progression. Zero runs wasted.

12 Abilities. 5 Ultimates. Total Destruction.

Void Breach gives you an arsenal that grows with every wave. Twelve unique abilities unlock as you push deeper—from Bull's invincible charge that rams through entire formations, to Vortex pulling dozens of enemies into a killing zone, to Cascade's chain-reaction explosions that turn one kill into six. Assign any five to your loadout and build combos that shred everything on screen.

- Bull: Go invincible and ram through enemies

- Vortex: Pull enemies into a crushing gravity well

- EMP: Strip every shield on screen instantly

- Phase: Blink-teleport through danger with i-frames

- Siphon: Drain the life force from surrounding enemies to heal yourself

- Cascade: Trigger chain-reaction void explosions across six targets

- Echo: Mark your position, scout ahead, then snap back through time

- Nova: Blast a blinding shockwave that damages and disorients everything nearby

- Shatter: Crystallize and detonate an area, leaving enemies taking 50% extra damage

- Reave: Launch seeking blades that chain between five enemies

- Prism: Deploy an explosive holographic decoy

- Push: Blast enemies away when you need breathing room

Void Surge — Your Reality-Warping Superweapon

Charge your Void Surge meter through kills, combos, grazing enemy fire, and boss damage—then unleash one of five devastating ultimate abilities that rewrite the rules of combat. Cycle between them mid-mission to match any threat.

- Orbital Strike: Call down a massive bombardment dealing 50% of every enemy's max HP in a huge radius

- Void Storm: Summon a growing maelstrom that gets stronger with every kill—swarm-killer supreme

- Time Fracture: Freeze time, deal massive damage, then shatter frozen enemies for bonus destruction

- Singularity: Create a black hole that crushes everything inward before detonating

- Phoenix Burst: Become invincible and fire in all 16 directions simultaneously—can even resurrect you from death

And when you need precision over power, toggle Chrono Rift to slow time to 30% while you move at near-full speed. Thread through bullet hell. Land impossible shots. Control the flow of battle itself.

20+ Enemy Factions That Fight Differently

Every faction in Void Breach has mechanics that force you to adapt. Hivemind ships split into smaller copies when damaged—kill them fast or face exponential swarms. Magnetic enemies deflect your projectiles back at you. Symbiotic pairs share damage, and killing one enrages the survivor. Berserkers get faster and deadlier as you hurt them. Crystalline ships shatter into lethal shards on death. No single strategy works against everything.

- Swarm: Overwhelming numbers, fast and relentless

- Void: Phase through your attacks with unpredictable movement

- Ancients: Massive health pools that endure sustained fire

- Phantom: Flicker in and out of visibility

- Inferno: Leave fire trails and explode on death

- Spectral: Untargetable while attacking—strike when they're idle

- Neural: Learn and adapt to your playstyle

- Overcharge: Absorb damage until they explode in chain lightning

- Nano: Rebuild themselves if you don't finish them off

- Mimic: Copy your own weapons and use them against you

Seven enemy tiers from expendable Fodder to terrifying Legendary threats with 1500 HP and 2.5x damage. Plus a Nemesis System—enemies born from your deaths return as unique, personal threats in future runs.

Progression That Never Stops

Two progression systems feed each other. In-mission, you level up to 100+ gaining damage, health, shields, speed, and crit bonuses every level. Collect orbiting Satellites—up to six passive modifiers giving you bonus damage, armor, attack speed, extra projectiles, XP, and energy cores. Grab temporary power-ups and consumable items from the Hangar Store for that extra edge.

Between missions, spend Energy Cores on 25+ permanent upgrades with 50 levels each. Triple your weapon damage. Max your fire rate. Add extra projectiles to every shot. Push your critical hit chance to 55% with 3.5x multipliers. Start higher missions at higher levels (up to level 50). Every single run makes your next run stronger—nothing is ever wasted.

- Offense: Weapon Power, Rapid Fire, Critical Systems, Critical Strike, Multi-Barrel, Seeker Launcher

- Defense: Hull Plating, Shield Capacitor, Shield Regenerator, Reactive Armor

- Utility: Engine Boost, Neural Link, Energy Siphon, Boost Cells, Satellite Protection

- Abilities: Cooldown reduction and duration extension for every ability

Key Features

- Roguelite Sessions: 5-10 minute missions with permanent progression that stacks across hundreds of hours

- 12 Combat Abilities: Unlocked progressively, assigned to 5 active slots, each with upgrade paths

- 5 Void Surge Ultimates: Reality-warping superweapons charged through skilled play

- Chrono Rift: Toggle bullet-time to slow the world while you move at near-full speed

- 20+ Enemy Factions: Each with unique combat mechanics that demand adaptation

- 7 Enemy Tiers: From Fodder cannon-fire to screen-shaking Legendary threats

- Nemesis System: Your deaths spawn personal rival enemies that hunt you in future runs

- Satellite System: Six orbiting passive modifiers with risk/reward—take damage and you might lose them

- 25+ Permanent Upgrades: 50 levels each with multiplicative stacking

- Procedural Missions: Multi-phase objectives—destroy, defend, escort, hack, survive, and more

- Combo System: Kill streaks multiply your score and charge your ultimate faster

- Hangar Store: Consumable items crafted from mission materials for tactical advantages

- Status Effects: Burn, shock, slow, and corrosion add tactical depth to every encounter

- Built for Performance: Hundreds of enemies, projectiles, and particles on screen at 300+ FPS

One More Mission. Then One More.

You're two kills from leveling up. You just found a satellite that adds +2 projectiles to every shot. Your nemesis is waiting in the next mission. That boss wiped you at 1% HP and revenge is non-negotiable. The Hangar upgrade you've been saving for is one run away.

Every mission ends with a reason to launch the next one. Welcome to Void Breach.

You are a Rogue Process—a former auditor turned probability distorter. Your mission: Bankrupt The House by playing the game harder than it was ever meant to be played.

Rogue 21 is a high-energy roguelike deckbuilder where standard Blackjack rules collide with illegal "Exploit" perks. This isn't a game of luck; it's a heist against a rigged reality. 

KEY FEATURES:

  • Combat Blackjack: It’s not just about getting close to 21. Use your card values combined with your Strength stat to deplete the Dealer Boss’s HP before they bankrupt you.

  • Risk Your Life, Literally: In the Gamble-State, you don't bet chips—you bet your health. Every hit is a tactical decision; every stand is a prayer to the glitch.

When everything is a gamble, refusing to play is the only losing move.

store_data.about_the_game:
A true 3D Momentum Platformer about flow, freedom of movement, and human community in a solarpunk world.

The core gameplay is about true momentum without limits.

The game environment shows a world where humanity is rebuilding.

And the story shows an interpersonal conflict between two sisters as this world is threatened.

Or I guess you can ignore the last two and just blast through the game, that's fine too.

Story

You play as the titular Nira, who's job to help a city with their power issues forces her to cross paths with her sister in an attempt to save the world from an otherworldly force threatening to destroy society.

Gameplay

Run and jump both on the ground and on walls to parkour through the towns and cities of Solarvale. There are no speed limits and the core of going fast involves discovering and executing on ways to gain, redirect, and keep your speed. Momentum is at the core of all mechanics and systems, so don't lose it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ready to bench press 355 kilos? Not for media or magazines, but for the most important thing in a person's life — respect from your friends! Or pedal a catamaran through a raging storm just to reach your beloved? Forget ordinary rules — here you need titanic strength, a passionate sincere heart, and friends who have your back like a mountain!

Young! Fire! — this is an explosion of teenage passion, where every date becomes an epic battle, and every word is a strike of fate. Four legendary friends dive into the whirlpool of love, which throws them into different worlds: shonen epic, retro-futuristic detective, criminal thriller, and many more!

We invite you to live the story of Youth of these unbreakable love-struck power monsters:

Felix Blaze Brodie — a daredevil with a delicate soul, picked up by friends almost from the street, who fell in love with the mysterious Noah.

Xavier Bloodstone Vines — a sturdy-titanic romantic, whose heart was conquered by the enigmatic May.

Maximilian Fluffy Veil — a rational sports MACHINE with a weakness for ice cream sprinkled with rainbow dragees, who lost his head over the unrestrained Minari.

Damian Skylark Hale — kissed by God with talent and luck, a heavenly dreamer whose eyes harbor sorrow, captivated by the enchanting Reiko.

Each story is a separate universe, where love pushes toward impossible feats, and friendship becomes the most powerful weapon. Laughter tears the sky, tears flood the oceans, and the flame reaches cosmic heights.

  • 4 routes, 4+ worlds: shonen battles, retro-futurism, noir thriller, heroic saga and...

  • Gameplay: unique for each route.

  • Hyperbolized youth (that is, ordinary..!): absurd challenges, catamarans against storms, ostriches against chthonic demons, and the Valkyrie Sisterhood — little warrior-Vikingesses battling intergalactic-time evil.

This is not just a game about love. This is a legend about how four friends overcome chaos in their hearts, life's challenges, and simply enjoy their magnificent Youth!

Young! Fire! is made of contradictions. But like real Youth, it leaves you face-to-face with these contradictions so you understand — no one is trying to fool you. It doesn't try to sell the illusion of "real reality."

And who the hell knows what's happening in this Youth. Some kind of absurdity.

Or maybe it's all just a game?

Or maybe it's just entertainment? Or maybe it's all made for a joke?

What difference does it make?

It's just like life...

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-building game.

You’ll draw cards that represent different “life states”, then combine them with stickers and tools to build a setup that feels just right:
some deal damage, some keep you alive, and some are there purely to stir up chaos.

The basics are simple:
Draw cards → place them on the board → press “Play.”

But as the difficulty ramps up, you’ll start caring about the details:

Where should this card go?
Which sticker is better to apply first?
Should this tool protect one card, or heal another?
Do you push your luck this turn — or play it safe?

Every run can unfold in a completely different way.

What’s the fun?

Trigger satisfying chain reactions in a single turn:
critical hits, combos, splash damage, counterattacks, stuns…

Even though it’s a battle, it feels oddly familiar —
each build is like planning a small daily escape:
less work, fewer chores, social obligations on pause.

No two runs are the same.
With different choices, cards, stickers, and tools, the same starting point can lead to entirely different paths.

You’ll feel yourself improving over time —
from “just placing cards” to precise positioning and planning.
The deeper you go, the harder it is to stop.

Key Features

  • Cards + Stickers + Tools — freely combine three types of resources to shape stats, ranges, and special effects

  • Random encounters and rewards — every upgrade brings new opportunities… and new problems

  • Positioning matters — placing the same card in different slots can completely change its impact and tempo

  • Multiple builds and synergies — unlock and discover powerful combinations as you progress

  • Light and cute presentation — a colorful 2.5D pixel-art style with clean visuals and a playful tone

Development Status

Taking Today Off is currently in development.

At this stage, development is focused on refining the core gameplay, including the card system, enemy AI behavior, and combat skill design and balance.

Planned future content includes:

  • At least 5 playable starting characters, each with unique starting decks and abilities

  • A deck-building system featuring 60+ cards, 20+ stickers, and 30+ tools

  • 40+ passive items and 10+ battlefield effects to further vary combat

  • 30+ distinct battles and 20+ mysterious events to encounter

All content is subject to change as development continues.
A Demo version is planned for Q1 2026.

store_data.about_the_game:
In-depth Decision-Making Gameplay

  • You can determine all parameters of every game you develop. Experiment with the optimal combination of parameters to create top-tier games.

  • You can choose to achieve "legitimate" success by developing high-quality games for profit, or monopolize the market through "underhanded tactics" such as malicious competition and poaching talents from rivals.

Engaging AI Interactions

  • Every rival and character in the game can think independently and respond to your actions.

  • If your game’s quality is too poor, you can bribe reviewers to get a favorable rating. Of course, reviewers may also take the initiative to demand bribes sometimes.

  • You can resort to underhanded tactics—and so can your competitors. Be careful not to let the game you slaved over become a wedding dress for others.

  • Your attitude toward employees will affect their behavior. Don’t exploit them too harshly, or else… the wrath of an ordinary person can be terrifying…

  • ......

Rich Character Personalities

  • Each character has unique skill levels and talents in various fields. The higher their level, the better the quality of the games they develop.

  • Every character has distinctive tags that can sometimes exert a crucial impact on the game. For example, the [Overachiever] tag affects the work speed and loyalty of team members; the [Lone Wolf] tag slows down a character’s work speed as more people gather around them......

  • More capable characters demand higher salaries accordingly. Yet sometimes, a suitable average character offers a far better cost-performance ratio than a "jack-of-all-trades".

Unpredictable Random Events

  • The game is packed with numerous random events, all presented in the form of mini-games. Victory will earn you substantial rewards.

Office Building & Decoration

  • You can rent an office and arrange workstations, decorations, and other items yourself. Certain in-game effects are tied to the office layout. For instance, employees within a 5-tile radius of the coffee machine receive a work speed boost.

  • As your team grows larger, you’ll need to consider renting a bigger office.

  • For players who dislike manual setup, a one-click decoration feature is also available.

Contact the Developer

  • Bilibili: Search for "孤灯独游"

  • QQ Discussion Group: 1067123260

store_data.about_the_game:
Cursed Ghost is a challenging 2.5D puzzle-platformer where survival depends on timing, awareness, and careful movement.

Once a ghost, now trapped in flesh.

The only way forward is to reclaim a Bound Soul—granting you a few fleeting seconds of spectral freedom before you are cursed again.

Each level is a carefully designed puzzle. One mistake means death.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Navigate deadly environments where touching the wrong surface is fatal

  • Collect a Bound Soul to briefly return to your spectral form

  • Use this short window to pass through walls and obstacles

  • Reach the exit before the soul’s power fades

  • Avoid moving hazards, patrolling entities, and human line of sight

FEATURES

  • 2.5D side-scrolling gameplay

  • Tight, unforgiving level design

  • Instant-death mechanics with fast restarts

  • Dark, minimalist atmosphere

  • Focus on skill, timing, and memorization

  • Keyboard and mouse controls

A TEST OF PATIENCE AND SKILL

Cursed Ghost is not about combat.
It is about learning the rules, respecting the environment, and surviving through mastery.

Every level teaches you something.
Every mistake teaches you faster.

store_data.about_the_game:
My Girlfriend is a V.A.M.P. — Vampire Autistic Magic Princess is a narrative-driven adventure game in which you guide your girlfriend through dangerous environments and everyday situations to bring her back to her castle.

Here, the challenge isn’t fighting enemies, but navigating daily situations that can be sensory-overwhelming. Through dialogue, care mechanics, and emotional support, the player helps protect the princess from overstimulation, shaping both the journey and the relationship between characters.

                                                                       

On your girlfriend’s birthday, you discover that she is, in fact, Patricia Rebecca Isabella Nastya Carol Elena Saori Silva — a Vampire Autistic Magic Princess who must return home to celebrate her birthday and assume her duties as a future ruler. She was sent to the human world to live among nonpires and promote peaceful coexistence between the two peoples.

However, as a VAMP who experiences specific sensory and social overloads, she struggles to make the journey back on her own. The player acts as her support throughout this journey.

Princess emotional management: The princess has a well-being meter that fluctuates based on the dangers she is exposed to. It’s up to you to notice her anxiety levels, expressed through gestures and actions. If the panic line reaches critical levels, the princess enters a panic state and becomes difficult to control. If the bar fills completely, she goes away.

Dialogue that deepens bonds: Multiple dialogue moments give the princess personality, revealing her humor, desires, and insecurities. Empathy is key to choosing the best responses and growing closer to her.

Protection against sensory triggers: You must guide the princess away from hazardous areas, such as direct light, keep NPCs or disturbing objects at a distance, and avoid smells she cannot tolerate, among other challenges.

Multiple Endings: Depending on your performance and empathy, multiple endings can be achieved.

store_data.about_the_game:
一款无需网络联机的短篇双人合作解密游戏。玩家需要口述交流游戏内场景中的线索，互相配合解决难题。游戏内两个可选视角的难易度与内容稍有不同。

游戏玩法

　　这是一款双人合作游戏，需要两位玩家在不同设备上同时进行游玩。玩家扮演不同角色进行探索，通过交流来交换线索。

　　游戏本身无需联网。请务必选择不同的主角。操作角色在各自游戏中的场景中移动从各自的视角寻找彼此需要的线索。您和伙伴可面对面沟通或通过电话、社交软件、会议软件进行远程沟通。如果感到游戏较有难度或在某处沟通存在问题时，可以分享一下彼此视角下的游戏画面以降低难度。

　　在不同时刻开始新游戏，部分场景中的某些细节可能会发生变化。

操作说明

　　键盘：方向键移动，ENTER键或Z键确认和调查，ESC键或X键取消和返回，PGUP键或PGDN键特殊互动。

　　手柄：方向键或左摇杆移动，A键确认和调查，B键取消和返回，L或R键特殊互动。

　　触屏或者鼠标：点击画面移动，点击面对的物件调查，点击屏幕左下角的镜进行特殊互动。

　　本游戏使用RM引擎制作，大多数界面的操作方式与该引擎制作的其他游戏基本相同。部分界面操作优化欠佳还望见谅。

背景故事

　　某个清晨，林铭与娜比收到了一个神秘的包裹，包裹里面静静地躺着一面古铜镜。

　　两人同时触碰镜面时，镜面发出了耀眼的光芒……回过神时，林铭发现自己身处一座奇怪的大房子中，而娜比似乎也在此处，却处于不同的空间，无法与林铭相见。在这里，只能听到彼此的声音。

　　就这样，平静的日常，被一面奇妙的镜子打破。这份来自未知发件人送给娜比的生日礼物使两人的冒险由此开始。

　　镜中的世界似乎由看到这面镜的人的记忆构成，充满让人熟悉的场景与事物，但也出现了许多从未见过的障碍。

　　一路上经过河谷、神殿、绘本世界，接下来能否离开这里？究竟是回到现实世界还是迷失在幻境？

角色简介

　　娜比

　　小时候镇子被洪水冲毁，娜比被自己的哥哥拼命救了出来。多年后独自搬到城中生活的她仍因体质较弱经常生病。

　　林铭

　　独自一人来到城中工作的少年林铭，喜欢安稳的生活。在某次交通事故中帮助并结识了娜比。

流程与时长

　　单次游玩约45分钟左右流程。实际所需时间会因您和伙伴的游玩方式的不同而有所浮动。游戏并非单一结局。游戏中某处的选择可能会影响故事的结局。

关于我们

　　欢迎加入交流群：887884044，一起交流或寻找玩伴。

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a 3D puzzle action game where players generate and manipulate blocks
using special abilities to clear each stage.

Players control a character and can create, stack, and rotate blocks.
By combining these abilities, they overcome various gimmicks placed in the stages.

If there is an obstacle blocking the way, players can use blocks to create a path.
If a shape does not fit, they can rotate blocks to place them perfectly.

If a place is too high to reach, players can stack blocks to create a foothold.

Each stage contains keys and an exit.
By solving gimmicks and collecting keys, players can move on to the exit.

The main feature of this game is that there is no single solution.
Depending on the player’s ideas and actions, the same stage can be cleared in different ways.

As the game progresses, new types of blocks and gimmicks appear.
This allows players to enjoy more freedom and strategic gameplay.

Observe. Think. Try.
Finding your own solution through repetition is the greatest fun of this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as a fallen god that's given a chance to reclaim godhood. As a godling, you must save the world from dark forces that only a god can truly repel. Gain back followers and their faith, which makes you stronger. With faith, you can upgrade your skills to better fight the forces of darkness. But that's not all you face.

You must also reclaim your authority from the four kingdoms that have betrayed you in the past and turned to atheism. As a god, you must gain back their submission to your divine rule. Accept offerings and grow your harem of royalty and nobles, which further increases your powers and authority.

The game features classic, simple turn-based combat with Quick Time Events. Some enemies are immune to certain types of damage, so you must use your skills wisely. The game features numerous enemies from monsters to human armies. You must defeat both on your path to regain godhood.

The game's world is in 2D pixel open world, where you explore the various towns and cities you must save. The game features a linear progression and plot with optional enemies to challenge and grind.

In regards to the harem part of the game, you can communicate with its members and train them as well as let them serve you. This content features adult content that combines 2D art and pixel graphics that are animated. It also includes voice acting. All content is fully uncensored.

The game's world is in 2D pixel open world, where you explore the various towns and cities you must save. The game features a linear progression and plot with optional enemies to challenge and grind.

In regards to the harem part of the game, you can communicate with its members and train them as well as let them serve you. This content features adult content that combines 2D art and pixel graphics that are animated. It also includes voice acting. All content is fully uncensored.

store_data.about_the_game:
Learning thousands of Japanese Kanji can be a daunting task, so we built a game to turn procrastination into progress.

Yomifuda: Kanji Survivors is a vocabulary-fueled bullet heaven where your knowledge is your only weapon. In this roguelite experience, reading and understanding words is the key to gaining power. Face down screen-filling hordes and fight your way toward Japanese fluency.

Master the Essentials

Learn all basic characters (Hiragana and Katakana) and all basic Kanji. Includes full audio for Onyomi and Kunyomi to sharpen your listening skills*.

The game tracks your progress and adapts to your skill level, introducing new challenges while reinforcing what you've already learned.

A Companion for the Long Road Ahead

Bond with a companion that grows with you. Feed and pet your friend to take a break from the battlefield, the perfect motivation to jump in for your daily study session (not available in the Demo).

Features

  • A familiar, addictive loop: Experience the classic "Survivors-like" dopamine hit while mastering a real-world skill.

  • Master the basics: Start with zero prior knowledge and jump straight into learning the fundamental Japanese scripts: Hiragana and Katakana.

  • Massive Kanji library: Conquer over 1,000 Kanji with a comprehensive focus on both On-yomi and Kun-yomi readings*.

  • Adaptive flashcard system: Our smart backend tracks your performance in real-time. By identifying the characters you struggle with and re-integrating them into the action, the game ensures true memorization rather than lucky guesses.

  • Immersive listening: Every word and reading is accompanied by high-quality audio, helping you develop accurate pronunciation and listening comprehension from day one**.

*Planned to be included in the final game. The demo contains 52 Hiragana/ Katakana words and 42 Kanji.
**Currently available for On-yomi and Kun-yomi.

Welcome to Celestine, an enchanting region where people called Makers use the ancient resource of Stuffing to bring magical dolls, called Huglets, to life!

In Stuff It, you take on the role of a Maker tasked with restoring peace by nurturing, training, and bonding with a team of of these charming plushies with thick, soft bodies and lots of love to give.

Blending the addictive loop of 90s "Tamagotchi-style" virtual pets with auto-battling, Stuff It offers a semi-idle experience where your care and preparation is the key to victory.



Key Features:

Deep Virtual Pet Simulation: Your Huglets are living companions. Keep them fed, clean, and happy to maximize their potential. Every interaction, from petting to renaming, strengthens your bond and unlocks new possibilities.

Tactical Auto-Battle Combat: Success is decided before the first blow is landed. Manage elemental types, equip powerful moves, and balance your team's energy. Watch your prep work pay off in battles against Celestine’s wild inhabitants.

The Art of Creation: Use Stuffing to create different Huglets to enjoy (currently 3 available, with 47 more on the way!)

Minigames: play fun minigames to increase your Huglet's stats. Engage in special lust-filled training to breed your dolls the old-fashioned way

Semi-Idle Progression: Perfect for multi-taskers. Let your Huglets explore and grow while you manage the big picture, making every click feel impactful.

What are you waiting for? Step into Celestine and start stuffing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia.

On a board where the four elements of wind, fire, water, and earth intertwine, you will command mages with distinct abilities. Your goal is to escort your Scepter to the central "Source of Magic" or to destroy the enemy's Scepter.

Core Features

Seven Unique Pieces:

Summoner: Summon an army to overwhelm your opponent.

Illusionist: Stealth and invisibility, shifting positions at will.

Abjurer: Project a Force Field to protect allies or crush enemies.

Necromancer: Manipulate life and death, reviving any corpse to serve you.

Diviner: Project a Divine Ward to suppress magic, the bane of all mages.

Evoker: Pierce through the battlefield, incinerating everything.

Scepter: The core and soul, the key to victory.

Contest the Center, Unleash Metamagic

The "Source of Magic" at the center of the board is a strategic focal point. When your piece occupies the center, it gains powerful Metamagic abilities. Controlling the center often tips the scales of victory in your favor.

2v2 Alliance Battles

In four-player matches, players sitting opposite each other form an alliance. Tacit cooperation is the key to victory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Silent Mainland is a Roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics, inspired by Slay the Spire and Monster Train. Build a unique deck in every run to challenge powerful foes, collect relics, and execute devastating combos across a procedurally generated continent. A must-play for fans of deckbuilding and Roguelike strategy!

Game Features

Spatial-Driven Strategy

  • Movement on the 5x12 grid is more than just positioning; it is the core engine for triggering card synergies. By integrating character displacement with spatial tactics, the game redefines the strategic depth of traditional deckbuilding.

Battlefront Depth & Relentless Waves

As waves of monsters pour onto the battlefield, utilize the 5x12 grid’s depth for kiting and defense. In a shifting tactical landscape, maintain composure under constant pressure to seize the perfect moment for a counterattack.

Global Campaign Mode

  • Moving beyond traditional linear progression, the Global Campaign Mode offers a more condensed pace and direct tactical feedback. Every node on the map presents a high-stakes decision, ensuring a tighter and more focused gameplay loop.

Multidimensional Card Evolution

  • In-game card upgrades offer diverse paths: Augmentation, Generalization, and Empowerment. Based on your evolutionary choices, every run allows for the development of entirely distinct archetypes and strategic synergies.

Content Included

  • 4 unique mercenaries: Dynamic Knight, Elemental Mage, Howling Druid, Sorrow Assassin

  • 350+ cards.

  • 130+ relics.

  • 50+ items.

  • 30+ events—challenge yourself or take a gamble!

Game Background

A group of adventurers brought together by life's low points forms a mercenary group to embark on a treasure hunt in the "Silent Mainland". They overcome powerful enemies in a perilous journey and ultimately gain not only treasures but also the courage to face adversities, the faith to rediscover themselves, and the precious bonds between each other.

We hope you enjoy playing "Silent Mainland" and love the game!

If you do, please consider adding it to your Wishlist—it means a lot to us.

store_data.about_the_game: Town Tower is a tower defense strategy game. Your goal is simple: transform an empty plot of land into a fortress capable of withstanding any siege. It's not just about shooting; it's about managing an economy. Build houses to generate villagers and assign them to gather the necessary resources while you focus on military defense.
