store_data.about_the_game:
Here, it’s the toys themselves that face off in the most chaotic races ever seen!

Every race is an unpredictable massacre: run, overcome obstacles, avoid traps, fly, snowboard down mountains, cross a child’s bedroom on a hoverboard, or surf through a water park.
With 16 crazy tracks and dynamic weather offering over 12 different climates, no two runs are ever the same!

Your goal? Finish first, no matter what. But in Little Toys, no one is ever safe. Set traps, turn the tables in a second, and snatch victory right from under your friends’ noses. Here, anything can happen… and especially the worst!

Play locally or online with your friends via *Steam Remote Play Together.

One purchase. Your friends play for free — even from anywhere!

In Little Toys, you play against your friends but also with them. Why? Because at the end of each championship, only the players on the podium contribute together to earning LittleFlouz, a currency essential for unlocking new maps and proving who the real couch champions are.

So cooperate… or sabotage each other, but never let the robots reach the podium!

Nothing is more satisfying than seeing your friends lose their cool when you steal first place at the very last second.

It’s funny, it’s unfair, it’s infuriating — and that’s exactly what makes every game of Little Toys unforgettable.

Key Features

  • Local multiplayer for up to 4 players – Challenge your friends, your family… even your grandma who’s never touched a controller.

  • Remote multiplayer with your friends via Steam Remote Play Together. *When using Steam Remote Play Together, remote players must use a controller.

  • 16 unique tracks – From children’s bedrooms to snowy mountains, water parks, and more.

  • Dynamic weather – Over 12 climates that turn every race into a brand-new chaos.

  • Varied movement modes – Run, fly, snowboard, hoverboard, or surf the waves.

  • Unpredictable chaos – Traps, obstacles, and spectacular twists in every match.

  • Podium & LittleFlouz – Climb the podium to earn the essential currency and unlock even more maps.

  • Explosive couch-party atmosphere – Laughter, betrayals, rage… get ready to ruin friendships.

store_data.about_the_game:
An Apathetic World

Built with the ideals of ancient CRPGS in mind, Apathema allows you to step into the Chasm and fight your way through an apathetic world full of strange creatures, secrets, and forgotten shrines.

The monsters you'll face are tough, requiring careful consideration of their weaknesses and abilities.

The world is rife with acid and darkness.

And your only guides might not be all they seem.

Tactical Combat

Manage your turns effectively in this turn-based combat system which leverages limb targeting, parrying, dodging, craftable spells, and unique skills to provide a tactical and engaging experience. Destroy or cripple limbs, exploit weaknesses, and reequip your character on the fly to counter the enemies in your way. But be warned, you're just as vulnerable as the monsters around you, and your turns are much more limited. 

Spell Crafting

Use the parts you take from the Chasm to craft either status or direct damage dealing spells and overcome the Chasm. You only get four spell slots to work with, so learning the area you're facing is vital for survival. 

Equip Accordingly

Featuring a variety of Armour, Weaponry, Spell-Guns, Passives, and Syringes, make sure to equip what you need to survive. Remember, a loadout for one area may not work for another.

Ensure Your Lantern Doesn't Go Out

Exploring the Chasm is already a dangerous task. To do so without your lantern will quickly lead to your end. Balance the use of your lantern as a tool in both exploration and combat if you want to descend to the bottom of the Chasm. Getting caught in the dark without a way out will see your sanity plummet, and horrors will quickly follow.

store_data.about_the_game:
Don’t Move the Mouse

Don’t Move the Mouse is a minimalist game about restraint, patience, and resisting the simplest impulse of all.

The rule is simple:
don’t move the mouse.

That’s it.

The timer starts the moment the game begins.
The slightest movement ends the run instantly.

No levels.
No story.
No objectives beyond staying perfectly still.

As time passes, the game will try to break your focus.
Fake pop-ups will appear.
Your patience will be tested.
Your hand will betray you.

Or maybe it won’t.

Your time is tracked down to milliseconds.
Every run is saved.
Your performance is ranked.

And yes — this game is designed with achievement hunters in mind.
Some achievements unlock quickly.
Others reward extreme patience and discipline.

Anyone can start.
Not everyone will last.

Features

  • One rule: don’t move the mouse

  • Precise time tracking down to milliseconds

  • Dozens of achievements

  • Random distraction pop-ups

  • Minimalist presentation

  • No ads, no microtransactions, no filler

Warning

Moving the mouse is a mistake.

store_data.about_the_game:
Soul Hunter is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of young paranormal researchers throw into the most mysterious and cursed places in Japan to prove the existence of the otherworld.

The only way to defeat the spirits is to capture them with a camera. In addition to sealing away the evil ghosts that attack you, the camera also serves as a charm against the evil eye, allows you to see through false illusions, and helps in the search for cursed objects.

GAMEPLAY

  •  “Soul Collector” Camera: This is your main tool and the only way to fight. The special camera is capable of repelling  vengeful ghosts, sealing away their powers, and capturing them. It is also used as a charm against the evil eye, helps you see through false illusions, and allows you to find cursed objects invisible to the naked eye.

  • Sanity: Keep an eye on your sanity. The longer you stay in a cursed area, the faster you’ll lose your mind. Better stock up on calming pills.

  • Exorcism: Only after performing a special ritual it is possible to fully exorcise the ghost. For each ghost, you must find and destroy all three of its cursed artifacts 

MULTIPLAYER

  • Cooperative play: Join forces with friends in this co-op horror game for a team of up to 4 people, where smooth collaboration is key to survival and success.

MAKE YOUR CHOICE

  • Explore the zones: The atmosphere here is truly oppressive. Dark abandoned buildings, the creak of wood, whispers, and voices from the void… definitely not for the faint of heart.

  • Bestiary: Each session is unique. You will encounter different creatures, each with its own special abilities and history. 

  • RPG elements: Play as one of the 4 researchers. Each has his own story and motive for participating in this expedition.

store_data.about_the_game:
KharkivVision-2035 is a narrative-driven atmospheric game about survival, time, and difficult choices.

You play as Mark, a young man who moves to Kharkiv in 2019 hoping to start a new life. Shortly after, he is diagnosed with a life-threatening illness.
He has only two months left to change his fate.

Story

The story unfolds between 2019 - 2035, following Mark’s journey through the realities of a large city:

  • finding work

  • building relationships

  • facing betrayal

  • making choices when time is running out

Every decision matters. Not all of them can be undone.

This is a story about:

  • how fragile ordinary life can be

  • fear and hope existing side by side

  • what truly matters when the future is uncertain

Key Features

  • A hand-crafted, atmospheric open city inspired by Kharkiv, changing over time 2019-2035

  • Explore freely between story missions:

    • return to your apartment

    • ride the metro

    • drive through the city

  • A grounded, emotional story told through dialogue and inner monologues

  • Realistic everyday situations instead of exaggerated drama

  • Focus on mood, immersion, and storytelling

  • Created by a solo developer

Gameplay

  • Narrative exploration

  • Story-driven cutscenes

  • Dialogue choices

  • Minimal UI and intuitive controls

  • You prefer atmosphere and meaning over action

All locations, mechanics, story, UI, and cutscenes are handcrafted.

Demo

store_data.about_the_game:
Combat in Harmonic Drift starts deliberately and controlled. Entities connect through energy beams, and you decide how much power flows through them.

Increase energy to deal more damage, but push too far, and the excess energy will harm you instead. Success comes from awareness and restraint, not reflexes.

Travel farther from the center to face stronger, evolving entities.

Defeating enemies grants experience, allowing you to shape your playstyle through the following attributes:

  • Force – increase damage

  • Resilience – reduce damage and regenerate health

  • Flow – move faster through the world

  • Clarity – expand your visible range

  • Focus – strengthen and extend buffs

Every run is a slow, intentional progression, guided by your decisions. Use mouse gestures to invoke temporary buffs, drawing on your Presence resource.

Harmonic Drift is designed to be calming and atmospheric with clean, abstract visuals and soft background music.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this peaceful realm, the Barrier protects everyone from monsters. Every thousand years, the Barrier falls, and a hero must defeat the monsters, collect keys, and find the mysterious Rainbow Key to restore the Barrier and bring peace to the realm.

You are Jumpy Tiger, and you are that hero!

Jumpy Tiger is a family-friendly collect-a-thon 2D platformer inspired by the classics of the 90s. It features seven levels, each with unique environments, enemies, bosses, hazards, and music. Levels are unlocked by collecting keys, which are earned by completing missions such as defeating all enemies, collecting five stars, or reaching the highest point in a level. Keys can be collected in any order, but all 35 must be collected to beat the game!

No AI was used in the creation of this game nor its assets.

store_data.about_the_game:
Boom Buddies is a fast-paced, fixed-position bullet hell survival game focused on pure action and replayability.

You have an animal hero locked at the center of the arena while enemies rush in from all directions. Survival depends on smart choices and right upgrades.

After clearing waves, you select upgrade cards that modify and enhance your weapon in powerful and sometimes unexpected ways. Each run becomes a new build, pushing you to experiment and survive longer.

As you progress, you unlock new animal characters, each starting with a different weapon and playstyle, encouraging fresh strategies and repeated runs.

Your goal is simple: eliminate as many enemies as possible before you fall.
Your kill count determines your place on the global leaderboard, where every run is a chance to climb higher.

Boom Buddies is easy to pick up, challenging to master, and built for players who enjoy short, intense sessions with endless replay value.

🔹 Key Features

  • 🐾 Fixed-position bullet hell survival gameplay

  • 🃏 Weapon upgrades through card-based choices

  • 🦊 Unlockable animal characters

  • 🌊 Endless enemy waves that ramp up in intensity

  • 🏆 Global leaderboard based on enemies defeated

  • 🔁 High replayability with fast, skill-based runs

store_data.about_the_game:
Blackjack Descent is a tense psychological horror roguelike where the classic rules of the card game are twisted and turned into a deal with fate. You find yourself in a dark basement casino, where not just the bank, but your life is at stake. Every night, you must sit down at the table against a sinister dealer to pay off a mounting debt.

Key Features:

  • Maniac Dealer.

Unlike classic Blackjack, the dealer doesn't follow fixed rules. He'll do everything he can to prevent you from winning...

  • Infected Deck.

The deck contains "infected" cards. These violate the standard Blackjack rules, alter point values, and trigger horror events, creating the effect of a "living" and hostile deck.

  • Charms and Amulets.

To increase your chances of survival and victory, purchase talismans and amulets of four rarities (common, cursed, ritual, and ancient). Each provides its own buffs during gameplay.

  • Two outcomes.

Your actions influence the ending: complete all six nights and pay off the debt in full to achieve the good ending and escape the room, or fail and become part of this cursed place in the bad ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
Open the notebook and explore seemingly ordinary yet mysterious incidents together with two girls!

Watsen, a student in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School, buys a notebook at a stationery store. At the time, she has no idea what she wants to write in it—she simply finds the cover cute and decides to buy it. This notebook becomes the starting point that brings Watsen and her classmate Homu together as a two-person team, investigating and deducing unusual incidents hidden within everyday school life.

To others, these incidents may seem like trivial problems caused by children. But for Homu and Watsen, each one is a difficult “case.” As the mysteries unfold one by one, a larger picture of life in Grade 5-B gradually emerges. With Homu’s sharp mind and decisive actions, and Watsen acting as her “assistant” who carefully records every clue, the two work together to uncover the truth behind each case. Along the way, classmates, teachers, and students from other grades all make their appearances, forming a full-fledged mystery story set within the school.

As the player, you will collect clues, conduct investigations, think things through, and make correct deductions alongside them. Watsen records all clues in her notebook—if you ever feel lost, try opening it and taking another look.

Watsen:

A cheerful and innocent elementary school girl in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School. She’s neither particularly noticeable nor invisible—just an ordinary student. She enjoys buying things she personally finds cute, though her taste isn’t always mainstream.

Homu:

A quiet and reserved elementary school girl in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School. She doesn’t have any especially close friends in class.

She is passionate about origami crafts and also has an interest in sprinting.

The game features a linear, chapter-based narrative structure, with seemingly ordinary incidents gradually forming a complete story.

  • The game consists of 5 chapters, each taking about 1 hour to complete.

  • Chapter 1 is released for free and offers a complete standalone story experience.

  • Chapters 2–3 will be released simultaneously as DLC.

  • Chapters 4–5 will be released later as DLC following the earlier chapters.

As the chapters progress, the scope of the story will gradually expand.

This title also serves as the starting point of a series. Future works set in the same theme and world are planned.
The series is expected to consist of multiple titles, each containing around five chapters, continuing to record mysteries hidden within everyday life.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the lifeline of a struggling town.

Beyond its walls lie hostile, ever-shifting regions filled with monsters, resources, and opportunity. Each journey is different while your success ensures the town's survival.

Enter different biomes, fight through multiple randomized levels per run, gather resources, and return home before midnight to supply your town and its people.

Core Gameplay Loop

  • Travel from your town to outside areas by using portals

  • Fight enemies and explore randomized levels

  • Collect resources, items, and rewards

  • Return to town to fulfill requests, rebuild the town, and prepare for the next run

Features

⚔️ Turn based Combat (with a twist)
Fight a variety of enemies across multiple biomes using my turn based combat, it works by having a preparation turn in which you decide your next 3 moves based on your energy. While your abilities are based on the weapons you equip and the training you do.

🌍 Randomized Runs
Each biome contains multiple randomized levels, ensuring that each expedition has it's own traps, rewards and misteries.

📜 Request Board Quests
Townsfolk post requests that can be difficult or simple, consisting of supply runs to high-risk quests tied to dangerous regions. Choose which missions to take and which to avoid.

🏘️ Town Progression
Resources you bring back help sustain and grow the town. Your success directly impacts the people relying on you while providing you with new supplies and areas to explore.

🎒 Items & Equipment
Discover and manage items gained from your journeys, shaping how you approach future runs.

🎨 Pixel Art World
Explore our pixel environments made with love by yours truly, the only dev. P.S: I did use some assets as I can't afford full time artists :(

Early Access

This game is launching in Early Access to allow the world, systems, and content to grow alongside player feedback. Expect regular updates adding new areas, enemies, items, and improvements to existing systems.

store_data.about_the_game:
THEY HIDE IN PLAIN SIGHT, BUT BEHIND THE GLAMOUR LIES AN ANCIENT GREED.

The world sees only wealth and glamour in the penthouse suites, the VIP lounges, and the boardrooms. But the real power isn't human. It’s hiding behind the velvet ropes.

The Demon Aristocracy has surfaced. Masquerading as the human elite, these entity "collectors" are liquidating humanity’s history. From the Torch of Lady Liberty to the Imperial Seal of Japan, they are stealing our greatest artifacts to decorate their personal underworlds.

The NIJI PROTOCOL is now active, and it's your job to stop these thieves in their tracks!

THE INVESTIGATION

Niji Protocol is a retro-styled detective puzzle game that pays homage to the classic "edutainment" deduction games of the 80s and 90s. As a field agent, you must track a thief across a global map, gathering clues to determine their next destination and their true identity.

But you aren't chasing common criminals. You are hunting demons.

  • TRAVEL across 30 neon-soaked cities, from the rainy streets of Neo-Tokyo to the frozen skyline of Toronto.

  • INVESTIGATE famous landmarks and interview local witnesses—from snooty Hotel Concierges to weary Street Vendors.

  • DECIPHER clues. Does the suspect have Red Skin or Blue Skin? Did they ask about the Yen or the Rupee? Did they flee toward a River or a Mountain?

THE LOGIC PUZZLE

Speed is essential, but accuracy is mandatory. You must correctly identify and catch the suspect before time runs out.

  • The Grimoire: Input the physical traits and habits you gather from witnesses. Filter the list of 24 High-Profile Demon Suspects to find your target.

  • The Seal of Banishment: You cannot make an arrest without the proper paperwork. You must positively identify the suspect and issue a warrant before the final confrontation.

  • The Confrontation: Corner the suspect at their final location. If your paperwork is in order, you banish them. If you guessed wrong... they escape with the loot.

KEY FEATURES

  • Procedural Cases: No two investigations are the same. The suspect, the stolen artifact, the flight path, and the clues are randomized for endless replayability.

  • Neon-Noir Aesthetic: A unique visual style blending 1980s retro anime character designs with a high-contrast, blacklight-fantasy color palette.

  • Educational Trivia: Use real-world geography, history, and cultural facts to determine where the suspect fled.

  • Rank Up: Start as a Rookie with a plastic badge and work your way up to an Ace detective, unlocking harder cases and elite clearance levels.

  • Original Soundtrack: Investigate to the smooth sounds of a soundtrack tailored for the twilight of the 20th century.

The clock is ticking, Agent. The collection is almost complete. Will you stop them?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Afterlife, Dear Spirits

Matchmaking for Ghosts is a character-focused, narrative-driven visual novel about love, loss, and unfinished business. You’re dead sure, but now what?The defining hook of Matchmaking for Ghosts lies in choice of perspective. Rather than following a single protagonist, players can step into the role of multiple ghostly leads, each with their own past, regrets, and stories. Every protagonist experiences the afterlife differently, and every route reframes the same world through a new emotional lens.

You’re thrown into a string of speed-dating rounds. Forced to come to terms with your death in a small period of time. All to find your soulmate, because if you don't, Death guarantees you'll receive a negative judgement.

Fortunately for you, 8 other ghosts have to persevere through the same fate. 
Make friends, break hearts, and spark a little bit of chaos along the way. Enjoy yourself~

But be warned… 

This is your second chance, and you don't get a third. 

 

Matchmaking? For Ghosts?

You play as one of the dead, thrown into an afterlife hotel by Death itself.

Here, you are given one final chance: to connect, to love, and to be understood.

Form bonds with other lost souls through fun conversations, risky flirting, and difficult decisions. At the end, your efforts will be judged: ascension, descent, or something worse, awaits. 

To get in the mood, Matchmaking for Ghosts is best experienced at a relaxed pace, with sound on.  Don't rush, allow yourself to be immersed, and enjoy yourself while making choices. The saving features allows the player to save whenever they'd like and pick up exactly where they left off. 

Features

  • POV: Play as one of the ghosts yourself & date a cast of intricately crafted individuals who are all from different time periods and regions of the world. 

  • Decisions Matter: Your path is shaped by every single choice you make, including the risks you take and the words you use. 

  • Multiple unique CGs for every available pairing and several CGS per character. 

  • Pair or matchmake a variety of ghosts. Chase romance, stir conflict, or engineer absolute messes. Every pairing unlocks unique scenes, provided new character details, and leads to vastly different outcomes.

  • A Variety of Environments: Discover a creepy hallway, a glowing arcade, an opulent Victorian living room, and even a Bunny Cafe during your stay that are all brought to life by unique soundtracks, artwork, and backgrounds.

  • Unique Sound Design: Each round of dating includes engrossing aural cues, including footsteps, wooden creaks, flickering candles, and other SFX.

  • Original OST: The official soundtrack of the game is completely original, and each background environment, and ghostly character has their own respective theme. There are over 35 tracks in the current game!

This DEMO includes:

  • Mary & Ryder as the two playable POV characters. 

  • Zack, Alice, Ryder, and Mary as dateable characters;

  • Multiple rounds of fun, and over 8 hours of gameplay. 

  • Multiple choice sets per round;

  • Emotional voice overs, polished visuals, and immersive audio;

  • And GIFTS from each character for you (the player) to collect!~

Meet the Cast (and You)



Mary: A fragile but sharp orphan pianist, resigned to despair but harboring sparks of hidden thrill. The rain is heavier than usual tonight. 



Alice: A classy, but cruelly blunt ghost with a psychotic streak and a dark past. A chaotic, malicious spirit who may hold ulterior motives for this game. 



Zack: A laid-back streetwise ghost who masks deep regrets and jealousy with humor and chill vibes. Riding through life until he reached a dead-end. 





Ryder: A detective who died with honor, now learning to live without purpose. This hotel holds many secrets... perhaps he can get to the bottom of this case?


...And many more spirits waiting to test your heart!
Do you dare to fall in love... with the dead?

Note: The game isn't released quite yet, but it will be during Steam Next Fest. Feel free to check out our Itch page, Wishlist and follow our socials to stay up to date!

content_descriptors.notes:
Matchmaking for Ghosts explores dark, emotional, and complex themes that may be sensitive for some players.

The story includes:

- Non-graphic depictions of violence, including supernatural attacks, ghostly injury, and, in potential endings, character deaths. 
- Psychological horror elements, such as intimidation, coercion, manipulation, and threatening behavior by specific characters
- Strong emotional themes, including death, grief, trauma, regret, guilt, and moral judgment
- Alcohol and drug use, portrayed within the narrative
- Suggestive dialogue, flirting, and adult themes, without explicit sexual acts or pornographic content

Some narrative paths may lead to lethal or morally disturbing outcomes, depending on player choices. All violence is stylized and non-graphic, but may be intense in tone.

There are no depictions of sexual assault or non-consensual sexual acts. However, the game may portray emotional distress, power imbalances, and psychologically unsettling situations as part of its storytelling.

Players sensitive to themes involving death, violence, psychological tension, or darker relationship dynamics should use discretion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Civica brings the Italian Renaissance to life. Up-and-coming city-states compete for influence, humanist ideals spread throughout the country and challenge the old dominance of the still powerful Church, artists create masterpieces that define an entire era and long-established families such as the Medici attempt to divide power among their peers. 

Civica offers a unique combination of a city-builder and a first-person role-playing game.

Assert yourself as a successful city lord and transform a small Tuscan village into a metropolis that is second to none. With gridless organic city building, flexible residential building slots and countless building upgrades, there are no limits to your vision.

Build production facilities and farms in the surrounding area and manage a variety of complex production chains to produce resources such as mosaics, roof tiles, pottery and wine. Satisfy the needs of four different population groups – farmers, craftsmen, citizens and nobles – with everyday goods and luxury items.

Build public buildings such as churches, fountains or schools to improve the quality of life in your city and attract higher classes who are not only willing to pay higher taxes, but also enable the construction of new buildings.

Establish a dynasty and care for your offspring. Secure influence in the city council and determine policy at regular council meetings with other city leaders. Decide whether there is room in the city for the new humanistic ideals or whether to seek solidarity with the church. 

Engage your residents in conversation at the market square and attend to their individual needs and concerns, bribe the town council before the next election and lend a hand yourself when building the next residential building if progress is once again too slow.

Manage a complex goods cycle consisting of primary resources, processed goods, luxury goods and a wide variety of food types. Take care of the variable needs of your residents for luxury goods, food and access to public buildings, which become increasingly complex in higher social classes. Trade with merchants at the marketplace and various lords in the surrounding area to compensate for supply shortages.

Roads can be built flexibly in organic shapes. The slots for residential buildings can also be designed flexibly in terms of shape and size and adapt to the shape of the roads. Neighboring residential buildings are connected to each other, enabling continuous rows of houses – as is typical in Tuscany, Italy. The backyards of residential buildings can be expanded with various upgrades, for example to increase food production by adding a chicken coop.

The complete simulation of residents with working hours, sleeping hours and leisure activities creates a bustling atmosphere in the city centres of Civica. While the residents go about their work in the businesses during the day, they visit the market square or the church in the afternoon, or rest at home after a long day at work, before falling into bed exhausted in the evening. All residents have individual needs that need to be met and occasionally give the player various quests.

In addition to the day-night cycle, life and production are influenced by a dynamic weather system that can bring droughts or floods. The annual cycle also determines the cultivation of vegetables and cereals.

Playing from a first-person perspective is an integral part of the game. Resource extraction and processing, crafting and building construction can be carried out by the player themselves. All actions are influenced by the player's experience, skills and stats (health, stamina, hunger, sleep).

All models are modeled after Italian examples in order to authentically capture the Italian Renaissance period. Both the flora and fauna are influenced by Tuscany. The production techniques, resources and food are also based on the period, as are the names of cities, places, and people.

You awaken from your primordial slumber as an age old tree. Filled with vengeance and wrath, you seek to destroy the invaders of your peaceful dwelling and return order to the natural world. The Children of Vangarod are seeking to resurrect an ancient and evil Lovecraftian deity to fulfill their wicked prophecies, and they have summoned you by mistake. Purge them and their vile creations from these lands and put a stop to the age of chaos and violence brought about by the resurrection of Vangarod by any means necessary. 

The enemies you'll encounter in IronWood vary, from regular cultist foot soldiers and healers, to more mythical and unearthly monsters that require the player exercise high caution. Be prepared to face powerful foes and unimaginable creatures!

In IronWood you travel through diverse environments filled to the brim with enemies, structures, and secrets. Prepare to cross through rural environments like forests, swamps, caves, and many other breathtaking locations. Use the environment to your advantage to explode, combust, and crush enemies.

The 10+ weapons you will come across in IronWood mostly follow the norms previously set by other titans of the FPS genre, but there are a handful of weapons that break the mold and offer a unique combat experience. Expect to see your old favorites like pistols, shotguns, and rifles, along with new mythical and Lovecraftian armaments to add to your ever-growing arsenal. Weapons have unique ways to use them to take on enemies in the coolest way you can utilizing shotgun jumps, rapid fire, and rage abilities.

IronWood is for people longing for a boomer shooter with fast paced combat, and epic boss fights.

store_data.about_the_game:
The price of friendship 

Julien has just lost her best friend, Sarah, and her death has had more of an effect on her than she realised. Strange visions are starting to lead her towards a mysterious corporation that promises to heal trauma through dream exploration, but how much can ‘Focus on Dream’ really be trusted? 

Curious and driven to dive deeper, reality begins to distort. Sarah may still be alive, but Julien... Julien’s mind might not be her own. 

The stuff of nightmares 

Descend into a haunting narrative-driven story that offers a gripping psychological thriller experience and tense atmosphere. Packed with environmental puzzles woven into every thread of the story, players will need to manipulate objects, decode cryptic messages, rearrange fragmented memories, and rewire intricate devices to progress the story.  

One man’s trash is another man’s treasure 

Julien’s pursuit for closure will be aided by her trusty slingshot. Threats in the distorted dreamworld can be outwitted with additional, unique projectiles, including EMP stun pellets and smoke bombs to aid stealthy escapes.  

 

Exploration and creativity are rewarded in AMIGO, allowing players to tailor their approach to combat, puzzles, and NPC decisions. Scavenging for materials will allow players to upgrade and customize their slingshot. 

Travelling in style 

Hop on your bicycle to explore areas and evade threats as your search for Sarah unravels. Traverse dreamworlds with the VisionBox, a mysterious device that alters the environment. Learn time control and mind-manipulating abilities as you progress through the story, which can be used to slow time during intense chases or against your enemies. 

Sleep soundly 

AMIGO’s tense atmosphere, unpredictable events, and emotional storytelling is enshrouded by its haunting original soundtrack, composed by Mad Var Studios.

store_data.about_the_game:
RiffHammer is a rhythm hack-and-slash game where every strike lands in time with the music. Stay on the beat to unleash devastating blows.

You’re not the only one bound by the music. Your enemies attack in rhythmic patterns of their own. Read these patterns and exploit their rhythm to dominate the battlefield.

Fight as a grumpy dwarf through procedurally generated dungeons and handcrafted scenarios — or defend the local tavern and its precious beer barrels against ferocious hordes. Face off against undead, orcs, demons, insectoids, and more.

Every weapon in RiffHammer comes with its own moveset, soundtrack, and beatmaps—each tailored to its unique fighting style.

Swing the Doomhammer for slow, crushing devastation. Tear through enemies with the Thrash Daggers in frantic close combat. Or shoot bolts from the Argent Impaler, if you don't like anyone in the direction you are pointing.

Want to take it further? Import your own songs and beatmaps to create your custom riffhammering experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lock. Load. Light Up.

When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours.
You’re The Exterminator , a rough-around-the-edges hired gun for a secret government agency that prefers to stay off the books and out of the headlines. Your job? Eliminate threats with extreme prejudice, one cheesy one-liner at a time.

Inspired by the golden age of 90s shooters, Call the Exterminator blends retro FPS attitude with modern flair, delivering fast gunplay, stylized violence, and a signature mechanic that keeps the action smokin’...literally.

FEATURES

90s Retro Shooter Vibes
Chunky pixels. Punchy weapons. Explosive combat arenas. This is the era of circle-strafing and keycard-hunting, reborn with modern punch, In classic 2.5D style.

 

Smoke for Slow-Mo
Light up a cigarette mid-fight to trigger adrenaline-pumping slow motion. Dodge bullets, line up perfect shots, and savor that sweet, sweet tactical breathing room.

Cheesy One-Liners 
The Exterminator never shuts up—and that’s a feature. Enjoy a classic barrage of action-hero quips.

Over-the-Top Gunplay
Blast through waves of terrorists using shotguns, SMGs, rifles, and DIY extermination tools designed to delete problems in style.

Gibs, Explosions, and Excess
Because if everything isn’t exploding all the time… is it even a 90s FPS?

Suit up. Light up. Call the Exterminator.
Someone’s gotta take out the trash—and it might as well be you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rugby Management: School to Senior

This is a management simulation that bridges the gap between school rugby and the professional senior game. The world is populated by thousands of players who start their careers at age 16 in the school leagues and progress into the full senior system.

A Connected Ecosystem The game simulates a complete rugby career path. Players you see in school competitions today will be the free agents and transfer targets of tomorrow.

  • Scout: Find talent in the school leagues before they turn pro.

  • Develop: Track player progress over seasons as their attributes change.

  • Manage: Build squads that balance current ability with future potential.

Career Progression You choose where you fit into this world.

  • School Coach: Take charge of a school 1st XV and develop young talent.

  • Senior Manager: Jump straight into the top leagues with established clubs.

  • Unemployed: Start with no job and apply for open positions. The game uses an interview and prestige system—you must earn the reputation required for better jobs.

Tactics and Simulation You have full control over the technical side of the game. Matches are simulated live, allowing you to watch the action unfold through commentary and stats. Your decisions on zone defense, phase play, set-piece moves and team selection influence the result.

Customization The game features a fully open database structure. You can export league, team, and player data to CSV, edit the files externally, and import them back in to create your own custom game worlds.

Key Features

  • Interconnected World: A single ecosystem containing both School and Senior leagues.

  • Player Progression: 40,000+ players who age, improve, and retire within a living simulation.

  • Career Mode: Start at any level or begin unemployed. Navigate job interviews and build your managerial prestige.

  • Tactical Depth: Configure specific zone defense, attack phases, and first-phase set-piece moves.

  • Squad Management: Handle training regimes, contract negotiations and transfer budgets.

  • Match Simulation: Watch matches play out via a detailed descriptive engine.

  • Database Editor: Full support for CSV export and import allows for total database customization.

  • Global Scale: Includes over 100 leagues and 800 teams.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE HOUSE DOESN'T ALWAYS WIN

Welcome to MAZINO – where the casino floor is a maze and every corner could be your last. You are Chip, a lucky token trying to cash out big while evading the Dealers, relentless enforcers who patrol the neon corridors and don't let anyone leave a winner.

WHAT IS MAZINO?

Navigate maze-like casino floors, collect chips, avoid the Dealers, and survive long enough to bank your winnings. Simple to learn, impossible to put down. MAZINO blends arcade action with casino psychology, creating a feedback loop that keeps whispering "just one more run."

THE STREAK SYSTEM

Your performance builds momentum:

Cold – You're losing. Multipliers drop.

Neutral – Steady play. Standard rewards.

Warm – Getting hot. Bonuses increase.

Hot – On fire. Big multipliers kick in.

Blazing – Unstoppable. Maximum rewards, maximum risk.

One hit resets everything. Do you play it safe or push your luck?

CASINO MECHANICS

Mystery Chips – Scattered across the floor. Grab one for bonus chips, speed boosts, extra lives... or a nasty surprise. Risk and reward.

Jackpot Triggers – Hit the right combination and watch chips rain from the sky as the screen explodes in gold.

Wheel of Fortune – Fill the meter through skilled play, spin the wheel, claim your prize.

Near-Miss Bonuses – Almost got caught? The casino rewards the bold. Brush past danger for bonus chips.

Comp Points – Loyalty pays. Earn points just by playing and spend them on upgrades.

THE DEALERS

Four enforcers patrol the floor, each with unique hunting behavior:

The Chaser – Relentless. Follows your every move.

The Interceptor – Cunning. Predicts where you're going and cuts you off.

The Wildcard – Erratic. Works with others in unexpected ways.

The Drifter – Passive until you get close. Then suddenly deadly.

Learn their patterns. Exploit their weaknesses. Survive.

ADAPTIVE DIFFICULTY

MAZINO watches how you play. Dominating the floor? The Dealers speed up and coordinate. Struggling to survive? The pressure eases – just enough to give you hope before the next spike. Every session feels tailored to your skill level.

BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Every few floors, a Boss Dealer appears. These aren't standard enforcers – they have multiple attack phases, summon backup, and require pattern recognition to defeat. Take them down for massive rewards.

MUSIC-REACTIVE WORLD

The entire casino pulses to the soundtrack. Lights sync to the bass. Neon blooms on every beat drop. The floor isn't just a maze – it's a living, breathing rhythm experience.

VIP PROGRESSION

Rise through the ranks:

Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond

Bank your chips between runs. Unlock permanent bonuses. Climb the global leaderboards. Your lifetime earnings determine your VIP status.

FEATURES

- Original arcade action with casino flair

- Deep economy system: chips, streaks, multipliers, banking

- Adaptive difficulty that responds to your skill

- Boss encounters with unique mechanics

store_data.detailed_description:
THE HOUSE DOESN'T ALWAYS WIN

Welcome to MAZINO – where the casino floor is a maze and every corner could be your last. You are Chip, a lucky token trying to cash out big while evading the Dealers, relentless enforcers who patrol the neon corridors and don't let anyone leave a winner.

WHAT IS MAZINO?

Navigate maze-like casino floors, collect chips, avoid the Dealers, and survive long enough to bank your winnings. Simple to learn, impossible to put down. MAZINO blends arcade action with casino psychology, creating a feedback loop that keeps whispering "just one more run."

THE STREAK SYSTEM

Your performance builds momentum:

Cold – You're losing. Multipliers drop.

Neutral – Steady play. Standard rewards.

Warm – Getting hot. Bonuses increase.

Hot – On fire. Big multipliers kick in.

Blazing – Unstoppable. Maximum rewards, maximum risk.

One hit resets everything. Do you play it safe or push your luck?

CASINO MECHANICS

Mystery Chips – Scattered across the floor. Grab one for bonus chips, speed boosts, extra lives... or a nasty surprise. Risk and reward.

Jackpot Triggers – Hit the right combination and watch chips rain from the sky as the screen explodes in gold.

Wheel of Fortune – Fill the meter through skilled play, spin the wheel, claim your prize.

Near-Miss Bonuses – Almost got caught? The casino rewards the bold. Brush past danger for bonus chips.

Comp Points – Loyalty pays. Earn points just by playing and spend them on upgrades.

THE DEALERS

Four enforcers patrol the floor, each with unique hunting behavior:

The Chaser – Relentless. Follows your every move.

The Interceptor – Cunning. Predicts where you're going and cuts you off.

The Wildcard – Erratic. Works with others in unexpected ways.

The Drifter – Passive until you get close. Then suddenly deadly.

Learn their patterns. Exploit their weaknesses. Survive.

ADAPTIVE DIFFICULTY

MAZINO watches how you play. Dominating the floor? The Dealers speed up and coordinate. Struggling to survive? The pressure eases – just enough to give you hope before the next spike. Every session feels tailored to your skill level.

BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Every few floors, a Boss Dealer appears. These aren't standard enforcers – they have multiple attack phases, summon backup, and require pattern recognition to defeat. Take them down for massive rewards.

MUSIC-REACTIVE WORLD

The entire casino pulses to the soundtrack. Lights sync to the bass. Neon blooms on every beat drop. The floor isn't just a maze – it's a living, breathing rhythm experience.

VIP PROGRESSION

Rise through the ranks:

Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond

Bank your chips between runs. Unlock permanent bonuses. Climb the global leaderboards. Your lifetime earnings determine your VIP status.

FEATURES

- Original arcade action with casino flair

- Deep economy system: chips, streaks, multipliers, banking

- Adaptive difficulty that responds to your skill

- Boss encounters with unique mechanics

- Music-reactive lighting and visual effects

- Full controller support with haptic feedback

- Steam Achievements and Global Leaderboards

- Daily Challenges with unique modifiers

- Ghost Replay – race against your best runs

store_data.about_the_game:
It all started on a sunny afternoon... until an incredibly stupid-looking spaceship fell from the sky.

Stinky Cat was just minding his own business when he was kidnapped by an Evil Fox and his henchmen (a goofy Dog and a Donkey). Their diabolical plan? They strapped a "High-Tech Electronic Toilet Plunger" onto Stinky Cat's head.

ZAP—BOOM!
Stinky Cat has been uploaded into [Cyber Space]. To escape this digital prison (and remove the plunger from his head), he must bomb his way through a virtual world filled with crates, glitches, and chaos!

He is a Tuxedo cat. He has a... let's call it a "very distinct" pattern on his face.

He might look a bit goofy, but he has a talent for explosives. Oh, and he has a serious addiction to Surströmming (fermented herring).

Stinky Cat is a humorous and cozy puzzle game that blends the logic of "Sokoban" with the destructive joy of "Bomberman". No intense countdowns, no stress. Just observe, plan, place a bomb, and—KABOOM!

Key Features:

  • Push Boxes & Blow Stuff Up:
    Some paths require logic to push boxes; others require brute force (high explosives).

    Use boxes as shields against turrets or blast them away to clear a path. Made a mistake? Don't worry, Stinky Cat is used to flying through the air.

  • Bio-Hazard Power-ups:
    Find the legendary Surströmming cans.

    To others, it's a smell that violates the Geneva Convention; to Stinky Cat, it's a delicious snack! Eat it to trigger special states (and turn slightly green).

  • Wild Mechanics:
    Navigate through a variety of contraptions. Jump through Portals, ride Conveyor Belts, and unlock doors. The puzzles evolve as you progress!

  • Absurd Enemies:
    You are not alone in this maze.
    Watch out for the Annoying Dog—he loves nothing more than messing up the boxes you just perfectly arranged.
    Dodge the Crazy Police Car that ignores all traffic laws.
    Is that a UFO? Yes, even aliens are here to drop bombs on your head.

  • Cozy & Chill Vibes:
    Despite the explosions, this is a relaxing experience. Enjoy the vibrant cartoon art style and chill music. Grab a coffee(actually beer is better), watch this silly cat create chaos, and solve puzzles at your own pace.

Ready? Hold your nose, light the fuse, and let the adventure begin!

store_data.about_the_game:
Paradise Corner is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.

After years of wandering, you finally return to your native land. Your garden, once lush and blooming, is now overgrown with weeds, the beds are bare, and pests roam every corner.

But with your return, everything will change! A young man greets you at the door – a faithful helper who has held onto hope for your return all these years and carefully tended to what could still be saved. With his support and your determination, the journey to reviving the garden begins.

Your task is to gradually, step by step, restore life and beauty to the garden. Destroy pests by clicking on them to protect the seedlings and allow future harvests to flourish without threat. Uproot the weeds, making room for new plantings and allowing the garden to bloom once again. Plant a variety of crops and eventually restore your garden's grandeur, filling it with vibrant flowers and a bountiful harvest!

“Dusk Park” is an exploration adventure game
where you attempt to escape from a mysterious building
bathed in the light of the setting sun.

While avoiding a pursuer that roams the building,
you must search for items and find a way to escape this world.

Story

After dozing off on a park bench,
the protagonist wakes up inside an unfamiliar building.

The building, filled with the glow of the setting sun,
has no visible exits.

Your search for a way out begins.

There are several different ways to escape the building.

All of them require collecting specific items.

Item locations are randomized,
and the number of items you can carry at once is limited.

The Pursuer

A relentless presence wanders the building,
constantly chasing the player.

If you are caught, it is game over.

None

store_data.about_the_game:
Move Your Whole Body to the Beat

Stand up and follow the coach on screen. Step to the rhythm and sync your body with the music.

Turn your webcam on for AI motion scoring, or play with it off and simply follow along.

All exercises are done in place — no running, jumping, or large movements needed. One square meter is all you need for a great workout.

Play Your Way

  • AI Scoring Mode (Optional Webcam) — Tracks your moves and scores your accuracy. Challenge yourself!

  • Follow-Along Mode — No camera? No problem. Just follow the coach for a sweat session.

Rich Content

  • 200+ motion-captured fitness exercises

  • 150+ music tracks

  • 80+ virtual coaches

  • 15+ scene environments

Covering warm-up, cardio, strength, stretching, dance, and more. From low to high intensity to match your fitness level.

Is This Game for You?

  • Desk workers — 10 minutes of movement, no need to leave home

  • Rhythm game fans — This time, play with your whole body

  • Fitness beginners — Just follow the coach

  • Small spaces — In-place exercises, no large room needed

What Do You Need?

Just a PC and the willingness to stand up. No VR headset, no motion controllers, no fitness ring, no wearables, no subscription required.

Webcam is optional for AI motion scoring and mirror mode.

Track Your Progress

  • Level system records your workout journey

  • Daily/weekly challenges keep you moving

  • Achievement system marks every milestone

Train Like You're in Front of a Mirror

With a regular webcam, you can also turn on mirror mode to see yourself in real-time.

Just like working out in front of a gym mirror — check your form and adjust anytime.

Advanced: Use Your Own Music

Want to work out to your favorite songs?

Drop music files into the MyMusic folder, and the game analyzes the beat automatically.

Same experience as built-in tracks, plus you can mix and match into your own playlists.

Advanced: Create Your Own Routine

Preset workouts not enough? Build your own.

Pick from 200+ exercises, set duration, adjust rest intervals.

Save as your personal routine and reuse anytime.

Health Notice

  • Make sure you have enough safe space before exercising

  • Wear non-slip shoes or go barefoot to prevent slipping

  • Stop immediately if you feel unwell

Game Background:

As an outstanding coin collector, you won't give up any coin in this world. Upon learning that the pyramid area contains a large number of coins and mysterious treasures, you hurriedly arrive at its outer region. After investigating, you find that in order to unlock the ultimate treasure, you must traverse the lava area and collect all the coins.

Gameplay:

Use your double-jump ability to avoid and pass through the lava area, collecting all the coins along the way to unlock the final treasure chest.

As a single-player coin collection game, it features platforming and collectible gameplay. You can play leisurely, with no time limits, using your double-jump ability to collect all the coins and achieve victory. During the game, you must be careful of hazardous environments—scalding lava.

Game Background:

As an outstanding coin collector, you won't give up any coin in this world. Upon learning that the pyramid area contains a large number of coins and mysterious treasures, you hurriedly arrive at its outer region. After investigating, you find that in order to unlock the ultimate treasure, you must traverse the lava area and collect all the coins.

Gameplay:

Use your double-jump ability to avoid and pass through the lava area, collecting all the coins along the way to unlock the final treasure chest.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Nostalgic Journey Through 1998

The war has been over for six years, and the world is finally breathing again. Step into a lo-fi driving experience that celebrates the slow, steady pace of life. There is no hunger, no thirst, and no pressure—just the open road, the changing sky, and the hum of your engine. Whether the sun warms your dashboard or moonlight guides your way, the city is yours to navigate.

The Rhythm of the City: Day & Night

Experience a living world that shifts with time:

  • Golden Hours: Spend your days navigating the streets, fulfilling delivery contracts, and managing your routine under the sun.

  • Midnight Serenity: When the sun goes down, the city takes on a poetic silence. Pick up late-night passengers, listen to their stories, or simply drive through the misty glow of streetlights.

Build, Donate, and Grow

Every mile you drive has a purpose:

  • Drive to Earn: Take on simple taxi jobs or transport essential goods at your own pace—no timers, no rush.

  • A Heart for the City: Use your profits to donate to charities or reinvest in your own company to unlock new opportunities.

  • The Collector’s Garage: Save up to unlock 3 different vehicles, each with its own driving feel.

Peace of Mind

It’s not about staying alive; it’s about staying balanced:

  • Nurture Your Spirit: Keep your sanity high by taking intentional breaks. Enjoy a simple meal, pull over to appreciate the view, or just breathe.

  • A Pure Experience: Minimalist UI, atmospheric sound, and peaceful streets—just you, your car, and a world finally at peace.

Take the Wheel

Hit the road and explore the city at your own pace. Let every mile tell a story, and find your own rhythm behind the wheel.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Wind and Pasture] is a blend of high-freedom exploration and whimsical ranching simulation. In this fractured world, the planet has shattered, and an irresistible gravity slowly pulls everything toward an endless abyss. Yet, before the end, the wind is still gentle, and flowers still bloom. You will rebuild your home on floating islands and find the meaning of survival in a world teetering on the edge.

🌌 The World: Dancing Above the Abyss

We once nested safely inside small planets. Now, the world has crumbled into an archipelago suspended in the void. The laws of physics here are both dangerous and mesmerizing—gravity pulls directly into the abyss. You must navigate the fractured terrain with care, but also embrace the freedom to defy the fall.

  • Absolute Mobility: No invisible walls block your path. Climb any cliff, ruin, or floating rock, and sprint across the vast, open fields.

  • Ride the Wind: Grasp a giant dandelion to glide effortlessly between floating islands. Feel the flow of the wind—it is your only guide in this broken world.

🐞 Ecology: Ranching Galactic Critters

This wasteland is far from dead; countless miraculous life forms thrive here against the odds.

  • Discover & Collect: Explore every corner to find "bugs" of all shapes and sizes. Some carry ores on their backs, others secrete glowing fluids, and some even float like clouds.

  • Build a Bug Ranch: Capture and tame them. Learn their habits. They will provide rare resources and help you survive in this perilous world.

🌻 Farming: Sowing Hope Before the Fall

Farming is your innate talent, and your weapon against the encroaching void.

  • Create a Sky Garden: Till the land on your floating ranch. Whether it's a sea of golden sunflowers or strange, glowing flora adapted to the void, the choice is yours to plant.

  • Rebuild Your Home: Use collected resources and crops to build your sanctuary. Watch as desolate meteorite fragments transform into a vibrant, green ark.

📜 The Story: To That Which Must Fade

"I always worry that, perhaps one day, we will all become burning shooting stars, falling finally into the abyss."
But until that day comes, we choose to live.

  • Explore Ruins: Uncover the truth behind the shattering of the mother planet and read the final messages left by your kin.

  • Cherish the Moment: Even on the edge of a cliff, take a moment to watch the sunset and listen to the wind rustling through the insect songs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep Space Exodus is a sci-fi, multi-ending narrative simulation game set against the backdrop of deep-space navigation.
You alone bear the fate of an immigrant starship, making irreversible decisions again and again in the boundless universe.

You Are the Administrator of The Noah

As the sole decision-making core of the immigrant starship The Noah, the future of hundreds—perhaps thousands—of lives rests on your judgment.
During this long and lonely voyage, there are no “correct answers.”
There are only consequences.

Explore the Unknown Depths of Space

Throughout your journey, you will continuously encounter the unknown:

  • Unfamiliar planets of vastly different natures — each may offer hope, or conceal a deadly trap

  • Other starships and interstellar travelers — will you ignore them, cooperate, or confront them? A choice must always be made

  • Mysterious signals from deep space — are they cries for help, warnings, or bait? The universe will not explain. It will only wait for your response.

The voyage is never peaceful. Crises can strike at any moment:

  • 🏴‍☠ Sudden attacks by space pirates

  • 🛰 Secrets hidden within abandoned space stations

  • ☄ Unpredictable stellar storms

  • ❓ Incomprehensible anomalies and critical moments of decision

Every event forces you to choose between risk, cost, and humanity.

Resource Management: The Core Law of Survival

Resources are time. Resources are life.

  • ⚡ Energy — the foundation of propulsion, life support, and exploration

  • 📦 Supplies — how long your crew can endure

  • 👥 Population — labor, hope, and burden alike

Resources are always limited, and problems are always greater than what you can afford.
You must decide what takes priority—and what can be sacrificed.

Every Choice Shapes the Ending

There is no linear storyline.
There is no predefined perfect ending.
There are only outcomes shaped by your own decisions.

Remember: every choice you make may determine the historical course of an entire civilization.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Medieval Lord Tycoon is a charming pixel-art medieval lord simulator that puts you in the crown of a rising ruler, tasking you with building, managing, and defending a thriving medieval domain. Blending hands-on craftsmanship with strategic governance, it offers a flexible and immersive take on feudal leadership—where every choice shapes the fate of your lands and people.

Core Gameplay

Step into the boots of a lord with dual paths to prosperity: roll up your sleeves for hands-on labor, or rule with shrewd delegation. Till fertile fields, swing an axe to chop timber, and track game in the forests to secure resources firsthand—savoring the gritty charm of medieval self-sufficiency. Or, optimize efficiency by assigning these trivial daily tasks to your townsfolk, freeing you to focus on the grander work of growing your realm.

Crucially, you won’t micromanage your people’s daily lives—but your authority guides their success. Regulate your domain through tailored taxes (balancing treasury health with public morale), enforce laws to maintain order, and roll out policies that align with your vision—whether prioritizing agriculture, trade, or defense. Every decision ripples through your settlement: fair governance boosts loyalty, while missteps may sow discontent.

When raiders or rival lords threaten your lands, your prestige becomes your greatest weapon. The higher your standing among the people, the more peasants will rally to your banner, taking up arms to defend their homes and your rule. Lead them to victory, and your legend as a wise and formidable lord will grow—securing your domain’s place in medieval history.

Key Features

  • Dual Play Styles: Choose between hands-on labor (farming, chopping, hunting) or efficient delegation to townsfolk—play how you want to rule.

  • Strategic Governance: Shape your realm through taxes, laws, and policies—no direct control over daily lives, but total influence over long-term prosperity.

  • Prestige & Defense System: Build your reputation to rally more defenders during attacks; the loyalty of your people is your strongest fortress.

  • Charming Pixel-Art Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, visually cohesive medieval world brought to life with detailed pixel graphics and atmospheric design.

  • Dynamic Realm Growth: Watch your humble village evolve into a bustling town (and beyond) as you master resource management, governance, and defense.

What You’ll Experience

From the first plow in the soil to the clash of swords against invaders, Medieval Lord Tycoon lets you live out the fantasy of ruling a medieval domain on your terms. Whether you prefer getting your hands dirty with manual labor or orchestrating grand strategies from the castle walls, the game adapts to your leadership style. Balance short-term needs (securing food, wood, and game) with long-term goals (building prestige, uniting your people, and repelling threats) to create a legacy that endures. With its blend of accessibility and depth, it’s perfect for both casual players drawn to pixel-art charm and strategy enthusiasts craving meaningful decision-making.

THE NIGHTMARE BEGINS You wake up in a house that feels strange. The exits are locked. What starts as a set of spooky puzzles in the dark will lead you into forgotten caves and eventually into a vast, quiet forest.

KEY FEATURES

  • Non-Linear Path: The forest offers no clear routes. Wander freely, but be careful: the deeper you go, the closer the darkness gets.

  • Fight Back: Look for ancient artifacts and gather the tools needed to turn the tide against the creature hunting you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

My name is Jack. When I was a little kid I saw a beautiful girl in my neighborhood who had just moved in. I talked to her. Her name was Evelyn. She gave me a beautiful smile. I just wanted a friend to play with.

I had no other friends. She agreed. But then she took a step back and her face changed. "I can't. I should ask my mom first," she said. I was confused. Then I learned that she has a serious illness. She is basically dying. She cannot do much work. So we only played board games.

Time passed. By some miracle she is still alive and well. I could not live without her. Without her innocent smile. I married her.

I am 35 now and we decided not to have kids because of her illness. Starting last month she grew weaker every day. I do not know how much time she has left. But I cannot wait. Her doctor said she has one last chance. But it will cost a lot of money.

I left her at home and went to a big city far away to build a business with my friend Robert. The plan was to make enough money for her treatments. Two months in and we failed. And failed. And failed. We lost a lot of money.

Things got worse when a call came from Evelyn's doctor. "Jack, we need to find money quickly or come back home before autumn."

I have failed in every way possible. Now all I can do is stay with Evelyn in her final days.

But I should give it one last try. I still have time. I took my van and started driving home.

This van can turn into a shop. I can trade with people. I can sell things and make a profit along the way.

Home is thousands of miles away and this is my last chance to make things right.

Gameplay

The gameplay loop is simple and relaxing.

  • Drive your van along the road toward home. Pass through different environments. Small towns. Villages. The wilds.

  • You never pass through the same area twice. The journey only moves forward.

  • Stop at small towns and villages along the way.

  • Park your van. Buy items cheap. Collect things. Trade. Sell them and make money.

  • Take on side quests. Help people who need it. Some will help you with money in return if you tell them about your situation.

  • Level up your online reputation as you travel. A better reputation opens better opportunities.

Features

  • A short relaxing experience. Roughly 3 to 4 hours of gameplay.

  • A journey with manually designed levels. No repeated locations.

  • Light trading mechanics. Buy low and sell high.

  • Semi open world segments that let you choose your stops.

  • Side quests that offer real help along the way.

  • A reputation system that grows with your journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
SEX, SIN & ROCK’N’ROLL is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration, mixing rock music, mysticism, dark humor, and pure chaos into a story about fame, temptation, and the price of success.



You play as a shy, broke musician stuck with his band in a dead-end city that slowly crushes dreams. Everything changes the moment you buy an old guitar — one that shouldn’t exist. From it emerges a seductive demoness who offers you a deal: instant success, packed venues, screaming fans… in exchange for their energy.



The contract will be completed the day you become a true rock star. But the brighter your stage persona shines, the more your real self begins to fade. Explore the city in a 3D side-scroller format, dive into bars, clubs, and strange mystical corners, and meet colorful characters who either push you toward fame or try to pull you back from the edge.

Write songs, craft tracks, rehearse with your band, and perform live in rhythm-game concerts where every show brings you closer to glory — or total self-destruction. Your choices shape relationships, story branches, and one of several endings. No matter the path, you must gain enough popularity to play the final concert, leave the city behind, and make the ultimate choice: break the demonic contract or fully embrace your dark rock-star alter ego.



Key Features


🤘 3D side-scroller exploration with interactive locations and story events

🎸 Rhythm-game concerts where your performance truly matters

🔞 Adult (18+) content, including erotic scenes, provocative dialogue, and temptation-driven encounters

🖤 Bold, edgy tone packed with dark humor, absurdity, and rock’n’roll attitude

SEX, SIN & ROCK’N’ROLL is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration, mixing rock music, mysticism, dark humor, and pure chaos into a story about fame, temptation, and the price of success.



You play as a shy, broke musician stuck with his band in a dead-end city that slowly crushes dreams. Everything changes the moment you buy an old guitar — one that shouldn’t exist. From it emerges a seductive demoness who offers you a deal: instant success, packed venues, screaming fans… in exchange for their energy.



The contract will be completed the day you become a true rock star. But the brighter your stage persona shines, the more your real self begins to fade. Explore the city in a 3D side-scroller format, dive into bars, clubs, and strange mystical corners, and meet colorful characters who either push you toward fame or try to pull you back from the edge.

Write songs, craft tracks, rehearse with your band, and perform live in rhythm-game concerts where every show brings you closer to glory — or total self-destruction. Your choices shape relationships, story branches, and one of several endings. No matter the path, you must gain enough popularity to play the final concert, leave the city behind, and make the ultimate choice: break the demonic contract or fully embrace your dark rock-star alter ego.



Key Features


🤘 3D side-scroller exploration with interactive locations and story events

🎸 Rhythm-game concerts where your performance truly matters

🔞 Adult (18+) content, including erotic scenes, provocative dialogue, and temptation-driven encounters

🖤 Bold, edgy tone packed with dark humor, absurdity, and rock’n’roll attitude

🎤 Branching story with multiple endings, shaped by your choices and lifestyle

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Super Wash Simulator, a relaxing open world cleaning simulator where every job feels satisfying and every surface is a chance to turn chaos into perfection.

Pressure Washing in an Open World

Step into a first-person (FPS) pressure washing experience and explore a living town at your own pace. Drive your starter golf cart, accept contracts through an in-game messaging system, follow the marker, and clean everything until it’s spotless — then get paid and move on to the next job in this calm, task-driven simulator.

But the city doesn’t only wait for missions. As you freely explore the open world, you’ll discover hidden side opportunities: dirty people, animals, and objects scattered throughout the environment. No map marker, no notification — just curiosity, discovery, and extra cash for those who pay attention.

Tools, Sprays, and Progression

Cleaning is simple, satisfying, and surprisingly skill-based. Each pressure washer features three spray modes — tight and powerful for precision cleaning, wider sprays for faster coverage, and the widest mode for large areas with reduced efficiency. Choosing the right spray at the right moment is key to mastering this power wash simulator experience.

Earn money by completing main contracts and side cleanups, then invest it wisely. Upgrade your equipment with 7 different pressure washers (your first one is free), buy food when hunger strikes, and make small moral choices like helping people in need. Just don’t ignore your basics — eating and sleeping are essential, and pushing yourself too far can cause you to pass out.

Day & Night Cycle

As the day turns into night, the world of Super Wash Simulator keeps moving. Time passes naturally, lighting changes, and exhaustion becomes a real factor. You can choose to push on and finish one last job — or head home to sleep, recover, and start a fresh day. Managing your rest is part of the experience, adding a subtle layer of realism without ever breaking the game’s relaxing flow.

A City Full of Cleaning Jobs

From police vehicles and trucks to gyms, aircraft hangars, city infrastructure, basketball courts, garages, ATMs, and more, Super Wash Simulator offers a wide variety of satisfying cleaning jobs. There are no timers and no pressure — just you, the washer, and the pure pleasure of watching dirt disappear.

Key Features

  • Relaxing open world pressure washing simulator with free exploration

  • Phone-based contract system: accept or decline jobs freely

  • Hidden side cleanups involving people, animals, and objects

  • 3 spray modes per washer (precision, medium, wide)

  • Equipment progression with 7 unlockable pressure washers

  • Drive a golf cart between jobs and explore the town naturally

  • Eat & sleep system that adds light life-simulation depth

  • Large variety of cleaning locations and job types

  • Single-player experience with realistic, satisfying sound design

  • 26 supported UI languages

Build your routine. Explore the city. Upgrade your gear. Turn grime into shine — and make the entire town spotless in Super Wash Simulator.

store_data.about_the_game:
Signal Lost: The Ping


You wake up inside a sealed underground facility where the lights are gone and the corridors feel endless. There’s no map, no clear way out, and every decision echoes in the dark.

Your only reliable tool is PING—a sonar pulse that briefly reveals the environment like a sound-driven flash. But every ping also raises the facility’s attention. The more you rely on it, the more the system adapts… and the hunter gets closer.

Restore power across the complex by activating six Signal Nodes, piece together what happened through scattered logs, and reach the final exit protocol before the facility decides you’re the problem.

Key Features

  • PING Navigation: Reveal corridors, doors, hazards, and hidden paths for a split second through sonar-like pulses.
  • Risk vs. Clarity: Pinging helps you survive, but it also increases Threat and changes how the facility responds.
  • The Sentinel: A relentless security unit that learns your habits. It doesn’t chase noise—it chases signal.
  • Six Nodes, One Way Out: Activate critical systems across distinct facility sectors to unlock the Exit Protocol.
  • Explore & Uncover: Find logs and environmental clues that reshape your understanding of the mission.
  • Multiple Endings: What you discover (and what you ignore) affects how the story ends.

Gameplay Loop

Move carefully through near-total darkness, choose when to ping, manage your routes under pressure, and use the environment to survive. Sometimes the safest path is longer. Sometimes the shortest path is a trap.

Atmosphere First

No flashy heroics—just tight corridors, oppressive silence, and the uneasy relief of seeing the world for one second… then losing it again.

Note: Headphones recommended for the best experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Russia faces a threat unlike anything it has known before. From across the ocean arrives Lazarus Crow, an ancient vampire. Seasoned, cunning, and obscenely confident. His goal is simple: to seize powerful Russian artifacts and bend both the human world and the realm of supernatural creatures to his will.

Local dark forces are already whispering and bowing to their new master.
But not all of them.

This land remembers the light, and it is not ready to surrender.

A grim story awaits you, where allies may prove more terrifying than enemies, and the line between Good and Evil has long since blurred.

You will take control of:

  • Sergius, a former priest and descendant of monster hunters, who knows the value of prayer and a solid punch;

  • Katya Zemtsova, a police captain for whom even a forest spirit is just another suspect;

  • James Smith, an American farmer who came searching for the truth about his missing sister—and found far more than he bargained for.

Not every creature serves the darkness. House spirits, Bereginyas, woodland beings, and even some witches who still honor ancient lows are ready to aid you. This is not merely a battle of Light versus Darkness. It is a war between an invader and those who defend their homeland

Magic here is no special effect—it is part of reality itself. It seeps through concrete apartment blocks, stirs in forest thickets, hums behind rusted garages, and gazes out from beneath old icons. Familiar places reveal a twisted, fairy-tale underside, along with new and deadly dangers.

Use «True Sight» to uncover traces of magic, hidden paths, zones of power, and invisible enemies. Tactics begin long before the first shot is fired.

Each hero brings unique abilities:

  • Katya’s specialized ammunition;

  • Sergius’s blessings, prayers, and rituals;

  • James’s raw, straightforward strength.

The supernatural punishes routine. Combine abilities, exploit enemy weaknesses, and win battles not only efficiently, but spectacularly.

Develop your heroes through an extensive skill tree and shape your own playstyle. But remember: you cannot learn all. Every choice has consequences.

Dialogue decisions alter the course of events, open new paths, soften or escalate conflicts. Even your companions will react to your actions, and not always with approval.

It is time to unite ancient spells and modern tactics, Orthodox relics and folk rituals, to strike back against the darkness that threatens all you hold dear. The enemy is strong, ruthless, and merciless, but this land has not spoken its final word.

Game Features:

  • A flexible, turn-based tactical combat system.

  • Non-linear dialogues and meaningful moral choices.

  • Russian folklore reimagined as urban fantasy.

  • A large collection of unique and useful artifacts.

  • A blend of free exploration and tactical battles.
