================================================================================
Zombie Virus Survives Alone
Zombie Virus, Survive Alone
================================================================================

【 Introduction to the game 】

It's a zombie survival game set in Taebaek City.
You're the only survivor of the zombie virus outbreak in the world,
You have to explore different places, collect resources, combat zombies, and survive.
The goal is to escape the city or create a safe survival zone.

================================================================================
【 Game Mode 】

1. Survival Mode
- It challenges survival freely in a fixed map structure
- Exploring the places based on the actual place names of Taebaek City
- You can survive through a variety of strategies and pathways

2. Roguelike Mode
- Every game, a map is generated completely randomly
- The starting location and the connection of all places change every time
- Each play provides a new experience

================================================================================
【 Gameplay 】

■ Basic Operation
- Arrow key (↑↓): Select menu
- Spacebar: Check/Select
- I: Open Inventory
- B: Opening the equipment window
- E: Open Navigation Window
- C: Open Character Window

■ Major Systems

1. navigation system
- Items can be explored and collected at each location
- Each place has different items and probabilities
- Finding important items will help you survive

2. a combat system
- The battle against zombies is on a turn-based basis
- Player's preemptive attack probability: 86%
- Probability of success when fleeing: 67%
- You can improve your fighting power with a variety of weapons and equipment

3. Health Management
- Physical fitness: If attacked by zombies, it will decrease
- Hungry: It declines over time. Get well by eating food
- Thirst: Decreases over time. Drink water to recover
- Anxiety: Increasing in dangerous situations

4. Item system
- Weapons: Used in combat against zombies (knives, guns, etc.)
- Food/Water: Restores Hunger and Thirstyness
- Medical supplies: restore physical strength or heal injuries
- Material: Used for vaccine production or base construction
- Note: Provides important information for the progress of the game

5. Note system
- Operation Note: Guide the game's main objectives and ending conditions
- Tip Note: Provides useful information for gameplay
- Reading the notes will give you the information you need to play the game

6. a random event
- You can meet dogs or cats on the move
- Taking animals with you can help you survive

7. Resting system
- You can relax in a safe place
- It takes time to recover your physical strength when you rest
- Hunger and thirst are consumed even during rest

================================================================================
【 Ending Type 】

There are many endings to the game:

1. Helicopter Escape Ending
- When you learn how to fly a helicopter and you're ready for it
- You can get out of the city by helicopter

2. Vaccine Ending
- I'm going to study and make a vaccine
- Find a solution to the zombie virus

3. Survival Zone Ending
- Create a safe zone in the city
- Build a base that can sustainably survive

4. Road Escape Ending
- Escape the city through lockdown

5. All Kill Ending (Special)
- If you kill 3000 zombies
- You can see the special ending that exterminated all zombies in Taebaek City

================================================================================
【 Key Places 】

The game has various locations based on Taebaek City:
- Living room (starting point)
- an apartment hallway, stairs
- Prosperity Road, Convenience Store, Mart
- a hospital, a pharmacy
- a lodge, a military unit
- a wind turbine
- other places

Each place has its own items and risks.

================================================================================
【 Multilingual Support 】

- Korean
- English

You can change the language in in-game settings.

================================================================================
【 Game Tips 】

1. Make sure you have enough food and water in the beginning
2. Look for weapons and improve your fighting power
3. Read the notes to find out what information you need to play the game
4. Rest in peace to restore your physical strength
5. Please check what you need for each ending
6. In log-like mode, explore different routes each time

================================================================================
【 System Requirements 】

Minimum Specifications:
- OS: Windows 7 and later
- CPU: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
- RAM: 4GB
- Graphics: DirectX 9.0c Compatible
- Storage: 500MB

Recommended Specifications:
- OS: Window

store_data.about_the_game:
HeroInc is a strategic simulation RPG where heroics is a business, and you are starting from the bottom.

In a monochromatic city crying out for help, you begin as a literal "Nobody." You have no powers, no fame, and no money. Your goal? To manage your time, optimize your stats, and evolve into the ultimate savior.

Will you remain a street thug, or build the ultimate hero company?

👊 FROM ZERO TO HERO

You don't start with a sword of destiny. You start with debt and ambition. Every day is a resource. Balance your daily actions between Training your stats (HP, Damage, Speed) and Laboring to earn the cash needed to survive.

  • Incremental Progression: Watch your numbers grow and your punches hit harder.

  • Rise from the Bottom: Experience the satisfaction of evolving from a weakling into a powerhouse that can one-shot bosses.

🧬 EVOLVE AND ADAPT

Unlock new classes and titles as you progress. Transform from a brawler into a Stray Dagger, a Tank, or something even deadlier. Encounter mysterious strangers offering choices that change reality. Will you take the Red Pill for raw power at a cost, or play it safe?

  • Dynamic Choices: Make risky deals that alter your stats and gameplay.

  • Class Evolution: Unlocking a new title isn't just cosmetic; it drastically changes your combat efficiency.

💀 FIGHT THE FEAR

You build the hero; they do the fighting. Explore a vast Skill Tree to tailor your hero to your playstyle. But remember: this isn't just about getting stronger—it's about holding back the chaos.

The City is Watching. Every enemy you fail to defeat increases the city's Fear. If the Fear Meter fills up, the city collapses into panic, and your career is over.

  • High Stakes Auto-Battles: Victory isn't about fast reflexes; it's about smart preparation.

  • Manage the Panic: You must prioritize threats and clear neighborhoods before fear consumes the population. If you lose, it's because you didn't train hard enough.

🌃 STYLISH NOIR AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted pixel-art city. The high-contrast black and white world is punctuated by neon UI elements, making every upgrade and action pop.

SharedScreen Wagons 2 is a local multiplayer chaotic game. Quick rounds, reaction check, tournaments. 8 players are supported. Collect, unload, kill, cut!

A bright and fun game. Here you will compete in who is the best and fastest builder, who will smash the enemy base faster and who will be able to survive among enemy traps and long entanglements of their own and other trains!!!
An exciting game suitable for both alone and for a group of friends or family time!

The game lets you know how rich and large your vocabulary is, especially if you play with children)))
Hotseat Wagon 2 will allow you to experience a huge range of emotions: joy, sadness, fun, suffering (nowhere without it) and the exultation of victory =)
Bottom line: A stunningly fun and atmospheric game, addictive from the first minutes, does not let go until the end and often dreams!
For a great time with friends or family. Despite the variety of feelings and emotions, both good and bad, the game leaves a pleasant aftertaste and a desire to play it again.

The idea was born before celebrating the new year with friends in 2021. Is it possible to play something on the projector with six people? The idea was implemented and since then there have been more than 200 gatherings with joy and suffering, fun and whining, screaming and whimpering. I hope it will bring you as many emotions as it does to us.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grief is a competitive, turn-based digital board game for 2–5 players, focused on card play and hand management.
Plan your cards and actions carefully, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to complete all five stages of grief represented by unique Grief Tokens.

This experience brings the feeling of a physical board game into the digital space, where every decision can change the course of the game.

Gameplay Overview:

  • Each turn, players may choose only one of three actions:
    draw cards, claim a location, or exchange Grief Tokens.

  • Each location can be claimed using unique combinations of card colors and point values. To succeed, players must hold onto the right cards and use them at the right moment.

  • However, your hand size is limited. A poorly timed decision or a missed opportunity can derail your entire strategy. Opponents may act before you, claim your target location, and reshape the balance of the game.

  • When a location is claimed, it awards one or more Grief Tokens, each representing a stage of grief.
    The first player to collect all five different stages of grief wins Grief.

Cards and Tactical Decisions:

Cards drawn from five different decks provide not only points, but also special effects.
Some activate when played, some when discarded, and others trigger the moment they are drawn.

Will you hold onto your cards or sacrifice them?
Will you act now, or wait for the right moment to move forward?

Competition and Player Interaction:

Players can directly interfere with each other’s plans:
stealing cards, disrupting turns, breaking hands, or temporarily blocking advantages.

Players who advance too quickly through the stages often become targets, and the balance of power is constantly shifting.

Theme and Atmosphere:

Grief is inspired by the psychological stages of grief, weaving themes of loss and emotional struggle into its core mechanics.

Through a stylized and abstract presentation, the game pairs a dark, restrained visual style with a psychological tone that reinforces every decision the player makes.

Game Description

Disaster strikes!
Humiliated by hecklers, Kun Kun turns to the legendary Lao Da to learn the true art of basketball.
But Lao Da’s trial is cruel: you must find the basketball that explodes.

KUNKUN Basketball is a Roguelite + Devil Roulette–style game, inspired by chaotic “Wanning Edition” mechanics — faster, crazier, and far more explosive.

Use a variety of off-court support skills to turn the tide of battle, including powerful abilities that swap items with Lao Da or reverse all live and blank balls in play.

Build different synergies and playstyles to steadily improve Kun Kun’s basketball skills.
Money isn’t just a number — invest it into two and a half years of relentless practice, pushing Kun Kun’s technique further and further… until he finally surpasses Lao Da.

Features

Enter the basketball court and face Lao Da in a brutal duel
Either blow Lao Da away — or let Kun Kun explode.

Choose wisely
Throw exploding basketballs at Lao Da.
Throw non-exploding ones at yourself.

A lighter tone than Devil Roulette
No oppressive horror atmosphere — whether you win or lose, you’ll probably laugh.

Escalating challenge
As rounds progress, Lao Da gradually stops holding back and reveals his true power.

store_data.about_the_game:
CAFE LIFE SIMULATOR: RULE THE CITY

Are you just a cafe owner, or the city's new boss?

Cafe Life Simulator is a comprehensive life simulation that blends detailed cafe management mechanics with a living open world and adrenaline-fueled action. While you serve the freshest coffee to your customers in the morning, earn respect in the city's underworld at night, tear up the streets with your modified car, and build your own empire.

On this road from zero to hero, the rules are simple: Work, Earn, Fight, and Live.

MANAGE YOUR BUSINESS AND TEAM

Everything starts with a small shop, but with your vision, you can take over the entire city.

  • Detailed Cafe Management: Prepare sandwiches in the microwave at the right temperature and master the coffee machine. But be careful; there might be cunning customers trying to run away without paying (dine and dashers). Chase them down and take what is rightfully yours!

  • Hire Staff: You don't have to do everything alone. Hire employees to lighten your workload and keep the cash flowing while you explore the city.

  • Total Customization: Design your dream cafe with thousands of combinations. Take online orders via your tablet and deliver to the city.

  • Buy a Nightclub: Is the cafe not enough? Expand your business and buy the city's most popular Nightclub to dominate the entertainment sector.

A LIVING CITY ATMOSPHERE

This city never sleeps, and every moment feels alive.

  • Dynamic Weather & Time Cycle: Serve coffee on a sunny morning or take shelter in your shop during a stormy and rainy night. Feel the flow of time with a realistic Day/Night cycle.

  • Vibrant Graphics & Sound Design: From the bustle of the city to the roar of car engines and the sound of rain hitting the window... Detailed graphics and atmospheric sound design will immerse you in the game.

  • Voiced NPCs: The people in this city are not silent robots. Discover a world full of characters who speak to you, react, and have voiced dialogues when you interact with them.

GARAGE, TUNING, AND SIDE HUSTLES

There are a thousand ways to earn and spend money in this city.

  • Drive a Taxi: Bored of cafe work? Jump behind the wheel and work as a Taxi Driver to learn the city like the back of your hand and earn extra income.

  • Dream Vehicles & Tuning: Buy sports cars or motorcycles from the dealership. Enter your garage and modify (tune) your vehicle to increase performance and reflect your style.

  • Sail Away: Nothing left to do on land? Buy your own luxury Yacht, get away from the city noise, and sail into the blue.

FINANCE, ACTION, AND SELF-CARE

Take care of yourself and your wallet; to survive in this city, you must be both strong and rich.

  • Banking System: Don't keep your money under the mattress. Use the Bank to secure your savings or take out loans to expand your business.

  • Fitness & Form: "A healthy mind in a healthy body." Go to the gym, lift barbells, and increase your stamina.

  • Show Your Style: Image is everything. Visit the Barber to get a haircut and beard trim according to the latest fashion.

  • Defend Yourself: There may be bullies or mafia trying to extort money from you. Grab your baseball bat and show them who the boss is with the physics-based combat system.

KEY FEATURES

  • Detailed cafe management from a First-Person (FPS) perspective.

  • Voiced NPCs and interactive dialogues.

  • Dynamic Weather and Day/Night cycle.

  • Hiring staff and chasing customers who refuse to pay.

  • Side jobs like Taxi Driving and a comprehensive Banking/Loan system.

  • Buying cars and motorcycles with a detailed Tuning/Modification system.

  • Nightclub management and Yacht driving.

  • Changing appearance at the Barber and lifting weights (barbell) at the Gym.

  • Combat system, mafia interactions, and pet system.

Put on your apron, open the door, and start the adventure. Cafe Life Simulator is waiting for you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Planet is a science fiction survival experience blending exploration, constant tension, and intense combat on a hostile planet overrun by an extraterrestrial threat.

You play as an isolated survivor sent to a distant world to investigate an abandoned base, uncover the origin of the invasion, and find a way to escape alive. Every area you explore deepens the mystery, and every encounter tests your ability to adapt.

The universe draws inspiration from the epic and mysterious scope of HALO and the oppressive atmosphere of Alien, while delivering dynamic action sequences reminiscent of Resident Evil. The goal is to create an immersive, intense, and believable experience where atmosphere plays a central role.

The experience is not punitive; it is built around progressive learning. Observing, understanding enemy behavior, managing resources, and adapting to the environment are the keys to survival. Every mistake becomes a lesson, and every confrontation strengthens your mastery.

Developed solo with passion, Last Planet offers a demanding yet fair adventure designed for players seeking a strong atmosphere, constant tension, and a sense of progression driven by growth rather than frustration.

Gameplay and Core Mechanics

  • Single-player action and survival-focused FPS

  • Intense combat against a variety of alien enemies

  • Management of ammunition, health, and oxygen

  • Exploration of enclosed environments

  • Collection of equipment and resources

  • Native compatibility with both AZERTY and QWERTY keyboards

Player Progression

  • Unlockable mobility abilities:

    • double / triple jump

    • dash

    • jetpack

  • Character stat upgrades:

    • health

    • stamina

    • oxygen

  • Weapon upgrades and customization

  • Special artifacts that modify gameplay rules (e.g. New Game Plus)

Current Content (Early Access Version)

  • A playable single-player campaign

  • Multiple types of alien enemies

  • Various weapons with magazine-based ammo management

  • Crate system (ammo, medical kits, jetpack, upgrades)

  • Immersive HUD integrated directly into the weapons

  • Sound design and music focused on science-fiction and horror

Challenges and Objectives

  • Survive in a hostile environment

  • Explore and uncover the planet’s story

  • Manage resources efficiently

  • Upgrade your equipment to face increasingly dangerous enemies

Estimated Playtime

  • Current version: 1 to 3 hours

  • Planned final version: 8 to 12 hours, depending on playstyle and added content

What Makes Last Planet Unique

  • FPS / survival hybrid with strong atmospheric tension

  • Progression focused on mobility and vertical gameplay

  • Dark and oppressive universe

  • Immersive approach (weapon-integrated HUD, real-time resource management)

SYNOPSIS

A forgotten planet. An irreversible mistake. One last chance.

In a distant future, humanity exploits the far reaches of the galaxy in search of vital resources. On Khelag-X61, an isolated mining planet, a deep drilling operation goes too far. By digging beyond the rock layers, the colonists awaken something that should have remained buried.

Ancient, aggressive creatures emerge from the depths. But that is not all: a massive buried structure of alien origin activates. Within hours, Khelag-X61 descends into chaos. An alien AI takes control of the network, locks down all exits, and places the colony under absolute quarantine.

You play as a surviving Cosmoldier, trapped in a maze of industrial tunnels and abandoned research facilities, where even the atmosphere itself feels hostile. Security systems no longer respond. Communications are cut. Every corridor is a threat.

A pro tennis career, told through the moments that change everything

AVA'S VARIATIONS is a choice-driven interactive story about Ava, a rising pro tennis player. You won't play full matches—you'll live the decisions around them: training, travel, pressure, relationships, and what she's willing to trade when the stakes rise.

In tennis—and in life—everything is decided in key moments. Your choices land at those turning points and echo forward, shaping Ava's trajectory, who she trusts, and where she ends up.

Ava isn't alone. Her dog is a steady presence on the road—sometimes grounding, sometimes challenging—always by her side.

  • Read, choose, and commit.

  • Face immediate or delayed consequences

  • Shape Ava's trajectory across multiple routes and endings.

  • Voices available in English, French, or Spanish.

Wishlist now—and stay close as Ava's story unfolds.

store_data.about_the_game:
SILENT REALM is a free-to-play, single-player, story-driven experience set in a non-human world where life has completely ended, governed by rules unlike those of our own reality.

This is not a land after catastrophe — it is a realm after existence itself has collapsed. Skeletal remains dominate the environment, structures feel unnatural and unstable, and silence replaces any recognizable sense of order. Nothing lives here, and nothing ever truly belonged.

The world is not empty — it is hostile. The environment itself functions as a threat, oppressive and dangerous, as if death has become a governing force rather than a consequence. Every movement reinforces the idea that survival is not expected, but resisted.

In this realm, death is active. Threats form and collapse from the remains of what once existed, forcing constant tension and confrontation. Combat is a necessity, not a choice, and awareness is as critical as firepower.

SILENT REALM focuses on atmosphere and world design, blending exploration with action-driven survival. The experience is built to feel relentless and unsettling — a journey through a place that should not exist, and actively resists anything that does.

Gameplay Overview:

The game is experienced from a first-person perspective, placing players directly inside a hostile and unfamiliar world where survival is never guaranteed.

Players take on the role of an individual searching for a missing brother, venturing into one of the most dangerous regions of this world. Progression is driven by exploration, environmental awareness, and constant threat management, pushing players deeper into increasingly dangerous areas.

Combat is a core element of the experience. Players rely on firearms while carefully managing limited ammunition, choosing when to fight and when to avoid confrontation. Specialized detection devices are used to locate threats, scan the environment, and navigate dangerous zones without drawing attention.

Survival depends on awareness, movement, and decision-making. Enemies are not meant to be confronted recklessly, and the environment itself often serves as an obstacle as dangerous as the entities within it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Down Below casts you into an afterlife where myth, religion, and legend overlap. You are a lone traveler racing for the fabled city of Agoralopis while the creeping force known as the Oblivion closes in with every step.

The game is a narrative driven adventure focused on exploration, dialogue, and sudden high intensity combat. You will uncover layered lore through conversations and environmental storytelling while shaping how characters react to your choices. Exploration takes place in a top down pixel world, while combat shifts into fast paced arena encounters where survival depends on movement, positioning, and awareness. Each chapter builds toward powerful confrontations and morally complex decisions.

Chapter One is the opening chapter of the full experience and introduces the world, its first cast of characters, and the core gameplay systems. Future chapters will expand the story, locations, and mechanics as the journey toward Agoralopis continues.

KEY FEATURES

• Narrative first experience with dense, text driven dialogue and character interactions that influence relationships and uncover hidden lore.

• Hybrid gameplay combining top down exploration with sudden arena based combat and boss encounters.

• Atmosphere focused world blending mythology, religion, and original fantasy into a cohesive afterlife setting.

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 2016. You find yourself in the middle of the night contemplating what a messy year it was.

Things changed.

Or maybe, you're the one who changed?

It really doesn't matter anyway.

All you gotta do now is grab a pot, fill it with water, turn on the stove, and wait. You gotta eat something before going to bed.

And in the meantime, why not do some house chores? I'm sure mom is going to be proud.

...

If only-

If only you hadn't seen things. Certain things. Things you were not supposed to see. Then maybe, just maybe.

You wouldn't have company this night.

  • Moody, dark environment.

  • Immersive, low fidelity (low bit rate and crispy!) sound design.

  • (so) RETRO graphics and true low-res.

  • Slightly randomized tasks every run. (Just different combinations, really!)

  • 6 additional difficulty modes to be unlocked!

  • Short duration (20-30 minutes per run).

Grab a pot, fill it with water, turn on the stove and wait. Wait until it starts boiling.

Complete house chores, go for a walk. The water will boil faster when you're not looking at it.

Pay attention to your sanity. You don't want it to get too low.

If you have a visitor, don't worry. He can't physically hurt you. Just close your eyes near the burning stove and breathe. It's all in your mind.

Just don't stay with your eyes closed for too long.

Trial and error is key. 

Pay attention to your surroundings, to your environment.

Finish your chores. Prove them wrong.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cursed ancestral haveli. A forgotten bloodline. An entity that adapts to how you survive.

Rahasya is a horror experience set inside an abandoned Indian haveli in 1992. After reclaiming your family’s ancestral estate, you enter a house that was sealed for decades — only to realize something inside has been waiting.

Something moves through the halls. Something listens. Something learns.

The haveli once belonged to your bloodline, but it was locked away after a dark incident that no one fully remembers.

What begins as a return to your ancestral home slowly turns into a fight for survival. Strange sounds echo through empty rooms, rituals reveal forgotten truths, and the haunting begins to point toward something far older than a ghost.

The deeper you go, the more you uncover a forgotten duty tied to your family, ancient rituals, and forces beyond the human world. You were not meant to enter. But the haveli knows you are inside.

There is no combat in Rahasya. You cannot fight the entity hunting you.

Survival depends on movement, hiding, awareness, and the choices you make under pressure. You are free to explore the haveli, solve objectives in different orders, and uncover the truth at your own pace. But freedom does not mean safety. Every route you take, every sound you make, and every decision you repeat can change how dangerous the house becomes.

Explore an interconnected Indian haveli filled with locked rooms, hidden spaces, ritual areas, courtyards, underground passages, and secrets buried beneath decades of silence.

The haveli is not a straight path. Some areas can be explored in different orders, and many puzzles require observation instead of direct instructions.

A room that feels safe once may not stay safe.
A path that helped you earlier may become dangerous later.

The entity is not just a scripted monster moving through fixed paths.

It reacts to sound, movement, repeated routes, and player habits. If you keep using the same path, it may begin appearing there. If you make too much noise, it may come searching. If you rush without thinking, you may trap yourself.

The longer you survive, the more aggressive the entity becomes.

The fear is not only that something is chasing you — it is that something may be learning how you survive.

Progression is built around environmental puzzles, ritual objects, hidden clues, locked mechanisms, and item-based exploration.

You may encounter rotating disk locks, symbolic clues, ritual components, hidden compartments, locked trunks, and rooms that only reveal their purpose after returning later.

Some puzzle elements and item placements can change between runs, making each playthrough less predictable.

LIMITED SURVIVAL

You have limited chances to survive.

There is no manual save system to erase every mistake. Every decision carries weight, and every failed escape can cost progress.

The goal is not to make you feel powerful.

The goal is to make you feel trapped, watched, and responsible for every choice you make.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not Customer Support.
You are the Saviour of Monarch.

This is a story-driven interactive narrative game told entirely through messages, group chats, internal tools, and digital artifacts. You play as a support agent inside a chaotic online gambling platform, navigating corporate absurdity, moral compromise, and personal burnout as the system around you slowly collapses.

What begins as a job quickly turns into a descent through exploitation, paranoia, and responsibility—where every message matters, and every choice pulls you closer to an unavoidable end.

Gameplay Overview

  • Genre: Interactive Narrative / Psychological Satire

  • Perspective: Text-based, message-driven gameplay

  • Playtime: ~3–5 hours (single playthrough)

  • Structure: Linear story with reactive dialogue choices

  • Input Style: Messaging decisions, responses, investigations, and moral choices

You interact with:

  • Internal company chats

  • Private DMs

  • Support tickets

  • Developers, executives, and contractors

  • Legal threats and ethical dilemmas

Your responses shape how characters treat you, what information you uncover, and how events escalate.


Each task pulls you deeper into a scene where no one actually knows what they’re doing — but everyone claims they do. You're not here to win, you're here to maintain order.

Only then can you be the Saviour of Monarch.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are Kai Atcher, an anomaly monitoring operator employed by I.D.S. (Inter-Dimensional Security) - a private corporation specializing in the detection and containment of interdimensional threats.

You are assigned a top-secret mission: to restore operations at an abandoned observation tower located within a long-forgotten recreational area, erased from official maps and records. Once a popular tourist destination, the site is now infamous for a series of unexplained incidents, disappearances, and deaths - all officially classified as “accidents.”

You arrive at the site alone. Power is unstable. Surveillance cameras glitch and distort. And within the footage, shapes and movements appear that should not exist.

This is not just another shift. This is a job at the edge of reality.

Key Features

  • Camera-based surveillance gameplay
    Monitor multiple camera feeds to detect anomalies in real time.

  • Extermination mechanic
    Identify threats and eliminate them before they reach the tower.

  • System management under pressure
    Repair broken cameras and power systems manually during active threats.

  • First-person immersive horror
    Minimal UI, oppressive atmosphere, and constant tension.

  • Escalating difficulty
    Each night introduces more danger, failures, and psychological pressure.

  • Story-driven environment
    Environmental storytelling, documents, and logs reveal the lore of I.D.S. and Echo Valley.

store_data.about_the_game:
EVERY ARREST STARTS WITH PROCEDURE

Search detainees, have them empty their pockets, and comb through their belongings for unauthorized or suspicious items.

VERIFY EVERY IDENTITY

Not everyone tells the truth. Check IDs, run visa and residency status, administer breathalyzers, and cross-reference records before anyone walks free.

RUN YOUR OWN POLICE STATION


The streets are only as safe as the station behind them. Hire and assign officers, dispatch patrols and investigations, and upgrade your facilities to handle a growing caseload.

Manage a Living Police Station

A police force runs on organization as much as authority.

  • Manage queues, holding cells, and interrogation rooms

  • Assign officers to desks, patrols, or investigations

  • Upgrade equipment, offices, and security systems

  • Balance efficiency, legality, and public satisfaction

As your station grows, chaos grows with it.

Be strict. Be fair. Be human.

The badge doesn't make the decisions; you do.

Additional Context

The game is set in a fictional modern American city, drawing inspiration from real-world policing structures, including local departments, state jurisdictions, and federal agencies. Some cases may involve immigration-related procedures, coordination with ICE, and enforcement priorities shaped by national policy shifts.

The city's legal and political environment reflects different periods of U.S. governance, including policy frameworks associated with Donald Trump–era administrations, as well as regional influences inspired by places like Minnesota. These elements exist as background systems, not narratives, and serve to ground the simulation in a believable contemporary setting.

For Players Who Know That Every Badge Carries Weight

The appeal of police simulation has always lived in the gap between the rule and the human being standing in front of it. Papers, Please made bureaucratic enforcement feel like a moral act at every checkpoint — and Police Officer operates with the same understanding. Players who loved the patrol loop of Police Simulator: Patrol Officers and wanted more depth in the human interactions will find it here. Those who spent hours in Contraband Police carefully logging infractions and building a reputation for rigor will recognize the same satisfaction in processing a difficult case correctly. And anyone who has played This Is the Police or This Is the Police 2 understands that running a law enforcement operation means constantly choosing which problems you can afford to solve and which ones you have to let pass.

The Street-Level Simulation

Games like Flashing Lights put you inside the emergency services loop — lights, sirens, response times, co-op radio chatter. Highway Police Simulator and Police Simulator: Patrol Duty explored the specific rhythm of traffic enforcement. The Precinct recently showed how much players hunger for a police-themed open world with real procedural weight. Police Officer goes deeper on the station side: the waiting room, the intake desk, the interrogation room, the holding cell. The chaos doesn't come from traffic; it comes from people, their needs, their lies, and their expectations. 911 Operator players know what it means to be the pivot point between a crisis and a resolution. Rescue HQ players understand the management layer underneath the sirens. Police Officer puts both in your hands.

Tactical Clarity and Protocol

SWAT 4 built a generation of players who understood that law enforcement gameplay doesn't have to be reckless to be tense, precision, protocol, and communication under pressure are their own kind of adrenaline. Ready or Not carried that tradition forward into a modern setting where every room clearance has procedural and ethical weight. Police Stories gave us the top-down version of that same discipline. Police Chief Simulator lets players build the institution from above. Police Officer operates at the street level: you are not the administrator deciding policy, and you are not the SWAT commander breaching a door. You are the officer at the counter, on the patrol beat, and across the interrogation table — and that middle ground is exactly where the interesting decisions live.

The Investigator's Mindset

L.A. Noire built its entire interrogation system around reading faces and deciding whether someone was lying, the same core skill Police Officer demands when a citizen's story doesn't quite add up. Disco Elysium showed that detective gameplay works best when the investigator's own psychology becomes part of the puzzle. Shadows of Doubt proved that a procedurally-generated city full of individually-simulated citizens creates genuinely unpredictable cases. Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One and Sherlock Holmes The Awakened demonstrated that deduction rewards patience and observation over action. Return of the Obra Dinn made pure logic feel thrilling. The Case of the Golden Idol and The Rise of the Golden Idol both showed how much players crave investigation mechanics that trust them to figure things out without hand-holding. Nobody Wants to Die showed that crime scene reconstruction can be its own genre. The Roottrees Are Dead proved players will happily spend hours cross-referencing evidence when the puzzle is tight. Police Officer's citizen interviews are built on the same principle: the truth is in there, and it's your job to find it.

Authority, Conscience, and Systems

Beholder and Beholder 2 explored what happens when the person enforcing the rules becomes indistinguishable from the system itself. Not Tonight brought document-checking to a nightclub door and made it carry the same bureaucratic dread as a border post. Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You handed players institutional surveillance authority and let them sit with what that means. Suzerain gave players a presidential chair and discovered that good intentions bend under structural pressure. Democracy 4 made clear that policies made in the abstract land on real people in concrete ways. Frostpunk 2 showed that management games become genuinely disturbing when the resources you're managing are human. These are the games Police Officer shares DNA with — simulations where the player holds institutional power and is asked, quietly and persistently, whether they're using it well.

The Criminal Economy

Schedule I approached the other side of the law with full simulation depth, showing how much players love detailed systems around illegal economies, which only makes sense when you're playing the officer trying to dismantle one. Crime Scene Cleaner demonstrated that procedural interactions with crime aftermath can be compelling in their own right. Prison Architect and Prison Simulator both explored what happens after the arrest, the correctional institution as a management puzzle with human stakes. Border Officer put players in the specific tension of a checkpoint where everyone has a story and not everyone is telling the truth. Prison Architect players who've spent hours maintaining order across a facility will recognize the same logic at work in Police Officer's station management layer.

Investigation Culture on PC

The detective and investigation genre has never been healthier on Steam. Her Story and Telling Lies showed that reading between the lines of recorded testimony, catching the hesitation, the deflection, the thing someone almost said, is a deeply satisfying game mechanic. Pentiment showed that historical evidence and human memory require the same kind of interpretive detective work. The field has exploded with titles that trust players to think: it's the genre for players who want engagement, not just reaction. Police Officer inhabits the same space. Every citizen who walks through your door is a puzzle. Every statement contains something true and something not quite right. The job is figuring out which is which, and deciding what to do about it.

For the Roblox Generation Growing Into Deeper Simulations

A huge community of players first experienced police roleplay on Roblox, in Jailbreak, where the cops-and-criminals dynamic plays out across an open world with tens of thousands of concurrent players; in Emergency Response: Liberty County, where the emergency services simulation gets serious about procedures and dispatch coordination; in Brookhaven RP and Greenville, where freeform city roleplay includes police as one of the defining social roles; in Mad City, where players cycle through heroes, criminals, and officers across a living environment; and in Da Hood, where street-level roleplay gets gritty and unscripted. Hillview County brought even more realistic county-based policing to the platform. Build the Station. Earn the City's Trust. Do the Work.

Players who've watched public approval move in unexpected directions in Democracy 4 will recognize the dynamic. Players who felt the ground shift under a decision that seemed right in Suzerain will recognize the feeling. A good police station isn't built by being strict. It isn't built by being lenient either. store_data.detailed_description:
EVERY ARREST STARTS WITH PROCEDURE

Search detainees, have them empty their pockets, and comb through their belongings for unauthorized or suspicious items.

VERIFY EVERY IDENTITY

Not everyone tells the truth. Check IDs, run visa and residency status, administer breathalyzers, and cross-reference records before anyone walks free.

RUN YOUR OWN POLICE STATION


The streets are only as safe as the station behind them. Hire and assign officers, dispatch patrols and investigations, and upgrade your facilities to handle a growing caseload.

Manage a Living Police Station

A police force runs on organization as much as authority.

  • Manage queues, holding cells, and interrogation rooms

  • Assign officers to desks, patrols, or investigations

  • Upgrade equipment, offices, and security systems

  • Balance efficiency, legality, and public satisfaction

As your station grows, chaos grows with it.

Be strict. Be fair. Be human.

The badge doesn't make the decisions; you do.

Additional Context

The game is set in a fictional modern American city, drawing inspiration from real-world policing structures, including local departments, state jurisdictions, and federal agencies. Some cases may involve immigration-related procedures, coordination with ICE, and enforcement priorities shaped by national policy shifts.

The city's legal and political environment reflects different periods of U.S. governance, including policy frameworks associated with Donald Trump–era administrations, as well as regional influences inspired by places like Minnesota. These elements exist as background systems, not narratives, and serve to ground the simulation in a believable contemporary setting.

For Players Who Know That Every Badge Carries Weight

The appeal of police simulation has always lived in the gap between the rule and the human being standing in front of it. Papers, Please made bureaucratic enforcement feel like a moral act at every checkpoint — and Police Officer operates with the same understanding. Players who loved the patrol loop of Police Simulator: Patrol Officers and wanted more depth in the human interactions will find it here. Those who spent hours in Contraband Police carefully logging infractions and building a reputation for rigor will recognize the same satisfaction in processing a difficult case correctly. And anyone who has played This Is the Police or This Is the Police 2 understands that running a law enforcement operation means constantly choosing which problems you can afford to solve and which ones you have to let pass.

The Street-Level Simulation

Games like Flashing Lights put you inside the emergency services loop — lights, sirens, response times, co-op radio chatter. Highway Police Simulator and Police Simulator: Patrol Duty explored the specific rhythm of traffic enforcement. The Precinct recently showed how much players hunger for a police-themed open world with real procedural weight. Police Officer goes deeper on the station side: the waiting room, the intake desk, the interrogation room, the holding cell. The chaos doesn't come from traffic; it comes from people, their needs, their lies, and their expectations. 911 Operator players know what it means to be the pivot point between a crisis and a resolution. Rescue HQ players understand the management layer underneath the sirens. Police Officer puts both in your hands.

Tactical Clarity and Protocol

SWAT 4 built a generation of players who understood that law enforcement gameplay doesn't have to be reckless to be tense, precision, protocol, and communication under pressure are their own kind of adrenaline. Ready or Not carried that tradition forward into a modern setting where every room clearance has procedural and ethical weight. Police Stories gave us the top-down version of that same discipline. Police Chief Simulator lets players build the institution from above. Police Officer operates at the street level: you are not the administrator deciding policy, and you are not the SWAT commander breaching a door. You are the officer at the counter, on the patrol beat, and across the interrogation table — and that middle ground is exactly where the interesting decisions live.

The Investigator's Mindset

L.A. Noire built its entire interrogation system around reading faces and deciding whether someone was lying, the same core skill Police Officer demands when a citizen's story doesn't quite add up. Disco Elysium showed that detective gameplay works best when the investigator's own psychology becomes part of the puzzle. Shadows of Doubt proved that a procedurally-generated city full of individually-simulated citizens creates genuinely unpredictable cases. Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One and Sherlock Holmes The Awakened demonstrated that deduction rewards patience and observation over action. Return of the Obra Dinn made pure logic feel thrilling. The Case of the Golden Idol and The Rise of the Golden Idol both showed how much players crave investigation mechanics that trust them to figure things out without hand-holding. Nobody Wants to Die showed that crime scene reconstruction can be its own genre. The Roottrees Are Dead proved players will happily spend hours cross-referencing evidence when the puzzle is tight. Police Officer's citizen interviews are built on the same principle: the truth is in there, and it's your job to find it.

Authority, Conscience, and Systems

Beholder and Beholder 2 explored what happens when the person enforcing the rules becomes indistinguishable from the system itself. Not Tonight brought document-checking to a nightclub door and made it carry the same bureaucratic dread as a border post. Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You handed players institutional surveillance authority and let them sit with what that means. Suzerain gave players a presidential chair and discovered that good intentions bend under structural pressure. Democracy 4 made clear that policies made in the abstract land on real people in concrete ways. Frostpunk 2 showed that management games become genuinely disturbing when the resources you're managing are human. These are the games Police Officer shares DNA with — simulations where the player holds institutional power and is asked, quietly and persistently, whether they're using it well.

The Criminal Economy

Schedule I approached the other side of the law with full simulation depth, showing how much players love detailed systems around illegal economies, which only makes sense when you're playing the officer trying to dismantle one. Crime Scene Cleaner demonstrated that procedural interactions with crime aftermath can be compelling in their own right. Prison Architect and Prison Simulator both explored what happens after the arrest, the correctional institution as a management puzzle with human stakes. Border Officer put players in the specific tension of a checkpoint where everyone has a story and not everyone is telling the truth. Prison Architect players who've spent hours maintaining order across a facility will recognize the same logic at work in Police Officer's station management layer.

The detective and investigation genre has never been healthier on Steam. Her Story and Telling Lies showed that reading between the lines of recorded testimony, catching the hesitation, the deflection, the thing someone almost said, is a deeply satisfying game mechanic. Pentiment showed that historical evidence and human memory require the same kind of interpretive detective work. The field has exploded with titles that trust players to think: it's the genre for players who want engagement, not just reaction. Police Officer inhabits the same space. Every citizen who walks through your door is a puzzle. Every statement contains something true and something not quite right. The job is figuring out which is which, and deciding what to do about it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Serpent Squad is a modified version of SNKRX (by a327ex, MIT License), adding multilingual support, controller input support, and changes to squad controls, among other improvements. This is a bullet‑hell roguelike game where you control a snake‑like squad made up of multiple heroes, each with their own attacks, passives, and classes. Inspired by the auto‑battler genre, each hero in the squad belongs to a class, and collecting enough heroes of the same class grants additional class bonuses. Buying the same hero in the shop lets you level that hero up and make that hero stronger.

Gameplay

• The squad moves forward automatically; use up/down/left/right to steer

• Heroes automatically attack when close to enemies

• Combine heroes of the same class to unlock unique class bonuses

• Clearing stages grants gold, which can be used to buy heroes in the shop

• Buying enough copies of the same hero will level them up and make them stronger

Features

• 16 classes, each providing stat bonuses to your squad

• 50+ heroes, each with unique attacks and passives

• 80+ relics, each providing powerful global effects for your squad

• 25+ stages with progressively increasing difficulty

store_data.about_the_game:
Long ago, dokkaebi and humans coexisted in the same world, working together to subdue monsters and maintain balance. But on the night the full moon rose, when the call from the heavens reached them, the dokkaebi were destined to leave humanity's side. Before departing, they sealed their power within masks and entrusted them to humans. These masks became both a contract between dokkaebi and humans and the legitimate means to govern supernatural beings.

〈Mumyeonggjrokbu〉 is an urban fantasy isolation novel born from this imagination. It reinterprets Korean folktales, myths, dokkaebi lore, and ghost stories through the lens of a modern isolation narrative. Weaving together past and present, this work creates a multilayered world where players confront the precarious balance between humans and supernatural beings through investigation and documentation.

The containment corporation is composed of four departments:
Yangban Mask External Mediation Bureau,
Chorang-i Mask Secret Containment Division,
Lion Mask National Disaster Response Agency,
Imugi Mask Capital Management Bureau.

This organization adopts traditional Korean painted masks as its symbols, with each department fulfilling its designated role and function.

Containment levels—Mang, Hyeon, Choseung, Geumeum, and Sak—indicate the danger level of each contained entity. The Tal are used to classify, contain, and manage these anomalies according to their risk.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Subject 404 is a psychological horror game where you awaken as a test subject inside an unknown facility.

You are not given a name.
You are not given answers.
You are only given instructions and a number.

A panel speaks to you.
You are expected to obey.

Gameplay

The panel issues a continuous stream of commands that must be followed under time pressure.

Each command places you in a different situation:

  • Shooting specific targets

  • Locating objects inside the room

  • Navigating short vehicle sequences

  • Completing brief but stressful interactive challenges and more

The commands are fast, unpredictable, and intentionally disorienting.
Hesitation is often fatal.

Failure Has Consequences

If you make a mistake, the Executioner arrives.

You don’t see its face.
You only hear it approaching.

Death sends you back to the beginning.

Endless Rooms

Each room contains:

  • A door

  • A command

  • A choice under pressure

Complete the command correctly and the door opens, leading to the next room.
Each chapter requires a set number of successful commands before reaching a Safe Zone.

Safe Zones and Anomalies

Safe Zones remove time pressure — but not unease.

Inside them, you may encounter:

  • Environmental anomalies

  • Scattered notes and fragments of information

Narrative Approach

  • No cutscenes

  • No forced camera control

  • No interruptions

The narrative unfolds naturally as you move, observe, and interact with the environment.

Visual Style & Atmosphere

  • PS1-inspired low-poly visuals

  • Low resolution and visual instability

  • Cold, sterile, and unsettling environments

The visual style is not nostalgic — it is designed to feel uncomfortable.

Subject 404 is a short but intense psychological horror experience about obedience, control, and the consequences of hesitation.

Do you think you’re good at geography?

Put your knowledge to the test with Geobeast.

The concept is simple: find as many countries on the world map as possible before time runs out.
At the end of each game, your score is recorded, allowing you to compete with players worldwide through the global Steam leaderboard.

Normal Mode

The default competitive mode in Geobeast.

  • Each country found earns 1 point

  • 12 minutes to find as many as possible

  • Accuracy, memory, and speed make the difference

Jumbo Mode

The fun and strategic mode.

  • A score multiplier system is introduced

  • Find a country, then a neighboring country to double your points

  • A third neighboring country triples the score, and so on

  • 12 minutes to score as many points as possible

Here, the goal isn’t just to find a lot of countries, but to make smart choices.
Strategy is the key.

store_data.about_the_game:
This Game Costs 10 Dollars. Are you really gonna spend 10 whole dollars on this game? In this economy? 

This game has been made to take your money and I am not even hiding it. 

Or is it? 

This psychological experience is unlike any other game ever imagined. Yes even that one. And that other one too. 

This game is about a man, me, trying to take your money by any means necessary. This means that I have to entertain you for enough time for you to not be able to return it, like a parent babysitting their child. And you, my friend, are the child. 

GAMEPLAY

This game includes characters, many of which have human features and appear human. Whether they are or are not is up to your interpretation, if you dare. This game also includes buildings, many of which have walls and floors. My house does not have wall and floors. That's why I need your 10 dollars. That way I can finally fulfill my lifelong wish of buying a door. 

PSYCHOLOGICAL THRILLER 

This game will make you feel feeling you haven't felt since you were 12. Feelings like sadness, fortitude, and wondering "Where in these parts can I get a good burger without breaking the bank?" That last one can be answered quite easily by playing the game. This game will make you question your very existence and why you paid your 10 dollars. Or whatever it is in your currency. I don't judge. I take money from all kinds of people. Like the elderly and the divorced. Unfortunately, you can't get divorced in this game because that feature would simply be too fun for this game. And I can't allow that. 

TREES

This visual experience includes trees unlike anything you've ever seen. there are many trees scattered across the map. Yes, this game has a map. Exciting, I know, but I cannot yet reveal what it is. That would ruin the fun. But the trees on the map are also accompanied by bushes and benches. Thrilling, I know. 

ENDINGS

This game includes 10 unique endings to find based upon your choices. There are many ways for a life to end but these are the most exquisite ways to die in my humble opinion. Finding some of these ends may be a challenge. Good. You deserve a good challenge. Especially after last week's fiasco. You know the one. No, the other one. God, how much did you do last week? 

COMEDY 

This game has been labelled by my critics as a "lame comedy" but this game is not truly a comedy. It is a grave warning of the perils of the spending of man on overpriced steam games when you really need to be saving your money up for that rodeo your uncle keeps inviting you to. No, the rodeo is not in the game but if you close you eyes, you could imagine it is. This experience will make you think unlike any experience ever experienced by the world's most experienced experiencers. To call it a comedy is simply revealing that you lack the brain power in order to fully understand my mastermind and to that I say, don't even bother spending your ten dollars. You'll need it more than I do. And I cannot even afford a door for my man palace. And yes, that is the proper term for my abode. So move along, and find a better game for your weak mind.

PARANORMAL

Step into a world on the brink of collapse in Strange Horizons, a gripping survival-adventure game. When a dimensional portal tears open in the sky, chaos erupts as mysterious creatures spill into our world. As a civilian contractor working for the military, your mission is to enter the quarantine zone, recover critical data, save survivors, and uncover the secrets behind the disaster.

 

BASE BUILDING

Survive by building and upgrading your base to withstand the growing dangers. Gather resources and craft essential tools, weapons, and equipment to stay prepared. Explore a dangerous and atmospheric landscape filled with desolate buildings, eerie forests, and the looming energy vortex in the sky.

SURVIVAL

Face strange hybrid creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and make life-or-death decisions as you fight to close the portal before it's too late. Time is against you, and survival requires strategy, courage, and adaptability.

ADVENTURE

Featuring stunning cel shaded visuals, deep crafting mechanics, and an apocalyptic setting, Strange Horizons delivers an intense and immersive experience. Will you uncover the truth, or will the world succumb to the chaos of another dimension?

The unknown awaits in Strange Horizons.

store_data.about_the_game:
In T.R.A.I.N. (Transport Route Anomaly: Infected Node), you step into the shoes of a passionate urban explorer from the U.S., drawn to a remote forest in Ukraine after rumors surface about a train that mysteriously vanished just after the fall of the Soviet Union. What begins as a simple exploration turns into a nightmare drenched in fear, secrecy, and silence.

Discover eerie remnants of the past.
Unearth cryptic documents and strange artifacts.
But remember… some truths were meant to stay buried.

__________________________________________________________________________

🎮 FEATURES:

  • Atmospheric first-person horror experience

  • Realistic environments inspired by post-Soviet decay

  • A chilling soundtrack

  • Hidden lore and found-footage style storytelling

  • No combat — just you, your camera, and the fear

__________________________________________________________________________

CONTROLS:

Hold the F key to turn the flashlight off temporarily

Hold right-click to zoom in temporarily

NOTE:

T.R.A.I.N. is heavily based on environmental storytelling and hidden lore. To fully experience the world, players are encouraged to explore thoroughly and read all discovered notes and documents. The deeper you dig, the more the mystery unravels.

Strategy Over Simulation

The Village Rises focuses on meaningful choices, survival pressure, and defense planning — not complex micromanagement. Simple systems, deep consequences.

Medieval village rebuilding and defense gameplay

Resource gathering and structure construction

Defensive weapons and enemy waves

Atmospheric medieval setting

Survival-focused progression

The fate of the village is in your hands.

Rebuild. Defend. Survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the charming world of Salty & Slobbery" a cozy 2D platformer where you control two lovable goats on a whimsical adventure through atmospheric, beautifully crafted pixel art landscapes. Designed for cooperative play, Salty & Slobbery combines laid-back platforming, gentle puzzles, and bursts of exhilarating racing sequences seamlessly woven into each journey.

Each world features its own unique musical atmosphere, subtly shifting the mood as you explore, solve puzzles, and tackle brief, speed-driven challenges together. Enjoy the satisfying hook mechanic, swinging across tricky gaps and collaborating in creative ways to overcome obstacles.

Salty & Slobbery isn’t about stressful grinding or overwhelming difficulty, It's all about relaxing exploration, teamwork, and the delight of discovering cozy secrets with a friend or a partner. Simple controls make movement intuitive, while mastering the interplay between both goats delivers plenty of expressive, memorable gameplay moments.

So grab a companion, embrace the charm, and get ready for an atmospheric, heartwarming platforming adventure. Cozy up and explore the world, one jump at a time!

store_data.about_the_game:
Base 10 is dumb and overused.  What's so special about it?  Nothing! (other than it being how many digits most of us have).  However, for anything non-human, there's no reason to stop counting after 9...

You awaken.  You are a nascent being focused upon a speck of rock in an empty sea of blackness.  You have the ability to create life.  But creating life is difficult, it is fickle and short-lived.  But it is also persistent.

Seed the universe with life and study it to become better at what you do.  Engage in research of your creations and learn the tricks life employs to survive on hostile worlds.  Then introduce these methods to new worlds and allow life to thrive.

This unique incremental plays with the various concept of numbers themselves.  Instead of counting 0-9 then adding another digit, the base that you count in is dynamic and based upon the complexity of life at any given time.  Similarly, you cannot add endless digits to make your numbers go higher, you are limited by each planet's carrying capacity.  You'll have to expand life's reach if you wish to count to higher values.

Evolution and Extinction are baked into the core of the game, along with a college course in biology as you discover symbiosis, evolution, sexual reproduction, genetics, predation, and more.  Experiment on and learn from your creations as you seed the universe.

Explore nine different planet types, each with their own challenges and strengths, and each with secrets buried deep within them that you'll need to discover over many visits with new knowledge gained from elsewhere.

Enjoy 40-50 hours of gameplay (or 10 and a lot of offline progression) and learn some biology while you are at it.

Made by a solo dev, without a marketing budget or AI, but with human play testers making sure the game is actually fun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stop an alien invasion using your fellow aliens!

Deploy your allies and prevent hostile extraterrestrials from conquering Earth.

Simple controls! Deploy your alien allies in response to enemy advances.

Issue commands in real time and protect the protagonist from waves of incoming enemies!

Defeat all enemies to clear the stage!

Feature ① The Defense Target Can Move!

Unlike traditional tower defense games, the defense target can move freely!
Not only must you consider enemy routes, but also plan escape paths for the protagonist—strategic possibilities are endless!
You might even lure enemies in and wipe them out in one fell swoop!

Feature ② Turn the Tables with Powerful Special Moves!

Each character possesses a powerful special move that can drastically change the tide of battle!
Activate them at critical moments or when you want to annihilate enemies all at once!

Feature ③ Switch Jobs Anytime!

Your alien allies can change jobs during battle!
Adapt to the situation by switching between three roles: melee, ranged, and support.

The story is a completely original scenario created by manga artist Rensuke Oshikiri!
All characters are fully illustrated exclusively for this game!
Experience a brand-new Oshikiri world that can only be found here!

The insert song for GALAXYZ neo, titled “GALAXYZ,” is

performed by Sasaki Rico, an artist signed to TV ASAHI MUSIC!

The protagonist awakens in a hospital, having lost all of his memories.

Confused and unable to recall even his own name, he is approached by a mysterious boy named Rui.

Rui claims to be a relative and tells him to call if he ever needs help—then disappears.

Thanks to the kindness of Kaname Asayama, whom he befriended during his hospitalization, the protagonist moves into an apartment run by the Asayama family. Hoping to uncover his past, he heads into the city in search of Rui.

Though his memories are gone, he believes that slowly reclaiming a normal life might be enough…

But that fragile peace is shattered when he is confronted by a group of men in the city.

To his shock, they attack him using supernatural powers known as Esper abilities. Overwhelmed by fear, the protagonist awakens to his own power—the ability to Summon.

The summoned girl, Aviore, looks at him and declares

“Prince! You’ve summoned me at last!”

And so, his brief return to ordinary life comes to an end.

The boy is thrust into battle.

This is the story of a young man who fights to protect the Earth.

store_data.about_the_game:
【ミステリー×ラヴコメ！】

プレイヤーは、シュークリームマンとなって、カヌレ探偵の助手的存在として、事件解決のサポートを行います。

シナリオはシュークリームマン視点で進み、ノベルゲームスタイルで進行していきます。

シリアスな展開もありますが、日常はコメディータッチで描かれています。

時より挿入される選択肢を選ぶことで、ルートごとの、ちょっとした変化がありますので、周回プレイを楽しむことができます。

推理要素は薄く、日常の変化を選択肢で楽しみながら、誰でも事件解決に辿りつけます。

プレイヤーは、シュークリームマンとして、連続爆破事件や怪盗Aの盗難事件に翻弄されながら、途中に出会う女性たちと協力して事件解決に挑み、やがて恋愛へと発展していき、最後にどの女性と協力していくかで、違ったエンディングを迎えることができます。

あなたは、誰と事件解決に挑みますか？

【ストーリー】

スウィーツ王国・カスタード区の片隅でシュークリームショップを営んでいるシュークリームマンは、店舗2階に引っ越してきたカヌレ探偵と出会ったことから、いつもの日常が大きく変化していきます。

一人で探偵事務所を構えるカヌレ探偵に、毎回「依頼者が何を言ってるか分からない⁈」という理由で依頼の手伝いをお願いされます。

日々依頼を手伝っているうちに、マドレーヌ探偵、プリンプリンセス、ベイクドチーズ刑事、チョコバナナ記者、という4人の女性とも出会い、カヌレ探偵を含めた5人の女性に振り回されていきます。

5人の女性に振り回されながらも、徐々に親交も深まっていき、やがて恋愛関係になることも？

カヌレ探偵が引っ越してきた同日に、プリンプリンセスも来賓として王国に招かれました。そして、その日から連続爆破事件や怪盗Aによる盗難事件が勃発。はたして、カヌレ探偵は、シュークリームマンは、事件を解決できるのでしょうか？

【キャラクター】

カヌレ探偵

シュークリームショップの2階に引っ越してきた、自称名探偵。

天然な性格で、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

シュークリームマン

スウィーツ王国・カスタード区でシュークリームショップを営んでいる。

5人の女性にいじられがち。

マドレーヌ探偵

以前からスウィーツ王国で探偵をしている、こちらも自称名探偵。

ドジなところがあり、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

プリンプリンセス

プリン島の王女、来賓としてスウィーツ王国に招かれ2週間滞在。

世間知らずで、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

ベイクドチーズ刑事

スウィーツ王国の刑事で男性勝りの活躍をしている。

恋愛下手で、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

チョコバナナ記者

クレープスクープという雑誌の敏腕記者。

上から目線で、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

コーヒーゼリー爺

定年退職後は、定休日以外シュークリームショップに通っている。

年上らしからぬ行動で、シュークリームマンを振り回す。

store_data.about_the_game:
《Legacy of Y》是一款以传承与成长为主题的 回合制 RPG 冒险游戏。玩家将在不断推进的冒险中积累经验、强化角色，并将每一次战斗的成果转化为长期成长的力量。游戏围绕策略性回合制战斗展开，玩家需要根据敌人的能力特征、行动顺序和战场状态，合理选择技能与战术，以稳定推进冒险进程。

在游戏过程中，玩家将探索多个区域，参与战斗挑战并获取装备与成长资源。角色会随着战斗不断成长，逐步解锁更强力的技能与战斗能力，使队伍在后续挑战中具备更高的应对能力。《Legacy of Y》强调持续积累与长期规划，玩家通过一次次战斗构建属于自己的战斗体系，让角色的成长在整个冒险过程中形成清晰可见的变化。

本作提供完整的单人游玩流程，包含区域推进、角色培养与战斗挑战，适合喜欢通过策略思考与长期成长体验来完成冒险的玩家。

《Chronicle of Y》是一款以冒险进程记录与角色成长演化为核心体验的 回合制 RPG 游戏。玩家将带领一支逐步壮大的队伍，在持续推进的战斗与探索中书写属于自己的冒险篇章。游戏采用经典回合制战斗机制，玩家需要根据敌人的行动顺序、技能特点与属性弱点，合理安排攻击、防御、辅助与控制技能，以策略性的方式完成每一场战斗。

在冒险过程中，玩家会不断解锁新的区域与挑战内容，通过战斗获得经验、装备与成长资源。角色的能力会随着游戏进度持续变化，玩家需要根据当前阶段的战斗需求调整队伍配置与技能选择，使战斗策略随着冒险进程逐步深化。《Chronicle of Y》强调“过程的积累”，每一次战斗与选择都会成为冒险记录的一部分，推动角色从初始阶段成长为能够应对高强度挑战的队伍。

本作提供完整的单人游玩流程，包含明确的推进节奏、持续的角色培养以及不断变化的战斗挑战，适合喜欢在回合制战斗中规划策略，并通过长期进程体验成长反馈的玩家。

store_data.about_the_game:
DEVINICA: CLIP

Bite sized AI simulation. Play as a AI computer program training in a simulated stream of mass casualty events.

Military AI needs training. Bonk Corp provides. Training AI on a simulated stream of swat videos and mass casualty events. Run through various procedural levels and get scored based on the amount of time you take and how many enemies you slay.

Stack runs and further increase your score, use different weapons with various speed and damage modifiers and figure out which playstyle suits you best. Each run is perma-death. 

FEATURES

  • Roguelike Elements: Permadeath, Semi procedural generation.

  • Procedural Generation: Levels are random with 10,000 + variations. 

  • Tactical Movement: Lean, scope and carefully explore levels, death comes quick.

  • Diverse Weapons: Trade speed for damage and vice versa.

  • Horde Mode: Fight in cramped industrial sights against foes.

PROCEDUAL SIMULATION

Explore various level combinations with different layouts and enemy placement, no run is exactly the same.

CLAW LEVEL EDITOR

Build custom levels using the game logic and mechanics of Devinica: Clip using CLAW, an easy to use 3d level editor.

Explore the expanded lore of Devinica in this bite sized rouguelike.

store_data.about_the_game:
On Halloween night, three teenagers head out to enjoy the early hours in costume, unaware that they've chosen the worst possible place to go. While crossing an old, abandoned square during a strange storm, an occult ritual awakens a portal between dimensions—dragging the three into a dark world dominated by the chaos of Halloween.

Trapped in a dimension where monstrous creatures constantly emerge, they discover that their costumes have come to life, transforming into real powers. The witch controls destructive magic, the hunter wields cursed weapons, and the shadowy creature unleashes supernatural abilities capable of facing entire hordes of monsters.

But escape won't be easy.

To find the portal back home, they must survive increasingly dangerous waves of enemies, explore cursed regions, and defeat entities that control that macabre world. The further they advance, the stronger they become—and the more terrifying the dimension that tries to imprison them forever becomes.

During each match, new skills, weapons, and magical powers can be unlocked, allowing for devastating combinations and unique playstyles. Every choice completely alters the run, encouraging different strategies and builds.

Arcane Waves combines intense action, fast-paced progression, and frantic survival in an experience inspired by modern roguelikes, with quick matches, gigantic hordes, and visually impactful combat.

Highlights:

Three playable teenagers with unique powers based on their costumes

Halloween-inspired world, full of monsters and cursed creatures

Build system and combinable skills

Massive waves of enemies, elites, and bosses

Constant search for the portal to return to the real world

Endless mode to challenge your limits

Fast-paced combat with intense visual effects

High replayability with always different runs

store_data.about_the_game:
Plunge headfirst into the depths of Hell in a brutal, fast-paced action game inspired by Dante’s Inferno. Each level drags you deeper through the Nine Circles, where sin shapes the world, enemies grow more grotesque, and survival demands absolute mastery.

THE NINE CIRCLES AWAIT

From the despairing fields of Limbo to the frozen abyss of Treachery, every circle is a self-contained gauntlet with its own mechanics, hazards, enemies, and bosses inspired by the sins that rule them.

  • Lust tempts and disorients

  • Gluttony overwhelms and consumes

  • Wrath erupts in chaos

  • Pride punishes arrogance

  • Treachery leaves no room for mercy

Each descent tests reflexes, positioning, and decision-making at relentless speed.

FACE THE LORD OF HELL

Survive all nine circles and confront Satan himself, the final embodiment of sin and damnation. Victory is not guaranteed — Hell does not want you to leave.

FEATURES

  • ⚔️ Auto-Attack Combat (Bullet Heaven)

  • 🔥 Nine unique hellish biomes based on Dante’s Inferno

  • 👹 Sin-themed enemies and bosses

  • ⛓️ Relentless difficulty that rewards mastery

  • 🩸 Stylized, dark fantasy aesthetic

Hell is layered.
Sin is eternal.
How far will you fall?

store_data.about_the_game:
Pharma Craft is a crafting and research simulation where you build your own laboratory from the ground up. You start small, set up workstations, source raw materials, and gradually develop new processes, formulas, and products.

Research and production are at the heart of the game: unlock new recipes, gather the required ingredients, optimize your workflows, and turn simple materials into valuable goods. Whatever you invent, you can produce in batches, improve quality and efficiency, and sell your results to expand your lab even further.

Take on customer orders and supply different buyers such as pharmacies and hospitals. Different customers pay different prices and have specific demands—choose what to produce, manage your ingredients, and deliver reliably.

Upgrade your lab step by step, expand your production chain, and turn research into a working business—precise, efficient, and always one step ahead.

Key Features

  • Build and expand your lab with specialized workstations

  • Research progression: unlock new recipes, processes, and improved methods

  • Crafting-focused production: multi-step workflows that turn simple ingredients into valuable goods

  • Batch manufacturing: improve quality and efficiency over time

  • Customer orders: decide what to produce next based on demand

  • Supply the town and region: deliver to nearby buyers with different needs and prices

  • Step-by-step rebuilding: repair, extend, and modernize buildings in clear stages—nothing appears out of nowhere

  • Clear management systems: track income, expenses, storage, and production chains with transparent numbers

  • Calm, consequence-driven gameplay: no frantic timer, but decisions matter—careless spending keeps you small; careful planning builds a stable lab over time

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Qixia Apartment, where a wonderfully fragrant daily life awaits!

The Qixia Diary is an original Visual Novel inspired by the food culture of Hangzhou, China. You play as Sheng Sheng（Personification of Dingsheng Cake, a famous Hangzhou dessert）—a first-year art student at Yunqi University. Through her eyes, you’ll step into a vibrant and heartwarming life by the West Lake.

Chapter 1: Moving into Qixia Apartment and Meeting Her Flavorful “Roommates”

At the start of the new semester, Sheng Sheng moves into an old house called Qixia Apartment located on the shore of West Lake in Hangzhou, where she quickly realizes that co-living here is anything but ordinary:

Su Hupo (personified Dongpo Pork): An athletic, fiery sports enthusiast.

Long Siyue (personified Longjing Shrimp): A razor-tongued, logic-driven computer genius.

A Chuan (personified Pian’er Chuan Noodles): A gentle, reliable, healing-type older sister.

Living under the same roof with three distinctive girls—each inspired by a famous Hangzhou dish—their daily squabbles, teamwork, shared meals, and heartfelt chats create a lively, cozy symphony of laughter and warmth.

A Relaxing University Life Blended with the Charm of Hangzhou

The game beautifully merges freshman life with local Hangzhou scenery. Explore detailed settings and encounter authentic Hangzhou cuisine and cultural tidbits. Yet beneath the cheerful co-living surface, Qixia Lodge seems to hold hidden secrets… Late one night, a mysterious event quietly shatters the peace.

Game Features:

Food Personification, Cultural Reinterpretation: Immerse yourself in the lively modern campus life of five Hangzhou food-inspired girls.

Hangzhou Strolls, Modern Vibe: Experience the city’s scenery, history, and daily life through beautifully illustrated settings.

Heartwarming Daily Life & Subtle Growth: Focus on friendship, personal growth, and the ups and downs of shared living.

Mystery Subplot & Light Sci-Fi: Uncover hidden clues of soft sci-fi suspense woven into everyday life, gradually revealing a unique worldview.

Ready to join Sheng Sheng and her roommates? Together, write a story filled with delicious food, laughter, and a dash of the extraordinary in “The Qixia Diary”—amid the lakeside glow, bustling campus days, and the warmth of an old home.

Please note: The game chapters are still in development. The currently available content goes up to Chapter 2 Part 1.We plan to release Chapter 2 Part 2 and Chapter 3 in March 2026. Stay tuned!

store_data.about_the_game:
Inferno Loot: Bullet Hell Bound is a high-octane, top-down action roguelike where every run is a desperate struggle for survival against the legions of hell. Dive into a dark, pixel-art world where your skill, your weapons, and your luck are the only things standing between you and eternal oblivion.

Master the Bullet Hell

Face overwhelming waves of enemies in intense, fast-paced combat. Navigate through a chaotic storm of projectiles while unleashing your own devastating arsenal. Every second counts, and one wrong move could be your last.

Loot, Equip, and Evolve

As you fight through the inferno, discover a vast array of weapons and gear. From rapid-fire submachine guns to mystical scythes, customize your loadout to suit your playstyle. Level up during your run to increase your health, armor, and power, turning your character into an unstoppable force of destruction.

No Two Runs Are Alike

Embrace the challenge of perma-death. Every time you fall, you rise again stronger, learning from your mistakes. With procedural elements and a wide variety of loot combinations, every attempt offers a fresh experience and new tactical possibilities.

Key Features:

  • Intense Roguelike Action: Fight, die, and repeat in a satisfying loop of progression.

  • Deep Loot System: Find and equip powerful weapons like the AK47, M16, and mystical artifacts.

  • Character Progression: Level up your stats mid-run to survive the escalating difficulty.

  • Retro Pixel Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted dark fantasy world with vibrant visual effects.

  • Score Attack: Push your skills to the limit and aim for the highest score in the leaderboards.

Over the Blackboard is a playful adventure game where kids explore a colorful world filled with puzzles, mini-games, and challenges that secretly train real-world skills. Instead of answering worksheets, players solve problems by playing, moving, thinking fast, and making choices inside an evolving adventure.

Designed for children ages 6 - 13, the game adapts to each player’s pace, gradually increasing difficulty while keeping the experience fun, rewarding, and confidence-building.

  • Problem-solving, memory, and quick thinking

★Story★

This world is trapped in an endless war between humans and demons.

In this situation, the Demon Lord Alice went to challenge the brave chosen by the Goddess all by herself to defeat them, but she was defeated without being able to fight back.

In her dying moments, she regretted her reckless plans up until then and prayed for a chance to start over.

The next moment, Alice was reborn one year before she started conquering the world.

This is a reincarnation story where the Demon Lord, who has been granted a second chance, embarks on an adventure to realize her ambition of world conquest once more.
