store_data.about_the_game:
• Procedural and dynamic map:
    Each session presents a new map made of procedurally generated planets.

  • Diverse playstyles:
    Every level-up forces a choice. Focus on production, defense, management or pursue a balanced path.

  • Deep economy and political systems:
    Dynamic supply and demand systems create opportunities to manipulate the market. Planets will trade and go to war among themselves.

  • Every action has consequences:
    Selling weapons strengthens one side, while trading with the other side becomes more expensive. Unmet demands can clog logistics chains, while clearing pirates from space revitalizes the economy.

Gargantua is a city-building and strategy game with deep trading mechanics, set in a dynamic and complex universe filled with dozens of procedurally generated planets. Every trade, journey, and decision has tangible consequences.

Planets specialize in producing certain resources while demanding others depending on time and circumstances. Prices fluctuate based on global supply, available raw materials, and the difficulty of interplanetary logistics. If you monopolize a product, you can manipulate the market, hoard goods, inflate prices, and generate massive profits. But every product is part of a complex supply chain—shortages in one resource can ripple across industries and trigger large-scale crises.

Interplanetary travel is never safe. Defend your ship against waves of enemies as you travel through space. Build defensive towers on the deck of your massive spaceship—city. Every tower requires ammunition, and every shot must be produced in your factories or purchased.

Your economic decisions directly determine your military strength.
In Gargantua, economy and war are two sides of the same coin.

“War is profit.”

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on an Epic Retro Rampage!

Dive headfirst into Multi Class Quest, the ultimate fusion of arcade retro beat 'em up action and innovative roguelike mechanics! Developed single-handedly by indie visionary KHQ, this pixel-art masterpiece transports you to a hauntingly beautiful forgotten fantasy world shrouded in dark magic, ancient ruins, and perilous shadows. Wield your blade, unleash devastating spells, and carve a bloody path through 20 grueling levels teeming with over 50 unique enemies—from swarming grotesque minions to colossal, screen-shaking bosses that demand pixel-perfect precision.

Classic Beat 'Em Up Meets Roguelike Mastery

Experience the pure thrill of tight, responsive controls and combo-driven combat straight out of arcade golden age legends like Streets of Rage, Final Fight, and Golden Axe—but supercharged with modern roguelike depth! Each run is a fresh adrenaline-fueled gauntlet where death is just the beginning. Collect and unlock hundreds of skills scattered throughout the levels, then mix and match them across five distinct classes to forge godlike hybrid builds. Imagine a tanky warrior infused with rogue stealth and mage AoE blasts, or a nimble assassin raining down summoner minions—the customization possibilities are endless, ensuring every playthrough feels uniquely yours.

Roguelike Persistence: Build Your Legend Run After Run

True to its roguelike roots, Multi Class Quest features meta-progression that rewards persistence. Skills you master in one class carry over to future runs, letting you gradually unlock a sprawling skill tree shared across all playstyles. No more starting from scratch—your victories compound, turning you into an unstoppable force over time. Experiment wildly: Will you go full glass-cannon DPS, unkillable juggernaut, or chaotic support nuker? Hone your build through trial, death, and triumphant rebirth, with infinite replayability baked in from the ground up.

The Five Classes: Choose Your Archetype

Select from five powerhouse classes, each bursting with thematic abilities tailored for beat 'em up mayhem:

  • Warrior: Melee bruiser with heavy swings, shields, and crowd-control stomps.

  • Rogue: Agile dagger-dancer excelling in dodges, backstabs, and poison traps.

  • Mage: Ranged spell-slinger hurling fireballs, ice storms, and arcane barrages.

  • Ranger: Master of archery, calling forth animal allies to overwhelm foes.

  • Paladin: Holy hybrid blending tanky defense with righteous smites and heals.

But here's the twist—cross-class synergy lets you transplant skills freely, creating hybrids like a "Frost Rogue" or "Warrior Archer" that shatter expectations!

A World of Brutal Challenges

Traverse 20 meticulously crafted levels, each a sprawling stage of environmental hazards, secret paths, and escalating enemy waves. Battle through fog-shrouded forests, crumbling citadels, infernal lava pits, and eldritch abysses. Face off against 50+ unique foes with distinct patterns—from flying imps and armored knights to hulking behemoths and tricky trap-layers—culminating in epic boss encounters that test your combos, positioning, and build ingenuity. Every level pulses with retro charm: vibrant pixel sprites, thumping chiptune soundtrack, and juicy feedback on every punch, slash, and explosion.

Key Features:

  • Arcade-Perfect Beat 'Em Up Combat: Fluid animations, chaining attacks, special moves, and parry/dodge systems for satisfying, high-score-chasing brawls!

  • Deep Roguelike Buildcrafting: Hundreds of skills to collect, upgrade, and hybridize across 5 classes—craft your dream fighter with meta-unlocks that persist forever!

  • Massive Campaign Scale: 20 levels, 50+ enemy types, and massive bosses for dozens of hours of content, plus endless roguelike runs.

  • Solo Mastery with Sharing: Pure single-player perfection, optimized for intense focus—plus Steam Family Sharing so loved ones can dive in too!

  • Achievements & Leaderboards: Chase Steam Achievements and global high scores for combo chains, fastest clears, and wildest builds.

Multi Class Quest revives the soul of arcade beat 'em ups while layering on roguelike addiction that keeps you coming back. It's the perfect blend of nostalgic comfort and fresh innovation—ideal for fans of Dead Cells, Hades, Streets of Rage 4, or any game where buildcrafting meets button-mashing bliss. Whether you're a casual pixel enthusiast or hardcore permadeath grinder, this is your next obsession.

Coming 2026—Wishlist Now!

store_data.about_the_game:
Five Nights At Monkeys: Flat Mode brings the chaos and unpredictability of the original VR experience to flatscreen play. Every night is different, with changing mechanics, systems, and threats that keep you on edge. Monsters roam freely, power systems can fail at the worst times, and things rarely go as planned. Learning how to react quickly is just as important as planning ahead.

Throughout the nights, you’ll find yourself moving between a range of new locations, including forest treehouses, canyon huts, city streets, and dark underground mines. Each area introduces its own mechanics, dangers, and surprises, forcing you to adapt your strategy as you go. Some nights are quiet and tense, while others spiral into chaos without warning.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Riviera Resort lobby smells like citrus polish and money. Mid-afternoon light turns marble into pale fire.

In Ice Melts on the Riviera, you arrive as Jack Mercer, an affluent guest with a perfect cover and an imperfect conscience. The resort is built for indulgence—but you’re here to observe, gain access, and uncover truths that shouldn’t be yours.

Between polished hallways and moonlit garden paths, the assignment starts to blur into something sharper: attraction, guilt, and the risk of wanting something real.

Meet the Cast


Elena — The Protector
Cool, precise, and in control. Elena runs the Riviera like a fortress, and she treats you like an intruder until proven otherwise. If you’re a threat to her staff—or to her own composure—she’ll handle you personally.



Sofia — The Soft Light
Warm, sincere, and quietly brave. A poolside server who makes the resort feel human. Her kindness is disarming… and dangerous, because it makes you want to stop performing and start telling the truth.



Isabella — The Siren
A lounge singer with a voice like velvet and a gaze that feels like a dare. Isabella understands power, attention, and what people do when they think no one’s watching.

Key Features


  • Three Distinct Routes: Choose who you pursue first—Elena, Isabella, or Sofia—and follow a character-driven path of tension, intimacy, and consequences.
  • Resort Noir Atmosphere: Sunlit luxury by day, dangerous silence by night—where every glance feels like surveillance and every touch feels like evidence.
  • Meaningful Choices: Your decisions shape how close you get, what you learn, and what it costs.
  • High-Stakes Romance: You’re here with a mission, but the people you’re targeting refuse to stay “targets.”

store_data.about_the_game:
You Are Not a Pilot. You Are the Balance.

In Posterior, you are a space trader inside a production capsule stationed in the depths of space.

Your mission is simple:

Supply starships.
Earn money.
Build your colony.

But nothing here is weightless.

⚖ Real Weight. Real Consequences.

Every material inside your capsule has physical weight.
Every movement shifts the balance.

When you carry cargo:

  • The capsule tilts

  • The center of gravity shifts

  • Stability breaks

If you fail to control the balance, chaos begins.

Deliveries become harder.
Loads become heavier.
Precision becomes survival.

🚢 Trade With Passing Starships

Starships arrive with dynamic requests.

They demand materials such as:

  • Reactor components

  • Heat shield alloys

  • Rare radioactive elements

  • Experimental space technologies

Your task:
Find the requested materials, stack them, and deliver them while keeping your capsule stable.

The more you trade, the more complex the balance becomes.

🏗 Infinite Production System

At the center of your capsule lies an endless elevator system.

Materials are constantly produced and sent downward.

Your job is to:

  • Receive incoming materials

  • Physically stack them

  • Distribute weight evenly

  • Prevent imbalance

This is not an inventory game.

This is physical survival.

🌍 Build Your Colony

Earn money through successful deliveries.

Upgrade your capsule:

  • Stabilization systems

  • Interior expansion

  • Production efficiency

  • Advanced materials

Transform your fragile capsule into a self-sustaining space colony.

🎯 Core Gameplay Features

  • Weight-based physics system

  • Dynamic balance management

  • Increasing difficulty

  • Endless production loop

  • Strategic stacking

  • Risk vs reward trading

🔥 The More You Earn, The Harder It Gets

Growth is risky.

As production increases:

  • Loads become heavier

  • Orders become more complex

  • Balance becomes harder to maintain

Profit creates instability.

Can you build an empire without collapsing under your own weight?

This game contains non-graphic psychological horror elements.
Players may experience distorted visuals, time perception manipulation, intense sound effects, and a tense, oppressive atmosphere that may be unsettling for some audiences.

The game does not include graphic violence, blood, sexual content, nudity, drug use, alcohol use, self-harm, or suicide.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Little Otter's Fishing Life!

Leave the stress of the busy world behind and dive into this fresh and cute world. In this casual fishing game, you play as a curious Little Otter living on a unique spherical island. Your goal is simple: become the best master angler, fill your encyclopedia, and create a cozy home.

Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to immerse yourself for a long session, the gentle waves are waiting for you.

Game Features

  • 🎣 A Collector's Dream Ready to catch over 300 unique species of fish? From common river fish to mysterious giants of the deep, every fish has its own habits. Open your encyclopedia and enjoy the simple pleasure of completing your collection bit by bit.

  • 🌏 Living, Breathing Spherical World Time flows naturally here. Experience dynamic day/night cycles and changing seasons. Watch the weather! Some rare fish only appear at specific times or under special weather conditions, waiting to be discovered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game world

You find yourself aboard a space station that has lost contact with the outside world. The crew has vanished, automated systems function erratically, and many sectors are sealed off. The station is still operational, but its behavior grows increasingly unpredictable. Something unknown has breached the station and continues to spread within it.

Horror and Atmosphere

The space station no longer feels like a safe place. Silence presses in, familiar spaces appear distorted, and rare sounds force you to stop and listen. Danger is present even when it cannot be seen — and this constant tension follows you throughout the journey.

Exploration and Movement

Move freely through large station levels, explore rooms, and navigate connections between sectors. Wander, encounter threats, flee when necessary, and discover new routes. Lighting affects orientation and spatial awareness: in darkness, it becomes harder to judge distance, notice movement, or understand what lies ahead.

Enemies

Various creatures inhabit the station. Some appear suddenly, while others linger nearby for long periods, forcing changes in route or pace. Danger rarely reveals itself directly — often you sense a threat before you see it. Poor decisions can escalate tension and lead to unpredictable consequences.

Crafting and Items

Create items by combining two components. The outcome depends on the chosen combination and is not always obvious in advance. Some items help deal with threats or environmental effects, while others may have side effects or even harmful consequences. Crafting is only available in specific areas of the station, making preparation and resource management a key part of survival.

Effects and States

The environment and its inhabitants affect the character’s condition. Temporary effects can alter controls, distort visuals, or change spatial perception. Not all effects can be removed immediately — sometimes you must keep moving, adapting to altered conditions and making decisions under pressure.

Conclusion

As you venture deeper, you begin to piece together what happened on the station. Each new sector brings you closer to understanding the situation, while simultaneously increasing the risk. The space grows more dangerous, the margin for error shrinks, and the station continues to operate by its own increasingly distorted rules.

store_data.about_the_game:
Drop coins, earn profits, and repay your loan-shark-level debts at the end of each round. Use your earnings to purchase key items and upgrades from the bar, carefully planning your survival strategy. But be warned—the pusher hides dangerous secrets. It can be your tool for profit, or the very trap that drags you into the abyss.

Every coin toss is a choice between risk and reward. Challenge randomness with your decisions.

Create your own coin-pushing strategy through unique item and buff combinations.

Experience the surreal thrill of coins pouring down like waterfalls and stacking into towers, accompanied by their crisp clinking sounds.

This machine is always hungry. Feed it coins to activate its greed, but be prepared for unexpected returns.

After each round, the creditor knocks at your door. The only way to survive is to keep the coins flowing.

Some secrets and powers require a price higher than money to obtain.

This machine, this bar—everything holds a dark story waiting for you to uncover.

How many rounds can you survive? As your debt snowballs, will you go all-in, or unravel the eerie mystery behind the machine to find your ultimate escape?

In CoinPit, you can:

- Experience the exhilarating, almost impossible thrill of building massive coin towers with the help of special items.

- Uncover the dark secrets hidden deep within the coin pusher itself.

- Discover clever easter eggs that subtly connect the game to real life...

Your choices will determine whether you fight for freedom or become part of the machine itself.

P.S. Is this a gambling game?

No, actually... it's a game about quitting gambling...

COINPIT is a rogue-lite horror game, not a coin pusher gambling simulator. Our coin pusher is designed to challenge you, offering a unique, thrilling experience, and will never ask for real money!

The records have their own designations and are accompanied by background information:

  • place of discovery

All events are reproduced in the first person and presented without interpretation — exactly in the form in which they were recorded by the camera operator.

Segments is perceived not as a single story, but as an archive of documented cases of an unknown nature.

GAMEPLAY

The gameplay is limited by the perspective of the operator's camera and focuses on observing what is happening.

Each segment lasts 5-7 minutes and is a completed recording containing:

  • recording of abnormal activity

  • changes in the environment

  • visual distortions

  • the appearance of unknown entities

Player:

  • has no interaction tools

  • cannot counteract what is happening

All events are reproduced in the first person and presented without interpretation — exactly in the form in which they were recorded by the camera operator.

Segments is perceived not as a single story, but as an archive of documented cases of an unknown nature.

GAMEPLAY

The gameplay is limited by the perspective of the operator's camera and focuses on observing what is happening.

Each segment lasts 5-7 minutes and is a completed recording containing:

  • recording of abnormal activity

  • changes in the environment

  • visual distortions

  • the appearance of unknown entities

Player:

  • has no influence on the development of events

  • has no interaction tools

  • cannot counteract what is happening

His role is to review and relive the material that has already been recorded.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ultimate Dream is a combination of a realistic tactical FPS with adventure and exploration elements in a psychological and psychedelic world. Intense gunfights meet with a heavenly realm the player hopes to return while he is bound to a bleak social security supported reality in our mundane world.

DEMO IS OUT NOW!

  • Realistic tactical shooter combined with psychedelic and psychologic plot development. Solve light puzzles, explore a strange realm higher than ours and converse with its strange fellow enlightened beings and blast your way through various deadly encounters. Will you eventually compherend the nature of reality?

  • The combat of UT emphasises the hectic nature of firefights. One hit can kill and will at least limit the player’s abilities depending on the point of impact. The player fights against lowlives, out-of-their-mind cultists and rifle wielding island tribals but as the game progresses, the enemies become increasingly ferocious and technological.

  • In between the realms. There are sections in the bleak mundane reality of ours. In this mortal and destitute realm, the player is an unemployed man, reliant on social security, who has learned of the existence of a higher plane than ours and thus found a greater purpose to his life.

  • A great variety of levels with vastly different environments, scale and gameplay approaches. Levels vary from a wasteland to large free to roam verdant jungle island, a dubious warehouse, an eerie neon-lit mall to a realm of nightmares. Some levels require exploring, others call for close combat prowess that favors tactical approach.

  • The player has a varied arsenal, special abilities and technologies including remote controllable sniper rifle, holo-mines, various grenades, a radar and combat meditation ability. The levels themselves feature environmental variables the player can use against the enemies.

  • More fun. The game features an unlockable hardcore campaign and special game modes.

May the power of love and justice protect you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Cats & Tails is a coin-based game focused on probability, repetition, and persistence.

Players flip a coin with two possible outcomes and attempt to achieve a streak of 10 Cats in a row. Each flip is independent, and outcomes are driven by chance. Progress depends on maintaining streaks over time rather than mastering reflexes or skills.

The game is designed around repeated play sessions, where success may take time and multiple attempts. Different playthroughs can lead to multiple endings, encouraging players to continue experimenting and pushing their luck.

Cats & Tails does not rely on complex controls or fast-paced action. Instead, it centers on long-term engagement, probability, and the tension created by near-success and failure.

Key Features

  • Coin-based gameplay driven by chance

  • Streak-focused progression system

  • Multiple endings unlocked through repeated play

  • Designed for extended play sessions

  • Simple controls with long-term goals

store_data.about_the_game:
The main character is Lisa, a successful sex therapist whose life is full of other people's stories about sex, but who herself has been living alone for years, without a single touch. Her office is a quiet island of revelations, where patients share their most intimate secrets. But one evening, Nick walks through the door—a young man who has come for help with his loss of confidence after a breakup. His words about his fear of intimacy echo in her own emptiness.

At first, it's therapy: conversations, trust exercises, visualizations. But their gazes linger longer than they should, the air grows heavy with unspoken words, and their professional distance melts away with each session. What began as help turns into a game where Lisa, for the first time in a long time, allows herself to feel not like an expert, but like a woman — desirous, vulnerable, ready to break all the rules.

Now they have to decide: stop while they can still maintain control, or give free rein to what has flared up in this room, where the walls have heard thousands of stories of passion, but never their own.
In this session, it is no longer possible to lie to themselves.

Game features:
• A deep erotic story unfolding in the cozy office of a sexologist.
• Tense dynamics between professionalism and forbidden desire.
• An atmosphere of intimacy, trust, and the gradual breaking down of barriers.
• Colorful characters with internal conflicts, loneliness, and awakening passion.
• Cinematic presentation that creates a sense of closeness, tension, and complete immersion in each scene.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the Alchemist. The world is the Anomaly. Everything burns.

Flask & Fury is an alchemical action roguelite where survival isn't about hoarding resources—it's about burning them. You are building an engine of destruction, and it runs on Essence. If you run out of fuel, you die.

THE ALCHEMICAL ENGINE: BURN TO SURVIVE

Hoarding is death. The Furnace is your lifeline.
  • Scavenge ingredients from the endless hordes of the Cursed Forest.
  • Incinerate your loot in the Furnace to generate elemental Essence.
  • Fuel your arsenal. Every potion cast consumes Essence.
Will you burn that rare Fire Petal for immediate ammo, or save it to infuse your Fire Bomb with permanent power? The choice must be made in seconds.

THE SLOW SWARM



You are the center of the storm. The horde is massive, relentless, and exponential.
  • Face over 800 enemies on screen at once.
  • Combat is physics-based: Create gravity wells, chain lightning reactions, and massive magma patches to control the crowd.
  • Positioning is key. There is no escape, only the path you carve with your flask.

THE APPARATUS: BUILD YOUR LOADOUT



There are no random weapons here. You choose your tools.
  • The Apparatus: Spend Essence to Purchase new potion recipes permanently. Once unlocked, they are yours forever.
  • Infusion: Feed ingredients to your potions to level them up, unlocking devastating Mutations at Level 5.
  • The Belt: Equip up to 6 Active Potions and unlock over 30 Passive Slots to turn yourself into a walking bullet hell.

ADAPT AND MUTATE

Level up during your run to draft powerful synergies.
  • Standard Upgrades: Boost your radius, damage, or fuel efficiency.
  • Risky Gambits: Take upgrades like Alchemist's Gambit (pay HP instead of Fuel to cast) or Glass Cannon (massive damage, fragile health).

METAPROGRESSION

Death is just data. Return to The Metropolis to upgrade the machine itself.
  • The Workshop: Expand your Fuel Tanks, increase burn yields, and unlock inventory space.
  • Sigils: Equip permanent artifacts like the Homunculus Core (minions explode on death) or Warden's Sigil (start runs with massive health regeneration).

KEY FEATURES

  • 🧪 The Alchemical Engine: A unique ammo economy where you burn loot to power your attacks.
  • 🔥 Physics-Based Combat: 800+ units on screen. Explosions push, black holes pull, and walls crumble.
  • 📜 Deterministic Unlocks: No RNG weapon drops. Purchase the spells you want and build your perfect loadout.
  • 💀 Exponential Difficulty: The horde grows stronger every minute. Can your engine keep up?
  • 🎵 Adaptive Audio: An intense orchestral soundtrack (generated via Soundraw) that reacts dynamically to the density of the swarm.

The Anomaly is growing. The Furnace is lit. Are you ready?

store_data.about_the_game:
You are sent to Soleris—an island on a world threatened by an existential danger. You are trapped in a time loop to prevent the catastrophe. Every reset is another chance to learn, improve, and (hopefully) save the world.

Tactical Turn-Based Combat

Plan every move in tactical, turn-based battles where Action Points control movement and actions, and mana fuels spells. Positioning matters. Line of sight matters. Mistakes matter—until the loop kindly lets you try again.

Two Heroes, Two Different Paths to Power

Play as Diana, who levels up, distributes attributes, and gains new actions through equipment—

and Artemis, a dragon who can’t equip items (tragic), but makes up for it with a flexible, dice-driven Dragon Breath system.

Gear, Loot, and Enchantments

Defeat enemies to earn weapons, armor, misc items, and enchantments. Equip gear to unlock new actions and bonuses—then do what every responsible adventurer does:

  • Dismantle unwanted loot into parts

  • Upgrade rarity for stronger stats and better abilities

  • Enchant gear to push your build even further

Gear abilities cover everything from melee, ranged, and AoE attacks to debuffs, buffs, shields, absorbs, heals, heal-over-time effects—and even summoning.

Dice Pool Progression: Buy, Upgrade, Destroy

Artemis’ power is built from dice. Each round, dice are drawn from your pool—so refine it:

  • Buy better dice with essence

  • Upgrade dice types for stronger rolls

  • Destroy weak dice to increase consistency

Pick your dice to shape Dragon Breath—damage, healing, summons, buffs, debuffs, or essence—then roll, tally the symbols, and let the outcome speak for itself.

Quests Across Multiple Loops

Quest chains are designed so that progress persists across loops whenever possible. If someone reveals a secret, you won’t “forget” it just because the world resets. The loop may rewind the day—but it doesn’t rewind your knowledge.

Explore Soleris

Travel the island, discover points of interest, track quests, and fast travel once a location is discovered—just remember: when time passes, enemies grow stronger. So yes, you can take your time… but Soleris won’t.

store_data.about_the_game:
REDAST

Redast is an adrenaline-fueled survival experience that blends the horror and detective genres with co-op dynamics. Prepare to solve terrifying cases across the globe with your friends—from the prestigious museums of Europe to the mystical temples of the Far East, and from the ancient lands of the Middle East to the freezing silence of the Arctic.

Test Your Wit and Courage In the universe of Redast, 50 different supernatural entities, each with its own unique intelligence and behavior patterns, await you. Your adversary is not just an enemy; it is a hunter that tests you, monitors your movements, and forces you to adapt your strategy at every turn.

Observe, Predict, Collect, and Exterminate

  • Analysis: Identify the type of entity by observing the unique behaviors it exhibits.

  • Strategy: Trust no one—not even your friends—but never stay alone.

  • Extermination: Vanquish the darkness by gathering the necessary items and performing the unique combinations specifically designed for each entity.

Far more than an ordinary horror game, Redast invites you on a true detective adventure with a dynamic structure that changes with every mission. Gather your team, observe, piece together the evidence, and survive!

store_data.about_the_game:
This game was created as part of a game jam.

Have you ever felt like you are rushing through life? When you purchase this game, you'll feel it even more! 

You are a ghost that has to escape a level every 10 seconds. Sounds easy? We thought so too. That's why we added special cards that change how the game is played. From extra jumps to camera warping effects, these cards are sure to make the game feel challenging. Every 5 levels, you have to pick a card to continue.

Expect a simple game that you can play casually when you have some free time. We chose a low price so everyone can suffer as much as we did when testing this game. 

Do you think you have what it takes to complete all achievements?  If you do complete them all, send us a message. We want to work with you for our upcoming game 'The Rift Between Us'.

store_data.about_the_game:
Static Shift is a psychological horror co-op game with Lovecraftian monsters and environments. You (and possibly some of your fellow employees) have to work through your week-long shift at the warehouse, completing whatever tasks you select from the higher-ups, all whilst trying to survive what you can't possibly imagine. Will you go solo or ask for help from your colleagues? Each day expands your tools, area, and problems. Not to worry, you're the best employee. :)

Anomalies

These monsters and anomalies appear frequently during your shifts. Each one that appears, hostile or not, must be logged and reported at the end of each day. After every day, things get worse and worse, with more and more problems.

Tasks

You get to choose your own jobs at the warehouse (how generous), ranging from the mundane to the borderline peculiar. Alternatively, you can explore the warehouse yourself and discover what isn't being fully told to you: What are you really doing? What is this warehouse for? What happened to the people who worked here before you?

Rewards

Completing tasks grants you equipment to assist you and ensure your survival. But losing track of your gear or choosing the wrong task can be fatal. Choose wisely, or you and your colleagues will pay with something far more valuable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Photomaly is a PSX-style FPS horror/thriller where you take over the photo studio your father left behind. Take portraits for customers, process their orders, and deliver the correct prints.

Photography isn’t always as simple as pressing the shutter. Develop incoming film under the right conditions, prepare the final photos, and make sure they end up in the right hands.

Restock your supplies, earn money, and unlock studio upgrades to improve the quality of your work, better equipment, better setups, better results.

I don’t know who he is, but I’m pretty sure he works for the government. And lately.. I can’t shake the feeling that someone is watching me every day.

Key Features

  • First-person photography and printing workflow through the studio PC

  • Customer orders: film development requests or USB print jobs

  • Earn money to buy studio upgrades and keep your stock replenished

Seasonaut follows the journey of a young traveler who, while exploring an imaginary world divided into four seasons, finds himself involved in problems much bigger than they appear.

Each quest helps build the narrative and reveal new layers of the adventure.

  • Exploration focused on discovery and narrative

  • Quests that evolve from simple problems to larger mysteries

  • Captivating characters and stories connected to the world

Ready for Liftoff?

In Rocket Adventures, you don't jump – you thrust, glide, and crash! Take control of a daring little rocket in a world where gravity is both your best friend and your worst enemy.

Key Features

  • Physics-Based Flight: Feel the weight of the rocket. Master the throttle to hover gently or blast off at full speed.

  • Stylized 3D Worlds: Explore vibrant, low-poly environments filled with moving platforms, tight corridors, and vertical challenges.

  • Precision Platforming: It’s easy to take off, but can you stick the landing? Precision is key to avoid exploding on impact.

  • Full Controller Support: Designed to feel great with a gamepad for maximum analog control.

Whether you are a speedrunner looking for the perfect line or a casual player enjoying the view, Rocket Adventures offers a unique flight experience.

Strap in, check your fuel, and launch!

Not all the level will be the same

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

You are trapped inside an abandoned asylum as the latest experiment of a mad scientist - Dr. Otto Reikmann.

He has implanted you with a neurological device that injects chemicals into your brain every time you blink causing hallucinations and slowly driving you into madness.

Dr. Reikmann watches your descent through surveillance cameras, constantly taunting you over the PA system.

When you attempt to escape, he dispatches his wicked assistant to hunt you down and capture you.

Throughout the asylum you find previous victims that have already gone mad and left notes with survival strategies. Follow the notes and you will make it out alive.

Blink mechanic

Every blink triggers dynamic events throughout the asylum. Some of them are helpful while others are terrifying. 

If the player refuses to blink his vision begins to blur and split, simulating the physical strain of forcing the eyes to stay open. 

With each blink, the neurological device pushes the player closer to madness.

The Assistant

The game’s main antagonist is the Doctor’s Assistant. 

Once human, he is now a disfigured result of the doctor’s failed experiments. 

Though blind, he sees everything through the asylum’s surveillance camera system. 

To evade him, the player must disable the camera in each room before being detected.

Once his sight is cut off, survival depends on silence - player must move carefully or distract him by throwing objects, as his hearing is exceptionally sharp.

He moves closer to the player every time player blinks.

store_data.about_the_game:
“If there is a palace, there is a tyrant to bring down.”

A Turn-Based Rebellion, Told Through Simple Play

Lead a small spark of resistance on a besieged island nation. Command your heroes in fast, turn-based battles, take missions from a desperate people, and push back a tyrant’s grip—one hard choice at a time. Time moves as you travel, fight, and gamble on events, and some opportunities only exist at certain hours. Rest at camp to recover and press on… but every rest advances the calendar, and not every mission will wait.

Turn-Based Battles — No Grid, No Filler

Battles are clean, decisive, and turn-based. Each unit acts in sequence with a limited number of moves per turn—attack, use an item, or spend a skill use you might not get back until you rest. Enemies can come in waves, and victory earns experience and loot to keep the uprising alive.

Missions That Open the Road Forward

Take missions from NPCs across the map: win a fight, survive an event, retrieve a critical item, or reclaim a building from occupation to gain new advantages. The main story follows a chained path toward the true enemy—with fail-forward progress when things go wrong, keeping the struggle moving even through setbacks.

Camp, Caravan Market, Blacksmith, Rest, and the Cost of Recovery

Camp is where you rearm the rebellion: adjust stats, pick skills and masteries, manage items, and rest to fully recover and refresh skill uses. But rest advances the day—and without enough food, recovery won’t come easy. When you need to gear up, visit the Caravan Market to buy or sell supplies, or bring battered equipment to the Blacksmith for repairs. Your time is a resource. Spend it well.

Boss Encounters With Their Own Rules

Bosses don’t just hit harder—they change the fight. Face duelists that force one-on-one showdowns, commanders that summon reinforcements mid-battle, and commanders that escape only to test you again later. Learn their patterns, adapt your tools, and survive long enough to keep hope breathing.

Lost Stories You Can Collect and Read

Find letters and book fragments that reveal the island’s past—and its wounds today. Some stories are more than lore: reading them can trigger special missions and legendary threats with higher rewards and harsher consequences. In this rebellion, words can be weapons.

The uprising starts small.

Keep your heroes standing. Keep the people believing.

Still Winter is a Retro Dark Action-Adventure game with light RPG and survival elements about a retired adventurer whose story is not yet finished.

Hunt monsters, cook powerful meals from their remains, and descend into a mysterious dungeon to uncover the source of the spreading threat.

FEATURES:

  • Explore a multi-leveled dungeon - uncover the source of the spreading threat

  • Engage in slow, methodical combat - inspired by classic first-person fantasy games where positioning, timing, and stamina matter more than speed

  • Hunt and fight monsters - harvest their parts to sell for coin or use in cooking

  • Cook meals from monster parts - prepare recipes that grant temporary buffs and status effects.

  • Help the remaining villagers - complete quests to earn unique rewards

  • Survive - carefully manage hunger, warmth and exhaustion

  • PS1-inspired retro aesthetic - pixelated graphics and optional filters for a classic console look

store_data.about_the_game:
《INK Mountains And Rivers》is a casual ink style idle collection and cultivation game, with themes taken from worldviews similar to Shanhaijing and Honghuang. It is a mountain and river world full of exotic treasures and beasts. Here, you can collect various exotic beasts, cultivate them to become stronger, break through bloodlines to enhance your realm, and even cultivate them into the form of a beast queen.

《界墨山河》是一款水墨风格的休闲挂机收集养成类游戏，题材取自类似山海经和洪荒的世界观，是一个全是奇珍异兽的山河世界。在这里，你可以收集各种异兽，培养它们变强，突破血脉提升境界，甚至可以修炼化形成兽姬形态。

There are various gameplay options in the game, including dispatching them to participate in battles, explorations, tree cutting, mining, farming, medicine refining, equipment refining, and more.

游戏中拥有各种玩法，可派遣它们参与战斗、探索、砍树、挖矿、种田、炼药，炼器等等。

Battle 战斗 

  • You can deploy 1 to 5 characters to engage in battles, adjusting team compositions based on their unique skills and talents, and challenge stages to obtain various resources.

    你可以派遣1-5个角色上阵参与战斗，根据不同角色的技能天赋调整阵容搭配，挑战关卡获取各种资源。

Building a campsite 建设营地

There are 18 buildings in the game, each with a corresponding functional system or gameplay.

To unlock new buildings and features, it is necessary to collect various materials through various means such as combat, exploration, and production decomposition to build a campsite.

游戏内有18个建筑，每个建筑都有对应的功能系统或玩法。

想解锁新建筑与新功能，需要通过战斗、探索、制作分解等各种途径手段收集各类材料用来建设营地。

Plant 种田

When lacking resources or leisure time, one can also cultivate various spiritual plants, exotic grasses, and other materials in the fields to obtain them.

缺乏资源或休闲时，也可以在作田内种田获取各种灵株异草等各种物资

Alchemy 炼药 

Collect various exotic fire and herbal materials, which can be pounded, decocted, and refined at the pharmacy to obtain better cultivation materials and maximize the effectiveness of the medicine.

收集各种异火和草药材料，可以在药坊处捣药、煎汤、炼丹，获得更好的修炼物资，使药物效果最大化。

Evolution/Personification 角色突破血脉进阶/兽姬化

Beasts can evolve (break through bloodlines) into new race characters. Starting from the first stage character (entering the realm of the world traveler), each character has a corresponding form of Beast Hime, which can be cultivated and transformed into Beast Hime when certain conditions are met.

异兽们可以进化（突破血脉）变成新的种族角色。1阶角色（入世行者境）开始，每个角色都有对应的兽姬形态，当满足一定条件时即可修炼化形成兽姬。

The preliminary setting of the game character has a total of 11 Stage:

游戏角色初步设定共有11个境界:

先天元灵(元灵境) → 入世行者(行者境) → 不羁轻狂(轻狂境) → 扶摇红尘(红尘境) → 自在逍遥(逍遥境) → 神游龙门(神游境) → 大罗万象(万象境) → 返璞归真(归真境) → 无止问道(问道境) → 永恒圣尊(圣尊境) → 无上鸿蒙(鸿蒙境)

Collecting 收集异兽

The game has an illustrated system with a wide variety of races and characters that need to be obtained and collected through different channels.

If possible, homeless people can be accommodated at the campfire;

Interact with NPCs to obtain their offspring;

Obtaining specific race characters through trap hunting, etc.

游戏设有图鉴系统，有超多种族和角色需要通过不同途径获取和收集。

如可在篝火处可以收留流浪者；

与NPC交互获取它的子嗣；

通过陷阱狩猎获得特定种族角色等等

PS: Currently, the development has only reached Stage3 (Red Dust Realm), and future development will gradually improve and perfect the realm roles

PS：目前开发只做到了3阶(红尘境)，后续开发会逐步提高和完善境界角色

The game world view and character demand are relatively large, and it is not yet fully formed. New content and characters will be updated and added from time to time.

游戏世界观和角色需求量比较庞大，目前还不是完全形态，会不定时更新加入新内容，新角色。

PS: Due to the author's insufficient English proficiency, the above is a machine translation. Sorry for the inconvenience.

store_data.about_the_game:
EON Survivor is a survivors-like action game set in space, where you must fight your way through massive waves of alien enemies while collecting critical minerals before time runs out.

Humanity is locked in an unprecedented intergalactic war. To keep the war machine running, a special unit is created to carry out resource-gathering missions in hostile territories. You are one of these elite soldiers.

Each mission is a race against the clock: survive, destroy enemy swarms, and gather as many resources as possible while facing everything from alien fighters to colossal motherships.

🚀 Intense Space Survival

Control a spaceship in frantic battles where attacks are automatic and positioning is everything. Dodge, endure, and dominate the battlefield as enemies relentlessly close in.

🎶 Original Soundtrack

An original soundtrack written exclusively for the game by Radoslaw Polewczak, featuring high-quality sci-fi compositions that create a strong atmosphere and elevate the intensity of the experience.

🛸 Choose Your Ship, Define Your Playstyle

  • Unlock and choose from up to 8 playable ships, each with unique characteristics.

  • Adapt your strategy based on your ship, weapons, and the upgrades gained during each run.

⚔️ Weapons and Upgrades

  • A wide variety of weapons that activate automatically.

  • Level up during each run and upgrade your arsenal to create devastating combinations.

  • Every decision matters if you want to survive longer and collect more minerals.

🌌 Enemies and Factions

  • 5 alien factions, each with distinct behaviors and threats.

  • 25 unique levels, featuring enemy variants that increase the challenge.

  • Face massive motherships that will push your build and reflexes to the limit.

⏱️ Clear Objective: Collect and Survive

It’s not just about holding out:
your mission is to collect strategic minerals before time runs out. The greater the risk, the greater the reward… if you survive.

- Game Overview -

TOYCAMP is a heartwarming pixel-art JRPG inspired by the likes of EarthBound and Bluey. Dive into a wildly imaginative world through the eyes of a child. Here, you won’t fight scary monsters. Instead, your foes are crazy socks, cheeky mice, and even doodles that have leapt right off the page!

Let's set out on a grand, small-scale adventure about family, growing up, and seeing the world through a wonderfully weird lens. I’m rooting for you! :-)

- Character Profiles -

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

A quirky and mischievous fifth-grader.

Unlike most kids her age, she prefers “making friends” with her toys over people.

She loves exploring the woods and catching bugs, but absolutely can’t stand cold weather.

As the protagonist of this story, she is the key to reaching Dadom Island.

She’s a bit afraid of her cousin Hockie.

Brickey’s cousin, a ninth-grader in junior high.

Her perpetually grumpy face makes it hard to read her true feelings.

Though awkward in social situations, she’s a reliable defender on her school’s hockey team.

She's dragged into Dadom Island against her will, and doesn’t really get along with Brickey.

Her hair is dyed, and beneath the surface, she harbors the rebellious and anxieties of a teenager,

maybe more intense than most.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

store_data.about_the_game:
Vampy was cast out of vampire society for being too small. In the Vampire Court, weakness is unacceptable.

Then Solea found him. A sun fairy with no business befriending a vampire, Solea believes Vampy might be the Ashborn: a figure of prophecy destined to either end sunlight forever or bring down the vampire court itself. She's decided to help him be the good version of that.

Together, they'll sneak through sunlit villages full of people who would very much prefer Vampy wasn't there. Some will panic. Some will fight. And occasionally, they'll find someone genuinely worth helping. The deeper they go, the less it feels like an accident and the more it feels like a conspiracy.

THE SUN IS THE ENEMY

Manipulate shadows to carve a path through a world built entirely against you. Solea can move the light. You just have to stay in what's left of the dark.

YOUR CHOICES QUIETLY MATTER

Spare villagers or don't. Help or ignore. The world notices in small ways: how NPCs react, what Solea says, who Vampy is becoming. There's no big moral report card. Just consequences that feel earned.

SHORT, WEIRD, AND HAND-DRAWN

Built in a goofy MS Paint aesthetic, Vampy's Big Day is a small, colorful adventure about an unlikely friendship and a prophecy that might be giving everyone too much credit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right

A simulation game about the transmission and healing of trauma from one's family of origin

In the rapidly developing urban environment, competition for educational resources is intensifying, and family structures are becoming increasingly smaller.

Parents, filled with anxiety and expectations, are often forced to assume the dual roles of "manager" and "investor."

In a society where "successful results" are the sole measure, control based on love and responsibility gradually intrudes into every stage of a child's growth—

school pathways, interest choices, time allocation, and emotional expression.

External achievements accumulate,

while internal psychological resilience is quietly depleted.

Children seem to be "growing up well,"

but silently accumulating scars,

ultimately manifesting as abnormal behavior, relationship breakdowns, or self-denial.

Every seemingly "correct" choice may come with an unnoticed price.

Playtime: Approximately 15 hours or more.

Text Size: Approximately 600,000–1,000,000 words

Keywords: Realism / Psychological Growth / Choice-oriented.

Current Stage: Core gameplay finalized, Demo in testing

Game Features

A Refined Numerical System

Emotions, moods, and temperament interact at multiple levels. A child's instantaneous emotions alone involve over 100 variables. Referencing Prattsik's basic emotional model, it emphasizes the complexity of emotions and rejects simplistic increases or decreases in stress.

Multi-Dimensional Development and a "Hidden Cost" Mechanism. Short-term gains often come with long-term consequences; success is no longer a cost-free choice.

Non-Binary Choice Design All choices stem from conflicting values, not judgments of right or wrong.

Deeply Integrated Story and Gameplay. It's not simply about reading the story; you drive the character's fate through system actions.

Small Gameplay Variations Driven by Psychological State. Game mechanics differ as the character grows and their psychology changes.

Multiple Endings Educational methods, interest cultivation, and life paths collectively determine the final outcome.

Long-Term Influence Trauma System: Referencing the formation mechanisms of complex psychological trauma, this system allows early choices to continue to manifest in the future.

Talent and Physical Difference System Inspired by differentiated growth experiences in reality, this system combines strengths and limitations to encourage players to understand diversity and cherish the ordinary and whole.

(Planned Content) External Growth System Through multiple playthroughs, players accumulate experience to unlock richer starting conditions and social environments.

Main Gameplay

Main Gameplay

  • High-Freedom Story Progression

  • Schedule Planning and Character Development

  • Emotionally Driven Stress-Relieving Mini-Games

    Team Introduction

    We are a small team composed of childhood trauma survivors, hardcore fans of simulation games, and members with applied psychology backgrounds.

    We focus on real-life parent-child relationships, growth pressures, and psychological costs. We hope that through the relatively safe medium of games, players can reflect on their choices and find relief and peace through understanding.

    This is not a game that blames parents, but a game that attempts to understand "why this happened."

If the past cannot be changed,

At least the pain can be prevented from being passed on.

Perhaps there is no rebirth in this world,

But even something as insignificant as moss

has a chance for rebirth.

Producer/Lead Planner/Scriptwriter

Zhang Hanqi (Binggunya)

A self-media creator and independent game planner with millions of views, possessing many years of experience in writing and content operation. Responsible for the overall planning, numerical planning, narrative structure, and world-building of this project.

×Programmer

Sweet Couple

Studied Computer Science in the US and returned to China. Passionate about all kinds of games, with over twenty years of experience playing computer games despite being only in their twenties. Possesses complete project development experience, responsible for core system implementation and performance optimization.

Representative work: *Xia Shang Xiong Xin*

Chief Art Director

Ye'an

Studied Digital Media Art at Beijing Institute of Fashion Technology (received an A++ rating in the latest discipline evaluation, ranking among the top in the industry), with 4 years of experience as a freelance illustrator. Despite family objections, she earned all her art exam preparation fees and university living expenses by taking on freelance work, overcoming obstacles with her love for art. She is an inspirational role model in our team.

Original Artist

Tantan

A long-term collaborating illustrator with two years of original artwork experience, responsible for character and key illustrations. A 5.0-star preferred illustrator at Mihuashi, with a 100% on-time delivery rate.

Psychological Consultant

Yuyi

With a 211 university background in Applied Psychology, he participated in setting review and content discussion. Primarily grounded in scientific theory, supplemented by counseling practice (focusing on CBT + adolescents), I possess profound firsthand experience in psychoanalysis. Currently navigating the seven-year itch in my psychology career, I'm financially strapped but brimming with passion for the profession and a wealth of knowledge. I hope to contribute my life's work to the project, allowing players to experience the sincerity, fun, and love the development team poured into designing the game.

UI: Haita

Project Management: Heiya

Our Commitments

  • Maintaining transparency in project progress

  • Timely updates on key milestones

  • Respecting every act of support and diligently fulfilling every commitment

store_data.about_the_game:
Watch out, your friend may become your foe!

Lost in the Temple of Nimh, your party trying to fight their way to freedom. Level up using the Ancient Cards and clearing each room of enemies as a team. All is fine until one of you is corrupted by the Traitor Card... Now it is not only a battle to escape but a battle to stay alive against your once friend!

-=== Set Up ===-

Connect 2 - 4 controllers to your laptop/PC via either Bluetooth or cable.

Stand on the pressure plates to start, select your cards and fight your way through the dungeon!

-=== How To Play ===-

In Game (General):

Movement: Left Joystick

In Game Menu (Toggle): +

Stats Peeks: Left Bumper

Switch:

Primary - Y

Secondary - B

Xbox:

Primary - X

Secondary - A

Card Selection:

Select Card - Left Joystick

Confirm - A

Deny - B

-=== ===-

Please note that if you wish to connect a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller as a wired controller, or experience controller vibration on a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, you must enable Steam Input for Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers (from your Steam client controller settings) before launching the game, as Unity does not support either of these features natively.

Please also make sure the "Use Nintendo Button Layout" toggle is OFF, otherwise in-game button indicators will not be accurate.

store_data.about_the_game:
Note: As the game is still in early development, this beta version currently supports Chinese only. An English version will be released once the build stabilizes.

Magical Girl: Final Simulation is a strategy RPG that blends card-based summoning with tactical board control. Players must fight for dominance over key nodes to secure victory.

Story

Set in a futuristic world, you take on the role of a "Tactical Simulation System." To train the ultimate Magical Girls, you must simulate their greatest enemies—the Witches—and engage them in rigorous combat.

Through intense tactical drills and daily interactions, you will forge deep bonds and earn the trust of the girls, slowly uncovering the personal stories behind each one. As the narrative unfolds, you will eventually piece together the hidden truths buried at the heart of this world...

Tactical Gameplay

Battles take place on a compact tactical board where players spend "Computing Power" to play cards and summon units.

  • Node Control: The "Computing Nodes" on the board are the focal points of every encounter.

  • Resource Management: Capturing these nodes grants additional Computing Power, allowing you to summon more powerful units to overwhelm the opposing Magical Girls or Witches.

  • Deck Building: Victory rewards you with new cards, allowing you to refine your strategy and construct an increasingly unstoppable deck.

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn on your webcam. Allow access to your microphone. The experiment begins.

You have become the first subject in the final phase of the Null Institute Protocol Zero trials. The goal is to objectively measure the limits of human self-control. The reward is first. The method is full monitoring. Your task is to complete four stages, adhering to absolute rules. Your body is the primary variable in this equation.

Full tracking system

This experience is only possible with an active webcam and microphone. The game analyzes the video stream and audio from your devices in real time. The mechanics are built not on button presses, but on physical inactivity, precise movements, and absolute concentration. The system records blinking, lip movements, silhouette movements, and hand trajectories. Any violation is a critical failure and results in immediate termination of the experiment.

You are Subject Zero.

You have signed a contract with a foundation renowned for its neurological research. You are the first and key participant. Your codename is Protocol Zero. You are not given the ability to know what came before or what will come after. As the trials progress, through voice instructions and snippets of data, the true scope of the study will be revealed to you, where the subject's resilience is just one of many measurable parameters.

Go through four phases, each testing different aspects of your control. Breaking any rule ends the session.

Stage 1

The system monitors your blink rate by analyzing the camera image. Your task is to not blink for a set period of time. The sensors will detect any eyelid movement. A tear rolling down your cheek is also considered a violation.

Stage 2

You must maintain a completely still posture and remain silent. Software analysis will compare your silhouette with the original position and record any shifts. The microphone will record any sound above the background level, including breathing and random noises.

Stage 3

A sequence of gestures will be briefly displayed on the screen. You must reproduce it precisely, in the correct order, and within a limited time. Computer vision will compare the trajectory and position of your hand with the reference model. A mismatch will result in a crash.

Stage 4

You will be given a command to move or freeze depending on the signal (green or red light). The system continues to monitor your immobility through the camera during the "red light" phase. An incorrect response to the signal or movement during the prohibited phase will be considered a failure.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world has ended. Homgard can’t be saved… but someone still needs to do the paperwork.

You move through the broken world by solving logic puzzles, each one revealing a little more of what was lost. Along the way you'll find heroes who hit snooze on destiny, gods who went to get snacks and never came back, and apocalyptic cults arguing over font sizes. Apparently, this is considered normal.

 

The story is already over.

So why does the world still feel like it’s waiting for you?

FEATURES

Solve puzzles to uncover what remains
Complete nonograms (also called picross) to reveal 25 unique regions and open new paths. It’s a world that’s happy to let you wander at your own pace.

 

675 handcrafted puzzles, with 6 new mechanics
A large collection of carefully handcrafted puzzles, from small and friendly to large and strange. Classic nonogram logic is expanded with varied grid shapes and coloured cells that play by different rules. Every puzzle is solvable without guessing.

 

Let the story unfold
Discover hundreds of short written stories that you slowly piece together into a greater mystery: royal conspiracies, ancient secrets beginning to stir, time agents meddling where they shouldn’t… and someone who's clearly here just for the drama. Read as much or as little as you like.

 

Cosy by default, as challenging as you like
No timers. No stress. Take it slow. Use optional assist features for a relaxed session, or turn them off for a purer logic challenge. Adjust colour palettes and font sizes to suit your eyes.

 

Book 1 of a larger saga
This is the first book in a four-part series: a complete, self-contained story, with much more waiting beyond the edges.

 

An in-world radio
Six different stations, each with its own vibe. Calm, strange, occasionally perfect.

Tiny Farm, Big Money is a calm and relaxing game where you trade vegetables and fruits with a city living underwater, saving the money you earn inside a giant piggy bank.

As you progress, you unlock new vegetables and fruits and increase your income by producing more valuable goods. New mixes, different products, and many mysterious events waiting to be discovered are all part of the journey. In the end, your goal is a peaceful vacation in the middle of the ocean, simply watching the view. Earn more, save more, and most importantly—relax. No one will disturb you here.

Unlock all mixing machines to upgrade your products and earn much higher profits.

Follow the market, buy products when purchase prices are at their highest, and sell them at the most profitable time. Save more money for your dreams.

Carrying vegetables one by one can be tiring—so we have a special solution. With the multi-vegetable holder, you can carry multiple vegetables at once, making your work faster and more efficient.

Does all of this sound complicated? Don’t worry—the way you finish the game is completely up to you. You can unlock every vegetable and fruit and use all machines, or simply grow and sell tomatoes and follow a simple but profitable path.

Tiny Farm, Big Money offers a peaceful experience with its calm atmosphere, satisfying progression, and stress-free gameplay—just sit back and enjoy.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Other Order is a surreal-gothic roguelike with turn-based duels, where you build tile runs and sets to attack your enemies. You and your enemies share the same set of tiles, allowing both of you not only to build and reshape your own combinations, but also to rebuild each other’s to deal damage. Every move you make can both hurt you and strengthen your enemy’s strategy.

Combat is based on tile combinations. Chains are tiles of the same color linked in ascending number order. Groups are tiles of the same value across different colors. These combinations deal damage.

There are 54 tiles in total, shared between both sides. This means you don’t just build your own combinations, but also extend and reshape existing ones on the board — including your enemy’s.

Since both tiles and combinations are shared, any modification to the board can also benefit your enemy.

Your enemies follow the same rules as you do — but some possess mystic powers that alter the flow of the fight and give them an advantage.

In response, you can obtain special tiles that enchant your combinations. These enchantments allow you to adapt, counter enemy powers, and even out your chances to win.

- Turn-based duels built around tile combinations

- Shared tiles and shared board — every move can be used against you

- Runs and sets deal damage and shape the fight

- Rebuild your own combinations or interfere with your enemy’s

- Enemies with mystic powers that alter the rules of combat

- Enchant tiles and combinations to adapt and counter enemy advantages

- A quiet, surreal world where order is never stable

store_data.about_the_game:
Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?

The Missing Threads is a strategic detective adventure where you become an amnesiac investigator. In a race against your own fading mind, you must reconstruct both the truth behind the case and your own lost past within a limited number of investigative opportunities.

Your mind is still unstable. While you can explore crime scenes without restriction, the 'Focus' required to deeply analyze evidence or pressure suspects is strictly limited. Every decision counts. The threads you choose to pull will lead you to the truth, but those you ignore may become knots that bury your past forever.

Key Investigation Systems

  • 🔍 Unrestricted Field Investigation: Collect Every Fragment There are no time limits at crime scenes or while reviewing records. Explore freely and gather every possible clue. Your power of observation is the starting point of every case.

  • ⚠️ Limited Focus, Meaningful Choices
    A detective’s focus is finite. Each day, the number of interrogations and analyses you can perform is strictly limited, and you cannot pursue every lead.

    By day, gather clues and question suspects. By night, analyze the evidence and anticipate how suspects will respond in future interrogations. Prioritize wisely, make every action count, and solve the case in as few days as possible.

  • 🧠 A Pure Deductive Experience There is no combat or reflex-based gameplay. Success depends entirely on meticulous evidence cross-referencing, psychological warfare with suspects, and efficient resource management.

Recommended For Players Who...

  • Enjoy strategic investigation and designing the most efficient route to the truth.

  • Seek deep narratives where solving individual cases and recovering the protagonist's past are intricately linked.

  • Value authentic deduction that relies on logic and observation rather than physical action.

Your mind is still unstable. While you can explore crime scenes without restriction, the 'Focus' required to deeply analyze evidence or pressure suspects is strictly limited. Every decision counts. The threads you choose to pull will lead you to the truth, but those you ignore may become knots that bury your past forever.

Key Investigation Systems

  • 🔍 Unrestricted Field Investigation: Collect Every Fragment There are no time limits at crime scenes or while reviewing records. Explore freely and gather every possible clue. Your power of observation is the starting point of every case.

  • ⚠️ Limited Focus, Meaningful Choices
    A detective’s focus is finite. Each day, the number of interrogations and analyses you can perform is strictly limited, and you cannot pursue every lead.

    By day, gather clues and question suspects. By night, analyze the evidence and anticipate how suspects will respond in future interrogations. Prioritize wisely, make every action count, and solve the case in as few days as possible.

  • 🧠 A Pure Deductive Experience There is no combat or reflex-based gameplay. Success depends entirely on meticulous evidence cross-referencing, psychological warfare with suspects, and efficient resource management.

Recommended For Players Who...

  • Enjoy strategic investigation and designing the most efficient route to the truth.

  • Seek deep narratives where solving individual cases and recovering the protagonist's past are intricately linked.

  • Value authentic deduction that relies on logic and observation rather than physical action.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alchemist Watch is a physics-based anomaly hunt game where you use telekinesis to fix or destroy reality inside a time-looped alchemist’s house. This game combines elements of games like "Anomaly" and "spot the difference" with the mechanics of "props hunt". This game will test your memory, perception, perseverance, and luck. A headset is highly recommended… you might hear things.

You are a thief who breaks into an Alchemist’s Study in search of valuables.
Just as you touch a mysterious pocket watch, you trigger a hidden mechanism.

The doors seal.
Time rewinds.
The house fills with anomalies.

Each day, reality subtly breaks - objects shift, duplicate, or appear where they don’t belong.

Now you’re trapped in an endless loop, forced to relive the same day - unless you can restore the house to normal.

  • Wake up inside the house

  • Search for anomalies

  • Fix or destroy them

  • Go to bed to end the day

  • Repeat

  • Grab objects from a distance using telekinesis

  • Gently return objects to their proper place

  • Or destroy anomalies by slamming, dropping, or colliding them

Be careful - moving objects from their original position or destroying a normal object creates new problems.

All physics objects are fragile - handle with care.

Anomalies are created from over 300+ physical objects:

  • Objects moved from their original position

  • Extra objects blending into the environment

  • Subtle changes that test your memory

Because everything is movable, no two days play the same - even on the same round.

  • The loop starts with 1 anomaly

  • Each round adds one more anomaly

  • Up to 10 anomalies at once

To clear a round, you must fix all the anomalies present.

  • Each round has a time limit

  • Fix all anomalies, then go to bed to progress

  • Run out of time, and the round resets

  • Strange disturbances mean anomalies are still present

  • Mistakes are permanent - until the loop restarts

store_data.about_the_game:
Your First Job

After earning your first diploma from culinary school, you’re eager to break into the industry. Fortunately, a relative knows a guy who knows a guy with an open position at a shady restaurant where cooking isn’t the only item on the menu...

Run a Restaurant. Serve the Boss.

Crooked Cooks is a chaotic co-op game for up to four players, where running a restaurant doubles as a front for criminal business.

You and your crew must cook, plate, and serve food to demanding customers while handling shady jobs ordered by “The Boss,” a nameless man who runs a tight operation and tolerates no mistakes. He’ll send you to collect debts, steal from rivals, and keep trouble under control. Whatever you do, don’t disappoint him.

Chaos, Crime, and Progression

Running a crooked restaurant means juggling multiple responsibilities at once.

  • Prepare and serve food under constant pressure

  • Take on criminal jobs assigned by the Boss

  • Handle problematic customers and unexpected situations

  • Equip your crew with better tools to deal with growing threats

  • Customize your characters to stand out during the chaos

As you progress, managing both the kitchen and the criminal side becomes more demanding — and more dangerous.

Keep things running smoothly, and your restaurant will grow into the most feared operation in the area.

Built for Physics-Based Co-op Chaos

Crooked Cooks is designed from the ground up for cooperative play.

  • Up to 4 players

  • Shared responsibilities and constant multitasking

  • Fast-paced decision making

  • Communication is essential, mistakes are inevitable

The physics-based gameplay turns every task into a challenge. Expect dropped plates, flying ingredients, and chaotic recoveries that are as hilarious as they are stressful.

The game can also be played solo, but managing both the kitchen and criminal operations alone is a much greater challenge.

Whether you’re cooking, collecting debts, or dealing with trouble, everything is better (and worse) with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Don't Destroy On Load" — A tale of memories engraved upon the board.

DDOL is a next-generation strategy game that fuses the tactical depth of card games with the overwhelming sense of dominance found in area-control board games.

■ Succession of Souls and Board Dominance

The board is more than just a grid; it is where "Souls" reside. Each turn, players drop a single card and pay the Soul Cost to pass their power down the line.

"Expansion," "Reinforcement," "Destruction"... How will you manage your 15-card deck? Where will you channel your limited Souls? Every choice is engraved upon the board as a permanent legacy.

■ "Lock" – Severing the Chain of Succession

When the flow of souls is severed, a rejection manifests on the board in the form of heavy chains. This is the "Lock".

The core of DDOL lies in this system: physically obstructing your opponent’s options and seizing control of their thoughts. A tense psychological battle over the only two "Breakthrough" cards allowed to each player. When the board is draped in golden chains and all paths are sealed, a rock-solid "Checkmate" is achieved.

...That moment of catharsis, when your dominance is "Finalized," is the true essence of DDOL.

■ "Judge" – Finalizing Your Dominance

The "Judge" is more than just a results screen. It is a "rite of passage" granted only to those who have truly mastered the board and seized control.

In this game, area size isn't the only thing that matters. Trap your opponent as planned, seal them with chains, and deliver the killing blow with your score.

The moment the golden chains lock the board and your dominance is "Finalized"—that pure catharsis is the true essence of DDOL.

■ Agile and Adorable – Unity-chan in Action!

Behind the deep strategic depth, a 3D Unity-chan moves dynamically across the board! The snappy tempo, synced with card actions, is one of the true highlights of this game.

Enjoy the contrast between the intense tension of tactical planning and her charming, lively animations.

The "Judge" is more than just a results screen. It is a "rite of passage" granted only to those who have truly mastered the board and seized control.

In this game, area size isn't the only thing that matters. Trap your opponent as planned, seal them with chains, and deliver the killing blow with your score.

The moment the golden chains lock the board and your dominance is "Finalized"—that pure catharsis is the true essence of DDOL.

Behind the deep strategic depth, a 3D Unity-chan moves dynamically across the board! The snappy tempo, synced with card actions, is one of the true highlights of this game.

Enjoy the contrast between the intense tension of tactical planning and her charming, lively animations.

store_data.about_the_game:
Remember dial-up? The anticipation of watching a progress bar crawl? The satisfaction of finally completing a download?

File Hoard brings back that feeling - then cranks it up to absurd levels.

Download

Click to download files. Buy generators that download for you. From humble cursors to botnets, undersea cables, time travellers, and eventually... becoming the internet itself.

Prestige

When your hard drive fills up, archive everything to tape. Tapes give permanent bonuses. Start fresh, but stronger. Then do it again. And again.

Format

A second prestige layer. Reset your tapes for Drives - a permanent currency that unlocks powerful upgrades. Auto-prestige, overclock, critical mass, and a 16th generator that downloads from every possible timeline.

Mini-Games

  • Virus Scanner - Quarantine infected files. Build streaks. Don't click the clean ones.

  • Defragmenter - Swap coloured blocks. Group them together. Your hard drive will thank you.

80 Achievements

Some obvious. Some hidden. Some require a specific sequence of inputs. Browse them all in the achievements tab - with icons.

Random Events

74 events. Your mum picks up the phone. Your ISP "performs maintenance." A Nigerian prince needs your help. Complete click challenges for speed boosts.

Stray Packets

Random files drift across your screen. Click them for bytes, speed boosts, or tapes. Or don't. They'll fade away eventually.

Automation

Auto-clicker, auto-prestige, auto-upgrade, auto-generator. Toggle everything from the automation tab.

Steam Features

  • Steam Cloud saves

  • 80 Steam achievements

  • Steam leaderboards

  • Full controller support

What You'll Do

  • Download files (obviously)

  • Buy cursors that click for you

  • Steal your neighbour's WiFi

  • Build a botnet (for science)

  • Tap into undersea cables

  • Become the internet

What You Won't Do

  • Learn why you're downloading

  • Stop

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a soul. Well, you (you reading this) are a soul, but that's besides the point. 

But you - in Past Spirals to Present - play the game as a soul who exists in a dimension between earthly incarnations. 

You (the game you, not you you) are ready for your next life on earth. Before you can incarnate, you need to remember your past lives so that you can intentionally plan your next life based on gaps or lessons you've still yet to learn.

To assist with this exercise of preparation, you will visit the Interdimensional Museum: a building whose contents reflect the past lives of whoever enters. As you tour the museum, you will encounter artifacts, displays, and dioramas that communicate critical moments from your past lives.  

The artifacts will prompt you into memories from their respective lifetimes, and as you respond to the memories, you will slowly remember your soul persona across earthly incarnations. 

The museum will tell you when you've remembered enough, and will reveal your next life to you. 

Key Features:

  • 2D narrative exploration through a beautifully crafted museum

  • Multiple-choice dilemmas that reflect on past life decisions

  • Multiple endings determined by your reflections and choices

  • High replayability – discover different past lives and future incarnations

  • Contemplative storytelling about reincarnation, morality, choice, and the human condition

Ready to enter the museum?

store_data.about_the_game:
Rise of Chi is a story-driven adventure game about loss, courage, and the power of kindness. When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything she knows behind. Guided by unlikely allies and haunted by self-doubt, Chi must face treacherous paths, and enemies far greater than she imagined.

A fun short game with a blend of story, action, strategy, resource management and thoughtful exploration.

🐔 Play as Chi, the Brave Chicken

Step into the feathers of Chi, an unlikely yet determined hero on a journey that begins with a personal mission, but quickly escalates into something far greater.

💎 Resource Gathering & Exploration

Explore diverse environments and gather essential materials to survive and progress. Venture into mines and caves to extract valuable resources and defeat creatures to collect unique ingredients.

🎒 Inventory & Item Management

Manage collected items and resources using inventory bar and use them for combat, and crafting.

🛒 Trading & Economy

Earn and manage coins to fund your journey and upgrades.

🧪 Potion Crafting System

Use the Potion Maker to craft powerful potions using collected ingredients to help your journey.

🗺️ World Map & Fast Travel

Navigate a world map with key teleport points. Use teleportation to jump between discovered locations.

♠️ Mini Card Game

Engage in a mini card game to earn extra coins.

🧩 Puzzles & Progression

Solve environmental and logic-based puzzles. Find keys to unlock doors and access new areas. Progress is tied to exploration, observation, and problem-solving.

🎮 Controller Support

  • Xbox controller support

  • Playable on SteamDeck

store_data.about_the_game:
This is an 8th Exit-inspired game, reminiscent of the original.

Proceed down the corridors of an abandoned hospital. If you notice any anomalies, shoot them.

You only have 8 bullets, so avoid wasting shots.

If no anomalies are present, continue toward the exit.

Whether you shoot an anomaly or find nothing, you can proceed to the next area. If you miss an anomaly, you'll be sent back to the starting area.

Estimated playtime for clearing one run is 10 to 60 minutes.

With 32 types of anomalies and 8 types of outfits, completing everything is expected to take over 3 hours.

It's TPS-style, but there are no difficult actions requiring player skill. Both keyboard & mouse and gamepad are supported.

Story

The protagonist is Nix, a strong and sexy former soldier.

Now working as a “jack-of-all-trades,” he takes on various requests.

This time, his request is to investigate disappearances at an abandoned hospital.

Nix heads to the abandoned hospital to search for clues.

That abandoned hospital was an unreal place where surreal phenomena occurred.

If Performance is Lagging

The Options menu contains a “Settings” section. Lowering the graphics quality to “Low,” setting the frame rate to “30fps,” or reducing the resolution scale to 90% or below will decrease the load and improve performance.

Streaming Guidelines

There are no restrictions on streaming. Streaming is permitted without permission, regardless of whether you are an individual or a corporation. Monetization is also allowed.
