store_data.about_the_game:
"What happened to me?"

"You found your way home."

"This doesn't feel like home."

"Ah, but it will be. It will be more of a home than you have ever had before. And it will be made just for you."

What will you do with eternity?

You are a being that has gained awareness after an unknowable amount of being nothing at all, and thrown out into the world to find out who you are. You have a very minimal understanding of the world around you, and must learn everything by speaking to others and learning from them, and form your person in the process.

The world around you has not changed for the past eternity, and will never change. What do you do with an infinite amount of time with no end? What will you do with an infinite amount of things to do?

GAMEPLAY

SUBURBIA INFINITUM is an open world visual novel, where every character has in depth conversations that have ranging impacts on your playthrough. Certain conversation can give you thoughts, which allow you to bring up certain topics with other people.

There are several areas in the game, each with different people to talk to, different items to examine, and thoughts to entertain.

What kind of person do you want to be?

store_data.about_the_game:
You Stay is a short, atmospheric psychological visual novel about arrival, routine, and the quiet terror of not being able to leave.

You step off a bus in a town with no schedule, no destination, and no clear beginning. The streets are familiar too quickly. The people speak as if you’ve been here before. Days repeat, but never exactly the same. Time moves strangely — or maybe it doesn’t move at all.

There is no combat. No puzzles to solve. No instructions to follow.

Only observation.

As you walk through the town, small details begin to shift. Conversations repeat with different meanings. Rooms reset themselves. Choices appear to matter — until they don’t. The town reacts not to what you do, but to how long you stay.

Your experience unfolds slowly, through inner monologue, environmental storytelling, and deliberate pacing. Silence is as important as sound. Waiting is as important as action.

The story builds toward multiple endings, shaped by how you engage with the routine:
accept it, resist it, or begin to understand it.

This is a game about liminality, repetition, and the fear of comfort becoming containment.

You can try to leave.

Or you can stay.

Key Features

  • Psychological Horror (No Jump Scares)
    Unease built through atmosphere, repetition, and subtle narrative shifts.

  • Slow-Burn, Story-Focused Experience
    Heavy emphasis on pacing, silence, and internal thought.

  • Meaningful Choices & Multiple Endings
    Your relationship with the town determines how the story concludes.

  • Minimalist Presentation
    Carefully composed backgrounds, restrained sound design, and deliberate pauses.

  • Short, Complete Experience
    Designed to be finished in one sitting, with replay value through alternate endings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Infinite Evolution Tower Defense is a deep strategy game that seamlessly blends Tower Defense, Survivor-like shooting, and Space Colonization. Set against a procedurally generated cosmic backdrop, you will build fortifications, pilot fighters, and command fleets to fend off endless threats from the void.

🎮 Five Distinct Game Modes

  • Level Evolution — Progressively advance through 25+ handcrafted campaign stages by completing objectives to unlock new levels. Fight your way from "Basic Tower Defense" all the way to "Eternal Council XIX" and "Zero-Bound Rift XXI". Each level features unique map sizes, wave configurations, and unlock conditions.

  • Survival Evolution — Shape the game mechanics themselves by selecting in-game buffs. With no out-of-game progression, you must survive entirely relying on your mechanical skill and strategic planning.

  • Space Colonization — Establish colonies on Earth-like planets, crimson deserts, or freezing tundras. Manage population, power, food, and happiness to maintain prosperity amidst enemy swarms.

  • Campaign Mode — Face high-pressure combat stages and the ultimate test against Flagship formations and Council Fleets. Clear them to earn massive Evolution Points.

  • Sandbox Testing — Infinite resources, all blueprints unlocked, and a custom enemy spawner. Experiment and perfect your defensive layouts to your heart's content.

🏗️ Rich Building & Crafting System

Construct over 20 types of defensive facilities and structures across three major categories:

  • Offensive Turrets: Sentry Turret (MK1/MK2/MK3), Tesla Coil, Blood Turret, Laser Tower, Railgun, Missile Silo, Machine Gun Turret, Flamethrower, alongside advanced variants like the Arc Bombardier, Pulse Lance, Shatter Mortar, Needle Array, and Plasma Fan.

  • Control & Support: Cryo Tower (Slow), Shockwave Tower (Knockback), Signal Relay (Anti-jamming), Barrier Weaver (Shield), Target Beacon (Vulnerability Mark).

  • Economy & Industry: Nuclear Power Plant, Bioreactor, Superconducting Battery, Power Station, War Factory, Colonial City, Debris Refinery, Resource Conveyor, and Auto-Excavator.
    Combine these with Defensive Walls and various Platforms (Standard / Accelerated / Reinforced / Hexagon) to construct your multi-dimensional defense line.

✈️ Controllable Fighters & Fleet System

In Survivor Mode, you will personally pilot an evolvable fighter into the battlefield. Gain experience by defeating enemies and choose from diverse upgrade paths:

  • High-Energy Laser (+30% Damage)

  • Rapid Reload (+20% Fire Rate)

  • Split Module (+1 Projectile)

  • Phase Piercing (+1 Pierce)

  • Vector Engine (Turn rate & Movement Speed boost)

  • Heavy Armor (Durability & Damage Reduction buff)

You can also command fleets for combined arms warfare, including the Storm Battleship (chargeable energy orb long-range bombardment), Void Radiance (precision laser strikes), Marines (platform-patrolling melee infantry), and Needle Fighters (locking lasers + stacking vulnerability marks).

🤖 Drone System

After constructing Factories and War Factories, automatically deploy three types of drones to assist your operations:

  • Gathering Drones — Autonomously collect mineral resources scattered across the map.

  • Construction Drones — Repair damaged structures and accelerate building progress.

  • Attack Drones — Autonomously track and attack enemy units.

👾 18+ Enemy Types

Face a wide variety of foes, ranging from early-game Space Flying Crawlers to late-game composite army formations:
Crawlers, Shooters, Mechanical Ouroboros, Chasers, Wraiths, Titans, Dashers, Bulwarks, Hell Portals, Carriers, Leviathans, Overseers, Behemoths, Blinkers / Leeches, and Grid Binders.
Enemies also feature an Elite Variant mechanic. As you progress through stages, the spawn rate of Elites gradually increases, bringing exponential pressure to your defenses.

🧬 Dual-Layer Evolution Progression

  • In-Game · Module System: Purchase modules at the wave-interval shop to reinforce your defenses. Over 30 modules span 6 rarities (Common → Rare → Excellent → Epic → Legendary → Mythic) and 6 categories (Offense, Survival, Control, Utility, Economy, Contract). Contract modules offer massive gains for heavy risks—e.g., the "Crimson Contract" grants +28% Damage and +16% Attack Speed, but reduces core Damage Reduction by 6%.

  • Out-of-Game · Assembly Room (Gestalt System): Accumulate Evolution Points and allocate them across 14 permanent upgrade paths—from "Synaptic Overload" (+5% Damage) to "Swarm Command" (+1 Drone Limit)—to forge your exclusive starting advantages.

  • Tech Tree: 18 tech nodes spanning 3 chapters, covering 6 branches (Combat, Economy, Defense, Industry, Control, and Shop). Each node can be upgraded multiple times to deeply customize your strategic playstyle.

🌌 Procedural Galaxy & Star Map

The game features a fully procedurally rendered cosmic background—including logarithmic spiral arms of galaxies, equirectangular projections of rotating planets, and a dynamic Star Map navigation interface. Chart your expedition in the Star Map to unlock new sectors and colonies.

🔧 Special Features

  • Mobile Base Mode: Your base platform is equipped with 4-directional thrusters. Use WASD to maneuver your entire base and dynamically evade enemy attacks.

  • Conveyor Belt Economy: Build conveyor belts to transport scattered mineral resources directly to your base core, establishing automated resource pipelines.

  • Hexagon Platforms: Plan the ultimate defensive layout within constrained hexagonal grids.

  • Custom Music Player: Drop your own .mp3/.ogg files into a designated folder, and the game will automatically play them, supporting playlist looping, single track looping, and shuffle modes.

  • Multi-Save & Migration: A secure save management system supporting legacy save archiving and backups.

In the endless void, only evolution survives.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fumpers 2 is a chaotic platformer that pushes your reflexes, patience, and control skills to their limits. Thanks to its physics-based gameplay, every jump, fall, and move can lead to different outcomes. As levels progress, increasing difficulty, unexpected obstacles, and surprising mechanics keep you constantly on edge.

The controls may seem simple at first, but mastering them is a real challenge. The game pulls players into a loop of trial and error where every failure teaches a lesson and every success delivers a brief yet satisfying victory. Fumpers 2 is designed for players who refuse to give up.

Staying upright, timing your moves, and using the laws of physics to your advantage are the keys to survival. Be patient. Learn. Try again. Because winning in this world isn’t easy… but when you succeed, it’s deeply rewarding.

You have been sent to colonize a string of islands infested with a wide variety of monstergirls. While these monstergirls are aggressive and must be pacified, they also serve as a source of labor and produce unique goods, so you'll need them to build your cities.

Capture Monstergirls

Every monstergirl is an individual with her own stats, genes, and productivity. Your monstergirls need to be housed, geared up, and put to work to create the goods your colony needs. You can also enlist them into your party to help pacify and capture more monstergirls

Build Massive Cities

Your islands can have hundreds of monstergirls, but to upgrade them you have to fulfill their needs. All monstergirls are different: Alraune eat fruits; Ratkin eat cheese; Harpies eat eggs.And that's only the first stage, as your population gets more diverse and demanding, you have to navigate a complex web of production chains to keep everybody happy.

Enact Laws

As you house more monstergirls, or sell them off to the empire, you'll have to decide whether to tolerate or oppress them. Or maybe you only dislike Spidergirls, and have no problem tolerating all other races. Each law has unique effects and bonuses, leading to (at least) two completely different playthroughs. You can try getting a nine-tailed Foxgirl with tolerance, or cage Harpies and turn them into moveable jukeboxes that buff nearby workplaces.

Craft Equipment

Use your colony's production output to craft gear for your monstergirls to increase your colony's production output to craft even more gear for the monstergirls you capture to craft even more gear. Equally, monstergirls can be trained to become better workers, fighters, or just look more visually appealing. And all of this can of course be automated, to create the perfect workers from the moment they hatch.

Embrace Genomics

When two monstergirls like eachother very much, they hug for a long time, and a new monstergirl is created with a selection of genes from both. By carefully deciding how to hug and with which gifts, you can further improve these genes and create the ultimate monstergirl.

Build the Ultimate Monstergirl Empire

There are 12 hand-crafted islands to settle each with unique effects and resources. They can trade with eachother, allowing for small specialist colonies optimized for productivity or large metropolitan islands filled with hundreds of needy nobles.

store_data.about_the_game:
Edgar Allan Poe’s Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition is the faithful restoration of the cult classic originally known as The Dark Eye.

Developed by the legendary multimedia studio Inscape, this surreal first-person point-and-click horror adventure broke new ground in 1995 with its nightmare-fuel combination of stop-motion animation, video collage, and psychologically disturbing storytelling.

Step into the fragmented minds of both victims and perpetrators as you relive Poe's most twisted tales: The Tell-Tale Heart, The Cask of Amontillado, and Berenice. Featuring narration by the iconic Beat writer William S. Burroughs and an uncanny visual aesthetic, the game explores madness, obsession, and guilt in a way few titles have dared to since.

Gameplay in Interactive Horror revolves around narrative-driven exploration, environmental interaction, and perspective-shifting storylines. You’ll click through surreal environments, examine symbolic objects, and trigger cutscenes and monologues that reveal each character’s descent into madness. Some sequences require solving light contextual puzzles, but the true horror lies in the psychological unraveling, not in combat or traditional challenge.

Now available again for the first time in decades, this re-release preserves the authentic original experience, optimized for modern systems.

Key Features

  • Three Classic Tales: Fully interactive adaptations of The Tell-Tale Heart, The Cask of Amontillado, and Berenice, woven together by an original framing narrative.

  • The Original 1995 Experience: This is an authentic re-release of the CD-ROM classic, preserving the original aspect ratio, distinct "multimedia" interface, and unpolished, raw aesthetic.

  • Dual Perspectives: Play through the stories as both the murderer and the victim to uncover the full scope of the tragedy.

  • Star-Studded Audio: Featuring the haunting voice of William S. Burroughs and an atmospheric score by Thomas Dolby.

  • Surreal Visuals: A disturbing mix of claymation (puppetry), live-action video, and architectural renders that defined the experimental era of 90s gaming.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pilot a high-tech combat robot in a fast-paced top-down arena and places where every second matters. Fight through relentless enemy waves, upgrade weapons and survive as long as you can — or hold the line and protect your servers under pressure.

CHOOSE YOUR GAME MODE

Survival Mode
Endless waves that keep getting tougher. Adapt your build, manage resources, and push your run as far as possible.

Defense Mode
Protect your servers against incoming attacks. Position carefully, control space, and eliminate threats before they overwhelm you.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT

Your primary fire keeps you alive — your secondary weapons win fights. Use powerful tools with different playstyles, such as:

  • homing missiles for tracking targets

  • a piercing laser for sustained damage

  • an airstrike / explosive burst for crowd control

  • a deployable weapon to support your defense

Mix and match to create your favorite “build” and handle different enemy types and arenas.

FEATURES

  • Top-down action combat with responsive movement and aiming

  • Roguelite progression per run: make tactical choices and grow stronger as the waves escalate

  • 6 distinct maps with different layouts and combat flow

  • 4 secondary weapons that change how you play

  • Two game modes: Survival and Defense

  • Enemies with varied behaviors that force you to move, dodge, and prioritize targets

  • Controller support (recommended)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Jingjie: Signals is a sandbox focused on emergence and artificial life.
There are no scripted events and no predefined outcomes—everything you see arises naturally from rules, interactions, and probability.

Developer Note:

This game features no tutorials. The system is meant to be observed, not learned.

(There is no randomness here. Every signal has a cause.)

🧬 Living Particles with DNA

Each particle carries its own genetic parameters that determine how it moves, interacts, and evolves.
Attraction, repulsion, transformation, inheritance—when particles meet, a living micro-world begins to unfold.

🌊 True Emergence

No cutscenes. No hidden scripts.
Colonies form, structures stabilize, and species rise or fall purely through systemic interactions.

✏️ Write the Laws of Nature

With a powerful rule editor, you can:

  • Define forces of attraction and repulsion

  • Create systems of competition, symbiosis, or predation

  • Change a single parameter and trigger a cascading butterfly effect

Each adjustment creates a new world.

🎨 Visual Meditation Mode

Slow down time and simply observe.
Watch particle trajectories, structures forming and dissolving, and experience a calming, hypnotic flow of light and motion.

🔬 Membrane & Higher-Order Structures

From chaos to order.
Particles spontaneously form stable membrane-like structures, giving rise to higher levels of organization over time.

🌿 Ecosystem Simulation

Build complete ecosystems:

  • Producers

  • Consumers

  • Apex predators

Genes interact through XOR-based rules, producing authentic inheritance and mutation across generations.

🎵 Audio-Driven Visuals

Import your own music and watch particles react to sound.
Frequencies and beats directly influence system behavior, creating unique audiovisual evolution patterns.

🌍 A Framework for Emergent Experiments

Jingjie: Signals is not just a game—it is a foundation for exploring emergence, complexity, and artificial life.
Future expansions will build upon this core simulation engine.

Perfect For

  • 🧘 Relaxation — Hypnotic particle motion and flow

  • 🔬 Curiosity — Explore emergence and complex systems

  • 🎨 Creativity — Design your own living worlds

  • 📚 Learning — See how simple rules create complexity

store_data.about_the_game:
Mossbound is a cozy exploration game about traveling through quiet, forgotten places.
Play as Milo and explore moss-covered paths, glide between islands with your umbrella, and discover the world at your own pace as new areas slowly open up.

Set out on a journey across forests, rivers, and small islands in search of a cure for your brother. Along the way, you’ll uncover hidden places, meet other mice, and experience a calm world shaped by nature and mystery.

A quiet, emotional adventure with an old-cartoon–inspired atmosphere.

Explore each place and discover what’s hidden

Every area rewards curiosity, offering hidden details, small interactions, and moments you might otherwise miss.

Campfires are more than just rest

Change time, weather, and upgrade your abilities as you explore.

You’re not alone in this world

Along the way, you’ll meet others, each with their own stories to share.

Sail out and discover what lies beyond

Travel across open waters, uncover distant islands, and encounter moments you won’t expect.

Help a small creature and it will follow you

A simple act of kindness can turn into a companion on your journey.

Key Features

  • Imagine being a small mouse on a quiet island, walking, listening, and simply exploring the world around you.

  • Fish by the water, mine rocks, dig beneath your feet, take breaks, and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of island life.

  • Mine crystals both deep inside caves and out in the open, uncovering resources hidden throughout the world.

  • Talk with other mice you meet along the way, each one has something small to share.

  • Look closely and wander freely to find hidden items and little secrets scattered across the island.

  • Travel by boat to discover new areas and see the islands from a different point of view.

store_data.about_the_game:
Experience three stories that each examine unique concepts and themes through different game-play mediums.

Sato is a classic turn-based Role-Playing-Game that explores the concepts of temperance, beliefs, and spirituality.

& is a Virtual-Novel that explores how connections and relationships interlink, building bridges to new worlds and realities.

Can be read from Left to Right or from Right to Left. 

Hama is an Experimental-Game that examines the nature of cyclicality through third person action, painting, traversing, and exploring.

These stories connect and create a larger overarching meditation on life. Experience the various different ways of expression, communication and story telling possible through art. 

"The history of games dates to the ancient human past. Games are an integral part of all cultures and are one of the oldest forms of human social interaction. Games are formalized expressions of play which allow people to go beyond immediate imagination and direct physical activity. Common features of games include uncertainty of outcome, agreed upon rules, competition, separate place and time, elements of fiction, elements of chance, prescribed goals and personal enjoyment. Games capture the ideas and worldviews of their cultures and pass them on to the future generation. Games were important as cultural and social bonding events, as teaching tools and as markers of social status. As pastimes of royalty and the elite, some games became common features of court culture and were also given as gifts. Games such as Senet and the Mesoamerican ball game were often imbued with mythic and ritual religious significance. Games like Gyan chauper and The Mansion of Happiness were used to teach spiritual and ethical lessons while Shatranj and Wéiqí (Go) were seen as a way to develop strategic thinking and mental skill by the political and military elite. In his 1938 book, Homo Ludens, Dutch cultural historian Johan Huizinga argued that games were a primary condition of the generation of human cultures. Huizinga saw the playing of games as something that "is older than culture, for culture, however inadequately defined, always presupposes human society, and animals have not waited for man to teach them their playing". Huizinga saw games as a starting point for complex human activities such as language, law, war, philosophy and art."

store_data.about_the_game:
Violet Impetus is a bullet-hell arcade melee 'em up set in a series of (lightly) procedurally-generated arenas. Drop into different biomes to rid the world of Æris—the demiurge, petrificate & fractured.

SKILL-BASED PROGRESSION

Violet Impetus is not a roguelite! Instead, core to the design is emphasis on player skill—there's no meta shop with 5% damage and move-speed ups, no item unlocks, no choosing between three things. Progression is based solely on performance.

DEVELOPED SCORING SYSTEM

Increment multipliers by putting yourself at continuous risk of death. Eliminate foes just before their attacks ("Clash") for the fast-fading mult CX, and graze just short of bullets for the slowly building GX. Avoid damage to increase your permanent PX. All on top of a system where basic survival is not so basic.

Or ignore it entirely!

INFINITELY SPAWNING ARENAS

Once per level, and only if you're quick enough, clash with enough enemies to enter Apeiros. This is an infinite-spawning mode that only ends when you take damage or let your combo run out. Prove your skill against eternity.

SINGLE- AND TWIN-STICK SUPPORT

While the core input methods are controller with two sticks or keyboard & mouse, there's options to support single-stick play with hinted aim. This allows the game to be played on an arcade stick, single-handedly (on both controller and m&k), or anything you've got with a stick and a few buttons.

store_data.about_the_game:
DREAMTONE is a turn-based RPG packed with old-school charm, brain-bending battles, and a heavy dose of the unexpected.

After a party in the woods gone wrong, Nathan Bloom and his brother, Neil, find themselves caught in the throes of a conspiracy that’s rocking America! Forced to make friends with a rotating cast of weirdos, they road-trip across Michigan. Our accidental misfit heroes will encounter bombastic gangsters, ancient demons, and creatures straight out of your Saturday morning nightmares!

Gameplay Features:

DREAMTONE throws you into complex battles where timing is everything. Chain together attacks, unlock new abilities, and swap out strategies on the fly. it’s brains over brawns! Trick your opponents and even sidestep battles altogether if you’re clever enough!

Switch between your party members to get a different perspective on the world. Every character has their own dialogue interactions, and special abilities, so leave no stone unturned if you want to see everything a character has to offer!

An inventory you’ll curse and then learn to love! When you carry too many items, you become over-encumbered. You’ll lose some speed in the overworld and perform badly in battles while over-encumbered. So, make sure to tidy up every now and again!

If you’re into RPGs, urban legends, or UFOs, then this game is just for you!

Grab a bat and pack your bag, ‘cause DREAMTONE is coming to your dreams.

store_data.about_the_game:
🕯️ ABOUT THIS GAME

You open your eyes in complete darkness.
You don’t know where you are. You don’t know how long you’ve been here.
You only know one thing: this place is not empty.

This is an atmosphere-driven survival horror experience set deep beneath the surface, inside a massive underground labyrinth. As you move forward, the environment grows heavier, silence becomes oppressive, and every step demands attention.

Fear here is not loud.
It does not rush you.
It settles in slowly and refuses to leave.

🌑 ENVIRONMENT & ATMOSPHERE

Endless tunnels, narrow corridors, and paths designed to erase your sense of direction.
The underground is claustrophobic, disorienting, and hostile.

Walls feel closer than they should.
The air feels thick.
Silence never feels safe.

The deeper you go, the more the darkness presses in — not just around you, but inside your thoughts.

🧟 THREATS

You are not alone down here.

Zombies move through the tunnels.
Some are seen.
Some are only felt.
Some are watching.

Hunters are different.
They are patient.
They wait.

Being in the wrong place at the wrong moment is often enough.

Every encounter is a test, and most mistakes are only noticed when it’s already too late.

⚖️ CHOICES

Survival has no single solution.

🤫 Sometimes you stay silent and blend into the shadows.
🏃 Sometimes running is the only option.
🛑 Sometimes you stop and wait for danger to pass.
🩸 Sometimes surviving means acting like one of them.

None of these choices are safe.
Some are simply less fatal than others.

🚪 RISK & AWARENESS

Not every door is worth opening.
Some lead forward.
Some break the silence — and nothing more.

Constant movement is not always strength.
🌬️ Finding a place to breathe can be survival itself.

🎒 Everything you carry matters.
Every item has weight, value, and consequence.
There is no excess here.

❓ YOUR OBJECTIVE

One thought follows you through the darkness:

Is there really a way out?

Maybe there is.
Maybe asking that question is already a mistake.

This is not a story of victory.
This is not a power fantasy.

This is an experience about how far you are willing to go in the dark.

And some paths exist
only to be entered once.

⭐ KEY FEATURES

  • 🌑 Dark, oppressive underground labyrinth

  • 🧟 Constant threat from zombies and hunters

  • ⚖️ Survival driven by awareness, timing, and choice

  • 🧠 Psychological horror and sustained tension

  • 🎒 Resource value and risk-focused progression

Pound for Pound is a deep MMA promotion sim where you start from nothing and build your way to the top. Sign unknown fighters, book smart matchups, grow your brand, and try to become the biggest MMA organization in the world while rival promotions fight you for talent, dates, and dominance.

You Control the Business

You’re in charge of everything that matters:

  • Sign and manage fighters

  • Negotiate and track contracts

  • Book fight cards and venues

  • Develop talent and shape divisions

  • Schedule events and manage growth

Start small. Expand your reach. Turn your promotion into a global powerhouse.

Deep Fight Simulation, Styles Make Fights

Every matchup is driven by underlying fighter attributes, tendencies, and skill development. Wrestling specialists neutralize strikers. Pressure fighters overwhelm counter punchers. Career progression and training shape long-term performance.

Build contenders. Craft divisions. Watch champions rise and decline over time.

Build Your Legacy, Expand Your Promotion

As your legacy grows, you’ll unlock new ways to level up your organization through a promotion upgrade system:

  • Unlock new weight classes

  • Expand your roster

  • Book bigger venues

  • Expand into new territories

  • Earn bigger opportunities like TV deals

  • Land sponsors and scale your events

Build Your Story

Fighters rise from unknown prospects to superstars. Champions come and go. Title lineages build history across generations.

Every save tells a different story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore not a world, but a person, a teenage fencer.

In kowareta, you follow a girl pushed into competitive fencing by her parents. As pressure builds, she begins to turn inward, where intrusive thoughts take form as tangible encounters, ones you may choose to reject or embrace.

The experience favors atmosphere and interpretation over constant dialogue. Much of the story is told through symbolism, visuals, and emotion rather than explicit explanations.

Combat is built around an unusual system where you draw to attack and parry enemy moves through a rhythm-style minigame. Success depends on timing, observation, and understanding each enemy’s behavior.

The way these encounters are faced has lasting effects. 
Acceptance and rejection both carry weight.

store_data.about_the_game:
A medieval strategy board game where economics, territory, and tactical card battles decide the fate of a kingdom.

Each game is a struggle for influence, resources, and control of the map, just like in a real board game.

Immerse yourself in the harsh and opulent world of the Middle Ages, where every decision has a price, and power is won not only with gold but also with steel. This game is a unique blend of Monopoly, turn-based military strategy, and economic management, inspired by board games and card battles.

Main idea

On a round playing field, 4 players meet, each represented by a different color:

Before the game begins, everyone chooses their Lord. Each Lord is unique and has its own characteristics:

Players take turns rolling dice, moving through regions, capturing land, developing cities, trading, recruiting troops, and engaging in tactical card battles for control of territories.

The playing field is divided into regions and neutral holdings.

Capture lands and collect tolls from your opponents.

Neutral zones and bandit-held areas offer various events.

Tactical card battles

If the land is owned by an enemy, you can pay tribute or seize it through card battles.

Form battle lines of warriors

Deploy units on the tactical battlefield

Use different types of troops:

Infantry

Rangemen

Cavalry

Each warrior is unique and has his own characteristics:

Health

Damage

Number of attacks

Critical hit chance

Dodge chance

Parry chance

Also, some warriors may have special skills, such as:

Stun

Poison

Increased damage to cavalry

Inflicts a bleeding wound

Each battle is a mini-strategy where the composition of the army and their equipment are important

Deep equipment system

Each warrior can be equipped individually depending on their equipment types:

Swords, axes, spears, sledgehammers

Arrow bows, crossbows, throwing spears, and axes

Shields of various types, from light and offering little protection to heavy and impenetrable

Helmets of various types

Armor of various types

Boots of various types

Additional equipment

Equipment directly affects combat characteristics and battle tactics.

Economy and trade

Obtain resources from the territories you control.

Develop cities to increase your income.

Trade resources and equipment by visiting the market (if you're lucky).

Economic superiority can be just as important as military superiority.

Roll dice on the tavern board or let your warriors rest to become stronger.

Explore the ruins of abandoned villages, castles, towns, and camps.

Each party develops differently and requires adaptation.

Key Features

A mix of board game and turn-based strategy

Tactical card battles

Territory capture and development

Deep warrior equipment system

Random elements through dice rolls

High replayability and strategic depth

Adjustable Game Pace

Play at your own pace—from a leisurely strategic game to a faster pace that cuts down on turn times without sacrificing depth.

Who is this game for:

Board strategy game lovers

Monopoly fans with a combat system

Those who value tactics, economics, and territorial control

Players looking for a meditative yet challenging turn-based strategy game

Conquer lands, fortify cities, equip an army and prove that you are worthy of ruling this medieval world

Game development plans:

• Local multiplayer – play with friends on the same computer (2-4 players)

• Online multiplayer – in development after local mode

Features are planned and may change during development.

If you like the game's concept, add it to your Steam wishlist.

This is the best way to support solo development and directly influences the priority of future updates.

FAQ

What is this game?

A digital board game with economics, territories, and card battles.

How long does a game last?

From 10 minutes to 60 minutes or more.

Is there multiplayer?

In development: local, then online.

Why should I wishlist it?

This directly supports the development and growth of the project.

store_data.about_the_game:
TAG! is a fast-paced multiplayer parkour showdown where you and your friends go head-to-head in the ultimate game of tag. The rules are simple: survive to the end. With support for 2–8 players, every match turns into a sprint, a chase, and a scramble for the last safe spot.

In the core mode, TAG!, everyone spawns into the arena where one (or more) players start as “It.” When the round timer hits zero, anyone who’s still It is eliminated, and the next round begins with the survivors. The pressure builds until only two players remain… then it’s an all-out 1v1 finale to decide who earns the title of true Tag champion.

But TAG! is more than a simple party game. Level up, earn in-game currency, and travel through Skill Scrolls to unlock new movement types, upgrades that boost your existing parkour, and powerful Ultimate Abilities that can flip a close moment instantly. You can only equip a limited set at once, so experiment, practice, and build the perfect Tag Loadout.

Never fear, your Technical Assistant Guru friend is here! TAG-Bot will be here to walk you through the tutorial of the game, get you started and even help you through the solo missions in the game!\

Battle your friends, and prove who the ultimate parkour tag player really is.

Please wishlist the game today! The game is still under development, if you are curious about the development of the game and what features are being added, feel free to join my Discord Server to ask questions and look around!

store_data.about_the_game:
It’s late. You need to get back home from work. You don’t feel safe walking around in this neighborhood late at night, so you figure you can cut through the usual parking garage like always and it would be fine, right?

Well, it would, if you hadn’t stumbled upon an untold danger there.

 

Watch Eye is a third-person survival horror game in which you must try to escape from this parking garage with your life. Collect items, unlock doors, and solve puzzles to get closer to the exit, all the while there’s an unrelenting entity chasing you down.

There is no fighting the entity, however. If it touches you, it will kill you, so you must try to stay out of its sight as best as you can.

But why is the entity after you? What is this mysterious entity, and where did it come from? Documents scattered throughout the building might help you solve this mystery... but you must survive first.

 

MAIN FEATURES

  • Limited inventory

  • Puzzles

  • Light stealth

  • Manual saving at save points

Protect the Core.

x999 Ball is a fast-paced, skill-focused action game where precision and reflexes matter. You are the defense in charge of protecting the core.

Launch your Node using slingshot-style controls, bounce through enemies, and turn tight arenas into explosive chain reactions. Consecutive hits matter, every angle counts, and mastery is rewarded with massive combos in a closed-quarters neon world.

SLINGSHOT COMBAT

Slow down time, line up your shot, and unleash chaos.
Smash through enemies to trigger devastating damage. Skilled positioning and timing can turn a single launch into a screen-clearing combo.

Can you hit a x999 Combo?

IN-GAME PROGRESSION

Earn Data from fallen enemies during each run and choose upgrades on the fly. Adapt your build and find the upgrades that best fit your playstyle as the difficulty ramps up.

Every run is a chance to go further.

PERMANENT UPGRADES

Defeated? Your progress doesn’t end there.

Spend your earned Credits to unlock permanent system upgrades between runs. Start with more health, earn Data faster, or unlock the ability to revive when systems fail. Each upgrade pushes you closer to mastery and higher-level play.

SKILL, SPEED, AND MASTERY

x999 Ball is designed for players who enjoy:

  • Fast, skill-based arcade gameplay

  • Physics-driven combat and movement

  • Replayable runs focused on improvement and mastery

Protect the Core. Perfect your shots. Chase the x999 Combo.

Launch your Node using slingshot-style controls, bounce through enemies, and turn tight arenas into explosive chain reactions. Consecutive hits matter, every angle counts, and mastery is rewarded with massive combos in a closed-quarters neon world.

SLINGSHOT COMBAT

Slow down time, line up your shot, and unleash chaos.
Smash through enemies to trigger devastating damage. Skilled positioning and timing can turn a single launch into a screen-clearing combo.

Can you hit a x999 Combo?

IN-GAME PROGRESSION

Earn Data from fallen enemies during each run and choose upgrades on the fly. Adapt your build and find the upgrades that best fit your playstyle as the difficulty ramps up.

Every run is a chance to go further.

Spend your earned Credits to unlock permanent system upgrades between runs. Start with more health, earn Data faster, or unlock the ability to revive when systems fail. Each upgrade pushes you closer to mastery and higher-level play.

store_data.about_the_game:
You Shake a Hand. The Rest is a Chain Reaction.

Shaking Hands is a decision-driven shop management game set in a crumbling city of the 1920s.

In this city, you are not a soldier; you are an arms dealer. Who you sell to changes not just your cash register, but the city's balance, the newspaper headlines, and the mood of your daughter waiting at home.

Here, no sale is ever just "business."

Your Choices Change the City

The trade you conduct within these walls echoes beyond them.
  • You Write the Headlines: The weapons you sell become tomorrow's news.
  • The Public Reacts: Newspapers shape the public's anger or hope.
  • The Streets Erupt: The public's reaction changes the streets, and the streets change your shop.
A sale to revolutionaries today might set the streets on fire tomorrow. Playing into the State's hands reduces inspections but makes the people hate you. The wrong balance means a month where rent goes unpaid.

The Shop is Not a Sanctuary, It is Pressure

  • Negotiate: Every customer is different. Who is scared? Who is lying? Who will point that gun at whom? You must be a judge of character.
  • Take Risks: Illegal sales mean more money, but higher chances of inspections, raids, and robberies.
  • Survive: Rent, taxes, debt... Money isn't just profit; it's a burden on your back.

There is Another War at Home

Your daughter is affected by your choices. As the city darkens, so does she. Some nights she goes silent; other nights she loses control.

Making money doesn't always mean being a "good father."

Key Features

  • A sales-based decision system that alters the narrative.
  • Dynamic newspaper and city states shaped by your trade.
  • A delicate balance between factions: State, Resistance, Crime Network, The People.
  • Dark, Noir atmosphere and management tension.
You sell weapons. But everyone pays the price.

store_data.about_the_game:
Abyssal Merge is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where your survival depends on your ability to multitask. As a lone captain in the heart of a monster-infested ocean, you must defend against waves of creatures while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net.

Fight to Protect the Net

From the top of the screen, horrific sea creatures will try to get into your net. You are the only line of defense. Protect your haul by shooting enemies in fast-paced, arcade-style combat.

Merge to Grow Stronger

While fighting for your life, you must manage your net at the bottom of the screen. Merge fish to create larger, more valuable catches. The more you merge, the stronger your boat becomes, giving you the power needed to survive the escalating waves of enemies.

Choose Your Build

Every level-up is an opportunity to choose from a variety of upgrades to define your playstyle. Whether you focus on raw firepower or net efficiency, every run offers a new opportunity to experiment with a unique, game-breaking build.

Defeat the Abyssal Bosses

The deeper into the ocean you get, the more terrifying the horrors become. Prove your skills by defeating massive final bosses to secure a massive payout for the fish in your net.

Die, Buy, Repeat

In true roguelite fashion, a failed run is not the end. The money earned from your merged fish can be spent in the Permanent Upgrade Store. Boost your stats and upgrade your ship to ensure your next adventure takes you even deeper into the abyss.

Unlock New Challenges

Beating the final boss is just the beginning. Victory unlocks new boats, each providing a significantly higher level of challenge. These vessels aren't just skins - they require you to craft and master entirely builds.

The Ultimate Test: Endless Mode

Once you have purchased every permanent upgrade, you unlock Endless Mode. With your meta-progression complete, only pure skill remains. Push your build to its absolute limit and compete for the high score against infinite, escalating waves of monsters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Master the art of color under pressure

ToSaVa is a fast-paced arcade puzzle designed specifically for digital artists, designers, and visual students. In this game, you don’t just play; you train your eyes and your brain to master the technical foundations of color theory in a high-pressure environment.

The Concept

You are a chameleon in a constantly changing digital world. To move forward and stay safe, you must blend in perfectly with the ground. But there’s a catch: you don’t just pick a color from a palette—you must build it manually using professional color models. Achieve a "Perfect Match" to earn stars. Getting 5 stars in a row within the same color mode will allow you to progress and unlock more advanced game modes, from RGB to the challenging Lab space.

The Professional Artist's Training Ground

The entire User Interface (UI) has been meticulously designed to mimic industry-standard software like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects. This makes the game a perfect bridge between theory and practice, allowing you to sharpen the skills you use every day in your professional workflow.

Key Features

  • Three Core Mastery Modes:

    • HSV: Learn to think in terms of Hue, Saturation, and Value.

    • RGB: Master the additive color model used in every digital screen.

    • Lab: Challenge yourself with the most advanced, perceptually accurate color space used by high-end professionals (L*a*b).

  • Arcade Pressure: It’s not just about accuracy; it’s about speed. Can you calculate the correct values before the time runs out?

  • Educational Foundation: Developed by a 3D Animation and Interactive Environments professor as a practical tool to gamify the learning of complex visual concepts.

  • Minimalist & Aesthetic Design: A clean, professional look that keeps you focused on the core mechanic: the science of color.

Why play ToSaVa?

Stop guessing hex codes and start understanding how color works. Whether you are a student trying to pass your color theory exam or a senior designer looking to sharpen your "color-picking" reflexes, this game transforms a complex technical skill into an addictive arcade experience.

Think you know color? Prove it.

Fun fact: ToSaVa stands for 'To, Saturació, Valor', which is Catalan for Hue, Saturation, Value. Also, my name is Tomàs Sala, and is my first game as a SoloDev, it could be like " Version Alpha". Both are ToSaVa...

store_data.about_the_game:
Your city has a problem.

It’s not zombies.
It’s not aliens.
It’s not a mysterious fog.

It’s drunk people.

In this chaotic co-op game, waves of heavily intoxicated NPCs spill into the city and begin their heroic journey toward their cars. Your job is simple: stop them from getting there. If even one drunk reaches their vehicle and drives home, the entire team pays the price.

Work together with friends to intercept, block, distract, and outplay an ever-growing crowd of wobbling citizens determined to make terrible decisions. Each wave brings more drunks, worse coordination, and increasingly questionable pathfinding. Between waves, you’ll get a short moment to breathe… before the countdown hits zero and the next disaster begins.


The Goal

Prevent the drunks from reaching their cars.
That’s it.

If they time out, you’re safe, if they reach the hotel, you’re safe.
If they drive home… you weren’t good enough.


Features

  • Co-op chaos – Coordinate with up to 4 friends or yell at them when things inevitably go wrong

  • Escalating waves – One drunk becomes two, two become ten, and suddenly nobody is okay

  • Shared failure – One mistake affects everyone. Blame accordingly

  • Physics, pathfinding, and poor life choices

store_data.about_the_game:
Escape the shifting tides! Become a cute mole, dig through the mud for resources, and repair your ship to survive. Explore ever-changing terrain with friends and flee the island before the sea swallows everything!

🌊 Living 3D Mudflats & Shifting Tides

The world of Mudventure is never static. Your strategy must change with the real-time ebb and flow of the tide. Explore hidden caves revealed during low tide, but hurry to high ground before the water rushes back! As the tide rises, new paths open while new dangers emerge.

⛏️ Limitless Terrain Transformation

Don't just dig—reshape the world. With the Digger System, you can freely destroy and mold the mudflat terrain. Carve your own paths to find rare resources deep underground or create efficient escape routes to evade pursuing monsters.

🎣 Fish, Gather, and Survive

The mudflats hold more than just dirt. Utilize everything the island offers to aid your escape.

  • Fishing: Cast your line to catch essential items or rare fish that fetch high prices at the market.

  • Gathering: Scour the island for mysterious resources. Roam the newly opened "Starfish Island" to collect precious materials for crafting.

🔮 The Witch’s Cauldron & Arcane Recipes

Craft essential survival items using the Witch’s Cauldron. Dig up hidden recipes from the mud or purchase new ones from the shop. The tools and potions you craft will be your only shield against giant monsters and the harsh environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sometimes you want tactical depth. Sometimes you just want a gigantic army that steamrolls everything in its path. Doomstacker combines both - a condensed fantasy-strategy experience in an auto-battler format, where smart planning and absurdly huge stacks go hand in hand.

Build your castle

Develop your castle and decide which creatures you want to rely on. But the higher the difficulty and the tougher the opponents, the more you’ll adapt to whatever resources you have the most of - and to the artifacts you manage to find.

Create synergies

Each castle has 10 creatures, but you can bring only 5. Some lineups work far better than others, and there are tons of possible combinations. Experiment and discover your favorites.

Grow into unstoppable armies

In Doomstacker, any creature can become terrifying - if you have thousands of them. And there are multiple ways to boost your army even further.

Upgrade and evolve into a Doomstack

If your resources allow it, you can upgrade creature buildings multiple times. A big stack can become something much, much worse for your enemies… a true Doomstack.

Artifacts and rings

Strengthen your armies by buying and upgrading artifacts - making them stronger, tougher, and faster. Equip rings to grant an army an ability that originally belonged to a different one, opening up even more build possibilities. The number of combinations is huge. Try weird ideas. Break the game (legally).

Play for fun or play seriously

We want you to enjoy both:

  • pure power fantasy - build an enormous army and revel in your own might

  • competitive play - climb rating, learn matchups, and squeeze value from every attack and ability

Study battles your way

It’s an auto-battler, but battles play out in turn-based mode. Use the battle log to rewind to any previous turn and replay from that moment - step-by-step (like classic strategies) or in a faster automated view (like auto-battlers).

Fight AI or player army “ghosts”

Battle AI armies or face copies of other players’ armies at a similar rating. There’s no rush - prepare for each fight at your own pace.

Build the Doomstack of your dreams!

store_data.about_the_game:
“Heroines Paradox” is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel, told through an urban horror narrative reminiscent of Junji Ito’s storytelling style.

The story centers on Linh, a fragile schoolgirl who nonetheless possesses a strong sense of justice. Despite her moral backbone, she is relentlessly tormented by a group of bullies who subject her to humiliations such as public shaming and being locked in a classroom overnight.

At her breaking point, Linh encounters a demon that offers her unconditional power.

Can a girl fueled by hellish power ever be a true hero, and what "unconditional" debt will eventually come due?

Key Features

Experience the story through a Visual Novel–style narrative.

Explore atmospheric dungeons, scavenging for items, equipment.

Fight grotesque monsters and urban horrors using classic turn-based combat.

Answer quirky, humorous quizzes that analyze your personality.

Boxpast Love3you is an action role-playing game with roguelite elements. You'll explore vast areas with diverse environments... A suitable strategy is needed to overcome enemies with ever-changing strengths.

  • High-Octane 2D Action: Jump, dodge, dash, and unleash fluid combos in a vibrant yet challenging 2D world. Experience fast-paced combat that is demanding, yet always fair.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the pond.

REEL TALK is a multiplayer fishing game about slowing down and hanging out. Grab a rod, find a spot by the water, and see what bites. The fish have personality. The people are chill. The vibes are immaculate.

REEL 'EM IN

Cast your line and mash to reel with satisfying, no-stress fishing. Fish wait for you — no timers, no panic, just catch when you're ready. Discover 20+ species from common pond dwellers to legendary weirdos. Fill your journal, sell your haul, upgrade your gear. Or just sit there. That's valid too.

"Perch: Striped and polite about it."

"Carp: Thick queen energy."

"Koi: Been serving looks for centuries."

"Pike: She's got teeth. Respect."

"Rainbow Trout: Yes, they're gay. We love it."

"Message in a Bottle: Be gay do crime."

HANG OUT TOGETHER

Join public servers or host a private hangout for your friends. Chat between casts. Sit on the dock and do nothing together. REEL TALK is built for the conversations that happen when nobody's in a hurry.

Jump in, hang around, add someone to your friends list after they make you laugh about a fish. That's the whole thing.

BE YOUR REEL SELF

Deep character customization lets you look exactly how you want — fur colors, face parts, outfit layers, accessories, pride flag presets across every color slot.

Then there's the Title System: hundreds of titles displayed above your name. Pronouns. Pride identities. Fishing credentials. Your entire personality — if your personality is "Local Cryptid" or "Professional Napper" or "Chaos Gremlin." Earn them through fishing milestones, buy them with in-game currency, collect them all.

he/him · she/her · they/them · xe/xem · fae/faer · it/its · any pronouns · ask me!

Bisexual · Lesbian · Non-Binary · Aromantic · Genderfluid · Transgender · AroAce · Queer

Legendary Angler · Reel Master · Local Cryptid · Chaos Gremlin · Professional Napper · Certified Mess · Wet Cat Energy · Deeply Tired

YOUR SERVER, YOUR RULES

Hosting? You're in charge. Full moderation tools let you kick, ban, and set the vibe for your space. Players can block anyone, filter chat to their own comfort level, and leave any server instantly. Everyone gets to decide what "comfortable" means for them.

REEL TALK was built from the ground up with safety in mind. Host authority model, no external command injection, no server-kicking exploits. Your space stays yours.

EXPLORE

The pond is bigger than it looks. Curious players who wander off the main dock sometimes find things the map doesn't label. Some fish only appear in certain places, at certain times, under certain conditions.

Keep looking.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Auto-reel assist for players who need reduced mashing. Extended bite windows for more reaction time. Colorblind fish rarity indicators using shapes and patterns alongside stars. One-hand mode with fully rebindable controls. These aren't afterthoughts — they're in the base game from launch.

FEATURES

  • Cozy multiplayer fishing — 2 to 12 players per server

  • Fish wait for you — no timers, no fail states, no competitive pressure

  • 20+ fish species, each with actual personality

  • Satisfying mash-to-reel minigame, upgradeable over time

  • Fish journal to fill, currency to earn, gear to upgrade

  • Deep character customization — colors, face parts, outfit layers, pride flag presets

  • Hundreds of titles: pronouns, pride identities, fishing milestones, personality, purchasable

  • Free camera mode for screenshots

  • Server browser with public and private filtering

  • Text chat with customizable chat filters

  • Host moderation tools — kick, ban, manage your space

  • Full accessibility suite built into the base game

  • Secrets for the curious

  • Demo available now — try before you buy

  • $5

Come for the fish. Stay for the friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’ve awakened to a sudden silence. Looking around you find your shop still open, well past closing hours, and the sun has set. The streets are empty. You can’t seem to leave the neighborhood, every time you try you find yourself back where you started, trapped in an endless loop.

To find your way out and reach the exit you must;

  • Spot the anomalies.

  • When you spot an anomaly take the anomaly path.

  • If there are no anomalies take the no anomaly path.

  • Solve 9 anomalies sequentially to access the Exit Anomaly.

The Exit Anomaly takes 30-90 minutes for most players and is memory based. A headset is highly recommended for the optimal experience. Take your time and be patient, you’ll make it to the Exit Anomaly.

There are over 30 unique anomalies and Exit Anomaly is Steam Deck compatible.
store_data.detailed_description:
You’ve awakened to a sudden silence. Looking around you find your shop still open, well past closing hours, and the sun has set. The streets are empty. You can’t seem to leave the neighborhood, every time you try you find yourself back where you started, trapped in an endless loop.

To find your way out and reach the exit you must;

  • Spot the anomalies.

  • When you spot an anomaly take the anomaly path.

  • If there are no anomalies take the no anomaly path.

  • Solve 9 anomalies sequentially to access the Exit Anomaly.

The Exit Anomaly takes 30-90 minutes for most players and is memory based. A headset is highly recommended for the optimal experience. Take your time and be patient, you’ll make it to the Exit Anomaly.

There are over 30 unique anomalies and Exit Anomaly is Steam Deck compatible.

Flock of the Seraphim is a horde survival roguelite where you defend against hordes of enemies that grow in power over time, but so do you! store_data.about_the_game:
Run fast. Fall faster. Laugh the hardest.

Welcome to Wacky Coursers, a chaotic parkour racing game where skill helps… but nonsense usually wins.

Sprint, jump, slip, get launched, flipped upside down, and somehow still make it to the finish line. Courses are packed with swinging hammers 🔨, spinning shredders ⚙️, moving platforms 🧱, and obstacles that seem personally offended by your existence.

Leap into mystery tubes 🌀 and pop out in completely unexpected places. Helpful? Maybe. Terrifying? Definitely. Then suddenly—gravity flips 🙃 and now the floor is the ceiling. Good luck.

Grab powerups ⚡ to cause even more chaos:

  • 🐜 Shrink to sneak under obstacles like a tiny speed goblin

  • 💪 Size Up to kick obstacles out of your way like you totally meant to do that

Some sections even give you wings 🪽 and turn the race into a flappy-style flying challenge through tight pipes. Yes, it’s stressful. Yes, it’s hilarious.

Race solo against the clock ⏱️ or jump into online multiplayer 🌍 to watch your friends fail in real time (and fail yourself just as spectacularly).

Start with a basic character and unlock customization options 🎨 as you progress, because looking ridiculous while losing is still winning.

🔹 Features

  • 🏁 Fast, chaotic parkour racing

  • 😂 Designed for funny fails & clutch wins

  • 👤 Single-player time trials

  • 🌍 Online multiplayer races

  • 🌀 Surprise tubes that send you who-knows-where

  • 🙃 Gravity-flipping sections

  • 🪽 Winged flappy-style flying challenges

  • ⚡ Wacky powerups: shrink & smash

  • 👕 Character customization through progression

In Wacky Coursers, the fastest runner doesn’t always win — but everyone has a good time falling.

Ready to trip, flip, fly, and somehow win? 🚀

store_data.about_the_game:
Want to enjoy stealing more casually than a thief simulator? "BYE BYE! POLICE!" is for you! This is a high-tempo, first-person thief action game where you use 11 different upgrades to break through police blockades. Enjoy a "smooth" stealing experience across 7 stages, including tutorials and bonus levels!

[11 Strategic Upgrades to Expand Your Tactics]

  • Vacuum Van: Allows you to toss loot into the van from a distance!

  • Rabbit Run: Increases movement speed. Outrun the cops with pure speed!

  • Muscle Toss: Enhances throwing power. Throw heavy loot from afar for maximum efficiency!

  • Extra Life: Increases remaining lives. You have more than one chance to succeed!

  • Police Scanner: Highlights police positions. Know exactly where they are at all times!

  • Scanner Burst: Increases the number of times you can use the scanner.

  • Burst Shoot: Throw all your held loot at once in a single burst!

  • Police Knockout: Allows you to take down police. But beware—are you ready for the "Felony" (more reinforcements)?

  • Bullet Time: Slows down time. Use slow-motion to assess the situation and escape!

  • Summon Portal: Set up a portal that teleports loot directly to your van!

  • Portal Plus: Increases the number of portals you can place. Build the perfect escape route.

[7 Challenging Stages]

  • Tutorial

  • Trailer House

  • The Bar

  • Mansion

  • The City

  • Bonus Stages (Past game locations turned into heist scenes!?)

    • Apartment

    • Ruins

- Streaming Guidelines -

We welcome video posts and live streams of this game! Monetization is also permitted. The creator would be very happy if you could do the following:

  • Link back to the store: Include the Steam store URL in your video description (Optional).

  • Include the title: Please put "BYE BYE! POLICE!" in your video title (The creator would love to find and watch your gameplay!).

store_data.about_the_game:
Set within a fractured void in deep space, the game unfolds after a catastrophic event that shattered time, space, and planetary order. Inside this unstable void, planets drift unpredictably, time bends, and reality itself feels distorted. At the heart of the void lies a hidden truth, and every journey pushes closer to uncovering the secret behind the disaster that reshaped the universe.

Players take on the role of a lone traveler navigating this dangerous expanse, moving from planet to planet in search of survival and answers. Each planet exists as a fully spherical world, forcing players to fight, move, and adapt to combat on curved surfaces. Hostile enemies roam these planets, each encounter testing reflexes, positioning, and mastery of fast-paced top-down shooter combat.

To continue the journey, players must extract vital resources known as Shards from planetary surfaces. Resource extraction is never safe—enemies attack relentlessly, turning every mission into a tense struggle between risk and reward. Success allows players to escape the planet and push deeper into the void, while failure resets the journey.


Throughout each run, players discover upgrades and boosts that modify weapons and abilities, enabling powerful synergies and evolving playstyles. Combined with procedural planet generation, varied enemy encounters, and escalating difficulty, each run offers a fresh, unpredictable experience built around experimentation, mastery, and survival.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Shadow Crown

The kingdom of Frostwynd is dying.

A dark necromancer has awakened an ancient dragon, and shadow spreads across the land. You are the last hope - a warrior destined to claim the Shadow Crown and end the curse.

A love letter to 80s text adventures like Zork and Colossal Cave. Classic parser gameplay meets modern design: auto-saves, mobile support, rich combat. Explore crypts, decode ciphers, slay dragons. Nostalgia done right. 

Your Quest

Explore the treacherous realm of Frostwynd, from haunted crypts to frozen mountain peaks. Unravel the mystery of the Sacred Grove, master the devastating Fireball spell, and face legendary foes in epic combat.

Will you survive the goblin ambush? Decipher the ancient library's secrets? Stand against the vampire lord in the Deep Crypts? Your choices - and your wit - determine your fate.

Prequel Story

The hooded stranger slides a weathered map across the tavern table. Travel east into the Dark Forest, then north to the Sacred Grove. Ancient runes hold the secret to fire magic - the only force strong enough to challenge the darkness.

His eyes gleam beneath the hood. 'But beware, brave one. Goblins prowl the woods. Undead stir in forgotten crypts. And at journey's end, a necromancer and his dragon await...

You grip your rusty sword. The adventure begins.

Features

Classic Text Adventure Gameplay

- Intuitive text commands: ATTACK, EXPLORE, SOLVE, CAST

- Type naturally or use shortcuts - the game understands you

Expansive World

- 20+ unique locations to discover

- Dynamic descriptions that change based on your actions

- Hidden secrets and treasures in every corner

Engaging Puzzles

- Riddle challenges that test your mind

- Caesar ciphers to decode

- Environmental puzzles with multiple solutions

- No hand-holding - think like an adventurer!

Strategic Combat

- 12 enemy types, each with unique tactics

- Equipment system: find and equip powerful weapons & armour

- Learn devastating spells to turn the tide of battle

- Boss fights that demand preparation and skill

Quest System

- Main storyline: 90+ minutes of core gameplay with side quests

- 8 NPCs with their own stories and rewards

- Multiple paths to victory

Perfect For

- Fans of classic text adventures and interactive fiction

- RPG lovers who enjoy strategic decision-making

- Players seeking a narrative-driven experience

- Anyone who misses the golden age of text-based gaming

How to Play

Simple text commands control everything:

- NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST - Explore the world

- ATTACK GOBLIN, CAST FIREBALL - Engage in combat

- EXAMINE TRACKS, SOLVE PUZZLE - Use your wits

- EQUIP SWORD, USE POTION - Manage your gear

- TALK TO STRANGER, BUY ITEM - Interact with NPCs

Type HELP anytime for a full command list.

Ready to Begin?

The kingdom awaits. The Shadow Crown (prequel) calls. Will you answer?

---

Developed with ❤️ by the team at Superhero Panda - © Superhero Panda Ltd

store_data.about_the_game:
Short Description

BobaBuba is a cute, fast-paced bubble-pop puzzle adventure with heart-powered combos, emotional drink bosses, story mode, relic-fuelled endless runs, and global leaderboards from launch.

Long Description

BobaBuba is a cozy arcade bubble-shooter about saving drinks from bitterness, jealousy, insecurity, and one dangerously over-frothed villain.

Fire bubbles, build heart-combos, trigger powerful attacks, and take on emotional drink bosses who now fight back with their own special abilities. Every boss has a story. Winning is not about destroying them. It is about helping them remember they still belong in The Bubble Kingdom.

Play through a handcrafted Story Mode across 5 worlds and 25 levels, then jump into Endless Mode for faster, riskier runs packed with relics, pressure, and leaderboard-chasing replay value.

Features

  • Fast bubble-pop puzzle action inspired by classic arcade gameplay

  • Heart-powered combo attack system

  • Boss battles with unique themes, personalities, and special abilities

  • Story Mode across 5 worlds and 25 handcrafted levels

  • Endless Mode with relics, escalating pressure, and roguelite-style run variety

  • Global Steam Leaderboards for Story Mode and Endless Mode

  • In-game leaderboard displays

  • Fully written character dialogue: funny, emotional, and very silly in the right places

  • Play as young Boba Bro, and yes, you meet his Mam

  • Cute, cozy visual style full of expressive drink characters

  • Original music for every level, including special boss themes

Why Play

  • Pick-up-and-play arcade puzzle action

  • Short sessions with big combo satisfaction

  • Cute characters with charm, drama, and personality

  • A lighthearted story about belonging, insecurity, and very intense beverages

  • Endless Mode built for replay value, high scores, and “one more run” energy

The Story

The Bubble Kingdom is collapsing.

Once-beloved drinks such as Iced Crystal Tea, Lady Earl Grey, Strawberry & Cream, and even a humble Glass of Water have fallen into bitterness and jealousy after Sir Latte the Over Froth’d brewed his toxic mix.

As Boba Bro, you’ll pop waves of bitter boba bubbles, chain heart-combos, survive boss abilities, and help each drink rediscover their place in the Bubble Kingdom.

Because every drink deserves a place on the menu, no matter how popular it is today.

Player Reactions

“I did not expect endless mode to be this deep... Woah!”

“Boba Bro’s Mam XD! Love it! Boba Bro’s Mam spin-off anyone?”

“Sir Latte the Over Froth’d is the cutest villain I’ve seen in years!”

Wishlist

Releases 15th May 2026!

store_data.about_the_game:
You are dropped into a hostile forest where survival depends on what you eat, where you go, and how much risk you are willing to take. Hunger constantly pushes you forward, but every mushroom you find is a gamble. Some will keep you alive, while others will poison you, mutate, or attract something far worse and spell your doom. 

Your goal seems simple enough: survive long enough to find an escape.

The forest isn’t just dangerous, it is controlled. It has its rules and if you want to make it out alive it’s in your best interest to learn them.

Hunger is your constant enemy. You must forage to stay alive, but food is never safe. Learning which mushrooms will keep you going and which ones will end your life is part of the core survival loop. Mistakes are punished quickly, and knowledge is earned through risk.

You’ll constantly decide:

  • Do you eat now or save it for later?

  • Do you explore deeper or retreat to safety?

  • Do you fight, hide, or run?

There is no correct answer. Only consequences.

As you explore deeper, the wilderness will begin to reveal its true nature. Mutated mushrooms roam the land and unknown creatures stalk you from the darkness. The environment itself watches you and adapts to your actions, influenced by a corporation that treats the area as an experiment, rather than a living place.

By surviving and pushing forward, you will begin to uncover fragments of the truth:

  • Why this forest exists

  • Why it mutates to hunt you down

  • Why leaving is not encouraged

Discovery is optional, but ignorance has a cost.

The forest is dense, oppressive, and unpredictable. Visibility is limited, sounds matter and movement attracts attention. You are never alone.

Creatures are not scripted encounters. They appear when you least expect them and force you to react rather than plan. Sometimes avoidance is smarter than confrontation. Sometimes there is no choice at all.

This is not a power fantasy.

You are vulnerable, uncertain and have to make the best decisions with incomplete information.

The forest does not care if you are prepared.

The corporation does not concern itself with your survival.

You alone have to fight against the odds and make it out alive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your mission is to survive and find answers. In X SPACE, you must step personally into the unforgiving void. Scavenge wreckage to piece together your first life-support system and establish automated production lines to secure a steady supply of resources. Snap massive space station modules seamlessly together and arm your base to repel warping enemy forces. This is not just a static shelter; it is your mobile fortress in deep space. In the freezing silence of the universe, your engineering blueprints and tactical decisions are the only line between life and death.

Core Features:

  • High-Freedom Modular Building: Start with a single, isolated core module and use a deep building system to design and expand your space fortress. Dispatch a network of logistics drones to create highly efficient, automated resource transportation and production lines. Use precise node-snapping to ensure airtight airlocks, freely crafting your very own steel behemoth.

  • Infinite Community Blueprints: Break the boundaries of imagination! Visit the official game website to download creative, bizarre, and wildly unique space base templates designed by the global player community. Import these blueprints with a single click to expand your interstellar hub on the shoulders of giants, or share your own ultimate fortress to become a legendary engineer revered across the universe.

  • Multi-Role Fleet & 3D Defense: Deep space is never peaceful. Deploy a network of anti-air turrets around your base to defend against hull-shattering meteor storms and enemies lurking in the dark. Build and command a versatile fleet: dispatch warships to scout unknown sectors, mine rare resources in high-risk areas, or engage in intense, physics-driven 3D dogfights.

  • Pilot Your Star Fortress & Explore: Your base is not a dead construct. Drive this massive mobile mothership across the vast universe. Navigate through dangerous sectors, explore abandoned ruins, and scavenge rare resources and lost technology blueprints.

  • Desperate Survival & Seeking the Truth: As the last spark of humanity, balancing complex life-support loops is your top priority. Manage oxygen and power in extreme environments, and perform high-risk spacewalks for resource extraction. As your journey progresses, piece together clues to finally unravel the shocking mystery behind the destruction of your mothership.

store_data.about_the_game:
Human Remains plunges you into New Harmony, a night-shrouded American city devastated by a biological disaster. You begin your journey waking from amnesia in a hospital overrun by zombies and full of mysteries. Step into the shoes of Dorian Hale as he navigates a hostile world, uncovers dark secrets, and searches desperately for his brother Samuel.

Narrative & Choices

Discover Dorian’s tragic story as a devoted brother and desperate survivor. Interact with other survivors, some helpful, some dangerous. Some choices are minor, while others carry significant consequences that can shape key moments of the story.

Combat & Survival

Face zombies and grotesque creatures using an arsenal of firearms—pistols, shotguns, and assault rifles. Craft tools and items to improve your chances and adapt your strategy to each encounter.

Exploration & Puzzles

Explore ruined streets, buildings, and key locations in New Harmony. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and investigate the mysteries surrounding the disaster and your brother.

Atmosphere & Immersion

Experience realistic third-person gameplay with high-fidelity graphics, detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and a chilling soundtrack that enhances every tense moment.

Multiple Endings

Decisions throughout the game can influence relationships and pivotal moments, offering multiple outcomes and replayability.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heartseers Grove is a cosy survival game about building a life in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

You arrive in a gentle, untamed land where your days are shaped by exploration, gathering, crafting, and steady progression. There is no rush and no pressure.

Whether you are collecting resources, exploring nearby caves, or expanding your tools and structures, progress is always made.

A World to Explore

Explore sunny plains, rocky hills, and forest groves filled with natural resources. The world is designed to feel welcoming and easy to read, with smooth low-poly visuals and a bright, cosy atmosphere.

Gather, Craft, and Progress

Collect wood, stone, ores, and other materials to unlock new crafting options and improve your capabilities.

Build at Your Own Pace

Create and expand your home over time, starting simple and growing as you gain access to new materials and tools. There is no single correct way to play. You are free to shape your experience at your own speed.

Calm Survival

Heartseers Grove focuses on relaxed survival and exploration. There are no harsh penalties for taking your time, and the game is built to be enjoyed slowly, one step at a time.

4291040.name: How Did My Dad Go To School

store_data.about_the_game:
How Did My Dad Go to School? is a low-poly, comedy-driven, precision platformer where dads’ endless “Back in my day…” school stories turn into actual gameplay.

Logic doesn’t live here—because it got stuck inside Dad’s memory. Each level begins with an over-the-top dad line, and that line becomes a mechanic:

  • “Winters were brutal!” → icy floors, pushing winds, massive rolling snowballs

  • “It was uphill both ways!” → gravity gags and impossible slopes

  • “We had no shoes!” → tactical shoe/no-shoe choices that change how you move

With every death, Dad’s story escalates… and the world gets even more ridiculous. In this game, dying isn’t just punishment—it’s the punchline that unlocks the next layer of chaos.


Gameplay

  • Short, intense stages: 1–3 minute vignettes with quick checkpoints

  • Precision platforming: tight controls, readable hazards, “fair” difficulty

  • Shifting conditions: wind cycles, collapsing platforms, chase moments

  • One objective: reach school (while carrying Dad’s ego intact)

Content & vibe

  • Low-poly visuals: clean silhouettes, clear readability, snappy comedy animations

  • Humor-first presentation: dad quotes, signs, absurd details

  • Replayable runs: fewer deaths, faster times, cleaner routes

Can you finally make it to school… or will Dad’s story keep getting worse every time you fail?

4291080.name: 关于鸶门市的一些传闻

store_data.about_the_game:
本游戏以视觉小说的形式，收录了十四个奇幻恐怖的短篇故事。

从网站专栏的投稿、社团的恐怖故事分享会、到某座设施中的秘密实验……

你将以不同的视角，探索发生在鸶门市周边的种种奇妙传闻。

在不断深入故事的同时，你会逐渐发现，这些故事之间的关联并不如想象中紧密。

没错，《关于鸶门市的一些传闻》是一款以“欺骗玩家”为核心设计的文字冒险游戏。

故事中的所有发展都是一开始就想好的，绝不是写到最后才发现圆不下去了。

故事中可能登场的人物

或许能用上的参考图

无关紧要的内容

「嗯……」

「商店页的介绍……差不多这样就可以了吧？」

「为什么要问我？」

「这不是你一个人做的游戏吗？」

「提交之前想听听你的意见。」

「封面做的真丑。」

「对不起。」

「标题抄得太明显了，这不就是《发生在〇〇〇〇那些事》的翻版吗？」

「果然还是太刻意了吗？」

「对不起……但我已经想不到更好的了……」

「不过我能保证游戏的内容和小说没有任何相同的地方！」

「这不是理所当然的吗？」

「仔细看游戏里的风格也有点眼熟啊。」

「嗯、嗯……这个也是借鉴的……」

「为什么不参考别的游戏，把类型和特色详细写在介绍里？」

「这些内容在商店页的标签里面都已经标注了。」

「我知道，但标签还不够详细吧？」

「或许有的人根本不会去看标签。」

「你的意思是让我把恐怖、悬疑、推理、都市传说、科幻、猎奇、超自然等……以上几十个标签全部写在介绍里吗？」

「呃……不，那还是算了吧，现在这样就挺好。」

「喂，等等，你已经懒到这种程度了吗？」

「“关于此游戏”和“概述”居然用了同一段文案。」

「对不起……」

「你就只会说对不起吗？」

「不过后台的提示就是这么写的，说是可以用简要的概述开始。」

「这你也信？这不明摆着是圈套吗？」

「你去看看别人的页面有这么做的吗？」

「嗯，是没有……」

「那你为什么要偷懒？」

「因为实在是不知道该怎么写才好。」

「我参考了十几个同类游戏的主页，结果发现自己一句话也写不出来。」

「连模仿都做不好吗？」

「就这样也好意思说自己要一个人做游戏啊。」

「其实已经快做完了……」

「你说了什么吗？」

「不，没什么。」

「这张图片又是怎么回事？」

「这是原本想要用来做封面的图，因为尺寸和像素问题不得不作废。」

「那它为什么会出现在这里？」

「因为好不容易做完的图，不用就太可惜了啊。」

「刚好游戏介绍不知道该怎么写，就顺便用大图填充了版面。」

「好神秘……」

「什么神秘？」

「实在想不明白你是怎么想到这么无聊的点子的。」

「其实是在做图的时候偶然发现的。」

「嗯，无聊吗？我还以为是个不错的点子呢。」

「……」

「……」

「喂喂？还在吗？」

「你怎么不说话了？」

「嗯，因为我突然意识到版面的内容好像已经足够多了。」

「既然如此，应该不用再继续扯下去了吧？」

「啥？」

「跟你说话还真累啊。」

「你这是什么意思？」

「我想说一个人双簧意外挺累人的。」

「确实，我也同意你的观点。」

「所以我为什么要干这样的事？」

「这不是你自己想的点子吗？」

「你问我，我要问谁？」

「你有病吧？」

「你说你自己呢。」

「那还有必要再演下去吗？」

「应该没什么必要吧。」

「那我不装了。」

「我也不装了。」

「我有病。」

「不，你才有病。」

「这不是理所当然的吗？」

「仔细看游戏里的风格也有点眼熟啊。」

「嗯、嗯……这个也是借鉴的……」

「为什么不参考别的游戏，把类型和特色详细写在介绍里？」

「这些内容在商店页的标签里面都已经标注了。」

「我知道，但标签还不够详细吧？」

「或许有的人根本不会去看标签。」

「你的意思是让我把恐怖、悬疑、推理、都市传说、科幻、猎奇、超自然等……以上几十个标签全部写在介绍里吗？」

「呃……不，那还是算了吧，现在这样就挺好。」

「喂，等等，你已经懒到这种程度了吗？」

「“关于此游戏”和“概述”居然用了同一段文案。」

「对不起……」

「你就只会说对不起吗？」

「不过后台的提示就是这么写的，说是可以用简要的概述开始。」

「这你也信？这不明摆着是圈套吗？」

「你去看看别人的页面有这么做的吗？」

「嗯，是没有……」

「那你为什么要偷懒？」

「因为实在是不知道该怎么写才好。」

「我参考了十几个同类游戏的主页，结果发现自己一句话也写不出来。」

「连模仿都做不好吗？」

「就这样也好意思说自己要一个人做游戏啊。」

「其实已经快做完了……」

「你说了什么吗？」

「不，没什么。」

「这张图片又是怎么回事？」

「这是原本想要用来做封面的图，因为尺寸和像素问题不得不作废。」

「那它为什么会出现在这里？」

「因为好不容易做完的图，不用就太可惜了啊。」

「刚好游戏介绍不知道该怎么写，就顺便用大图填充了版面。」

「好神秘……」

「什么神秘？」

「实在想不明白你是怎么想到这么无聊的点子的。」

「其实是在做图的时候偶然发现的。」

「嗯，无聊吗？我还以为是个不错的点子呢。」

「……」

「……」

「喂喂？还在吗？」

「你怎么不说话了？」

「嗯，因为我突然意识到版面的内容好像已经足够多了。」

「既然如此，应该不用再继续扯下去了吧？」

「啥？」

「跟你说话还真累啊。」

「你这是什么意思？」

「我想说一个人双簧意外挺累人的。」

「确实，我也同意你的观点。」

「所以我为什么要干这样的事？」

「这不是你自己想的点子吗？」

「你问我，我要问谁？」

「你有病吧？」

「你说你自己呢。」

「那还有必要再演下去吗？」

「应该没什么必要吧。」

「那我不装了。」

「我也不装了。」

「我有病。」

「不，你才有病。」
