store_data.about_the_game:
The story begins with a dusty, mud-covered "Gongwan"...

As an Endemic Species Researcher, you encounter a unique creature known as "Gongwan." Together, you will embark on a heartwarming journey to restore a sanctuary, cultivate a thriving farm, and forge bonds with various endemic companions.

Game Features | Befriending Endemic Species

Unlike traditional monster-battling or monster-catching games, Endemism focuses on understanding, mutual support, and companionship. In this world, earning the trust of these unique creatures requires time, patience, and genuine care.

Your Exclusive Companion: Gongwan

"Gongwan" is your most loyal friend and your greatest pillar of support. Ride atop Gongwan to traverse obstacles together and explore the farthest reaches of this mysterious land.

Interactive Companion System

Every endemic species possesses a unique personality and set of habits. By nurturing these friendships, they will become your most capable assistants:

  • Adventuring Together: They join your team to explore the world while providing various beneficial buffs.

  • Farm Assistance: They lend a helping hand (or paw!) to manage daily chores on the farm when you’re busy.

A Multi-Talented Researcher

The daily life of a researcher is a "slashie" life full of challenges! From clearing land and gathering resources to tilling the soil—nothing is too difficult when it comes to restoring the sanctuary.

Beyond farm management, you must venture deep into the mines to unearth mysterious minerals. Discover unknown endemic species along the way and gradually uncover the deep-rooted secrets of this land.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pilot the ultimate defense weapon, the Skyrelic.

Thousands of meters above sea level. Only the roar of your machine gun cuts through the silence. This tactical rogue-lite shooter takes you on the role of the operator of the world's most powerful ground defense weapon, the Skyrelic, and literally "eliminates" heat sources from the ground.

The thrill of overwhelming firepower

Use three different weapons in real time to smash through soldiers.

25mm Gatling Gun: Plow the ground with a barrage of bullets and instantly suppress hordes of infantry.

40mm Autocannon: Precise and devastating sniping.

105mm Howitzer: The ultimate "delete button." Transform everything into a wasteland with a single hit.

Thermal Imaging: Dominate Your Vision

Equipped with a heat source detection system. Instantly switch between Normal and Thermal modes. Coolly acquire your target and pull the trigger. That split-second decision can determine the success or failure of your mission.

A fast-paced, intense "defense operation" experience.

Speed-up, 5-10-minute playthroughs: Experience devastating destruction in the gaps of your break.

Tactical suspense: A constantly rotating camera, a shaky reticle, and a faithful reproduction of the operator's perspective.

Infinite replays: Upgrades and enemy waves change every time. Falling once means starting over, but your experience is sure to grow.

store_data.about_the_game:
About Nuclearphobia:

In Area 71, a reactor failure doesn’t end with the explosion — it begins with it. The city locks into a nuclear winter, time crackles like glass, and creatures roam the surface that look like aliens… until you realize the strangest “invasions” don’t come from space, but from the future.

Nuclearphobia is a 2D action-adventure platformer where the pace of gunfights meets tight, timing-based platforming and the satisfaction of solving puzzles. You’ll cross ruined districts, underground laboratories, and places where reality splits into parallel timelines and dimensions. It’s a game about survival — but even more about understanding the rules that keep this zone running at all.

You’re not a lone hero here. You operate as a team: human + machine + cat. Switch between them, combine their abilities, and use them in combat and exploration alike. Discover and upgrade five experimental flying robots — each with its own specialization, working rhythm, and field use. And alongside them is a quantum cat: a peculiar ally that can turn “impossible” into “not calculated yet.”

What to expect from gameplay:

- Tight, timing-based platforming: traps, precision jumps, reflex-driven sequences, movement control, and reading the space.

- Sci‑fi combat: fights against energy and tech-based enemies, plus threats born from anomalies.

- Item- and interaction-driven puzzles: collect items and use them to unlock paths, solve environmental challenges, and build tactical advantages.

- Tactically designed bosses: each has at least 3 forms and demands the right sequence of actions — not “more DPS,” but the correct plan (e.g., blind it with the right robot, land a precise shot on a weak point, then close the phase with a specific weapon).

- Two game modes:

- Story Mode — a narrative campaign through Area 71, its secrets, and time loops.

- Training Mode — practice and refine skills without story pressure.

- Economy & exploration: collect coins, shop, complete your loadout, and prepare for what’s next.

- Geiger counter: a system that warns you about dangerously irradiated zones — risk can be rewarded, but never by accident.

- In-world minigames: including arcade-like spots in the city — short activities that break the pace, grant rewards, and build atmosphere.

- Ability progression: expand what the player and robots can do, unlocking new ways to fight, solve puzzles, and overcome obstacles.

Nuclearphobia is built so that every new ability is more than a “key for a door” — it changes how you read the environment, fight, and make decisions. Because in a zone where time has looped, the most valuable currency isn’t coins. It’s information — and every decision you make.

store_data.about_the_game:
VeinLight is a tense, atmospheric survival roguelite where you are alone against the crushing weight of a daily quota and the encroaching darkness.

🗣️ SCREAM TO SURVIVE

Forget staying silent. In VeinLight, your voice is your lifeline. The darkness in the mines is toxic—staying in the shadows drains your health. If your torch runs out, you have one last defense: Speak, sing, or scream into your microphone. Your voice pushes back the damage of the darkness. Keep talking to stay alive until you find the light!

⛏️ THE DAILY GRIND

You have one job: Fill the quota.

  • Mine & Collect: Gather coal, rare ores, and mushrooms.

  • Manage Time: The clock is ticking. You must fill the plate before nightfall.

  • Upgrade: Sell your loot to the merchant. Buy better pickaxes, lanterns, and potions to dig deeper.

👹 PUNISHMENT AWAITS

Failure is not an option. If you miss your daily quota, the Cave Troll awakens. This massive beast patrols the mines in the evening, hunting down those who didn't work hard enough. It cannot be killed—only escaped.

💀 ROGUELITE MECHANICS

  • Permadeath: If you fall, you lose your inventory and upgrades. You only keep the experience of the days you survived.

  • Risk vs. Reward: Will you dig for one more ore and risk the Troll's arrival, or bank your earnings and play it safe?

  • Luck Graveyard: Test your fate. Double your earnings or lose half of them in a gamble with death.

KEY FEATURES

  • Microphone Interaction: A unique mechanic where talking protects you from darkness damage.

  • Pixel-Art Atmosphere: A gritty, retro aesthetic with dynamic lighting and skybox.

  • Dynamic Threats: From environmental hazards to the unstoppable Cave Troll.

  • Exploration: Discover new regions, shortcuts, and secrets hidden in the mines.

👨‍💻 Developer's Note: VeinLight is being developed by a single person (SoloMaestro). I am constantly updating the game based on player feedback. Your reviews and ideas help shape the future of the mines!

store_data.about_the_game:
**An Exit 8–style game.**

The setting is a mansion.

It is said that ghosts appear in this mansion,

and you must not be caught by them.

While escaping from the ghost, look for anomalies and aim to clear the game.

—

**About the Game**

1. There are Normal Mode and Hard Mode. In Hard Mode, the ghost moves faster.

2. If there is an anomaly, go up the stairs; if there is none, go down the stairs.

Left-click near the stairs to bring up the choices.

Use the up/down keys and left-click to select.

3. If you get tired, press the P key to enter Pause Mode.

While the stair selection screen is displayed, the ghost will stop.

4. To change the mode, please restart the game and begin from the start.

※Note※

The background music has no relation to anomalies.
It changes randomly each time.

—

**Controls**

* Movement

Arrow keys or WASD

* Camera

Mouse drag (up, down, left, right)

* Pause

P key

It is said that ghosts appear in this mansion,

store_data.about_the_game:
The Shroud Descends

A mysterious black fog has fallen over the city of Dreadthorn, plunging it into endless night. Society has decided to call this phenomenon The Shroud, and it is corrupting some people, changing them in sinister ways.

Decide Your Clients’ Fate

A horror therapist-sim, where you play as a therapist new to the city. Talk to your clients, hear their stories, and help them out. But remember, some have become corrupted. Get rid of them before it’s too late… or take your chances?

Customize Your Office Apartment

Buy new furniture, walls, floors and special items to take your office space to the next level and attract VIP clients.

Keep the Lights On

Remember to pay your light bill to keep the lights on. Bad things happen when the lights go out.

Features:

  • Decide Who to Save: Not all clients can be saved. Your choices have consequences, not just for individual clients, but for the larger narrative.

  • Spend Wisely: Spend the money you earn on your light bill, customizing your office, and buying or upgrading equipment. 

  • Request Financial Assistance: Low on cash? Call your mysterious landlord for a loan… but strings will be attached.

  • Build Your Reputation: Clients react to your actions and will rate you and write reviews based on their experience.

  • Survive: The Shroud is corrupting some of your clients, turning them into a threat to you and others. Stop them before it’s too late.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sci-Fi and Fantasy Collide in a Living Open World

Downfall MMORPG is a cross-genre open-world MMORPG where advanced technology clashes with ancient magic in a persistent, player-driven war.

Choose your allegiance. Shape your playstyle. Decide the fate of an entire planet.

Two Factions. One World. Endless Conflict.

Kaelthera is home to the Lumen, a nature-bound civilization capable of wielding powerful magic drawn from the planet itself. Their world is under siege by the Coalition, a technologically superior spacefaring force stranded after a catastrophic crash and now determined to claim Kaelthera’s resources at any cost.

Your choice of faction defines your journey:

  • Embrace fantasy combat, ancient powers, and primal weapons

  • Or step into a sci-fi RPG experience with firearms, mechs, and advanced armor

Play Your Way

Downfall is designed to adapt to your preferred MMORPG playstyle:

  • Engage in large-scale PvP battles where entire servers fight for faction dominance

  • Focus on PvE progression, hunting wildlife, elite enemies, and world bosses

  • Explore a fully open world solo, with friends, or as part of a guild

  • Mix and match gear, skills, and classes to create your own unique build

Every choice matters. Every battle leaves a mark.

Deep Customization & Progression

  • 18 playable classes, each with unique abilities

  • All classes can equip all weapons and armor

  • Skillsets dynamically change based on equipped items

  • Hundreds of items ranging from medieval weapons to futuristic firearms

  • Upgrade and enhance your gear to push your power to its limits

A True Open World MMORPG

  • Fully open world with 7 distinct regions

  • Seamless exploration without artificial barriers

  • Dynamic environments and procedurally generated instances for infinite PvE replayability

  • Dedicated PvP zone featuring massive faction-wide conflicts and rewards

Cooperative & Social Gameplay

  • Form parties, alliances, and guilds

  • Take on epic bosses and high-risk content together

  • Own pets that assist you in combat

  • Collect mounts to traverse Kaelthera faster

Key Features

  • Open-world Sci-Fi & Fantasy MMORPG

  • PvP and PvE gameplay at massive scale

  • Two factions with distinct themes and playstyles

  • Procedurally generated content for endless replayability

  • Legendary loot, heroic quests, and world-changing battles

The war for Kaelthera has begun.

Choose your side. Forge your build.

Welcome to Downfall MMORPG.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌾 Your Dream Farm in the Mountains

Inherit a quiet farm hidden deep in a peaceful mountain valley and begin a slower, more mindful life. Surrounded by gentle peaks, wooden houses, and open fields, you can settle into a calm daily routine focused on farming, exploration, and steady progress.

🐔 Everyday Farm Life and Animals

Your farm is home to several animals, including cows, sheep, chickens, horses, and a loyal dog. Animals need food and water to grow and stay productive. Adult cows, sheep, and chickens provide valuable products, while horses can be raised and sold for profit once they mature.
The dog is a decorative companion, but earning its trust requires patience and regular feeding.

🥕 Growing and Harvesting Crops

Plant a variety of vegetables using seeds from the local shop. Each crop requires watering and goes through its own growth stages before it is ready to harvest. Vegetables have different values, and harvest results are not fixed. Each collection randomly rewards items based on defined chances, making every harvest slightly different.

🎣 Fishing and Skill-Based Mini Game

Fishing offers a relaxing but engaging activity. Use different types of fishing rods, where better rods allow you to catch rarer and more valuable fish. There are dozens of fish species with varying difficulty levels.
Each catch involves a short mini game where you must keep the fish within a safe zone until the progress bar fills.

⛏ Resources and Upgrades

Gather resources like wood and stone using tools such as an axe or pickaxe. These materials are essential for upgrading your house, tools, and farmland. Higher upgrade levels unlock new features and improve efficiency. Upgrades require not only money, but also the right character level and materials, all clearly explained in the upgrade shop.

🏡 House Progression and Cooking

You start with a small house that can be expanded step by step. As your home improves, new rooms and systems become available. Once your house reaches the required level, you can begin cooking meals using gathered products. Cooked meals can be sold for higher prices and restore more stamina than raw food.

⚡ Stamina and Daily Rhythm

Every action uses stamina. When it runs out, you can no longer farm, water crops, care for animals, fish, gather resources, or harvest vegetables.
Stamina can be restored by eating vegetables or by sleeping and starting a new day.

🌦 Living World and Weather System

The world features a dynamic weather system that changes daily. Rain waters your crops automatically, while fog reduces visibility. You can always check the forecast on the TV inside your home.

📜 Quests and Long-Term Goals

The game features both unique and repeatable quests. Completing them increases your level, grants useful items, and sometimes unlocks new mechanics such as fishing. Quests provide direction without pressure and encourage long-term planning.



👨‍🌾 Working for a Local Farmer

In the town, you can take on jobs for a local farmer from your very first day. Tasks are available during specific hours, making it easy to fit them into your daily routine.
No tools are required – everything you need is provided on-site.
In return, you’ll earn good money and experience points, making it a great way to grow in the early stages of the game.



✨ A Calm Low-Poly Fantasy World

Explore a cozy low-poly world filled with soft colors and a relaxing atmosphere. Wooden houses, glass greenhouses, open farmland, and mountain landscapes are designed to help you slow down and enjoy a peaceful experience.

No timers.
No pressure.
Just you, your farm, and a quiet moment in the mountains.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Capsule is a co-op focused survival, exploration, and building game set in the depths of space. Players begin their journey aboard a small capsule station, where they construct a modular spaceship, land on planets, gather resources, and struggle to survive in a hostile universe.

Story

Our home world was destroyed.
The last survivors were forced to flee into space inside a capsule.
Who did it? Why?
In Capsule, players fight to survive while searching for the truth behind the destruction of their world.

Modular Spaceship

The spaceship you use throughout the game is not a static environment.
Floors, walls, roofs, elevators, and systems are built, expanded, and dismantled by players in real time. The ship is a living structure, shaped entirely by player decisions.

Planetary Exploration

Capsule does not take place only in space. Players can:

  • Land on different planets

  • Gather resources on planetary surfaces

  • Face planet-specific dangers and enemies

  • Transport collected resources back to the ship to upgrade its systems

Each planet presents unique risks and opportunities.

EVA – Free Movement in Space

Players can exit the ship using EVA (spacewalks).
While tethered to the ship, they can:

  • Repair the exterior of the ship

  • Attach new modules

  • Reach drifting resources in open space

Gravity, orientation, and movement are fully determined by the ship’s physical state.

Co-op Experience

Capsule is designed for 1–4 player co-op gameplay.
All building, movement, and interactions are fully synchronized. Every player sees the same ship, the same changes, and the same planets in real time.

While one player pilots the ship, another may build, a third can perform EVA tasks, and others can gather resources on planetary surfaces.

Atmosphere

Capsule delivers a stylized yet serious sci-fi atmosphere. Space is silent, dangerous, and unforgiving. Rather than focusing on horror, the game emphasizes loneliness, discovery, and surviving together.

Key Features

🚀 Modular spaceship construction
🌍 Planetary landings and exploration
⛏️ Resource gathering and progression
👨‍🚀 EVA (spacewalk) mechanics
🤝 Fully synchronized co-op gameplay
🧱 Real-time build and dismantle system
🌌 Stylized sci-fi atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
Tiny Jar Farm is a relaxing idle farming experience built around growth, merging, and gentle long-term progression. Plant seeds, watch them grow over time, merge crops to increase their power, and turn your harvest into valuable goods inside a cozy kitchen system.Designed to be calming yet satisfying, Tiny Jar Farm blends idle gameplay, merge mechanics, and production economy into a smooth, low-pressure loop that rewards both short sessions and long breaks.

Grow & Merge: Plant seeds on a small seasonal grid and let them grow automatically. Merge identical crops to level them up, increasing their production and unlocking higher-value harvests. The higher the level, the faster and more rewarding your farm becomes.

Harvest & Cook: Collect fruits and vegetables and store them in your inventory. Use your harvests in the kitchen to cook recipes like bread, paste, and pizza, transforming simple crops into premium rewards. Upgrade your crafting queue or rush production when you’re in a hurry.

Seasonal Worlds: Unlock new seasons, each with its own themed crops, visuals, effects, and recipes. Expand your farm across cozy biomes like spring meadows and autumn groves, with more content waiting as you progress.

Idle Progression: Your farm keeps working even when you’re away. Return later to collect offline earnings, then prestige to reset and grow stronger with permanent bonuses, exclusive crops, and long-term upgrades.

Cozy by Design; Tiny Jar Farm focuses on comfort:

  • Soft pastel visuals and cottagecore vibes

  • Gentle animations and satisfying merge effects

  • Calm ambient audio and seasonal soundscapes

  • Simple systems with meaningful depth

Whether you check in for a minute or settle in for longer sessions, Tiny Jar Farm is made to feel peaceful, rewarding, and endlessly cozy.

While helping her boyfriend, a photographer, she begins to meet all kinds of people and step into worlds she has never known before, experiencing a wide range of events and encounters.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a strategy‑based guessing game centered on historical figures.

The system randomly selects a historical figure from the database as the answer. Each figure has a set of hidden “attributes,” covering key information such as active century, cultural region, role type, activity pattern, philosophical school, and more.

Players must continuously enter historical figures they believe might be the answer, gradually narrowing down the possibilities.

Core Gameplay

With every guess, the system compares your chosen figure with the correct answer.

The comparison results are shown through color‑coded hints:

🟩 Green: The two figures share an identical attribute

🟨 Yellow: The attribute is similar or related

⬜ No color: The attribute is completely unrelated

Players must analyze the historical connections between figures based on these hints and adjust their guesses accordingly.

Identify the figure selected by the system to win the game.

This challenges not only your knowledge of history, but also your ability to associate, compare, and reason across different contexts.

Multiplayer Modes

The game supports several two‑player modes:

Co‑op Mode

The system generates a random target. Players take turns guessing and work together to solve the puzzle.

Speed Mode

Both players start guessing simultaneously. Whoever identifies the target in fewer turns — and faster — wins.

Versus Mode

You set a target for your opponent, and they set one for you. Both guess at the same time, and the player who solves their puzzle in fewer attempts wins.

RogueFlip is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a logic puzzle game that is a hybrid of Picross and Minesweeper.    DataFall is a cyberpunk idle clicker built around automation, scaling systems, and controlled overload. Your units operate continuously, generating resources and filling the screen with motion and numbers. Progress continues whether you actively manage the system or let it run.At its core, DataFall is about building efficient systems and pushing them past their limits.

     Automated units generate income over time, while upgrades fundamentally reshape how your system behaves. As progression accelerates, visual density and pacing intensify. But automation has limits — boss encounters and ascension-style resets break the idle loop, forcing direct decisions and strategic adaptation. These moments define long-term progression.

Achievements & Progression

   A deep achievement system rewards optimization, milestones, and long-term commitment. Each unlock reflects permanent advancement, reinforcing progress across runs and encouraging experimentation. Even as systems reset, growth persists — turning every run into a step forward rather than a restart.

Advanced Systems & Late-Game Control

   As progression deepens, new layers of control unlock through systems like the Paragon Lab, Relic Shop, and Black Market. These mechanics redefine how your build evolves — offering powerful modifiers, rare upgrades, and strategic trade-offs that shape each run differently. Optimization becomes more than scaling numbers; it’s about choosing the right paths, adapting to new synergies, and pushing your setup into increasingly specialized directions.

Key Features

  • Automation That Never Stops — Units generate income and damage continuously, with or without input

  • Scaling Into Chaos — Speed, density, and numbers escalate until the system hits its limits

Levels await you, leading ever deeper into the forest. There are no randomly generated floors—instead, the game emphasizes tense progression, deliberate encounters, and constant environmental pressure. The forest has a life of its own and refuses to let the traveler go voluntarily.

Endless Weapon Customization

The main feature of Stumblepath is its deep and potentially endless weapon customization system. You don't find the "best" weapon—you create it yourself. Upgrade, combine, and experiment with mods, effects, and curses, turning ordinary weapons into something truly unique.

There is no armor in the game—survival is built around weapons and tactics. You can equip weapons in both your left and right hands, combining different fighting styles: aggressive, defensive, and control.

Turn-Based Combat and Risk at Every Turn

Battles are turn-based, where every move counts. Misuse of a weapon or a poor mod combination can cost you a run. But risk and experimentation are the keys to progress.

Each new run is another attempt to delve deeper, assemble a crazier weapon build, and see how far you can go along Stumblepath.

Battles are turn-based, where every move counts. Misuse of a weapon or a poor mod combination can cost you a run. But risk and experimentation are the keys to progress.

Each new run is another attempt to delve deeper, assemble a crazier weapon build, and see how far you can go along Stumblepath.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a disgruntled paranormal investigator and journey to a town that feels lost to time. Uncover a criminal conspiracy, solve a murder, all while exploring an open world and a massive sprawling castle shrouded in darkness. Featuring characters and themes inspired by Lovecraftian horror.

Haunting of Mageburrow is an RPG that combines that feeling of retro cozy gameplay, with horror and the surreal. Set in the small English town of Mageburrow, you will play as a Paranormal Investigator (male or female, your choice) who has been struggling with their job. Never enough proof to actually prove anything, but at least you are putting your clients minds at ease. All is somewhat well, until you begin having mysterious dreams. Followed by a phone call from a Professor, with a new job for you. Investigating the sprawling Mageburrow Castle.

What follows next is a series of mysterious events. A car accident. A murder. A shady real estate deal. Everything is connected. But to what? The occult. What is real, and what is pure fiction? You'll dive head first into the cult, a gothic castle, and a cozy English town to explore. Slowly you'll start to unravel the conspiracy as you meet the citizens of Mageburrow. From this crazy cast of characters, everyone has a secret to hide. Oh and there's monsters to battle. Don't forget the monsters.

The town of Mageburrow can be explored as you wish. You'll meet the townsfolk, purchase gear, and even find keys that unlock doors in the castle. Each building has many rooms to explore. You'll also get a room for yourself to call your own at the Inn. The town will change depending on if it's day or night.

Mageburrow Castle is a sprawling estate to explore, with many rooms and creepy haunts to discover. Locked doors, puzzles, and cultists will be around every corner. Flickering lighting effects add to the mood and mystery of what actually lurks in each room. And soon you'll discover that monsters lurk behind those walls...

You'll find yourself changing from a Paranormal Investigator, to someone who battles actual monsters of the occult. What is real and what is not? You'll need to find out. Your life and sanity depends on it.

You'll also find yourself gaining special abilities as you advance further in the story. Invocation (INV) will be a special skill that can aid you in battle. What will you learn? How powerful will you become?

  • Male or female character option

  • Retro graphics, top-down

  • Open world to explore, in and outside the castle

  • Modern lighting effects to provide dimly lit rooms and eerie streets at night

  • Turn-based battles

  • High replayability

  • Steam Deck and Handheld Gaming PC Support

  • Windows + Linux via Wine/Proton

store_data.about_the_game:
False Testimony is a story driven fantasy detective game focused on interrogation, logic, and deduction.

I am a detective. My job is to deal with situations that are convenient to blame on coincidence. Where there is no obvious crime, no confession, and no single place where "everything happened".

I visit different locations, talk to people, study the environment, and collect clues. Every conversation gives new information, every place adds details that need to be connected. No one lies outright, but everyone speaks from their own perspective, and I have to separate facts from interpretations.

There are no loud revelations or dramatic scenes in this work. The truth emerges gradually - from access, timing, sequences of actions, and small inconsistencies. To reach the right conclusion, I need to understand the full picture: who did it, how it was done, and what the motive was.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Dismissed Case: Black Hollow is a narrative-driven detective thriller set in 1993.

An old case, once closed due to lack of evidence, is reopened. Authorities have moved on, but the truth remains buried. As a dismissed detective, you take on the case no one else is willing to solve.

In the town of Ridgemour, you examine crime scenes, collect evidence, analyze reports, and question the locals. Every detail matters, and each deduction you make can change the direction of the investigation.

Throughout the game, you piece together clues, draw your own conclusions, and shape how the case unfolds. Wrong assumptions can lead you astray, while careful analysis brings the truth closer. The story adapts to the decisions you make.

Ridgemour is quiet. People avoid speaking. Some hide the past, others want it forgotten, but the town’s history refuses to stay buried.

This is not just an investigation; it is a detective experience where tension rises with every step toward the truth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Short Introduction

After a devastating alien invasion, the last survivors of humanity struggle to stay alive.

While attempting to rebuild civilization, they face overwhelming alien forces that now dominate the Earth.

But with the newly developed Orb Technology, humanity has one final chance to reclaim the planet.

World Information & Key Features

(Scroll down for gameplay details)

(⚠️ The game is currently in development.)

The game takes place on a post-apocalyptic Earth ruled by an alien invasion force.
The aliens are controlled by a central artificial intelligence, a supreme commander of sorts.

This AI is not just an enemy, but an independent faction:
Before sending troops against players, it must generate its own resources inside a simulation and make strategic decisions.
(More details in the Gameplay section.)

A Dynamic, Living World

Players are free to choose where on the world map their main base will be established.
Each continent presents unique challenges and features distinct alien enemies, adapted to the local environment, flora, and fauna.

The game places strong emphasis on a constantly evolving world, including:

  • new alien types

  • unexplored biomes

  • strange structures

  • changing ecosystems

As development continues, the world will expand and evolve alongside the community.

Upgradeable Buildings

Is your artillery firing too slowly? Does the minigun turret consume too much ammunition? No problem.

All buildings (including production facilities) can be customized through upgradeable modules. Players can fine-tune performance, efficiency, and stability to adapt their defenses to the current situation.

But be careful: pushing a module too far may cause it to overheat, become damaged, or fail entirely! Potentially leading to serious consequences.

Players who prefer a more hands-off approach can leave optimization to the built-in assistant. This automated system keeps all buildings running safely and efficiently, though not always at maximum performance.

Teamwork Is Essential

The most important key to survival is teamwork.
The AI is designed to focus on all players collectively, coordinating attacks to eliminate them.

Solo play is possible, but only through cooperation does humanity stand a real chance of reclaiming Earth.

Important Information

⚠️ The game is currently in development.
The AI is still learning how to play effectively. The longer the servers remain active, the smarter, more efficient, and more dangerous it becomes.

This means: The challenge grows together with the community.

The Ultimate Goal

The goal of the game, and of the entire community, is to fully reclaim Earth.

What happens if that succeeds?
… honestly, that’s not decided yet.
But if the community manages to retake the planet, everyone gets cookies.

Gameplay

The game offers multiple task roles that players can choose from.
These roles unlock gradually and support different playstyles.

Reclaiming Earth (Main Role)

The core focus of the game is the reclamation of Earth.
Players can take on this challenge alone or together with others.

At the beginning, players must construct a main base while already being attacked by small enemy groups.
Once the base is successfully built and defended, expansion becomes possible:

  • The game world grows significantly

  • Multiple outposts can be constructed

  • Each completed outpost expands the world further in its direction

As the world expands, so do:

  • lobby sizes

  • player counts

  • enemy strength and variety

The further humanity pushes forward, the more dangerous the alien resistance becomes.

Additional task roles unlock over time.

⚠️ VERY IMPORTANT INFORMATION ⚠️

The game is currently in active development.
Final features cannot be guaranteed, and all listed mechanics may change or be adjusted during development.

The following task roles are currently planned:

Task Role: Immediate Support

Players whose outposts or main bases are under heavy attack or close to total destruction can send an SOS signal.

Players assigned to Immediate Support will be deployed directly onto the map, landing with heavy weaponry to assist in defense.
Once the base is secured, support players withdraw and move on to help others in need.

Task Role: Farmland

Survivors need food to stay alive.
In this role, players build farms within secured zones.

These secured zones are provided by other players’ outposts, encouraging cooperation and interdependence across the community.

store_data.about_the_game:
A FATHER'S GREATEST TEST

Can an ordinary farewell turn into a father's worst nightmare? When you put your daughter on the plane, you couldn't have imagined it would be not an end, but a dark beginning. Your world crumbles when the "Plane Crash" news appears on the television screen, only to learn that the crash occurred on a mysterious island, hard to find even on maps.

You are determined to go alone to that island, which official rescue teams dare not go to, and about which chilling legends are told, in order to get your daughter back. All you have is a flashlight, a camera, and unwavering hope.

Can you pull your daughter out of that darkness? Or will the island swallow you too?

Gameplay & Core Features:

  • Limited Light & Battery Management: Your flashlight is your only ally in the dark corridors. But be careful; your battery can run out at any moment. You must scavenge for batteries to survive the shadows.

  • Survival Struggle: You are not alone on the island. Stay alert against lethal creatures. Find medical supplies to heal your wounds and manage your health to stay alive.

  • Eight Magic Keys: To uncover the secrets behind the locked doors, you must locate 8 mystical keys hidden across the island.

  • Power & Generator System: When you encounter obstacles blocking your path, you'll need to restore power by finding the necessary fuel and activating mechanisms within the environment.

  • Camera & Zoom System: Utilize your camera to scrutinize environmental clues or spot hidden details in the shadows. With zoom-in and zoom-out functionality, you won't miss even the smallest piece of evidence.

  • Atmospheric Horror & Surprises: Experience the chilling atmosphere of Büyükada with unpredictable jump scares and special animations designed to keep you on the edge of your seat.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sura is a Soul-like Roguelike action game infused with the folklore and dark imagination of medieval Japan. You awaken as a samurai cursed with immortality, embarking on a harrowing journey from the banks of the Sanzu River. Master the art of the perfect parry, execute ruthless finishers, and dominate the skies with aerial combat. Explore the ever-changing realm of Sura, slash through hordes of enemies, and carve your path through the afterlife.

The Weight of a Soul-like × The Variance of a Roguelike

The unforgiving tension of the Soul-like genre—where a single mistake spells death—meets the limitless replayability of a Roguelike. Every death reshapes the realm of Sura. The enemies that lie in wait and the rewards you seek will change with every attempt. Learn from the cycle of death, adapt to enemy patterns, and forge powerful synergies to push forward.

The Split-Second Duel: The Art of the Parry

Defense is the ultimate offense. Deflect the relentless assault of your foes with perfect timing. Break their posture, and the tide of battle turns in an instant.

  • See-Through & Counter: Read the enemy's killing intent, deflect their strike, and deliver a fatal counterattack.

  • Issen (Flash Strike): Experience the thrill of wiping out vulnerable enemies in a single, blinding flash of steel.

Ritual of Burning Karma Enemies from your past return as wraiths to block your path. Defeat them and perform the ritual to burn the 'Karma' harvested from their souls to grow stronger.

  • Cycle of Ill Fate: Hunt down bosses tied to your past memories and uncover the hidden truth.

  • Your Own Build: Your swordsmanship and abilities evolve based on the Karma you choose to burn. Your choices define your action.

Key Features

  • Medieval Japanese Dark Fantasy: A unique artistic vision of the Eastern afterlife, featuring the Sanzu River and the Realm of Shura.

  • Hardcore Action: Intricate combat and precise controls that will keep your palms sweating.

  • Strategic Choice: Infinite replayability combining Roguelike randomness with deep strategic decision-making.

Are you ready to sever the chains of your Karma?

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description:

This game contains mature themes and violent content including:

Visceral Combat & Blood: Intense sword-based combat against undead warriors and monstrous creatures. The game features frequent blood splatters and high-impact visual effects during execution moves and melee encounters.

Supernatural Horror Imagery: Graphic depictions of reanimated corpses, skeletal soldiers, and grotesque demonic entities. Enemies may shatter or disintegrate into fragments upon defeat.

Dark Historical Fantasy: Set in a grim, reimagined Eastern feudal era, the story explores a world where a mysterious corruption has collapsed the ruling order, leading to a landscape filled with death, spiritual decay, and fallen warriors.

Atmospheric Horror: Disturbing imagery of desecrated historical sites, mass graves, and a post-apocalyptic feudal setting that emphasizes themes of despair and relentless dread.

This game is intended for mature audiences comfortable with fast-paced action horror, frequent blood in melee combat, and dark supernatural themes presented in a fictional historical setting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Silan: Monster Girl Island is a monster girl capture & collection RPG developed entirely by me over the course of two years ——
combining soulslike exploration with battle mechanics inspired by Rance X.

✦ Capture & Raise Over 60 Monster Girls

The game features more than 60 unique monster girls.
Each one has:

  • Unique elemental attributes

  • 3 exclusive skills

  • Different combat roles and growth paths

You can capture and collect monster girls using the “Monster Ring”,
then strengthen them up to Rank 7 using magical enhancement stones.

✦ Soulslike × Rance X Inspired Combat

The combat system takes inspiration from Rance X while also incorporating soulslike elements such as:

  • Poise/Stagger mechanics

  • Execution systems

  • Fast-paced and high-pressure battles

My goal was to create combat that feels both strategic and satisfying hhh

✦ Minimal-Guidance Exploration

The game features a soulslike-style “minimal guidance” exploration system.

You can discover hints through messages scattered across the world while freely exploring forests, oceans, deserts, snowy mountains, volcanoes, and more.

Each region contains its own unique monster girls waiting to be discovered and captured.

✦ DEMO Available Now

If the game interests you,
please consider trying the DEMO or adding it to your wishlist — it would truly mean a lot to me!!

but I still want to sincerely thank everyone supporting Silan: Monster Girl Island.

store_data.about_the_game:
SIONIC LOVE is a visual novel game in which you search for goals and love by moving between the viewpoints of two main characters in the world of cyberpunk. Explore the world, talk to different characters, and reach different endings.

Plot

"Love City" where various people live together.

Rico, who lives with his family on the outskirts there, meets Aaron, the man who collapsed behind the house.

Getting to know each other and building a bond, the two come to a big tipping point in their relationship...

Character

Aron

A cold-tempered man lying in the back of Rico's house. He saves his life with Rico's help and opens up to Rico, but he seems to have something to hide about his goals.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation" is a command-based text adventure game inspired by the "Kemono Friends" fan-art series by Abubu-shi.

As an agent of a specialized investigation organization, you must step into the "Arai-san Mansion," a place swarming with paranormal phenomena. Your mission is simple but dire: explore its many floors using the elevator and ensure that these anomalies never leak into the outside world.

Game Features

  • Infinite Floors: The combinations of elevator buttons lead to an astronomical number of destinations. From floors shrouded in absolute silence and floors inhabited by Friends, to floors where death is certain in a single step... Knowing when to retreat is just as important as the courage to explore.

  • Strategic Card-Based Exploration: The keys to your survival are your "Skill" and the "Action" and "Ally" cards you collect. Your choice of skills and cards will branch the narrative and open new paths.

  • Diverse Mechanics: Centered around tense card battles, the game challenges you to uncover the truth through detailed text and overcome eerie gimmicks. Use every tool at your disposal to solve the mysteries of the mansion.

Game Flow

Your journey begins at the Entrance Floor, which serves as your base. Prepare yourself at the Market before heading into the floors via the elevator. There are two types of floors:

  • Special Floors: These contain unique events that advance the main story.

  • General Floors: These are spaces for training, earning money, and encountering paranormal entities.

Controls

  • Mouse: Select options, choose cards, and navigate menus.

  • Arrow Keys: Move between options.

  • F1 Key: Hide text window (useful for viewing background art or characters).

Disclaimer

  • This is a fan-made, third-party derivative work based on "Kemono Friends" and the "Arai-san Mansion" fan-art series by Abubu-shi. It is not affiliated with the original creators or official entities.

  • The developer of this game bears full responsibility for its content. Any issues related to this work will be handled by the developer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Seven murders planned. Seven religious tableaus designed.

One killer who calls himself the Messiah.

You are the lead investigator on the most disturbing serial case your city has ever seen. A killer with surgical precision is staging victims as works of sacred art—and a cult of 500+ followers worships him online.

Your only weapon? The contradictions witnesses can't hide.

How It Works

INTERROGATE WITNESSES
Question everyone at the crime scene. Press for details. Challenge their assumptions.

SPOT CONTRADICTIONS
Compare statements against evidence. Find the lies. Break their testimony.

BUILD THE PROFILE
Every breakthrough reveals new intel: a disguise, a skill, a mistake. Piece by piece, identify the Messiah.

Key Features

Deep Interrogation Mechanics – Analyze testimony statement-by-statement. Contradict using evidence to force witnesses to revise their stories.

Unreliable Witnesses – A priest who remembers nothing from a night. An urban explorer who conveniently lies . A security guard who signed off on fake maintenance crews. Everyone has reasons to lie.

Progressive Criminal Profiling – Start with nothing. Build a complete psychological and physical profile across 7 cases. Height, build, eye color, skills, methods—every detail matters.

The Delayed Cult – 500+ online followers post about murders before police discover them. They have inside knowledge. Some may be helping him.

Race Against Time – A man claiming to be the killer is dying in a pool of poison. Is he telling the truth, or is this another misdirection?

Moral Complexity – The killer believes he's creating divine art. The cult sees it as sacred judgment. Where does justice lie?

Escalating Threat – Each murder grows bolder. From locked churches to public monuments. From solo kills to organized teams. The final case threatens hundreds of lives.

The Seven Stations

Seven murders staged as religious symbolism. Each case reveals more about the killer. Each witness holds a fragment of truth.

The Holy Trinity – Cases 1-3: Father, Son, Holy Spirit
The Heavenly Messenger – Case 4: Heaven
The Damned – Case 5: Hell
The Purification – Case 6: Purgatory
The End Times – Case 7: Armageddon

Can You Stop the Seventh Crisis?

The Messiah is always three steps ahead.
The cult knows things before you do.
The witnesses are lying—or just helplessly confused.

But the truth doesn't change.

Contradictions expose lies.
Evidence reveals patterns.
Logic corners the guilty.

Find the contradictions. Build the profile. Catch the killer.

Before the seventh candle burns.

Perfect For Players Who:

✦ Love detective games with deep investigation mechanics and logical deduction

✦ Appreciate mystery games that reward careful observation
✦ Enjoy spotting logical inconsistencies and solving puzzles through careful observation
✦ Appreciate strong writing and narrative-driven gameplay
✦ Want to feel like a real detective building a case piece by piece
✦ Don't mind reading—every word matters

Not For Players Who:

✦ Expect action gameplay or quick-time events
✦ Want simple "point and click" adventure mechanics
✦ Dislike reading extensive dialogue and testimony
✦ Prefer games with straightforward moral choices

About the Critical Interrogator Series

CRITICAL INTERROGATOR: MESSIAH HUNT is the first entry in a franchise of detective interrogation games where logic, evidence, and careful observation are your only tools. Each game features a unique case with its own cast of witnesses, contradictions to uncover, and mysteries to solve.

From the Developer

Critical Interrogator was built on a simple philosophy: detective work should reward careful attention and logical thinking. Every witness statement is a puzzle. Every piece of evidence is a tool. Every contradiction is a breakthrough.

You won't find action sequences, hand-holding tutorials, or "detective vision" highlighting what to click. Just pure investigative gameplay where your intelligence and observation skills determine whether you catch the killer—or let him slip away.

The witnesses are waiting. The evidence is in your files. The Messiah is watching.

Can you see through the lies?

store_data.about_the_game:
Decay has taken hold, and all things wither. In this brutal yet beautiful top-down action game, embark on a lonely and cruel journey of redemption! Explore a forest kingdom twisted by plague, upgrade your character, collect gear, battle infected and mutated fruits and vegetables, and uncover the secrets behind the forest's infection. Death is not the end, but the price paid to purify this doomed and withering world.

⚔️ Dancing on the Edge: A Hardcore Combat Experience

This is a hardcore combat experience that is easy to pick up but hard to master. In this malicious world, reckless swinging will only invite death. You must observe your enemies' every wind-up and master the rhythm of offense and defense.

  • Rage & Transform: Only through perfect dodges or precise parries can you siphon energy from your enemies. Accumulate energy to break the limits of your flesh, shift into different forms, become a more powerful warrior, and carve a bloody path out of desperate situations.

💎 Charm System: Define Your Combat Style

Not just upgrading, but evolving. Beyond transformation abilities, the game offers a charm system. As you explore the decaying forest, you will collect "Ancient Seeds" and "Memory Shards" scattered in hidden corners.

  • Endless Build Possibilities: Each badge can alter your character's underlying mechanics.

  • Strategic Gameplay: Badge slots are limited. When facing enemies with different traits, a well-thought-out badge combination is often more important than simply grinding levels.

🗺️ Step into the Decaying Abyss: A Shattered World

Embark on a journey of redemption with no turning back. The world has collapsed, and only your footsteps can measure the sorrow of this land. In this linear yet deeply layered journey, you will traverse diverse and corrupted biomes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Catch fish!

More fish is a simple incremental idle clicker game. EXCEPT YOU DON'T USUALLY CLICK. Hover your cursor over the fish for catching them. Your cursor will turn into a fishing buoy when you are on ocean tiles. At the end of each fishing round, you upgrade many things and continue fishing in the next round.

Events - Something fishy going on
Events change the reality in different layers. They make game mechanics slightly more challenging and give extra rewards.

Pierce the fog...
Feel the nordic lights...
Beware of sea sickness...
Listen for a good catch...
Hold still during heavy storms...
Party together with THE FISH MASTER...

Skill tree
These upgrades permanently boost your skills, letting you catch MORE FISH. The left hand side of skill tree is about auto fishing game mechanics, the right hand side of skill tree is about game economy.

Fishing buoys and runes
Better fishing buoys and runes will help you catch MORE FISH. Some runes can change how you interact with mouse. If you remember, I said you don't usually click above. :)
Well... Sometimes you will have to click in different ways.

The statistics

The statistics will tell you the strength of your fishing buoy including all possible upgrades. For example: How is your performance of collecting coins and pearls over time? Which fish did you catch the most?

Fish Collection

There are 64 different fish from different places in the world. You can read fish details. You can select the fish you want to catch in the next round. They are also a source of passive income.

Talent cards
Levelling up means earning a talent scroll. Spend talent scrolls to reveal 3 random talent cards and pick one to keep!
Everyone loves a bit of card game. Soooo, why not, right? Right.

Event upgrades
Upgrade your event abilities to turn harsh seas and foggy nights into massive fishing opportunities. Events add a bit of spice to your gameplay, and give rewards. You will love them even more after some upgrades!

Lost Items
Lost items provide you with permanent upgrades. Lost items can be about game mechanics, game economy or utility.

Contact: ugur.yilmaz@broadstreetanalytics.com

The ocean holds many secrets. Add More Fish to your Wishlist today so you don't miss the boat!

store_data.about_the_game:
Rotting Valentine is a dark, gothic action slasher set in a decaying vision of Victorian England — a land abandoned by God and overrun by rot, heresy, and the restless dead.

You play as a wandering alchemist vigilante, an unholy executioner of the unnatural. Armed with a cursed scythe and a custom firearm, she travels through plague-ridden streets, forgotten villages, and desecrated cathedrals, driven by a purpose known only to herself.

Fast, aggressive slasher combat lies at the heart of Rotting Valentine. Master fluid melee with the scythe, combine it with precise gunplay, and tear through hordes of zombies, vampires, and twisted abominations.

Both weapons can be upgraded independently, each offering distinct progression paths and unique perks, allowing you to shape your own combat style — whether through relentless close-range carnage or calculated, deadly precision.

This world breathes decay. Gothic architecture, moonlit graveyards, and blood-soaked streets tell the story of a civilization long past salvation. Every enemy, every location, is steeped in death and forbidden knowledge.

Beyond violence, Rotting Valentine explores desire in a dying world.

The game features optional, fully mutual adult scenes with certain NPCs and defeated bosses. These moments are never mandatory, always initiated by the player, and exist as narrative extensions rather than rewards forced upon the experience.

Inspired by classic gothic horror, the game delivers a grim, stylized aesthetic — oppressive shadows, high contrast visuals, and a tone where beauty and decay coexist.

AfterJoy is a short psychological horror game set in an abandoned industrial facility long after its permanent closure.

You play as a lone character exploring a decaying complex where something has gone terribly wrong. The building is silent, the machines are cold, and the past refuses to stay buried.

There are no weapons. No combat.
Only exploration, tension, and the constant feeling of being watched.

As you move deeper into the facility, the environment itself becomes a threat. Strange sounds echo through empty corridors, lights flicker without reason, and unseen presences react to your actions.

AfterJoy focuses on atmosphere, environmental storytelling, and slow-burn horror. The experience is designed to make you uncomfortable, not empowered.

Some doors should never be opened.

store_data.about_the_game:
Busted is a 2d roguelike dungeon crawler based on blackjack mechanics. Explore different chambers, equip special abilities and use unique cards to your advantage as you descend further into the unknown.

Combine special cards to form optimal hands as you face different dealers across every dungeon. Every run is shaped by powerful one-round cards and dungeon effects that change how Blackjack is played.

  • Multiply rewards, save lives, or guarantee perfect draws

  • Trade health for coins of safety for power

  • Break the rules and manipulate the game to your advantage

These cards dont carry over - each one is a high impact decision that can turn a losing round into a winning one, or end a run instantly if misused.

Abilities give you direct control over the dealer and the deck.

Spend coins to unlock tactical options that influence draws, outcomes and survivability. They arnt mandatory, but using them intelligently can push a run far beyond what pure luck allows.

  • Freeze the dealer and alter their behaviour

  • Strike the dealer by discarding their cards and replacing them with negative counterparts

  • Optimise your deck to survive increasingly hostile encounters

With 20+ abilities planned for release, players must careful balance risk, coins and timing.

 

At its core, this is still Blackjack - but every hand carries weight

You'll play familiar hands while adapting to dungeon rules, special cards and rising pressure. A single card can shift the outcome entirely, turning a safe play into a risky gamble or saying you from an inevitable bust

Its not about memorising strategy. Its about reading the situation and knowing when to stop!

After each dungeon, you choose where to go next.

Different paths lead to different dealers, modifiers, rewards, and risks. Some routes offer safety and stability, while others promise large amount of coins at a cost.

Theres no "correct path" - only the one you think you can survive. Choose carefully, the dungeon wont forgive mistakes...

The game captures the raw beauty of Romsdalen, with its dramatic fjords, towering peaks, and dense forests. Feel the rush of wind in your face as you take on these daring stunts and hidden paths that most haven’t dared to tread. With realistic physics and breathtaking graphics, Wingsuit: Romsdalen brings the spirit of adventure to life like never before.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the depths of an ancient tomb buried beneath the sands of the Idnan Desert, Alstan, a young nomadic warrior, has just lost his sister to a mysterious curse: the mark of the desert, a symbol burned into the flesh of those who bear the burden of the djinn.

Overcome with grief, Alstan crosses paths with a strange traveller. The latter reveals that behind this mark lies an ancient and feared being: Rahim, a legendary Djinn who has been confined for centuries in a forgotten temple. Driven by anger, Alstan embarks on a quest for vengeance.

Play as Alstan and set off across the Idnan desert, an arid and enchanting world inspired by Amazigh and Tuareg cultures. Along the way, face fallen spirits, ancient Djinns who have also been twisted by the curse.

With fast-paced combat, dynamic exploration mechanics and strong art direction, Alstan offers an immersive experience in a semi-open desert world, where every step brings you closer to the truth... and revenge.

DYNAMIC COMBAT

Face a variety of enemies blocking your path and testing your skills and endurance.

EXPLORATION

Climb surfaces, slide across sand, and explore the most secret corners of the desert and its ruins to learn more about its history and find items to increase Alstan's power !

SAND POWER

Use the curse to your advantage by harnessing its power, delivering powerful shock waves or propelling yourself into the air. It's up to you to decide how to wield this valuable asset.

NOTE 

The game is a vertical slice created by a team of students as part of our graduation project.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ashentia Hauntings is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Noah, who decided to investigate the various haunted locations of Ashentia, a place that is surrounded by hills and forests.

During the 1970s, B.T. Villa was built on a burial ground located near the West Ashentia highway. It was said that the family started living in that villa in 1973 after the construction was completed, but there were no issues in the beginning. But during the 1980s, a few tragic incidents occurred in that villa, and consequently, the family that lived there for over a decade moved out of it due to unknown reasons and sold it to Mr. Otoza in the year 1998. It was the dark forces that were behind those tragic events.

After the new family moved in, they started to experience paranormal activities, and it was said that the family members could not live there for even 6 months and hurriedly escaped the villa, leaving behind their belongings. The property changed hands many times, and it was left vacant for years. Finally, it was sold to Mr. Hako in 2006, who is the current owner of the property. Soon after they moved in, he and his other family members also started to experience the paranormal activities, which included hearing disembodied voices, apparitions of a woman appearing suddenly in the various rooms inside the villa, and spirit voices coming from an old radio. So, Noah, the paranormal enthusiast, was asked by him to investigate the haunted villa in order to provide them with some answers.

You play as Noah, the paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the location for proof of the paranormal. Will you be able to help out the client?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire area of the haunted villa!
  • Come face-to-face with the Evil spirits!
  • Avoid deadly traps like spikes, knife etc.
  • Collect items like keys, photo album, old radio etc.
  • Explore the spirit world!
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE GREATEST ILLUSION IS THE ONE YOU BELIEVE FINIS ACTUS is a first-person psychological thriller set in the gloomy shadows of 1891 London. Inside the magnificent yet haunting mansion of a famous illusionist, the line between reality and deception blurs with every step.



THE TRAGEDY OF THE WADSWORTH FAMILY
Abandoned after a tragic event years ago, this mansion now calls you into its silent corridors. Unravel the unfinished story of the Wadsworth Family by following clues hidden within the walls and the sorrow embedded in every room. But remember: every secret has its price.



KEY FEATURES:

  • Victorian Atmosphere: Experience the heavy, foggy, and eerie ambiance of 19th-century London with meticulously crafted environments.

  • Environmental Storytelling: The narrative unfolds through every dusty letter, hidden object, and the memories trapped within the manor.

  • Psychological Depth: A plot focused on the unknown and the feeling of being watched, rather than traditional jump scares.

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve complex, story-driven puzzles designed by a master of illusion.

Are you ready to witness the final act before the curtain falls for good?

store_data.about_the_game:
IGNITION POINT

Ignition Point is a competitive racing game focused on meaningful progression and accessible, skill-based driving.

Designed to sit between arcade and simulation, the game delivers a driving experience where cars have weight, braking matters, and consistency is rewarded, without overwhelming players with unnecessary complexity.

Whether you’re playing solo or online, Ignition Point is about learning, improving, and earning every step of your career.

A CAREER THAT MAKES SENSE

The career mode is built around dynamic events and leagues that unlock naturally as you progress.

  • Earn league points based on race performance

  • Qualify for Grand Prix events to advance leagues

  • Unlock new regions and racing disciplines over time

Progression is merit-based. Advancement comes from driving well, not from grinding or handouts.

Your garage matters as the game will not adapt to your garage, it is the other way around. Choosing which cars to buy, repair, and upgrade directly affects which events you can enter and how competitive you’ll be.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE

Ignition Point features both visual and performance customization.

  • Body kits, wings, paint and liveries

  • Mechanical upgrades such as engine, transmission, brakes and suspension

Cars are expensive and not every career starts with a perfect machine.

Players begin with a used car, and a dedicated used car market offers cheaper vehicles with reduced performance that require repairs. Smart decisions and gradual improvements can open doors to entire racing categories.

LEARN, PRACTICE, IMPROVE

The game includes tools designed to help players grow naturally:

  • Dedicated training mode

  • Sector-based practice with real-time feedback

  • Ghost racing against best laps

  • Optional racing line guidance available only in training

Ignition Point rewards players who focus on consistency and improvement.

ONLINE RACING & MATCHMAKING

Race online through competitive matchmaking with:

  • Category-based matchmaking

  • Track voting and veto system

  • Multi-race championships

Each race weekend features practice sessions, qualifying, and races with tire wear, fuel consumption, pit stops and vehicle damage.

Dedicated servers, crossplay support and Easy Anti-Cheat integration are planned.

MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES

Compete across multiple motorsport disciplines, including:

  • Touring & GT racing

  • Karting

  • Formula racing

  • Rally events

Each category offers a distinct feel while sharing the same core driving philosophy.

FEATURE HIGHLIGHT

• Accessible driving with real skill depth

• Merit-based career progression

• Meaningful garage and vehicle customization

• Used car market and repair system

• Competitive online matchmaking

• Multiple racing disciplines

• Training tools and ghost racing

• Dynamic weather and fast loading times

• Stylized, performance-friendly visuals

EARLY ACCESS & DEVELOPMENT

Ignition Point has been in development for over 2 years by a solo developer and is currently approaching a complete gameplay cycle.

The game is coming to Steam with Early Access under consideration. Content such as tracks, vehicles and customization options will expand during development, with a strong focus on quality, balance and player feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
On a tiny rock floating in space stands the Trivia Tree. It’s not just an ancient tree—it’s a grumpy old fellow whose leaves come in 15 different colors, each representing a branch of knowledge, from history to the mystery of why bread always lands butter-side down. But knowledge comes at a price. The forces of ignorance from Earth—silly, ridiculous hordes—advance toward the tree. Conspiracy trolls, fake science fans, toxic tourists, and creatures that literally eat leaves of knowledge for breakfast.

The parliament of owls protects the tree. Collect the leaves, answer questions correctly, and use your wisdom as a weapon—but watch out: get it right, and you gain power; get it wrong, and the enemy grows stronger. And if the tree goes bald… it’s game over.

GAMEPLAY

TriviOwl mixes quiz questions with tower defense and path-building fun:

  • Build the enemies’ path on a rock floating in space, one tile at a time

  • Answer quiz questions to unlock power, bonuses, and control—over 1,500 questions across 15 different categories   

  • Miss a question and the invading hordes get stronger    

  • Face ever-stranger enemies 

  • Protect the Trivia Tree before it loses all its leaves    

  • Strategy, knowledge, and timing all matter—no single skill can save you alone

FEATURES

  • A fun mix of quiz questions and tower defense    

  • Path-building lets you control enemy movement    

  • Make smart choices to earn rewards or risk failure    

  • Colorful cartoon graphics with a whimsical, storybook style    

  • Hilarious enemies representing the forces of ignorance    

  • A fun, lighthearted game full of quirky characters and surprises

21 Dungeons mashes up the tension of Blackjack with the progression of an RPG.

In this game, your sword is your deck. Every turn is a gamble, and every enemy presents a new puzzle. Do you hit and risk a bust to deal massive damage, or do you stand and play it safe?

Roguelite Elements

Death is part of the journey. Each run challenges you to get further than before. When you conquer the dungeon, the game loops, scaling the difficulty infinitely. Test your limits against stronger foes and see how high you can climb.

Key Features:

  • Endless Mode: Equip powerful runes to survive the infinitely scaling difficulty.

  • 8 Upgrades: Strengthen your heroes between runs.

  • 9 Events: Face random scenarios that demand tough choices.

  • 40 Achievements: Prove your mastery of the cards.

    • 40 Enemies: Learn their patterns and exploit their weaknesses.

    • 24 Items: Collect loot that alters the rules of the game.

    • 8 Heroes: Unlock and master distinct characters.

    • 11 Special Cards: Customize your deck to manipulate the odds.

WHAT IT IS:

PWS combines a wheelchair simulation with game modes designed for both training and play.
The simulation focuses on realistic movement, environmental challenges, and mistakes that matter — without real-world risk.

WHY IT EXISTS:

Many real-world environments are not designed for wheelchair users.

PWS exists to make those challenges visible, playable, and trainable — in a safe digital space.

Game modes:
• Training scenarios for new wheelchair users
• Free-play exploration

• Endless Driver
• Competitive and social modes such as "Pop or Flop"

Development Status & Community Support:

PWS is in early development and is built without a publisher or external funding.
Support from the general player base — through wishlists and purchases — directly enables continued development and the steps required to deploy the simulation in real rehabilitation clinics.
Playing or supporting PWS as a healthy user contributes to the same platform that is being developed for safe training and experimentation in professional rehabilitation contexts.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Unbelievers, time is broken—and so is the world you know.

Set in 1986, you play as Rick, a hardened survivor who stumbles upon a mysterious box linked to the year 1919. When the box is opened, it tears a rift in time, dragging you into a decaying alternate past where reality is twisted, and nightmarish creatures rule the shadows.

Armed with era-specific firearms and sheer determination, Rick must navigate through haunted ruins, desolate villages, and forgotten bunkers in a desperate bid to survive. Uncover the origins of the artifact, piece together a century-old conspiracy, and confront a darkness that feeds on fear.

This is not just a fight for survival—it's a battle to reclaim your time.

Key Features:

  • Time-Twisting Narrative: Experience a story that shifts between 1986 and an alternate version of 1919, filled with mystery, horror, and dark history.

  • Intense FPS Combat: Use a variety of classic firearms to fight back against grotesque, otherworldly creatures. Every shot counts.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Explore eerie environments soaked in dread—abandoned buildings, fog-laden forests, and war-torn ruins.

  • Story-Driven Exploration: Discover notes, relics, and environmental clues to unravel the truth behind the box and the creatures it unleashed.

  • Immersive Sound Design: A haunting soundtrack and dynamic audio design bring the world to life—and death.

Are you ready to face what lies beneath history?

Unbelievers — Coming Soon. Wishlist now and prepare to cross the rift.

store_data.about_the_game:
GET RICH OR GET DELETED.

Binary Breach is an asymmetric co-op game that fuses 3D precision platforming with 2D strategic hacking. One player takes the role of a sentient virus inside the system. The other plays as the external hacker guiding them and controlling the environment.

Together, the pair must infiltrate a collapsing blockchain to breach the firewalls of an ultra-secure crypto wallet. The goal is to steal the assets before the system deletes the connection.

There is no solo mode. The team lives or dies as a pair.

TWO MINDS, ONE BREACH

  • PLAYER 1: THE RUNNER (3D)
    The Runner traverses the system’s architecture from within. Without a map or radar, they rely entirely on the operator to know what lies around the corner.
    Gameplay: Precision Platforming, Wall-Jumping, Air-Strafing.

  • PLAYER 2: THE OPERATOR (2D)
    The Operator views the heist through a retro-futuristic terminal. They act as the mastermind to edit reality. The Operator hacks doors, spawns platforms, and overrides physics to carry the Runner across the finish line.
    Gameplay: Environment Control, Tactical Hacking, Minigames.

TIME IS MONEY

Time is the only resource. Every second spent in the preparation sectors deducts directly from the final extraction window.

  • Speedrun the security layers to preserve the connection time.

  • Maximize the remaining duration in the extraction phase to drain the wallet.

  • Escape before the system collapse to secure the payout.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shattered images scatter through time. You are the one to pick them up, one by one.

Artifex is a narrative-driven art puzzle game. Accompanied by soothing music, you will slowly piece together broken illustrations and stories within a world where fantasy and reality intertwine.

There is no urgency or penalty for failure—just music, puzzles, and a perfect way to quietly spend an afternoon.

Purely Relaxing Jigsaw Experience

No time limits, pause and resume anytime—focus on the joy of the puzzle itself.

Multiple Puzzle Modes and Difficulties

From beginner to high-level challenge, supporting fragment rotation, special shapes, and various distribution methods.

Rich Fragment Shapes

Classic jigsaw, honeycomb structure, chemical formula shapes, random cuts, and more.

Listen to Music, Slowly Piece Together

Carefully arranged background music, suitable for long periods of play and relaxation.

Narrative-Driven Art Puzzles

Complete each puzzle to unlock corresponding stories and background art.

Time-Limited Challenge Mode

A challenge mode for players seeking efficiency and skill, supporting leaderboards and sharing.

Suitable for Everyone

No need for quick reflexes or intense control, perfect for solitude, relaxation, and long play sessions.

If you are looking for a puzzle game that allows you to listen to music, play slowly, and quietly relax, then welcome to the artistic realm of Artifex.

store_data.about_the_game:
This Silly Little Robot Needs Your Help to Deliver Packages!

He's not the brightest in the room, so he just keeps moving to the right... usually until he crashes into a wall...

But Luckily! You Can Drag & Drop Action Blocks to Command the Robot! :D
Once The Robot Collides with Any of These Blocks It Will Perform That Action!

Controls

Hold Left Click on a Block and Move Your Mouse Around to Drag It

Release Left Click to Drop The Block! It Will Snap to a Grid!

Right Click Over a Block to Remove It!

Use WASD, or Arrow Keys to Move The Camera in Longer Levels

Hover Your Mouse Over Certain Objects for Tooltips!

Press Enter to Toggle Game Modes 

Press F to Enter Fullscreen (This Game is Best Played in Fullscreen BTW)

Press R to Reset Level

Gameplay

There are Lots of Action Blocks for You to Use!
Here are Some of The First Ones You'll Encounter!

 

Jump Block

Makes You Jump :O

Flip Block  
Reverses The Robot's Direction

Accelerate Block
Switches the Robot Into a Faster Running Speed

Decelerate Block
Switches the Robot Into a Slower Walking Speed

Stop Block
Briefly Slows The Robot

Gravity Block
Reverses the Direction of Gravity

and There's Many More! 12+ in Total!

Hover Over Them in The Container In-Game to Read Their Tooltips!


There are Many More Blocks to Play with and Keep In Mind This Game Can Be Quite Challenging at Times. You Might Need to Think Outside The Box! 

You Can Also Put Blocks on Top of Each Other to Make Chain Reactions! For Example, Placing a Flip Block on Top of a Jump Block Is Great for Tight Vertical Spaces

This game was originally made in around 2 days, for the WOWIE Jam 4.0 with barely any sleep lol

store_data.about_the_game:
Pegture is a game that combines roguelike, deck-building genres with a classical peg solitaire game.

Jump over other pegs, build your deck and enhance your pegs to gain extra abilities.

At the start, choose your deck from 7 different options. Each deck has its own unique shape and features.

Clear rounds by jumping over pegs. Reach target scores through consecutive combos, enhance peg abilities and jokers, and watch your combo multiplier grow exponentially each time you jump with the same peg.

Explore and unlock new jokers, expand your deck, and craft powerful synergies. With endless card combinations, every run delivers a unique gameplay experience.

If you lose, don’t give up, try again with new strategies. After a win, experiment with fresh synergies on the same board or move on to a new one.
