store_data.about_the_game:
PoliCromix is a strategic online card game where placement matters more than reflexes. Instead of traditional turn-based duels, battles unfold on dynamic boards where cards interact automatically through directional attacks, making positioning, timing, and board control the heart of every match.

Strategic Board-Based Combat

Each match is played on a board where players take turns placing cards. Cards attack automatically based on their directional arrows, triggering battles the moment they are positioned next to opponents. Smart placement can flip enemy cards, control key areas, and completely change the flow of a match.

Battles are fast to learn but rich in depth, rewarding foresight, adaptation, and experimentation rather than complex inputs.

Multiple Battle Formats

PoliCromix supports several ways to play:

  • Player vs Bot (1v1): Training and story battles designed for learning, experimentation, and structured challenges.

  • Player vs Player (1v1): Competitive online matches against real players.

  • Multiplayer Boards (up to 8 players): Special boards allow large-scale battles where multiple players fight for control at the same time, creating unpredictable and highly strategic encounters.

All multiplayer matches are played online with real players.

Storybooks & Fantasy Campaigns

Several universes in PoliCromix feature storybooks: fantasy campaigns that combine narrative and gameplay.

Storybooks are structured into chapters and scenes, presented through dialog, visual-novel storytelling, or comic-style flipbooks. Each scene may include story segments, battles against bots, or both. As players progress through a storybook, they unlock exclusive boards that become permanently available for replay and even for PvP battles.

Storybooks are not just narrative content; they expand the game by introducing new boards, unique encounters, and themed gameplay experiences.

Progression That Matters

Progression in PoliCromix happens on two levels:

  • Player progression, earned by competing in matches.

  • Card progression, earned by actively using cards in battles.

Cards grow stronger the more they are used, unlocking their full potential over time. Progression is always forward and has a meaningful impact on gameplay, making long-term investment in your favorite cards both rewarding and strategic.

Training and story battles offer reduced progression, keeping competitive play as the primary path for growth.

Farming & Long-Term Investment

In addition to active play, PoliCromix offers an optional Farm system. Cards placed in the farm continue developing while you’re away, allowing unused or underleveled cards to grow in the background. Farming is a paid, optional feature designed to complement gameplay -not replace it- and to keep larger collections relevant over time.

Universes, Boards & Variety

PoliCromix spans multiple fantasy universes, each with its own tone, characters, and boards. Some boards are unlocked through storybooks, while others appear as seasonal boards that introduce special rules and unique cards available only during that season through gameplay.

Not every card is obtained through packs. Some exist only within specific boards or scenarios, emphasizing gameplay variety over pure collection.

Earning Cards & In-Game Economy

Cards in PoliCromix can be earned by playing. Defeating bots, winning battles, and progressing through the game allows players to expand their collection naturally. Card packs are also available through the in-game shop and can be obtained using in-game currency earned through play or through optional purchases.

The shop offers flexible ways to grow your collection, while all newly acquired cards always match your current progression level. Skill, strategy, and smart decisions -not spending- remain the foundation of success.

Fair & Flexible Play

PoliCromix is free to play. Optional purchases provide convenience and access to additional content, but progression and competitive outcomes are driven by gameplay, positioning, and long-term mastery rather than shortcuts.

store_data.about_the_game:
What is HexSwarm?

HexSwarm: Hostile Worlds is a co-op strategy board game. You and 1 to 5 of your friends are tasked with colonizing a hostile alien planet. Your have a number of buildings, research, and unique mecha pilots at your disposal to complete this task.
Can you survive the swarm?

The Planet

Every game is played on a uniquely generated map. It all begins in the center, with your settlement. Every turn, you'll be drawing Trapezoid-Shaped Tiles to place. These non-standard tiles lead to unusual, unique, challenging, and innovative experiences. They drive your expansion as you clear bugs and rocks, remove hives, and construct mines, labs, and turrets to keep your economy growing and safe. But don't forget the power plants to keep it all running.

The Team

Take on one of 7 Unique roles, each with distinctive art for both the mechs and their pilots.

  • Analyst - Optimized for defense and adaptation, help the team by cycling cards for cheap, and providing extra defense to your base structures.

  • Biologist - Optimized for SCIENCE! The Biologist will make sure your team can afford every piece of tech their hearts desire.

  • Constructor - Optimized for optimizing, the constructor brings the ability to build remotely and cheaply. Your economy will thank you.

  • Excavator - Optimized for turns rocks into not-rocks. You tackle the opposite end of the economy equation. Rather than building things cheaply, you'll be stuffing the coffers full of raw materials.

  • Exterminator - Optimized to remove threats,  your Action economy when it comes to removing bugs is unmatched. Remove twice as many as your friends, or remove bugs while performing secondary actions to keep your team on tempo.

  • Frontliner - Optimized for relentless fronts. The bugs don't stop you like they stop others. Your unmatched mobility and the ability to establish security under fire will make sure you're never left stranded by a stray bug.

  • Siegemaster - Optimized for complex situations; the siegemaster breaks the rules by letting you affect tiles you aren't on. Removing bugs from places you normally couldn't, and with more power than anyone else.

store_data.about_the_game:
Has it been three years already?

A Date With Chester 2 is a short, standalone story about remembering the good times. You've been with Chester for a while now. Have things gotten a little too comfortable? It's your anniversary today, and you've got something really special planned. You wonder what he's got in store for you...

Hey, snap out of it - you've been planning this for a long time!

Features:

  • A short but thrilling experience - 30 minute to 1 hour expected playtime. 

  • A nostalgic aesthetic that blends 3D with hand-drawn 2D art.

  • ONE OR MORE otters! (There's one.)

  • MORE THAN ONE ending! (....... There's two.)

  • Twists and turns shake up the gameplay, guaranteed to keep your heart racing!

  • A fresh, unexpected blend of genres, including point-and-click elements and tense first-person sections.

  • Loads of collectible items scattered throughout - seek them out to unlock Chester's deepest hopes and fears.

Note: Love can be a bit scary sometimes. That's okay, right?

store_data.about_the_game:
KEY FEATURES

  • Do not be bound by a single fighting style. Adapt your strategy on the fly with a vast array of weapons, armor, and magical artifacts found throughout your journey. Whether you prefer breaking enemy defenses with heavy strikes or dodging death with agile maneuvers, choosing the right equipment for the right enemy is crucial.

  • The guardians of the kingdom have not yet fallen. Face off against colossal bosses, each with unique attack patterns and weaknesses. Your reflexes alone won't be enough; your patience and strategy will be tested to their limits.  

    

  • The narrative is embedded in the crumbled statues, the background details, and the world itself. Observe your surroundings closely; every ruin whispers a fragment of a past tragedy.

  • True to the classic Metroidvania spirit, explore a labyrinthine world of interconnected maps. Backtrack to previously inaccessible areas with newfound abilities, uncover secret passages, and lose yourself in the atmospheric beauty of this pixel-art Dark Fantasy world.

  • Every conversation, every item description, and every enemy encounter holds a clue to the history of this cursed land. It is up to you to piece together the fragments and uncover the secrets of the kingdom.

store_data.about_the_game:
Steam Store Page Description (English)

Short Description (200-300 characters)

"Just being alive is already FANTASTIC!!" — A fictional radio show visual novel hosted by a self-proclaimed film director and an overly cheerful DJ. Experience a 30-minute radio program through text, BGM, sound effects, and insert songs. Celebrating life's small joys with humor and a touch of social satire.

About This Game

[h2]Introduction[/h2]

"It doesn't have to be your birthday. It doesn't have to be an anniversary — let's find a small celebration!"

This is a visual novel that lets you experience a fictional radio show called "Small Celebration."

As you read through the text, enjoy opening themes, sound effects, insert songs, and endings — a 30-minute experience that feels just like tuning into a real radio program.

[h2]Story[/h2]

Blue Hawaii Aniki, a self-proclaimed film director, suddenly finds himself making his radio debut.

Pushed around by the opportunistic staff writer Bonto Taira, he's paired with his new co-host: Cathy Koiwai, an impossibly cheerful FM radio DJ.

Together, they introduce letters from listeners sharing their "small celebrations" — modest moments of happiness. And so begins a radio show with its own unique warmth, sometimes surreal, sometimes bittersweet.

[h2]Program Segments[/h2]

[b]◆ Small Cele Letters[/b] The main segment where listeners' "small celebrations" are featured. A repaired air conditioner, the joy of seeing nieces and nephews... celebrating life's modest moments.

[b]◆ Live Reports[/b] Reporters venture out into the city, delivering unexpected encounters and discoveries.

[b]◆ CM Parodies[/b] Hilarious commercials for fictional products add color to the show. Expect some black humor with social commentary.

[b]◆ Opening / Ending[/b] Enjoy the banter between our two hosts.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list] [] [b]Text + Audio Production[/b] — BGM, sound effects, and OP/ED/insert songs recreate the atmosphere of a radio show [] [b]30-45 Minutes of Playtime[/b] — Perfect for your commute or before bed [] [b]Social Satire × Humor[/b] — A script with laughs and just a touch of bite [] [b]Colorful Characters[/b] — A self-proclaimed director, an overly cheerful DJ, an opportunistic writer... [/list]

[h2]About the Series[/h2]

This is part of the "Blue Hawaii Aniki" series.

"Small Celebration" is a radio show format spin-off — a comedic visual novel suitable for all ages. No prior knowledge of the series is required to enjoy this title.

[h2]Recommended Setup[/h2]

This is a work meant to be enjoyed with audio while reading text. [b]Headphones or earphones are recommended.[/b]

System Requirements (Reference)

[h2]Minimum Requirements[/h2] [list] [] [b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 [] [b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i3 or equivalent [] [b]Memory:[/b] 4 GB RAM [] [b]Graphics:[/b] Integrated graphics supported [] [b]Storage:[/b] 500 MB available space [] [b]Sound Card:[/b] DirectX compatible [/list]

store_data.about_the_game:
After suffering a defeat in the first round of the college entrance examination, you chose to travel to a quiet and beautiful island to embark on a one-year re-study journey. Here, you will fully plan and manage your own self-study life, relying on the resources of the island and its people to steadily progress. You will also encounter three girls with distinct personalities, and during your dates and relationships, you will gain practical learning experience. Only by reasonably distributing your physical and mental energy can you overcome the ultimate test and achieve a double harvest of academic and love success.

The core objective of the game: Academics and romance are eternal topics during one's student years. Players need to strive to achieve success in both aspects within the limited game time.

The path to academic success:

Continuously acquire knowledge in various subjects, thereby achieving good results in the final college entrance examination and being admitted to the desired university.

  • Desk Practice: Conduct a timed quiz game using the player's own desk in their room to accumulate exam knowledge. The more correct answers given, the more subject experience points will be earned.

  • Ask her: Characters who have a certain level of favorability towards players will be able to guide players in their studies. Obtaining knowledge of the subjects from the characters' dialogues is also an important part of the learning process.

  • Reading books: Bookstores sell various study-related books and materials. With a certain amount of money, one can obtain them. Compared to answering questions, books can more easily bring about academic experience points.

  • Making props: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth. By creating various props and fully applying knowledge from various disciplines, one can achieve the goal of deepening understanding of the subjects. Not only can you obtain the props, but you can also acquire additional subject-related experience.

  • Scene Object Exploration: The game scene contains a wide variety of objects that can provide inspiration for learning. These objects could be kitchen utensils from a restaurant or artworks from an exhibition hall.

  • Promoting goods: The experience of acquiring language skills by selling items to passers-by is one of the important methods for learning a language, and it can also lead to financial gains.

Date and Love:

Embark on a unique love story with three distinctively different beautiful girls on a vacation island. Through various interactive behaviors and dialogue events, gain the affection of the characters and fall in love. Whether to focus on one character or have multiple relationships depends on the player's choice.

  • Giving gifts: Giving small gifts is the most traditional way to enhance relationships. Players can obtain items through various means and then give them to the characters they admire. They will receive various different feedback dialogues, from which they can figure out which item is the character's favorite.

  • Dining together: Having dinner together with the date is a classic choice in a date. There are up to 24 different sets of dishes available for selection. The characters will also have their own unique understanding of the food, leading to various different conversations.

  • Watching movies: Under the dim screen lights, watching movies together with the person you admire is one of the important choices in dating. Each of the 12 movies brings a different experience to the characters. Listening to the characters' after-viewing thoughts and understanding their preferences can greatly help in enhancing the relationship between you.

  • Visiting Exhibitions: At various art exhibitions, one can not only acquire knowledge from various disciplines, but also engage in discussions with the characters about the exhibits, or have close interactions in front of the installation art, all of which can enhance the characters' favorability towards you.

  • Jointly promoting products: When selling items to passers-by, it is inevitable to encounter rejections. At this point, the date partner can help the player relieve the awkwardness and thereby increase the success rate of the sales. The higher the affection level, the higher the success rate. Therefore, please try your best to enhance the bond between you and the character.

  • Taking a hot spring bath: When in a close relationship with someone, one should engage in some intimate behaviors. store_data.detailed_description:
After suffering a defeat in the first round of the college entrance examination, you chose to travel to a quiet and beautiful island to embark on a one-year re-study journey. Here, you will fully plan and manage your own self-study life, relying on the resources of the island and its people to steadily progress. You will also encounter three girls with distinct personalities, and during your dates and relationships, you will gain practical learning experience. Only by reasonably distributing your physical and mental energy can you overcome the ultimate test and achieve a double harvest of academic and love success.

The core objective of the game: Academics and romance are eternal topics during one's student years. Players need to strive to achieve success in both aspects within the limited game time.

The path to academic success:

Continuously acquire knowledge in various subjects, thereby achieving good results in the final college entrance examination and being admitted to the desired university.

  • Desk Practice: Conduct a timed quiz game using the player's own desk in their room to accumulate exam knowledge. The more correct answers given, the more subject experience points will be earned.

  • Ask her: Characters who have a certain level of favorability towards players will be able to guide players in their studies. Obtaining knowledge of the subjects from the characters' dialogues is also an important part of the learning process.

  • Reading books: Bookstores sell various study-related books and materials. With a certain amount of money, one can obtain them. Compared to answering questions, books can more easily bring about academic experience points.

  • Making props: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth. By creating various props and fully applying knowledge from various disciplines, one can achieve the goal of deepening understanding of the subjects. Not only can you obtain the props, but you can also acquire additional subject-related experience.

  • Scene Object Exploration: The game scene contains a wide variety of objects that can provide inspiration for learning. These objects could be kitchen utensils from a restaurant or artworks from an exhibition hall.

  • Promoting goods: The experience of acquiring language skills by selling items to passers-by is one of the important methods for learning a language, and it can also lead to financial gains.

Date and Love:

Embark on a unique love story with three distinctively different beautiful girls on a vacation island. Through various interactive behaviors and dialogue events, gain the affection of the characters and fall in love. Whether to focus on one character or have multiple relationships depends on the player's choice.

  • Giving gifts: Giving small gifts is the most traditional way to enhance relationships. Players can obtain items through various means and then give them to the characters they admire. They will receive various different feedback dialogues, from which they can figure out which item is the character's favorite.

  • Dining together: Having dinner together with the date is a classic choice in a date. There are up to 24 different sets of dishes available for selection. The characters will also have their own unique understanding of the food, leading to various different conversations.

  • Watching movies: Under the dim screen lights, watching movies together with the person you admire is one of the important choices in dating. Each of the 12 movies brings a different experience to the characters. Listening to the characters' after-viewing thoughts and understanding their preferences can greatly help in enhancing the relationship between you.

  • Visiting Exhibitions: At various art exhibitions, one can not only acquire knowledge from various disciplines, but also engage in discussions with the characters about the exhibits, or have close interactions in front of the installation art, all of which can enhance the characters' favorability towards you.

  • Jointly promoting products: When selling items to passers-by, it is inevitable to encounter rejections. At this point, the date partner can help the player relieve the awkwardness and thereby increase the success rate of the sales. The higher the affection level, the higher the success rate. Therefore, please try your best to enhance the bond between you and the character.

At this point, some special interactions between the couple can be carried out. Please rest assured, the entire process is absolutely proper and there will be no any uncomfortable visual representations.

In addition, the game also includes various small interactive elements such as farming, fishing and cooking, which can help players achieve their goals in all aspects. These will be left to the players to explore and decide whether they need them or not.

If you encounter any bugs during the game, you can find the Bilibili link in the game's basic information and leave a private message. I will do my best to fix them.

Finally, I hope all the players can have a pleasant gaming experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Pretty Girls don't want you to die" is a game that combines strategy tower defense, survivor-like elements, and auto-chess. The game features a variety of resources that can be allocated, upgraded, and crafted according to your preferred tactics.

"Pretty Girls don't want you to die" features numerous pretty girl warriors, whose combat style resembles a turret, attacking at fixed points. However, during battle, players can command the pretty girls to move to designated locations, enhancing flexibility and maneuverability.

As the protagonist, you, the hero. You can gain various buff effects from the pretty girls. Once you are in a critical situation of near-death, the beautiful girl will teleport you out of the battlefield (i.e., the battle is lost).

Career system

Each character has its own combat profession, and can advance to second and third level professions. Special professions such as "Blacksmith", "Alchemist", and "Engineer" can produce various items. Professions like "Strategist", "Merchant", "Bard", and "Priest" each have their unique characteristics.

Equipment system

A wide range of equipment. Sets. Legendary equipment. Legendary sets.

Rich skills, numerous enemies.

"Pretty Girls don't want you to die" features two strategic tower defense modes: full defense and offensive deployment. Each map switches between the two modes.

store_data.about_the_game:
LEWD CONTROL 

Genre: Simulation 

Overview

You play as an ordinary guy starting a new job as a content moderator for a fictional social media platform. Everything happens through your phone messages, apps, decisions. What begins as simple moderation quickly turns into something more personal.

Story

Your supervisor, Emma, is the one who trains you, checks your work, and sets the rules. She’s professional, distant… at first.

As you review posts and handle shifting platform policies, your performance starts to matter, not just to the company, but to Emma. New responsibilities, and subtle changes in tone blur the line between work and something else.

Every choice you make shapes both your career and your relationship with her.

Features

  • Photo Modration with many handdrawn images.

  • Choices influence story and relationships

  • Light rom-com tone

store_data.about_the_game:
🔊 The Moment You Make a Sound, the Zombies Will Come

This is an online co-op survival game for up to 4 players.
You must move through areas filled with zombies that can barely see —
but never miss a sound.

They don’t watch you.
They listen.

🎧 Sound-Driven Survival

  • Running, throwing items, and collisions all generate noise

  • Different materials create different sound ranges and behaviors

  • One well-thrown object can open a path
    One careless sound can bring death

🧟 Zombies with Different Senses

  • Zombies that detect movement

  • Zombies that can always see, but crawl slowly

  • Each type requires a different approach

🩸 Realistic Survival Stats

  • Hunger, weight, and injuries affect your condition

  • These factors reduce your maximum stamina

  • If ignored, the time you can walk or run will keep shrinking

🎒 Scavenging and Condition Management

  • Search buildings for food, bandages, and survival items

  • Use items to manage bleeding, hunger, and fatigue

🚗 Your Goal: Escape

  • Avoid zombies while scavenging essential supplies

  • Repair a broken vehicle and reach the final destination

🔁 A New Map Every Run

  • Levels are procedurally generated

  • No two runs are ever the same

⚠️ Remember

The moment you make a sound, the zombies will come.

store_data.about_the_game:
凡人亦可逆天改命！这是一款深度还原原著的IDLE RPG大作。你将重走韩立的修仙之路，从七玄门的一介凡人，到叱咤三界的韩老魔。集结南宫婉、紫灵等红颜知己，御使噬金虫，炼制掌天瓶。就在此刻，开启你的飞升传说！

【游戏主要特色】

本游戏将带你体验最真实的“修仙时间管理”。核心玩法围绕“挂机收益”与“策略突破”展开。在日常玩法中，你将通过【闯关系统-飞升之路】不断挑战瓶颈，解锁更高的挂机资源倍率。利用碎片时间，你可以参与【玄界巡狩】、【虚天玄关】等原著经典副本，获取真气、元宝与稀有材料。到了晚上，【跨服BOSS】与【宗门斩妖】活动开启，你需要与宗门道友联手，在千人同屏的战场中抢夺BOSS归属权。更有【仙缘系统】，让你在漫漫修仙路上寻得道侣，生儿育女，共证大道。无论是佛系收菜，还是热血PK，这里都有属于你的修仙方式。

【游戏特色玩法】

  • **境界转生体系**

    从炼气筑基到化神炼虚，真实的境界压制。配合【丹药】与【聚灵阵】，体验一步步肉身成圣的快感。

  • **万千法宝策略**

    不仅有青竹蜂云剑、虚天鼎等本命【神兵】，更有【背饰】、【灵宠】（如啼魂兽）、【幻神】变身系统。不同的法宝组合可触发羁绊，针对不同BOSS属性进行五行克制。

  • **深度社交生态**

    【宗门系统】不仅仅是聊天室，更是资源争夺的堡垒。宗门神兽供奉、祭坛夺宝、主宰宝库分配，都需要宗门上下的通力协作。

  • **随机游历奇遇**

    【游历系统】还原修仙界的尔虞我诈，你可能会偶遇机缘获得上古残卷，也可能遭遇仇家截杀，甚至需要花费仙玉“破财免灾”。

  • 📜 **原著经典复刻**

    乱星海、阗天城、落云宗，百万字剧情带你重温韩老魔的成名之战。

  • ⚔️ **千人跨服斗法**

    修罗妖界、跨服BOSS战，体验修仙界残酷的“杀人夺宝”法则。

  • 🧞 **真灵九变系统**

    积蓄能量化身修罗、真龙等上古幻神，瞬间逆转战局。

  • 💕 **双修仙缘羁绊**

    与心仪的TA结为道侣，开启专属副本，培育拥有强力被动技能的子嗣。

You are ICF Officer no. 9496. Who are you? What's your identity? Irrelevant. You are a cog in the machine that is designed to get rid of a curse that plagues humanity. You are an Intensive Care Field Officer or ICF Officer for short.

Talk

Step 1) Talk to the infected about their symptoms and about their emotional state.

Diagnose

And repeat! Simple right?

It better be. Because remember...

Carbonize

store_data.about_the_game:
Analyze defense patterns and charge toward the prison! Prison Breaker is a hybrid puzzle game that combines melodic action with intense memorization challenges, introducing a unique gameplay called Prison Attack.

  • Pure skill-based action with no shortcuts

  • Analyze and memorize the prison's defense patterns

  • Position the polygon and dodge the obstacles with precision

  • Increase the polygon’s sides to multiply damage

  • Create unique melodies at your own pace

  • A ruthless obstacle-bouncing mechanic

  • 20+ exclusive stages in Time Trial Mode

  • Eternal Mode and Ranking System

  • Dodge: Tap or drag to avoid the obstacles and save your attack timing wisely. One solid blow from them sets off a powerful bounce with heavy recoil! Any tap or drag during Super Charge or while bouncing will be queued and carried out after the bounce ends.

  • Charge: Collect Energy, then tap or drag beyond the prison wall and charge to deal damage. After the charge, a control cooldown kicks in due to the recoil.

  • Super Charge: Back off from the wall and unleash Super Charge! It deals massive damage to the prison, but once you commit, it can’t be stopped. As long as the polygon hasn’t reached its max sides, you instantly gain 2 small Energy when dealing damage.

  • Destroy: When the prison's durability is completely depleted, it shatters. Clear the prison as quickly as possible to set a record for the best time!

Eternal Mode is the ultimate challenge reserved for those who have mastered nearly every defense pattern of the prison. Deal as much damage as you can and carve your name into the global leaderboard!

store_data.about_the_game:
A 90s Japanese Horror Experience

In the Japan of the 1990s, in a small town on the outskirts, Emica wakes up after falling asleep at the train station...

As she explores, searching for anyone, she realizes what is engulfing the town... she must solve puzzles and beware of strange creatures to escape.

Is this world real? Or a product of Emica's imagination?

An environment designed to generate terror as you walk, accompanied by puzzles and horror creatures that will stalk you until you are caught.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric 90s Japan Setting: Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world inspired by the twilight of the analog era in rural Japan. From the hum of vending machines to the heavy silence of deserted streets, every detail contributes to a sense of uncanny isolation.

  • Psychological Horror & Uncertainty: A narrative that blurs the line between reality and a crumbling psyche. Are you trapped in a haunted town, or your own mind? The answer remains elusive as you delve deeper.

  • Explore, Solve, Survive: Navigate a tense environment where exploration is key. Solve environmental puzzles integrated into the 90s setting while constantly looking over your shoulder for the creatures that stalk the shadows.

  • Relentless Stalkers: You are not alone. Unsettling creatures born from the anxieties of the era will follow you. There is no fighting, only hiding, outsmarting, and running.

store_data.about_the_game:
A top-down shooting game inspired by various shoot-em-ups and gaming classics.

Long ago, a deity came to the people of the world in their most desperate hour, and granted them Taika, a divine energy. As generations mastered this newfound energy, they discovered many ways through which Taika could grace all life with advancements in a variety of fields, grant longer lives, and push one and all to pursue masterful self-expression...









...









Only a few weeks have passed since the sudden appearance of the phantasm wisps - strange, colorful beings of light, made of the divine energy Taika.









Their source, determined to be somewhere on the Island of Fairies, has started leaking a wild, chaotic Taika. The Fairy Kingdom tried their best to contain the Taika, but ultimately failed. Now, the chaotic Taika takes form in phantasm wisps, and terrorizes those unlucky enough to stumble upon them.









House Vermillion is the head of a kingdom of Hybrids-a mix of man and fairy-and the Fairy Kingdom's closest ally. Now, with the Fairy Kingdom on lockdown, even they find themselves in the dark. King Augustine Vermillion grows uneasy regarding the state of affairs within the Fairy Kingdom, and his son, Nieo, takes notice.









As the eldest of Augustine's children still living on the royal grounds, Prince Nieo Augustine Vermillion, along with his two fairy retainers, Lucia Lavie and Huey Aldenne, set out on their own to the Island of Fairies, in search of the truth!

_____________________________________________________

In this game, you play as Nieo Augustine Vermillion, Lucia Lavie, and Huey Aldenne, making their way towards the Fairy Kingdom's capital city. Dodge waves of bullets in cover shooter + shmup-inspired combat, as you strike back with powerful attacks of your own! Use clever cover spots to gain an advantage over your enemies, find treasures to make yourself stronger, and avoid taking damage to raise your score!
_____________________________________________________

store_data.about_the_game:
Be your own route planner and design routes to ensure passenger and freight trains get to their destinations safely.

Freight trains increase their spilling chances if there are too many tight turns.

If there are dead ends or collisions it's game over.

The game is based on Mini Motorways and Train Valley with my own spin.

Key Features

Draw tracks to route passenger and cargo trains to their destinations that change every game.

Cargo trains have a low tip probability to keep things interesting but routes with several close turns will increase spill likelihood.

Use one fire truck per level to clean up your spills.

Explore maps with mini landmarks inspired by cities from around the world.

Choose from a variety of upgrades to expand your network: bridges, tunnels, bombs, and more.

Black and white noir style to make spills and explosions stand out.

Roadmap

In addition to normal mode, endless and destruction are planned.

At least 12 maps (Paris, NYC, Sydney, Seattle, Rio de Janeiro and more!).

Steam Cloud, Achievements and Leaderboards.

Interface localization for multiple languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grix is a grid-based roguelike set in procedurally generated dungeons.

The player is thrown into an unknown dungeon where all tiles are hidden, and must overcome unseen threats through deduction and choice.

Even without complex controls, you can experience the core addictive appeal of the roguelike genre.

Unknown Dungeons, Prediction Is Survival

All dungeon tiles are hidden at first, and what lies within them cannot be known until you step inside.

Through repeated runs, players learn the game’s rules and begin to predict the placement of enemies, treasures, and safe zones.

In Grix, growth is not only about character stats, but also about the player’s own judgment.

Every Choice Has Consequences

There is never only one way forward.

Will you charge ahead and risk danger?
Will you spend gold to reveal tile information?
Will you dig through walls to create an alternate path?

Every movement produces immediate results, and a single misjudgment can quickly turn into a crisis.

Classic Roguelike Structure and Permadeath

Dungeon layouts, enemy placement, item locations, and starting positions are newly generated each run.

Death resets your progress, but the knowledge and understanding gained through repetition deepen each new attempt.

store_data.about_the_game:
《The Seafloor》— An Interactive Narrative Journey About Depression, Listening, and Coexistence

Game Introduction
《The Seafloor》 is an emotionally immersive interactive narrative game played from a first-person perspective.
You will play as "River", a young girl experiencing depression, and live through seven seemingly ordinary yet internally tumultuous days through her eyes and heart.

Core Gameplay & Experience

  • Immersive Storytelling: Dive deep into the sensory and thought world of depression through rich inner monologues, environmental details, and character dialogues.

  • Crucial Choices: Your every small choice in daily life and social interactions—whether responding to a mother's concern or deciding to go outside—will influence the protagonist's emotional state and the story's direction.

  • Emotion Value System: The game features a subtle "Emotional State" mechanism. Your choices accumulate positive or negative emotional feedback, subtly influencing subsequent plot branches and the final outcome.

  • Multiple Endings: Based on your choices and emotional accumulation during the seven-day journey, the game will lead to two different endings, authentically reflecting the fluctuations and diversity of the recovery path.

Game Content & Features

  • Authentic, Detailed Vignettes of Daily Life: Experience mornings where getting up feels impossible, the cautious care of family, the unintentionally hurtful words of a friend... These real and fragmented life scenes form the emotional foundation of the game.

  • A Rich Cast of Interactive Characters: Encounter and interact with a mother who cares but is at a loss, a well-meaning but clumsy best friend Ali, a wise elderly woman in the park, a silently comforting Bernese Mountain Dog, a professional psychologist, and more.

  • Integration of Psychological Knowledge: Basic psychological knowledge and listening techniques are naturally woven into the game's dialogue and scenario design, aiming to provide an experience of "understanding" rather than "instruction".

  • Audiovisual Atmosphere: Carefully crafted scenes that align with the story's progression create an immersive emotional atmosphere, drawing you closer to the protagonist's inner world.

From the Developer:
I am a psychological listener. By chance, I once made a video about depression and subsequently received many pleas for help. Then I wondered if there was a way to make this kind of support reach more people. So, I began teaching myself basic coding and, with the help of several friends, created this game, 《The Seafloor》.

This is not a traditional "healing" type of work.
It is more like a long letter written to all those walking alone in the emotional night, and also an invitation for you to personally step into and touch those hard-to-describe feelings.

I cannot teach you "how to defeat it" in this game, but I hope to practice "how to coexist with it" together with you—how to recognize those faint yet real glimmers of light in a world washed in grey.
If you happen upon this work, may what you feel here not be instruction, but understanding; not an urging that you "must get better," but a reassurance that "it's okay to pause."

Perhaps what we learn in our lifetime is not how to escape the deep sea, but how to believe that light will still find its way down, even when we have fallen into the depths.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game
Your pirate ship has shattered into splinters—and the sea doesn’t care. Stranded in open water, the only way to survive is to keep moving: leap from object to object across floating wreckage, drifting crates, and whatever else stays above the waves long enough to hold your weight. Every jump is a risk, every landing a relief, and every run a chance to do better.

Whether you’re playing alone or teaming up, your goal is simple: reach safety. How you get there is where the fun begins.

🌐 Online Party with Friends
Jump in with up to 6 players online and turn every run into chaos and laughter. Race side-by-side, recover from bad jumps, and push each other to take faster (and riskier) routes across the debris. It’s quick to pick up, easy to replay, and perfect for party sessions with friends.

🏆 Achievements Hunt
If you love ticking boxes and mastering challenges, there’s plenty to chase. Go for completion, try unusual playstyles, and earn achievements by taking on specific goals and pushing your skills beyond “just surviving.”

⏱️ Time Hunt
Think you’ve found the perfect route? Prove it. Compete for the best times, challenge friends, and refine every movement until your runs become clean, fast, and fearless. One missed jump can ruin a record—so every second counts.

🗺️ Chapters That Keep Getting Tougher
Progress through multiple chapters filled with new setups and surprises. As you advance, stages become more demanding—requiring sharper timing, smarter decision-making, and better control under pressure. The further you go, the more satisfying every successful run becomes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shape the Fate of an Early Society

Lead a prehistoric settlement from its earliest beginnings and guide it through a harsh and unpredictable world. In this pre-historic city-builder and survival simulation, every decision matters — from how resources are gathered and shared to how belief, defense, and social structure shape the fate of your people.

Build and Expand Your Settlement

Design and grow your village with huts, tents, production buildings, and defensive structures. Assign citizens to jobs, manage food and materials, and plan your settlement layout carefully to ensure long-term survival as conditions and challenges evolve.

A Living Citizen Simulation

Your villagers are not just numbers. Each citizen acts autonomously, gathering resources, crafting tools, transporting goods, hunting animals, and defending the settlement. Their behavior is shaped by needs, environment, and the overall state of the village, creating an organic and dynamic simulation.

Belief, Culture, and Order

Survival extends beyond food and shelter. Religious and belief-based systems grant different bonuses and influence how your society develops over time. Early cultural and governance mechanics introduce meaningful choices that affect morale, stability, and settlement identity.

Defend Against a Hostile World

The world is dangerous and unforgiving. Players must prepare for and respond to hostile threats such as raids while balancing expansion and defense. How you organize and protect your people will determine whether the settlement endures or falls.

Interconnected Survival Systems

Built around deeply interconnected systems — survival, resource management, hunting, crafting, farming, and knowledge sharing between citizens — the game rewards long-term planning and thoughtful decision-making over simple optimization.

A brutal crime story in the Russian ’90s

JAGUAR is a hard-hitting narrative action game about a criminal showdown in a provincial town where everyone knows everyone — and disappearing is easy.

A botched escape from an abandoned building triggers a chain reaction: revenge, cleanups, and one last job that turns into open violence.

Fast, deadly combat

Every shot matters. Every mistake is fatal.

  • One-shot lethality[/b] — the fight ends fast, for you and for them.

  • Guns + close-quarters brutality[/b] — finishers, backstabs, improvised weapons, tight corridors.

  • Pressure and momentum[/b] — push forward, break the line, survive the next room.

A place you can get lost

Stairwells, basements, annexes, closed courtyards, and “utility” back areas — the kind of spaces where trouble hides and witnesses don’t talk.

You don’t run from this

You either make it out — or you leave nothing behind.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nowhere Highway is an atmospheric single-player Survival FPS set one year after a global catastrophe. An underground energy pulse of incredible power scorched nearly the entire surface of the planet. Only isolated patches of land were spared, and for unknown reasons, all of them are located along an old mountain highway that once connected small towns far from major cities. You will embark on a dangerous journey, exploring the post-apocalyptic world on foot and by car, discovering locations that still hold the remnants of a lost civilization.

Interaction with the World

Every action in the game has a cost, every decision has consequences, and a single problem may have multiple solutions. You choose your own survival strategy and character development path, while a random event system makes each playthrough unique, adding an element of unpredictability. You don't just exist in this world; you constantly interact with it, and it reacts to you.

True Freedom of Exploration

One of the core rules of the game is simple: if you see a door, you can go through it. From lonely roadside diners to apartment buildings in abandoned ghost towns, every structure is open for exploration. Items lie exactly where their owners left them on their last ordinary day. Every interior tells a silent story of the people who once lived there. There is no meaningless, randomly scattered loot. The world is logical and believable, meaning an attentive explorer will always be rewarded.

Character Development

Adaptability is the key to survival. The world changed after the catastrophe, and to survive, you will have to change too. The game offers a diverse character development system that allows you to grow to suit your chosen playstyle. There are no magical skill trees. Instead, you must find books to gain knowledge, use exercise equipment in abandoned homes, and hone specific skills to unlock new interactions with the environment.

Hardcore Survival

The game won't hold your hand: there are no navigation markers, quest indicators, or pop-up hints. Your main tools are observation and the ability to plan ahead. You'll need to explore this world on your own, learn its rules, and face the consequences of your decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
⚔️ Escape the Cursed Dynasty Tower

A conspiracy spanning an entire era has swallowed you whole. You awaken trapped in an endless tower shrouded in darkness, where the spirits of the Three Kingdoms are sealed. There is no time to hesitate—assemble your legion, utilize wisdom and strategy, and escape this devouring tower!

♟️ Core Gameplay: Lane Pushing × Deckbuilding × Strategy

This is not a traditional grid-based tactics game, but a war of macro-management. We have perfectly fused Roguelike Deckbuilding with Turn-Based Auto-Battler lane mechanics:

⏳ The "Deployment Timer" Mechanic
Cards in your hand are not instant-cast. Each card has a [Wait Value] that decreases each turn. Do you wait for a powerful General to finish their countdown, or flood the board with low-cost Vanguards? The tempo is in your hands.

⚔️ 3×10 Battlefield & Auto-Charge
The battlefield is divided into Left (You) and Right (Enemy). You do not control individual unit movement. You are the Warlord, orchestrating from behind.

  • Deployment Strategy: Drag cards into the 3×3 Zone in front of your Warlord.

  • Auto-Advance: Once deployed, units automatically charge forward based on their class (e.g., Infantry advances steadily, Cavalry rushes gaps).

  • Lane Tactics: Use flying units to bypass tanks, or cavalry to flank empty lanes. Every placement determines the push of the battle line.

🍶 Deep Customization: The Power of "Wine"

Break away from fixed meta-builds using a unique item system to craft your exclusive hero cards:

🍷 Grant Wine (Equipable Skills)
"Wine" is not just a consumable—it is removable skill equipment! You can grant any Soldier Card a specific Wine to imbue them with special effects (e.g., Lifesteal, Splash Damage, Multi-strike).

  • Want a Shieldbearer with Lifesteal? Or an Archer with Splash Damage? It’s all up to your imagination!

📜 Art of War (Global Auras)
Equip your Warlord with ancient Art of War scrolls to provide passive buffs or global auras to your entire army, fundamentally changing your tactical style.

  • The Black Market: Carefully manage your resources in the shop on each floor. Budgeting is the key to survival.

store_data.about_the_game:
EVEN ANGELS BLEED

Reclaim the fallen city of Gildenarch in this gothic, high renaissance action-adventure RPG.

In Crimson Moon, you embody the form of a Nephilim. A violent half-human, half-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity from hell using supernatural powers, weapons, and melee combat abilities.

Over the course of savage, replayable runs you’ll slay your way through an ever-evolving horde of demons, undead, vampires, and Hellgrowth abominations in visceral souls-inspired melee combat, culminating in brutal boss encounters with the fabled Dead Gods.

Whether you crusade alone or slay together in two-player co-op, the prophecy is yours to fulfill. So rise, violent one. And hail the Order of the Crimson Moon.

IMMERSE YOURSELF IN BRUTAL ELEGANCE

Save Gildenarch by venturing through every district and ward, each more hauntingly beautiful and hellish than the last. This is a world that remembers, reshapes, and pushes back, without demanding punishing repetition. 

 

BLOODSOAKED COMBAT

Fight demons, undead, vampires, and Hellgrowth abominations with adept seraphim vengeance and visceral executions unique to each enemy type. This is a game for those who thrive on improvisational and expressive combat.

 

CRUSADE ALONE OR SLAY TOGETHER

Your ally is your amplifier. Share lives, resurrect the fallen, and unlock synergies through optional co-op mode. Dynamic difficulty scaling and enemy composition ensures every mission feels fresh and personal.

 

HIGH RISK, HIGH REWARD MISSIONS

Every run is a ritual of transformation and resistance, with each triumph earning you new missions, modifiers, and skill achievements.

UNLEASH THE POWER OF ANGELIC TRANSFORMATION

Wreak holy havoc with evolving Nephilim powers that bestow temporary abilities and divinely devastating attacks.

FIND REPRIEVE IN REVERENT SPLENDOR

In between runs, return to the headquarters of the Church, your home base for permanent upgrades and NPC interactions. When ready, survey the city and plan your next mission via the War Table.

DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.

DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

Treat every suitcase like a loot box from a fever dream. You’ll find definitely-not-illegal things hidden in most unexpected places. It’s messy, it’s nosy, and it’s definetely glorious.

FLEX YOUR AIRPORT AUTHORITY

You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.

FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.

FEATURES

  • An airport where you must ensure total security

  • Crowds of impatient passengers

  • Contraband in suitcases

  • A cute little dog

  • A stun gun

  • Name badges

  • The fate of vacations is in your hands

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, expand, and destroy. In this card strategy game, you're not just surviving — you're fighting a war. Collect poker combinations to develop the settlement, manage individual decks of Outposts to contain the threat, and use powerful artifacts. Your goal is to completely clear the map of monsters.

BUILD AN IMPREGNABLE FORTRESS

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.

THE GOAL: TOTAL EXTERMINATION

In most games, you hide from monsters. Here you go for them. Your task is not to last N days, but to destroy the entire population of monsters.

Build up your military power, send troops on raids and clear the map sector by sector. But remember: if the monsters break through the Outpost line, your capital will fall.
